text: We want the nation to heal.
english: We want the nation to heal.

text: We want to forgive.
english: We want to forgive.

text:
Pero kun indi ka sinsero, excuse me!”

Ang konteksto sang homily ni Oso amo ang isa sa mga kinaiya ni Hesukristo nga amo ang pagpatawad sa mga sinsero nga nagahinulsol sa ila mga sala.
english:
But if you're not sincere, excuse me!”

The context of Oso's homily is that one of the characteristics of Jesus Christ is to forgive those who sincerely repent of their sins.

text: Subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 23, ginaselebrar sang Kristyano nga Katilingban ang Feast of Christ the King.#
english: Today, November 23, the Christian Community celebrates the Feast of Christ the King.#

text: Kun kahapon, ginbantayan sang basketball fans kun masulit ang isa na naman ka makahuluya nga sweep nga amo ang magapalayas sa Los Angeles Lakers sa Western Conference playoffs, subong nga adlaw, nakasentro ang atensyon sang tanan sa 2014 MVP nga si Kevin Durant kag sa team sini nga Phoenix Suns.
english: If yesterday, basketball fans were watching to see if another embarrassing sweep would repeat itself that would knock the Los Angeles Lakers out of the Western Conference playoffs, today, everyone's attention is focused on 2014 MVP Kevin Durant and his team, the Phoenix Suns.

text: Nagahimumugto man ang Suns sa Western Conference matapos nalubong sa 3-0 deficit sa best-of-seven series batok sa Minnesota Timberwolves.
english: The Suns are also stuck in the Western Conference after being buried in a 3-0 deficit in the best-of-seven series against the Minnesota Timberwolves.

text: 9:30 subong nga aga (oras sa Pilipinas) balantayan ang Game 4 nga patigayunon sa Footprint Center sa Phoenix, Arizona nga home court sang Suns.
english: 9:30 this morning (Philippine time) watch Game 4 to be played at the Footprint Center in Phoenix, Arizona, the home court of the Suns.

text: Matandaan nga nagtapos sa 126-109 ang hampang sang duha ka teams sang nagligad nga Sabado.
english: It can be recalled that the game between the two teams ended 126-109 last Saturday.

text: Kahapon, amo man sini ang sitwasyon nanday four-time NBA Champion Lebron James kag Los Angeles Lakers apang natigayon nila nga makabangon kag matuldukan ang 11-winning streak sang defending champions nga Denver Nuggets.
english: Yesterday, the situation was similar for four-time NBA Champion Lebron James and the Los Angeles Lakers but they managed to get up and end the 11-win streak of the defending champions Denver Nuggets.

text: Balantayan naman ang Game 5 sang Nuggets kag Lakers buwas,10:00 sa aga, oras sa Pilipinas.#
english: Watch Game 5 of the Nuggets and Lakers tomorrow, 10:00 am, Philippine time.

text: Nakit-an sang industry group nga amat-amat na nga nag-improve ang size sang itlog bangud sa pagbugnaw sang tyempo sa pungsod.
english: The industry group found that the size of the eggs has gradually improved due to the cooling weather in the country.

text: Suno kay Egg Board president Francis Uyehura, kun amo sini ang panahon, nagataas ang feed intake sang mga manok indi kaangay sang summer nga wala sila sang gana nga magkaon rason nga nagagamay man ang mga itlog.
english: According to Egg Board president Francis Uyehura, when this is the weather, the feed intake of chickens increases unlike in summer when they have no appetite to eat which is why the eggs are also smaller.

text: “Malaki po ang improvement sa pagtaas ng feed intake pag ganitong panahon, malayong-malayo sa sobrang init na wala talagang gana kumain ang mga manok.
english: “There is a big improvement in the increase in feed intake in this weather, far from the extreme heat that the chickens do not really want to eat.

text: Parang tao lang din na pag mainit, mahina kumain; ‘pag malamig, mas malakas kumain,” pahayag ni Uyehera.
english: It's like a human being who eats weakly when it's hot; ‘when it’s cold, it eats harder,” Uyehera said.

text: Pahayag pa sini, kun nagadaku ang size sang itlog, mapa-taas-taasan man sang egg farmers ang presyo.
english: He said that if the size of the egg increases, the egg farmers will also increase the price.

text: “Ang nararamdaman po nating pagtaas ng presyo ay pagbalik lamang po sa tamang presyuhan galing sa napakakababang presyo noong summer season,” dugang sini.
english: “The price increase we are feeling is just a return to the right price from the very low price last summer season,” he added.

text: Ginapanan-aw nga magasaka ang demand sa itlog sa masunod nga mga binulan apang bastante suno sa iya ang suplay sini sa Pilipinas: “Ongoing po yung pagdadag [ng manok] ng ating farmers in preparation po towards the holidays at the end of this year.”
english: Demand for eggs is expected to rise in the coming months but he said the supply of eggs in the Philippines is sufficient: “Ongoing po yung pagdadag [of chickens] ng ating farmers in preparation po towards the holidays at the end of this year.”

text: Ginklaro sang National Economic Development Authority (NEDA) nga wala ini sang intensyon nga limitahan ang pagsulod sang Chinese investors kag mga turista sa Pilipinas apisar pa sang mas nagasingkal pa nga tensyon sa tunga sang Beijing kag Manila sa isyu sang West Philippine Sea.
english: The National Economic Development Authority (NEDA) has clarified that it has no intention of restricting the entry of Chinese investors and tourists to the Philippines despite the escalating tensions between Beijing and Manila over the West Philippine Sea issue.

text: Suno kay Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Arsenio Balisacana, bukas gihapon ang pungsod sa anuman nga nasyon nga gusto mag-invest.
english: According to Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Arsenio Balisacana, the country is still open to any country that wants to invest.

text: “We have no intention of restricting investments or tourists from China.
english: “We have no intention of restricting investments or tourists from China.

text: Everyone is open to come to the country as investors or as tourists,” suno sa tiglikom.
english: Everyone is open to come to the country as investors or as tourists,” the secretary said.

text: Sa record sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), nagalab-ot sa $1.89 million ukon P111.35-million ang Chinese foreign direct investments sa Pilipinas sa una nga quarter sang 2024 nga may pagnubo nga 73.24 percent halin sa $7-million ukon P412.41-million nga kontribusyon sini sa una nga tatlo ka bulan sang 2023.
english: According to the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), Chinese foreign direct investments in the Philippines amounted to $1.89 million or P111.35-million in the first quarter of 2024, a decrease of 73.24 percent from $7-million or P412.41-million in the first three months of its contribution. 2023.

text: Ginpahayag ni Balisacan nga bisan may nakit-an nga pagnubo sa Chinese investments sa Pilipinas, indi ini direkta nga maangot sa away sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Balisacan said that although there is a decrease in Chinese investments in the Philippines, it is not directly linked to the dispute in the West Philippine Sea.

text: May iban pa nga rason nga nagaapekto sa world trade kag economy suno sa tiglikom kaangay sang giyera sa Gaza kag sa Ukraine.
english: There are other factors affecting world trade and economy, the secretary said, such as the war in Gaza and Ukraine.

text: “Nobody is spared from these global and regional tensions.
english: “No one is spared from these global and regional tensions.

text: Our global performance could have been admittedly better if the global trade has been more favorable than it is,” paathag ni Balisacan.
english: Our global performance could have been admittedly better if the global trade has been more favorable than it is,” Balisacan explained.

text: Suno naman sa data sang Department of Tourism (DOT), halin sang Enero-Mayo subong nga tuig, yara sa 168,628 Chinese tourists ang nakasulod sa Pilipinas.
english: According to the Department of Tourism (DOT), from January-May this year, 168,628 Chinese tourists entered the Philippines.

text: Katumbas ini sang 6.56 percent sang tourist arrivals sa una nga lima ka bulan sa 2024 nga mas manubo sa 682,362 South Koreans (26.56 percent) kag 403,721 Americans (15.71 percent) nga nakapadulong sa Pilipinas sa amo man nga period.
english: This is equivalent to 6.56 percent of tourist arrivals in the first five months of 2024, which is lower than the 682,362 South Koreans (26.56 percent) and 403,721 Americans (15.71 percent) who visited the Philippines in the same period.

text: Apisar sang ginsuprer nga injury kag penalty, nag-qualify ang Pinay fencer nga si Samantha Catantan sa Paris Olympics.
english: Despite suffering an injury and penalty, Filipino fencer Samantha Catantan qualified for the Paris Olympics.

text: Nagpangibabaw siya sa women’s foil category sa Asia-Oceania Zonal Olympic Qualifier sa Fujairah, United Arab Emirates matapos nga ginlutos si Sofiya Aktayeva sang Kazakhstan, 15-14, sa final round.
english: She dominated the women’s foil category at the Asia-Oceania Zonal Olympic Qualifier in Fujairah, United Arab Emirates after defeating Sofiya Aktayeva of Kazakhstan, 15-14, in the final round.

text: Siya man ang labing-una nga fencer sa Pilipinas nga maga-compete sa Olympiada matapos ang masobra tatlo ka dekada halin sang nagpasakop man anay si Walter Torres sa 1992 Barcelona Games.
english: He is also the first fencer in the Philippines to compete in the Olympics after more than three decades since Walter Torres also participated in the 1992 Barcelona Games.

text: Sa third and final round, nakaangkon pa ang Pinay sang one-point penalty bangud sang red card halin sa referee.
english: In the third and final round, the Filipina received a one-point penalty due to a red card from the referee.

text: Apang nagbawi ang 22-anyos nga fencer kag nag-skor sang apat sa masunod nga lima ka puntos agud mapatas ang skor sa 13-13.
english: But the 22-year-old fencer recovered and scored four of the next five points to tie the score at 13-13.

text: Indi nangin mahapos ang masunod nga natabo bangud sa injury sa wala nga tuhod ni Catantan nga amo man anay ang iya nga na-injure sa gold-medal match sa Southeast Asian Games sa Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
english: What happened next was not easy because of the injury to Catantan's left knee, which he had previously injured in the gold-medal match at the Southeast Asian Games in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

text: Sa SEA Games, nag-surrender si Catantan rason nga nagbulsa lamang sang silver, apang subong, tuman ang determinasyon sini nga makatapak sa Olympiada gani may ginhingyo lamang nga lima ka minutos nga injury timeout antes ginpadayon.
english: At the SEA Games, Catantan surrendered and only pocketed silver, but now, he is so determined to enter the Olympiada that he only asked for a five-minute injury timeout before continuing.

text: Matapos ang duha ka traded points sa 14-14 tie, nakuha ni Catantan ang final point nga amo ang nakahatag sa iya sang ticket sa Paris.
english: After two traded points in a 14-14 tie, Catantan earned the final point that earned him a ticket to Paris.

text: Wala man sini napunggan nga magluhod kag maghilibion samtang ginatabunan ang iya nawong kasunod sang kadalag-an.
english: It didn't stop him from kneeling and crying while covering his face following the victory.

text: Nahibaluan nga 13 ka iban pa nga fencers nga naga-compete para sa isahanon nga Olympic spot ang ginlutos ni Catantan sa women’s foil.
english: Catantan defeated 13 other fencers competing for the sole Olympic spot in the women's foil.

text: Paga-updan ni Catantan sa Paris Games ang 11 ka iban pa nga Pinoy nga una na nag-qualify para sa amo nga hinampang.
english: Catantan will be joined at the Paris Games by 11 other Filipinos who have already qualified for the games.

text: Nagdangat sa P158,000 ang estimated nga balor sang halit nga ginbilin sang sunog nga nagluntad sa sulod sang Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U).
english: The estimated value of the damage caused by the fire that broke out inside the Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U) reached P158,000.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Senior Fire Officer 1 Denmark B. Macoco, acting chief sang Investigation and Intelligence Unit sang Iloilo City Fire Station, iya ginpahayag nga tatlo ka mga hulot sa buluthuan ang apektado.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Senior Fire Officer 1 Denmark B. Macoco, acting chief of the Investigation and Intelligence Unit of the Iloilo City Fire Station, said three rooms in the school were affected.

text: Ini amo ang Cultural Office, Physical Education room, Faculty Office kag nalakip man ang marching band room.
english: These are the Cultural Office, Physical Education room, Faculty Office and also include the marching band room.

text: Pahayag sini, mahimo pa maglain ang balor sang halit kun magpasa ang eskwelahan sang affidavit of fire loss nga amo man ang iga-deklarar sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).
english: He said the value of the damage could increase if the school submits an affidavit of fire loss which will also be declared by the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).

text: Wala naman sang na-rekord nga nasamaran kasunod sang insidente nga nagluntad pasado alas nueve sa aga kaina, kag napalong pasado alas dies.
english: No injuries were recorded following the incident, which occurred around 9 am yesterday, and was extinguished around 10 am.

text: Padayon pa nga gina-imbestigaran sang BFP ang rason sang fire incident.
english: The fire brigade is still investigating the cause of the fire incident.

text: Nagpahanumdom naman ang BFP official sa publiko ilabi na sa mga magabisita sa patyo kadungan sang Undas nga i-check gid sang maayo ang mga appliances, kag i-unplug, i-switch off, ukon i-shut down ang kuryente antes maghalin sa balay.
english: The BFP official reminded the public especially those who will visit the cemetery during Undas to check their appliances carefully, and unplug, switch off, or shut down the electricity before leaving their homes.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini nga indi pagbayaan ang mga nakasindi nga kandila nga amo man ang masami nga ginahalinan sang kalayo.
english: He also urged people not to leave lit candles which are also a frequent source of fire.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes sa ISAT-U, may duha pa ka sunod-sunod nga sunog nga nagluntad sa Iloilo City kagab-i partikular sa Veteran’s Village sa City Proper kag sa Barangay Calaparan sa Arevalo.#
english: Before the ISAT-U, there were two consecutive fires in Iloilo City last night particularly in the Veteran's Village in City Proper and in Barangay Calaparan in Arevalo.

text: Inihayag ng kampo ng nagbtitw na si dating Ako Bicol Party List Representative Zaldy Co na gagawa ito ng legal remedy sa tamang panahon laban sa arrest warrant sa kaniya at posibleng panibagong isampang kaso ng graft at plunder kaugnay sa pagkakadawit niya sa umano’y korapsiyon sa flood control projects.
english: The camp of former Ako Bicol Party List Representative Zaldy Co said it will take legal remedy in due course against the arrest warrant against him and possibly re-file a case of graft and plunder in connection with his involvement in alleged corruption in flood control projects.

text: Paliwanag ng kaniyang abogado na si Atty. Ruy Rondain na sa ngayon, naniniwala silang susundin ang regular procedures sa pagsisilbi ng arrest warrant kayat gagawa sila ng legal na remedyo sa tamang panahon.
english: His lawyer, Atty. Ruy Rondain said that for now, they believe that the regular procedures in serving the arrest warrant will be followed so they will take legal remedies in due course.

text: Bumwelo din sa pagsagot ang abogado sa rekomendasyon ng Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) na maghain ng mga kasong plunder at graft laban kina Co at dating House Speaker Martin Romualdez hangga’t maberipika nila ang katotohanan.
english: The lawyer also responded to the recommendation of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to file plunder and graft cases against Co and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez until they verify the facts.

text: Matatandaan, nitong Biyernes, inanunsiyo ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: It can be recalled that on Friday, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: na inirekomenda ng DPWH at Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) ang pagusig kina Co at Romualdez para sa posibleng kaugnayan nila sa maanomaliyang flood control projects.
english: that the DPWH and Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) recommended the prosecution of Co and Romualdez for their possible involvement in anomalous flood control projects.

text: Nauna ng nakaladkad ang pangalan nina Co at Romualdez sa kontrobersiya matapos silang pangalanan ng iniharap na testigo ni Senator Rodante Marcoleta sa pagdinig noon ng Senate Blue Ribbon Committee na si Orly Guteza, na nakatanggap umano sila ng male-maletang naglalaman ng cash bilang kickbacks mula sa naturang mga proyekto.
english: Co and Romualdez's names were earlier dragged into controversy after they were named by Senator Rodante Marcoleta as a witness in the hearing of Senate Blue Ribbon Committee Orly Guteza, who allegedly received suitcases containing cash as kickbacks from projects.

text: Isang 15-anyos na Grade 11 student ang sugatan matapos saksakin ng kapwa estudyante sa loob ng paaralan, matapos umanong matakot ang batang suspek na hindi niya kayang tapatan sa suntukan ang biktima.
english: A 15-year-old Grade 11 student was injured after being stabbed by a fellow student inside the school, after the young suspect was afraid that he could not punch the victim.

text: Kinilala ang biktima sa alyas na “Toto”, isang estudyante sa San Joaquin School of Fisheries.
english: The victim was identified as “Toto”, a student of the San Joaquin School of Fisheries.

text: Ayon kay Police Captain Chrysler Jhon Ledesma, hepe ng San Joaquin Municipal Police Station, nagwawalis umano sa garden si Toto nang lapitan ng 13-anyos na suspek na tinuturing umanong “bully” sa paaralan.
english: According to Police Captain Chrysler Jhon Ledesma, chief of the San Joaquin Municipal Police Station, Toto was sweeping the garden when he was approached by a 13-year-old suspect who is allegedly a bully at the school.

text: Nagkaroon umano ng mainitang pagtatalo ang dalawa na nauwi sa suntukan.
english: The two allegedly had a heated argument that ended in a fight.

text: Dahil mas malaki umano ang biktima, posibleng naisip ng suspek na hindi siya uubra, kaya habang nagtutunggali sila ay bigla na lamang niyang sinaksak si Toto gamit ang kutsilyong dala niya sa kanyang bag.
english: Because the victim was older, the suspect may have thought that he would not work, so while they were fighting, he suddenly stabbed Toto with the knife he was carrying in his bag.

text: Tinamaan sa ibabang bahagi ng tiyan si Toto at agad isinugod sa ospital.
english: Toto was hit in the lower abdomen and was rushed to the hospital.

text: Kalaunan ay inilipat siya sa isang ospital sa Iloilo City para sa mas masusing gamutan.
english: He was later transferred to a hospital in Iloilo City for further treatment.

text: Nasa pangangalaga ngayon ng Women and Children’s Protection Desk (WCPD) ang menor-de-edad na suspek habang nagpapatuloy ang imbestigasyon.
english: The minor suspect is now in the care of the Women and Children's Protection Desk (WCPD) while the investigation continues.

text: Ayon pa sa pulisya, hindi na-inspeksyon ang bag ng bata sa pagpasok sa paaralan dahil abala ang school guard sa pagtulong sa mga tumatawid na estudyante sa highway.
english: According to police, the child's bag was not inspected upon entering the school because the school guard was busy helping students crossing the highway.

text: Samantala, kinumpirma ng Schools Division of Iloilo ng Department of Education (DepEd) na naganap ang insidente noong Hulyo 2, habang abala ang mga Grade 10 students sa paglilinis ng garden at dumating ang ilang Grade 9 learners, kung saan nagsimula ang gulo.
english: Meanwhile, the Schools Division of Iloilo of the Department of Education (DepEd) confirmed that the incident occurred on July 2, while the Grade 10 students were busy cleaning the garden and some Grade 9 learners arrived, where the chaos began.

text: Ayon kay DepEd-Iloilo spokesperson Leonil Salvilla, agad silang nakatanggap ng ulat mula sa paaralan at nagtulungan na ang San Joaquin Municipal Police at Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) para masigurong naipapatupad ang Child Protection Policy ng DepEd.
english: According to DepEd-Iloilo spokesperson Leonil Salvilla, they immediately received a report from the school and the San Joaquin Municipal Police and Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) have already helped to ensure the implementation of the Child Protection Policy of DepEd.

text: Ipinabatid ni Schools Division Superintendent Dr. Ernesto Servillon na agad silang nagpadala ng psychosocial support, nagpatupad ng Alternative Delivery Modes (ADM) para hindi maapektuhan ang pag-aaral, at pinaiigting na rin ang seguridad sa paaralan.
english: Schools Division Superintendent Dr. Ernesto Servillon said they immediately sent psychosocial support, implemented Alternative Delivery Modes (ADM) to avoid affecting learning, and tightened security at the school.

text: Nagsagawa rin ng general assembly ang pamunuan ng eskwelahan kasama ang mga magulang sa ilalim ng PTA upang ipaalala ang school rules at palakasin ang kampanya kontra bullying at karahasang pampaaralan.
english: The school administration also held a general assembly with parents under the PTA to remind school rules and strengthen the campaign against bullying and violence in schools.

text: Nagpirma sa statement ang masobra 30 ka Filipino-Chinese business groups agud magpanawagan sang malinong nga paga-resolba sa tensyon sa West Philippine Sea.
english: More than 30 Filipino-Chinese business groups signed the statement calling for a peaceful resolution of tensions in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Kasunod ini sang pagbangga sang China Coast Guard sa mga sakayan sang Pilipinas kadungan sang rotation and reprovision (RORE) mission sa Ayungin Shoal sang nagligad nga Lunes, Hunyo 17.
english: This follows the collision of the China Coast Guard with Philippine vessels during the rotation and reprovision (RORE) mission in Ayungin Shoal last Monday, June 17.

text: Sa sini nga statement, 33 ka Filipino-Chinese chambers sang commerce kag civic organizations ang nag-apelar sa gobyerno sang Pilipinas nga ikonsiderar ang banas nga magapasigurado sang kalinong, katawhayan, kag safety sang duha ka mga nasyon kag mga pumuluyo sini.
english: In this statement, 33 Filipino-Chinese chambers of commerce and civic organizations appealed to the Philippine government to consider a path that will ensure peace, stability, and safety of the two countries and their peoples.

text: “Instead of strife, let us choose harmony.
english: “Instead of strife, let us choose harmony.

text: Instead of conflict, let us choose stability.
english: Instead of conflict, let us choose stability.

text: In these tumultuous times, with rising tensions in other parts of the world, let us not risk the unity that has prevailed in our Asian region for hundreds of years,” kabahin sang statement.
english: In these tumultuous times, with rising tensions in other parts of the world, let us not risk the unity that has prevailed in our Asian region for hundreds of years,” the statement said.

text: Ginsiling man sang mga grupo nga madugay na nga mga henerasyon ang ginlawig sang Filipino-Chinese cultural and economic ties.
english: The groups also said that Filipino-Chinese cultural and economic ties have lasted for generations.

text: “Together we endured the trials of World War II and remained allies in many ways.
english: “Together we endured the trials of World War II and remained allies in many ways.

text: Our nations have consistently showcased the manifold benefits of mutual respect.
english: Our nations have consistently showcased the manifold benefits of mutual respect.

text:
As such, we implore both sides to refrain from actions or declarations that will only fuel the already precarious situation.”

Ginpanawagan man ang pagtukod sang neutral kag diplomatic venue para sa diskusyon nga magatib-ong sang mutual respect para sa Pilipinas kag China.
english:
As such, we implore both sides to refrain from actions or declarations that will only fuel the already precarious situation.”

It also called for the establishment of a neutral and diplomatic venue for discussions that will promote mutual respect for the Philippines and China.

text: “We firmly believe that only through constructive dialogue, devoid of reproach and condemnation, are we to find common ground that will lead to an amicable resolution of our differences,” dugang diri.
english: “We firmly believe that only through constructive dialogue, devoid of reproach and condemnation, are we to find common ground that will lead to an amicable resolution of our differences,” it added.

text: Lakip sa signatories amo ang Federation of Filipino-Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Chinese Filipino Business Club, Hong Kong Chamber of Commerce of the Philippines, kag ang Filipino-Chinese Youth Business Association.
english: Among the signatories are the Federation of Filipino-Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Chinese Filipino Business Club, Hong Kong Chamber of Commerce of the Philippines, and the Filipino-Chinese Youth Business Association.

text: Balantayan ang Filipino-American singer nga si Olivia Rodrigo sa 66th Grammy Awards ukon ang ginakabig nga “highest honors” sa patag sang musika sa bilog nga kalibutan!
english: Watch Filipino-American singer Olivia Rodrigo at the 66th Grammy Awards or the highest honors in the world of music!

text:
Photo: Rodrigo/IG

Pareho kanday Taylor Swift, Billie Eilish, kag Miley Cyrus, may anum man ka nominations si Olivia para sa amo nga prestihiyoso nga seremonya.
english:
Photo: Rodrigo/IG

Like Taylor Swift, Billie Eilish, and Miley Cyrus, Olivia also has six nominations for such a prestigious ceremony.

text:
Ini amo ang mga masunod:

* Album of the Year (“GUTS”)

* Song of the Year (“vampire”)

* Record of the Year (“vampire”)

* Best Pop Solo Performance (“vampire”)

* Best Pop Vocal Album (“GUTS”)

* Best Rock Song (“ballad of a homeschooled girl”)

Matandaan nga sang 2022, ginbulsa ni Olivia ang Best Pop Solo Performance para sa ‘drivers license’; Best Pop Vocal Album para sa “Sour”; kag ang Best New Artist award.
english:
These are as follows:

* Album of the Year (“GUTS”)

* Song of the Year (“vampire”)

* Record of the Year (“vampire”)

* Best Pop Solo Performance (“vampire”)

* Best Pop Vocal Album (“GUTS”)

* Best Rock Song (“ballad of a homeschooled girl”)

It can be recalled that in 2022, Olivia pocketed the Best Pop Solo Performance for ‘drivers license’; Best Pop Vocal Album for “Sour”; and the Best New Artist award.

text: Para sa 2024 nga Grammys, patigayunon ang seremonya sa Pebrero 4 sa Los Angeles.#
english: For the 2024 Grammys, the ceremony will be held on February 4 in Los Angeles.#

text: Ginlibot ni Police Regional Office (PRO-6) Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan ang major transport terminals kag mga patyo sa Iloilo kadungan sang bisperas sang Undas.
english: Police Regional Office (PRO-6) Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan toured major transport terminals and courtyards in Iloilo on the eve of Undas.

text: Lakip sa iya ginkadtuan amo ang Parola Wharf, Tanza Public Cemetery, Molo Public Cemetery kag Forest Lake Memorial Parks.
english: Among the places he visited were Parola Wharf, Tanza Public Cemetery, Molo Public Cemetery and Forest Lake Memorial Parks.

text: Ginbisita man sini ang Mohon Ceres Terminal kag Ceres Terminal sa Camalig, Jaro; kag ang Dumangas Port sa Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: He also visited Mohon Ceres Terminal and Ceres Terminal in Camalig, Jaro; and the Dumangas Port in Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Tuyo sini nga ma-check ang police deployment agud masigurado ang safety sang publiko samtang naga-sinako ang tanan para sa obserbasyon sang tigkalalag.
english: The purpose of this is to check the police deployment to ensure the safety of the public while everyone is busy for the observation of the tigkalalag.

text: Nagsaka man ang director sa mga bus kag naghatag sang mga pahanumdom kag safety tips sa mga driver kag mga pasahero.
english: The director also climbed aboard buses and gave reminders and safety tips to drivers and passengers.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ligan, iya ginpahayag under control ang security measures sandig sa iya nga assessment kag nakit-an may nga mataas ang police visibility sa convergence areas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ligan said the security measures are under control based on his assessment and found that there is high police visibility in the convergence areas.

text: Ginmensyonar man sini ang kooperasyon sang local government units kag transport operators nga nakabulig sa mga byahero.
english: He also mentioned the cooperation of local government units and transport operators that helped the passengers.

text: Nagpahanumdom ini sa mga pulis nga naka-deploy nga indi lang magpungko kundi mag-assist gid sa mga pasahero kag pati sa parking agud malikawan ang mga inaway ilabi na nga nagadali ang tanan.
english: He reminded the policemen deployed not only to sit but also to assist passengers and also in parking to avoid fights especially when everyone is in a hurry.

text: Halos 4,000 ka mga uniformed personnel ang iga-deploy sa bilog nga Western Visayas kadungan sang Undas lakip na ang masobra 2,700 ka nga kapulisan.#
english: Nearly 4,000 uniformed personnel will be deployed throughout Western Visayas during Undas including more than 2,700 policemen.

text: Wala sang tawo nga naabtanh sa condominium unit ni anay Congressman Zaldy Co sa Bonifacio Global City (BGC), Taguig sang ginserbe sang kapulisan ang warrant of arrest batok sa iya subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 22.
english: No one was found at the condominium unit of former Congressman Zaldy Co in Bonifacio Global City (BGC), Taguig when the police served the warrant of arrest against him today, November 22.

text: Ginkadtuan sang mga personell sang Southern Police District kag Taguig Police Station ang amo nga condo sang anay kongresista para iserbe ang warrant apang suno sa caretakers, halos isa na kabulan nga selyado ang amo nga unit.
english: Personnel of the Southern Police District and Taguig Police Station went to the condo of the former congressman to serve the warrant but according to the caretakers, the unit has been sealed for almost a month.

text: Wala man sang mga himata nga nag-atubang sang gintuktok sang mga awtoridad ang pwertahan sang condo unit.
english: No relatives came forward when authorities knocked on the door of the condo unit.

text: Matandaan nga nauna na gin-isyu ang warrant of arrest sa anay kongresista kag sa iban pa nga nakabaton sang ginapahayag nga kickbacks halin sa flood control projects.
english: It can be recalled that a warrant of arrest was earlier issued against the former congressman and others who received alleged kickbacks from flood control projects.

text: Ginlubong na ang Hollywood actor nga si Matthew Perry sa Los Angeles cemetery kasunod sang funeral service nga gintambungan sang iya mga himata kag castmates halin sa 1990s television sitcom nga “Friends.
english: Hollywood actor Matthew Perry has been laid to rest in a Los Angeles cemetery following a funeral service attended by his relatives and castmates from the 1990s television sitcom “Friends.

text: Gindala si Perry, kilala nga Chandler Bing, sa Forest Lawn cemetery sa Hollywood Hills neighborhood sang Los Angeles nga malapit lamang sa Warner Brothers studio kun sa diin gin-film ang hit show.
english: Perry, known as Chandler Bing, was laid to rest at Forest Lawn cemetery in the Hollywood Hills neighborhood of Los Angeles just a short distance from the Warner Brothers studio where the hit show was filmed.

text:
PHOTO: CBS via Getty Images

Ini man ang katapusan nga palahuwayan sang pila ka Hollywood A-listers kaangay kanday Michael Jackson, Lucille Ball kag Elizabeth Taylor.
english:
PHOTO: CBS via Getty Images

It is also the final resting place of several Hollywood A-listers like Michael Jackson, Lucille Ball and Elizabeth Taylor.

text: Sandig sa reports, yara sa lubong ang tanan niya nga “Friends” co-stars ni Perry– sanday Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc kag David Schwimmer.
english: According to reports, all of Perry’s “Friends” co-stars – Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc and David Schwimmer – were at the funeral.

text: Matandaan nga nangin popular ang Friends sang gin-ere ini sang 1994 tubtub 2004 kun sa diin ang final episode sini ang ginlantaw sang tubtub 52.5 million sa US nga amo ang na-rekord bilang most watched TV episode sang 2000s.
english: Friends became popular when it aired from 1994 to 2004 where the final episode was watched by 52.5 million in the US which was recorded as the most watched TV episode of the 2000s.

text: Sang nagligad naman nga semana sang gin-anunsyo nga napatay si Perry sa edad nga 54.
english: Last week, it was announced that Perry had died at the age of 54.

text: Ginahibalo pa kun ano ang kinamatay sini kasunod sang pagkumpleto sang Los Angeles County Medical Examiner’s Office sang autopsy kag toxicology tests.
english: The cause of death is still unknown after the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner's Office completed an autopsy and toxicology tests.

text: Sinibak ni PNP Chief Gen.
english: PNP Chief Gen.

text:
Nicolas Torre III ang hepe ng pulisya ng isang lungsod sa Rizal dahil sa umano’y kapabayaang ipinakita sa paghawak ng kaso ng pagnanakaw—na tila baga’y “natulog sa duty.”

Sa kanyang talumpati sa flag-raising ceremony sa Camp Crame nitong Lunes, Hunyo 30, ibinunyag ni Torre ang insidente kung saan pinauwi lamang umano ng mga pulis ang isang negosyanteng naghain ng reklamo laban sa dalawang empleyado na bigla na lang naglaho, kasama ang kalahating milyong piso ng kompanya.
english:
Nicolas Torre III, the police chief of a town in Rizal, was arrested for alleged negligence in handling a robbery case—apparently “sleeping on duty.”

In his speech at the flag-raising ceremony at Camp Crame on Monday, June 30, Torre revealed the incident where the police allegedly sent home a businessman who filed a complaint against two employees who suddenly disappeared, along with half a million pesos of the company.

text: “Hindi ito ang klase ng serbisyo publiko na dapat ipinapakita ng ating mga pulis,” giit ni Torre.
english: “This is not the kind of public service that our police should be showing,” Torre insisted.

text:
“Hindi natin palalampasin ang mga tamad at pabaya sa kanilang tungkulin.”

Kasunod ng agarang aksyon mula sa mas mataas na opisina, naaresto ang dalawang suspek sa isang lalawigan sa Negros Island Region at narekober ang humigit-kumulang P500,000 halaga ng nawawalang pera.
english:
“We will not overlook the lazy and negligent in their duties.”

Following immediate action from higher authorities, two suspects were arrested in a province in the Negros Island Region and recovered more than P500,000 worth of missing money.

text: Hindi na isinapubliko ang pangalan ng sinibak na hepe, ng negosyante, at ng mga suspek habang nagpapatuloy ang imbestigasyon.
english: The names of the fired chief, the businessman, and the suspects were not made public while the investigation continues.

text: Ibinunyag ng Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) na huling natunton sa Japan si Cassandra Li Ong, ang otorisadong kinatawan ng sinalakay at pinasarang Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) na Lucky South 99 sa Porac, Pampanga.
english: The Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) has revealed that Cassandra Li Ong, the authorized representative of the Philippine Offshore Gaming Operator (POGO) Lucky South 99 in Porac, Pampanga, was last traced to Japan.

text: Sa isang pulong balitaan ngayong Sabado, sinabi ni PAOCC spokesperson Winston Casio, nagtungo si Ong sa Japan sa unang kwarter ng 2025 matapos mapalaya mula sa detention ng Senado.
english: In a news conference on Saturday, PAOCC spokesperson Winston Casio said Ong will head to Japan in the first quarter of 2025 after being released from Senate detention.

text: Subalit, inamin ng opisyal na matapos siyang matunton sa Japan wala na silang ideya kung saan na nagtungo si Cassie Ong.
english: However, the official admitted that after she was arrested in Japan, they had no idea where Cassie Ong went.

text: Inilabas naman aniya kalaunan ang warrant of arrest laban kay Ong noong bandang Marso o Mayo na.
english: He later issued a warrant of arrest against Ong in March or May.

text: Subalit, ayon sa PAOCC official, subject na ng Interpol Red Notice si Ong at kasalukuyan nang nakikipag-ugnayan ang kanilang tanggapan sa iba pang law enforcement agencies para hanapin si Ong at maibalik sa Pilipinas.
english: However, according to the PAOCC official, Ong is now the subject of an Interpol Red Notice and their office is currently in contact with other law enforcement agencies to find Ong and bring him back to the Philippines.

text: Nakadepende naman na aniya sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) ang pagkansela sa pasaporte ni Ong.
english: He said it is up to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to cancel Ong's passport.

text: Matatandaan, nauna ng napag-alaman na wala na sa Pilipinas si Ong nang isiwalat ni Senator Sherwin Gatchalian sa sesyon ng Senado nitong Biyernes.
english: It can be recalled that it was earlier learned that Ong is no longer in the Philippines when Senator Sherwin Gatchalian announced it in the Senate session on Friday.

text: Base sa Senador, sa kasagsagan ng transition sa pagitan ng 19th at 20th Congress pinalaya si Ong.
english: According to the Senator, in the midst of the transition between the 19th and 20th Congress, Ong was released.

text: Paliwanag ng Senador, pinalaya si Cassie Ong nang matapos ang 19th Congress dahil wala pa namang kasong isinampa noon laban sa kaniya.
english: The senator explained that Cassie Ong was released after the 19th Congress because no case had been filed against her.

text: Sa ngayon, mayroong nakabinbing arrest warrant laban kay Ong kaugnay sa kasong qualified human trafficking.
english: Currently, there is an arrest warrant pending against Ong in connection with a case of qualified human trafficking.

text: Gin-ako ni Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia nga limitado ang otoridad sang City Council kag nagakadapat nga ang ICI ang mag-imbestigar sini lakip na ang ginapasuni nga ghost project sa Batiano River.
english: Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia acknowledged that the City Council has limited authority and the ICI should investigate it including the alleged ghost project in the Batiano River.

text: Matandaan nga ginsabat ni Congresswoman Baronda ang pamangkot sa ginpatigayon nga People’s meeting sang nagligad nga semana kag ginklaro nga wala sang ghost project sa siyudad.
english: Congresswoman Baronda answered the question at a People's meeting last week and clarified that there is no ghost project in the city.

text: Dugang ni Sarabia, ang ginapatigayon nga People’s meeting sa kongresista kag Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) ang isa lamang ka General statement para sa mga pumuluyo kag wala ginapunto ang problema sa baha.
english: Sarabia added that the ongoing People's meeting with the congressman and the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) is only a general statement for the people and does not focus on the flood problem.

text: Pahayag pa sang konsehal, wala sang klaro nga sabat nga nakuha ang mga pumuluyo sa ginahambal sang DPWH kag Office of the Lone District Representative sa ginhimo nga People’s Meeting.
english: The councilor said the residents did not get a clear answer to what the DPWH and the Office of the Lone District Representative said during the People's Meeting.

text: Handa naman si Sarabia nga magpa-utod sang ulo kun may makita nga nahuman nga proyekto partikular sa Batiano River.
english: Sarabia said he is ready to cut off his head if he sees a completed project particularly in the Batiano River.

text: Samtang nagahilapit ang Paris Olympics, nabutang pa sa kontrobersiya ang kredibilidad sang hinampang matapos nagguwa ang report nga may 23 ka mga Chinese swimmers nga nagpositibo sa iligal nga substance antes pa man ang Tokyo Olympics sang 2021 apang naka-intra gihapon sa kumpetisyon.
english: As the Paris Olympics approach, the credibility of the games has been thrown into controversy after reports surfaced that 23 Chinese swimmers tested positive for illegal substances before the Tokyo Olympics in 2021 but were still able to compete.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginbaton sang World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) ang pagpaathag sang Chinese authorities nga kontaminado ang kusina sa ila nga hotel rason nga naglagbong ang ila nga mga atleta sa drug test.
english: The World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) reportedly accepted the Chinese authorities' explanation that the kitchen in their hotel was contaminated, causing their athletes to fail the drug test.

text: Partikular nga nakabutang sa report nga positibo ang Chinese swimmers sa trimetazidine (TMZ) nga isa ka prescription heart drug nga ginadumilian nga gamiton sang mga atleta bangud mas mapa-enhance sini ang performance sang tawo.
english: The report specifically states that the Chinese swimmers tested positive for trimetazidine (TMZ), a prescription heart drug that is prohibited for athletes because it can enhance human performance.

text: Wala man nakabutang sa paathag sang China kun ngaa nga na-contaminate sang amo nga drugs ang ila nga kusina.
english: China did not explain why their kitchen was contaminated with the drugs.

text: Ang mas makakilibot pa sa report amo nga pila sa sini nga Chinese swimmers ang nagdaog pa sa Tokyo Olympics — lakip ang tatlo ka gold medals — kag ang kadam-an sa ila lakip ang two-time gold medalist nga si Zhang Yufei ang ginalauman nga magapasakop liwat sa Olympiada sa Paris subong nga tuig.
english: What makes the report even more surprising is that several of these Chinese swimmers went on to win the Tokyo Olympics — including three gold medals — and the majority of them including two-time gold medalist Zhang Yufei are expected to compete again at this year’s Olympiad in Paris.

text: Mangin ang iban nga pungsod kaangay sang Australia ang nag-anunsyo na nga magapatigayon ini sang kaugalingon nga inquiry kun ano ka matuod ang naglupok nga balita bangud nga indi ini patas sa iban nga mga atleta.
english: Even other countries such as Australia have already announced that they will conduct their own inquiry into the truth of the news because it is not fair to other athletes.

text: Nagsabat naman ang China paagi kay foreign ministry spokesman Wang Wenbin nga “fake news” ang reports sa 23 ka Chinese swimmers nga nagpositibo sa ginadumilian nga substance.
english: China responded through foreign ministry spokesman Wang Wenbin that reports of 23 Chinese swimmers testing positive for the banned substance were “fake news”.

text: Klaro suno kay Wang ang sabat sang World anti-doping agency nga kulang sila sa ebidensya agud nga kwestyunon pa ang bersyon sang China kun ngaa nagpositibo ang ila mga atleta.
english: Wang said the World Anti-Doping Agency's response is clear that they lack evidence to question China's version of why their athletes tested positive.

text: Ginsulit man ni Wang nga indi guilty ang ila nga participants bangud nga nagsulod ang contaminated drugs sa ila lawas nga wala sila sang ihibalo rason nga indi ini makabig nga doping violation.
english: Wang also reiterated that their participants are not guilty because the contaminated drugs entered their bodies without their knowledge so it is not considered a doping violation.

text:
Panindugan pa sang spokesman, istrikto nga ginapatuman sang Chinese government ang zero-tolerance position kun doping ang pagahambalan.#

Manan Vatsyayana/Agence France-Presse — Getty Image
english:
The spokesman said the Chinese government strictly enforces a zero-tolerance position when it comes to doping.

Manan Vatsyayana/Agence France-Presse — Getty Image

text: Nakuha sang Philippine techno-horror movie ni Mikhail Red nga “Deleter” ang Best Scare Award sa 15th Grimmfest, isa ka tuigan nga international festival sa Manchester, United Kingdom!
english: Mikhail Red’s Philippine techno-horror movie “Deleter” won the Best Scare Award at the 15th Grimmfest, an annual international festival in Manchester, United Kingdom!

text: Istorya ang Deleter sang isa ka online content moderator nga si Lyra nga gina-murto matapos sini gin-delete ang suicide video nga ginhimo sang iya nga ka-trabaho.
english: Deleter is the story of an online content moderator named Lyra who is haunted after she deleted the suicide video made by her co-worker.

text: Nangin top-grosser ini nga pelikula sa 48th Metro Manila Film Festival sang 2022 kun sa diin ang 30-anyos nga singer-actress nga si Nadine Lustre ang nahatagan sang Best Actress Award.
english: The film became the top-grosser at the 48th Metro Manila Film Festival in 2022 where 30-year-old singer-actress Nadine Luster was awarded the Best Actress Award.

text: Ang Grimmfest isa ka independent genre film festival nga popular sa pagkilala sa mga pelikula nga may genre nga horror, cult extreme fantasy, kag sci-fi.
english: Grimmfest is an independent genre film festival popular for recognizing horror, cult extreme fantasy, and sci-fi genre films.

text: Ginapasakupan ini sang iban nga dalagku nga pungsod kaangay sang Britain, Japan, Spain, Austria, kag France.
english: It is joined by other major countries such as Britain, Japan, Spain, Austria, and France.

text: Nag-advise si anay Ombudsman Conchita Carpio Morales kay Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla tuhoy sa kaso ni Sen.
english: Former Ombudsman Conchita Carpio Morales advised Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla on the case of Sen.

text: Joel Villanueva nga una na nga na-dismiss sa panahon ni anay Ombudsman Samuel Martires.
english: Joel Villanueva who was previously dismissed during the tenure of former Ombudsman Samuel Martires.

text: Si Morales ang nagpagguwa sa 2016 sang dismissal order batok kay Villanueva nga anay representante sang Citizens’ Battle Against Corruption Party-List (CIBAC).
english: Morales issued in 2016 a dismissal order against Villanueva, a former representative of the Citizens' Battle Against Corruption Party-List (CIBAC).

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan sa ginaalegar nga maanomaliya nga paggamit sang iya P10-million nga Priority Development Assistance Fund ukon pork barrel.
english: This is in connection with the alleged anomalous use of his P10-million Priority Development Assistance Fund or pork barrel.

text: Nagkonsulta naman si Remulla kay Morales kadungan sang kagustuhan sini ma-imbestigaran ang kontrobersyal nga isyu.
english: Remulla consulted with Morales on his desire to investigate the controversial issue.

text: Suno kay Remulla, ginhambalan siya ni Morales nga umpisahan ang imbestigasyon sa mismo nga record sang kaso sang Senador.
english: According to Remulla, Morales told him to start the investigation on the very record of the Senator's case.

text: Pahayag pa ni Remulla nga may yara sang team nga nagabusisi sa tanan nga record kag dokumento angot sa kaso ni Villanueva.
english: Remulla said there is a team that is reviewing all records and documents related to Villanueva's case.

text: Lakip sa mga ginatun-an sang Office of the Ombudsman amo ang kun ang mosyon ni Villanueva nga nagahingyo para ma-dismiss ang iya kaso ang iga-file sa prescribed period nga lima ka adlaw.
english: Among the issues being studied by the Office of the Ombudsman is whether Villanueva's motion seeking dismissal of his case will be filed within the prescribed period of five days.

text: Nag-file sang urgent motion para magatenir sa Pasig City Jail si convicted human trafficker Alice Guo.
english: Convicted human trafficker Alice Guo filed an urgent motion to remain in the Pasig City Jail.

text: Matapos ang pagguwa sang desisyon nga life imprisonment kay Guo sa diin ginmando nga isaylo siya sa Correctional Institution for Women sa Mandaluyong City.
english: After the issuance of the decision of life imprisonment to Guo where he was ordered to be transferred to the Correctional Institution for Women in Mandaluyong City.

text: Sa isa ka pahina sang order nga ginpagguwa ni Judge Annielyn Medes-Cabelis sang Pasig City Regional Trial Court Branch 167 nga gintalana nga hearing sa mosyon ni Guo sa Nobyembre 26.
english: In a one-page order issued by Judge Annielyn Medes-Cabelis of the Pasig City Regional Trial Court Branch 167, a hearing on Guo's motion was scheduled for November 26.

text: Nagakahulugan ini nga magatenir si Gou sa Pasig City Jail Female Dormitory samtang indi pa maresolba ang mosyon.
english: This means that Gou will stay in the Pasig City Jail Female Dormitory while the motion is not resolved.

text: Matandaan nga ginsentensyahan sang life imprisonment ang anay Bamban, Tarlac Mayor kag tatlo ka iban pa mapamatud-an nga guilty sa qualified human trafficking in persons kag organizing human trafficking sa Baofu compound.
english: It can be recalled that the former Bamban, Tarlac Mayor and three others found guilty of qualified human trafficking in persons and organizing human trafficking in the Baofu compound were sentenced to life imprisonment.

text: Samtang ang mga Chinese nationals nga sanday Wang Weili, Wuli Dong, Nong Ding Chang kag Lang Xu Po ang nasentensyahan sang acts of trafficking nga may life imprisonment.
english: Meanwhile, Chinese nationals Wang Weili, Wuli Dong, Nong Ding Chang and Lang Xu Po were sentenced for acts of trafficking with life imprisonment.

text: Ginapabayaf man sila sang korte sang tig-P2 million kada isa.
english: The court also fined them P2 million each.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-raid sang Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) kag Philippine National Police ang Philippine offshore gaming operator (POGO) Zun Yuan Technology sa Baofu compound na makita sa Tarlac sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) and the Philippine National Police raided Philippine offshore gaming operator (POGO) Zun Yuan Technology in the Baofu compound located in Tarlac last year.

text: Arestado ang dalawang lalaki sa magkahiwalay na insidente ng karahasan sa loob ng tahanan matapos isumbong ng kanilang mga asawa sa pulisya.
english: Two men were arrested in separate incidents of domestic violence after their wives reported them to the police.

text: Unang naaresto si alyas “Dro,” isang lalaki umanong nasa impluwensiya ng alak, matapos na walang habas na magpaputok ng baril sa Brgy.
english: Alias ​​“Dro,” a man allegedly under the influence of alcohol, was first arrested after he allegedly fired a gun in Brgy.

text: Poblacion bandang alas-10 ng gabi.
english: Poblacion around 10 pm.

text: Agad rumesponde ang mga awtoridad matapos makatanggap ng ulat mula sa kanyang live-in partner.
english: Authorities immediately responded after receiving a report from his live-in partner.

text: Nakumpiska mula sa suspek ang isang Caliber .45 Norinco pistol na may lamang magazine, 12 bala, isa pang magazine na may 10 bala, fired cartridge case, magazine pouch, at holster.
english: A Caliber .45 Norinco pistol with only a magazine, 12 rounds of ammunition, another magazine with 10 rounds of ammunition, a fired cartridge case, a magazine pouch, and a holster were recovered from the suspect.

text: Samantala, bandang alas-4 ng hapon naman sa Brgy.
english: Meanwhile, around 4 pm in Brgy.

text: Sta.
english: Sta.

text: Cruz, nadakip si alyas “Ruel” matapos umano nitong sakalin at takutin ang kanyang asawa gamit ang isang baril.
english: Cruz, alias “Ruel” was arrested after he allegedly stabbed and threatened his wife with a gun.

text: Agad na kumilos ang pulisya sa nasabing reklamo at nadakip ang suspek.
english: Police immediately responded to the complaint and arrested the suspect.

text: Nakuha mula sa kanya ang isang cal.
english: A cal. was recovered from him.

text: 38 revolver at isang gun replica.
english: 38 revolver and a gun replica.

text: Kasalukuyang nakakulong ang dalawang lalaki sa istasyon ng pulisya habang inihahanda ang kaukulang mga kaso laban sa kanila, kabilang na ang ilegal na pagdadala ng baril at pananakit sa kanilang mga asawa.
english: The two men are currently detained at the police station while relevant cases are being prepared against them, including illegal possession of firearms and assault on their wives.

text: VALDERAMA ANTIQUE – Nagapati si Valderrama Antique Vice Mayor  Josefino Castillon nga mahimo may lamud pamulitika ang tuyo nga pagtiro sa iya kun sa diin ginbawian sang kabuhi ang isa niya ka supporter matapos magtambong ang mga ini sa kahiwatan sa  Brgy.
english: VALDERAMA ANTIQUE – Valderrama Antique Vice Mayor Josefino Castillon believes that the shooting of one of his supporters may have been politically motivated after they attended an event in Brgy.

text: Buluangan I sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: Buluangan I sa nasambit nga banwa.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Castillon, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang kamatuoran ang ginapahayag old grudges bangud wala siya nagahupot sini kag isa siya ka maamiguhon nga tawo kag madamo sang kakilala.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Castillon said there is no truth in the alleged old grudges because he does not hold them and he is a friendly person and has many acquaintances.

text: Suno pa kay Castillon, wala man siya sang may ginatumod nga pangalan apang sa iya pagpanagupnop mahimo nga may lamud pamulitika ang nagluntad nga insidente.
english: Castillon said he did not mention anyone's name but he suspects that the incident may have been politically motivated.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginbawian gid sang kabuhi si Angelito Roquero Jr, 26 anyos sang Brgy.
english: Angelito Roquero Jr., 26, of Brgy.

text: Takas sa nasambit nga banwa  supporter ni Castillon sa diin nakaangkon ini sang igo sa dughan.
english: Castillon's supporter escaped from the said town where he sustained multiple gunshot wounds in the chest.

text:
Ginkilala naman ang suspek nga si  Raymart Francisco, 25 anyos, sang Brgy Cansilayan kag ginapahayag tinawo sang re electionist kag incumbent mayor sang Valderrama, Antique nga si Jocelyn Posadas

Sa subong preso ang suspek sa Valderama Municipal Police Station.
english:
The suspect was identified as Raymart Francisco, 25, of Brgy Cansilayan.

The suspect is currently detained at the Valderama Municipal Police Station.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Castillon ang liwat nga nagapadalagan bilang bise alkalde sa Valderrama Antique.
english: Castillon is running again as vice mayor of Valderrama Antique.

text: Napaslawan si Abegail Rait nga makakuha sang pwesto sa barangay sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga 2023 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections sa Imus, Cavite.
english: Abegail Rait failed to win a barangay seat in the recently concluded 2023 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections in Imus, Cavite.

text: Sa piniliay sa pagka-barangay kagawad sa Toclong 2-B sa Imus, nagpang-walo lamang ini apang madasig man ini nga nagpanginbulahan sa mga nagdaog kag nagpasalamat sa iya sumalakdag.
english: In the barangay kagawad election in Toclong 2-B in Imus, he only came eighth but he was quick to congratulate the winners and thank his supporters.

text:
Nag-post man ang iya 15-anyos nga anak nga si Gaile Francesca sang mensahe bilang suporta kay Rait: “We won’t close the book but will turn the page and begin new chapter together.”

Si Rait amo ang anay flight attendant nga nangin kontrobersyal sang damlag lang bangud sa pagguwa sini kag pagbuyagyag nga ka-relasyon niya anay ang OPM rapper nga si Francis Magalona.
english:
Her 15-year-old daughter Gaile Francesca also posted a message in support of Rait: “We won’t close the book but will turn the page and begin a new chapter together.”

Rait is the former flight attendant who recently came under fire for coming out and revealing that she was once in a relationship with OPM rapper Francis Magalona.

text: Ginsapubliko man sini nga si Gaile Francesca amo ang nangin bunga sang ila paghigugmaanay.
english: He also revealed that Gaile Francesca was the fruit of their love.

text: Marso 6, 2009 sang napatay si Francis M. sa edad nga 44 bangud sa ginsuprer nga acute myeloid leukemia.
english: Francis M. died on March 6, 2009 at the age of 44 due to acute myeloid leukemia.

text: Naghain ng urgent motion para manatili sa Pasig City Jail si convicted human trafficker Alice Guo.
english: Convicted human trafficker Alice Guo filed an urgent motion to remain in Pasig City Jail.

text: Matapos kasi ang paglabas ng hatol na life imprisonment kay Guo kung saan inatasan na ililipat siya sa Correctional Institution for Women sa Mandaluyong City.
english: After the sentence of life imprisonment to Guo, he was transferred to the Correctional Institution for Women in Mandaluyong City.

text: Sa isang pahinang oder na inilabas ni Judge Annielyn Medes-Cabelis ng Pasig City Regional Trial Court Branch 167 na itinakda ang pagdinig sa mosyon ni Guo sa Nobyembre 26.
english: In a one-page order issued by Judge Annielyn Medes-Cabelis of the Pasig City Regional Trial Court Branch 167, the hearing on Guo's motion was scheduled for November 26.

text: Nangangahulugan nito na mananatili si Guo sa Pasig City Jail Female Dormitory habang hindi pa nareresolba ang mosyon nito.
english: This means that Guo will remain in the Pasig City Jail Female Dormitory while his motion is not resolved.

text: Magugunitang hinatulang makulong ng habambuhay ang dating Bamban, Tarlac Mayor at tatlong iba matapos na mapatunayang guilty sa qualified human trafficking in persons at organizing human trafficking sa Baofu compound.
english: The former Bamban, Tarlac Mayor and three others are facing life imprisonment after being found guilty of qualified human trafficking in persons and organizing human trafficking in Baofu compound.

text: Habang ang mga Chinese nationals na sina Wang Weili, Wuli Dong, Nong Ding Chang at Lang Xu Po ay nahatulan ng acts of trafficking na may hatol na life imprisonment.
english: Meanwhile, Chinese nationals Wang Weili, Wuli Dong, Nong Ding Chang and Lang Xu Po were convicted of acts of trafficking with life imprisonment.

text: Pinagbabayad din sila ng korte ng tig P2-milyon bawat kaso.
english: The court also fined them P2-million each.

text: Magugunitang ni-raid ng Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) at Philippine National Police ang Philippine offshore gaming operator (POGO) Zun Yuan Technology sa Baofu compound na matatagpuan sa Tarlac noong nakaraang taon.
english: The Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) and Philippine National Police raided Philippine offshore gaming operator (POGO) Zun Yuan Technology at the Baofu compound located in Tarlac last year.

text: Wala naga-panic ang basketball superstar nga si LeBron James apisar sang kalutusan sang Los Angeles Lakers sa kamot sang defending champion nga Denver Nuggets sa Game 1 sang 2024 NBA Playoffs sa Western Conference.
english: Basketball superstar LeBron James is not panicking despite the Los Angeles Lakers' defeat at the hands of the defending champion Denver Nuggets in Game 1 of the 2024 NBA Playoffs in the Western Conference.

text: Ang pag-pierde sang Nuggets sa Lakers amo man ang nagamarka sang ika-siyam nga sunod-sunod nga paglutos sini sa amo nga team.
english: The Nuggets’ loss to the Lakers also marks its ninth consecutive loss to that team.

text: Wala pa nakaagi daog ang Lakers sa Nuggets halin sang Disyembre 16, 2022 apang tilawan nila nga makabawi sa Game 2 sa Ball Arena sa Denver, Colorado 10:00 buwas sa aga, oras sa Pilipinas.
english: The Lakers have not beaten the Nuggets since December 16, 2022 but will try to bounce back in Game 2 at the Ball Arena in Denver, Colorado at 10:00 am tomorrow morning, Philippine time.

text: Suno kay James, Game 1 pa lamang ini gani may tyansa pa sila nga kay-uhon ang hampang.
english: According to James, this is only Game 1 so they still have a chance to fix the game.

text: “It’s one game, they protected their home court.
english: “It’s one game, they protected their home court.

text: We have another opportunity on Monday to come back and be better.
english: We have another opportunity on Monday to come back and be better.

text: We know how challenging it’s gonna be, we know how difficult this opponent is and how great they are.
english: We know how challenging it’s gonna be, we know how difficult this opponent is and how great they are.

text: So that’s all a part of the game.
english: So that’s all a part of the game.

text: I don’t get into the doubt mindset, that’s not me.
english: I don’t get into the doubt mindset, that’s not me.

text: I’m the wrong guy to ask,” pahayag sini.
english: I’m the wrong guy to ask,” he said.

text: Gindayaw man sini ang execution sang offense sang Denver sa third quarter; kag gin-ako man nga kulang ang Lakers sa pagtutok sa detalye sang hampang kun gusto nila nga makalagas sa serye.
english: He also praised the execution of Denver’s offense in the third quarter; and also admitted that the Lakers lack focus on the details of the game if they want to chase the series.

text: 114-103 ang skor kahapon kun sa diin nagpanguna si Nikola Jokic sa Nuggets may 32 points kag 12 rebounds; samtang si James naman ang may 27 points kag may 32 points naman si Anthony Davis.
english: 114-103 yesterday with Nikola Jokic leading the Nuggets with 32 points and 12 rebounds; James had 27 points and Anthony Davis had 32 points.

text:
Ang Game 1 sa tunga sang duha ka teams amo ang ginbantayan gid sa imbukada nga hampang sa 2024 NBA Playoffs ilabi na bangud nagsambuwa man ang mga ini sa Western Conference finals sang nagligad nga tuig.#

english:
Game 1 between the two teams was the most anticipated opening game of the 2024 NBA Playoffs especially since they also played in the Western Conference finals last year.

text: Muling itinanggi nina Senador Joel Villanueva at Senador Jinggoy Estrada ang anumang kaugnayan nila sa umano’y katiwalian sa mga proyekto ng flood control.
english: Senator Joel Villanueva and Senator Jinggoy Estrada have again denied any involvement in alleged corruption in flood control projects.

text: Ito ay matapos irekomenda ng Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) sa Office of the Ombudsman (OMB) na sampahan ng kasong plunder, bribery, at iba pang kaugnay na kasong may kinalaman sa korapsyon ang dalawang senador, dahil umano sa pagtanggap nila ng benepisyo mula sa mga kuwestiyonableng proyekto.
english: This comes after the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) recommended to the Office of the Ombudsman (OMB) to file plunder, bribery, and other related corruption-related charges against the two senators, for allegedly receiving benefits from questionable projects.

text: Iginiit ni Villanueva na makikita sa mga rekord ng Senado na mula pa sa simula ay tinutulan na niya ang mga naturang proyekto.
english: Villanueva insisted that the Senate records show that he has been opposing these projects from the beginning.

text: Ayon sa kanya, isa siya sa mga unang nagbunyag at kumuwestiyon sa mga proyektong ito, na marami sa mga ito ay hindi pa rin natutupad hanggang ngayon.
english: According to him, he was one of the first to baptize and question these projects, many of which are still not implemented today.

text: Dagdag pa ng senador, malinaw umano sa pahayag ng dating DPWH District Engineer na si Henry Alcantara na wala siyang anumang kinalaman sa mga proyekto sa flood control.
english: The senator added that it is clear from the statement of former DPWH District Engineer Henry Alcantara that he has nothing to do with flood control projects.

text: Gayunman, sinabi ni Villanueva na hihintayin niya ang magiging aksyon ng Ombudsman at maghahain ng pormal na tugon sa tamang panahon upang patunayan ang kanyang kawalang-sala.
english: However, Villanueva said he will wait for the Ombudsman's action and will file a formal response in due course to prove his innocence.

text: Samantala, mariin ding itinanggi ni Estrada na nakatanggap siya ng anumang pondo na may kaugnayan sa mga proyekto ng flood control.
english: Meanwhile, Estrada also denied receiving any funds related to flood control projects.

text: Tiniyak ng senador sa publiko na handa siyang ipagtanggol ang sarili at dumaan sa proseso ng batas upang patunayan ang katotohanan at ang kanyang katapatan bilang lingkod-bayan.
english: The senator assured the public that he is ready to defend himself and go through the legal process to prove the truth and his sincerity as a public servant.

text: Binigyang-diin pa ni Estrada na lilinisin niya ang kanyang pangalan at naniniwala siyang sa tamang panahon ay mananaig ang katotohanan.
english: Estrada stressed that he will clear his name and believes that in due time the truth will prevail.

text: Nagpabutyag si Golden State Warriors coach Steve Kerr nga indi niya luyag buy-an ang basketball superstar nga si Klay Thompson apisar sang mahina nga performance sini sa ginapanan-aw posible nga katapusan nga hampang sini para sa team.
english: Golden State Warriors coach Steve Kerr has expressed his reluctance to let go of basketball superstar Klay Thompson despite his poor performance in what is expected to be his last game for the team.

text: Kasunod sang 118-94 nga kalutusan sang Warrios sa kamot sang Sacramento Kings sa Western Conference play-in tournament, padulong naman sa free agency ang 34-anyos nga guard kag indi pa klaro kun ano ang masunod sa iya karera.
english: Following the Warrios' 118-94 loss to the Sacramento Kings in the Western Conference play-in tournament, the 34-year-old guard is headed to free agency and it's unclear what's next for his career.

text: Ang kalutusan sang Dubs ang nagakahulugan man nga nahulog na ini sa NBA playoff contention.
english: The Dubs' loss also means they have fallen out of NBA playoff contention.

text: Wala naka-skor si Thompson sa katapusan nga game sang Warriors sa sini nga season — 0-for-10 shooting — nga amo ang ikalima nga tion sa iya karera nga wala ini nakapuntos kag ikaduha nga tion sa idalom ni Kerr.
english: Thompson didn’t score in the Warriors’ final game of the season — 0-for-10 shooting — marking the fifth time in his career he didn’t score and the second time under Kerr.

text: Para sa coach, gusto pa sang Warriors nga makaupod ang nasambit nga guard nga isa man ka four-time NBA champion.
english: For the coach, the Warriors still want to be with the said guard who is also a four-time NBA champion.

text: “We need Klay back.
english: “We need Klay back.

text: He’s still got good years left.
english: He’s still got good years left.

text: And I know I speak for everybody in the organization: We want him back.
english: And I know I speak for everyone in the organization: We want him back.

text: … What Klay has meant to this franchise and as good as he still is, we desperately want him back,” suno kay Kerr.
english: … What Klay has meant to this franchise and as good as he still is, we desperately want him back,” according to Kerr.

text: “I’ve watched him the last couple years fighting the feeling of devastation from injuries and I watched him this season flip his season around.
english: “I’ve watched him the last couple years fighting the feeling of devastation from injuries and I watched him this season flip his season around.

text: I saw him enjoy the second half of the season and play with a little more freedom and joy, so tonight was tough to see him struggle,” dugang sini.
english: I saw him enjoy the second half of the season and play with a little more freedom and joy, so tonight was tough to see him struggle,” he added.

text: Para naman kay Stephen Curry kasunod sang espekulasyon nga ini na posible ang katapusan nga hampang nga updanay sila nanday Thompson kag Draymond Green, ginsiling sini nga indi pa sini makit-an ang iya kaugalingon nga nagahampang nga wala ang duha.
english: As for Stephen Curry, following speculation that this may be the last game with Thompson and Draymond Green, he said he can't see himself playing without the two.

text: Indi naman makit-an ni Green nga magabiya si Thompson bangud nagapati siya nga may bag-o nga deal: “I don’t think there’s any scenario where Klay leaves and that’s the best decision for this organization.
english: Green doesn’t see Thompson leaving because he believes there is a new deal: “I don’t think there’s any scenario where Klay leaves and that’s the best decision for this organization.

text: …They did right by me.
english: …They were right by me.

text: They’ve done right by Steph.
english: They’ve been done right by Steph.

text: They’ve done right by all of us.
english: They’ve been done right by all of us.

text: Klay tore his ACL and they paid him 160 million dollars.
english: Klay tore his ACL and they paid him 160 million dollars.

text:
I have no reason to think ownership aren’t going to take care of us the way we taken care of this organization.”

Mayor nga parte sang franchise si Thompson nga nakadaog sang apat ka kampyonato kag anum ka byahe pa-Finals halin sang 2015-2022.
english:
I have no reason to think ownership aren’t going to take care of us the way we take care of this organization.”

Thompson was a major part of the franchise, which won four championships and six trips to the Finals from 2015-2022.

text:
Ang iya 2,481 nga 3-pointers sa regular season amo ang ikaanum sa pinakamataas sa NBA history kag ang 501 sa playoffs ang mas mataas man sa bisan sin-o nga basketball star magluwas kay Curry.#

PHOTO: NBC SPORTS
english:
His 2,481 3-pointers in the regular season are the sixth most in NBA history and the 501 in the playoffs are also more than any basketball star other than Curry.#

PHOTO: NBC SPORTS

text: “𝘐 𝘤𝘢𝘯 𝘯𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘳 𝘴𝘦𝘦 𝘮𝘺𝘴𝘦𝘭𝘧 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘵𝘩𝘰𝘴𝘦 𝘵𝘸𝘰 𝘨𝘶𝘺𝘴,” direkta nga sabat sang Warriors superstar nga si Steph Curry nga nagatumod kanday Draymond Green kag Klay Thompson.
english: “A 𝘐 𝘤𝘢𝘯 𝘯𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘳 𝘴𝘦𝘦 𝘮𝘺𝘴𝘦𝘭𝘧 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘸𝘸𝘩 𝘵𝘩𝘰𝘴𝘦 𝘵𝘸𝘰 𝘨𝘶𝘺𝘴,” Warriors superstar Steph Curry directly replied referring to Draymond Green and Klay Thompson.

english: This follows their 118-94 defeat at the hands of the Sacramento Kings in the Western Conference play-in tournament which also means the team has fallen out of NBA playoff contention.

text: Apisar may nabilin pa sa kontrata nanday Green kag Curry, indi naman klaro kun ano ang masunod kay Thompson bangud free agent na ini sa offseason kag POSIBLE nga makahampang sa iban nga team sa labing-una nga tion sa iya karera sa NBA.
english: Although Green and Curry still have some remaining on their contracts, it's unclear what's next for Thompson as he's a free agent in the offseason and POSSIBLY could play for another team for the first time in his NBA career.

text: Nagsugod nga mangin teammates ang tatlo sang 2012-13 season nga amo man ang tion nga nagsulod si Green sa liga bilang second-round pick.
english: The three started being teammates during the 2012-13 season which was also when Green entered the league as a second-round pick.

text: Sang 2012-2023, ang Warriors ang nakahimo sang siyam ka appearances sa playoffs sa 11 ka seasons.
english: From 2012-2023, the Warriors made nine playoff appearances in 11 seasons.

text: Lima man ang ila sunod-sunod nga NBA Finals appearances halin sang 2014 tubtub 2019, kag anum ang Finals appearances sa walo ka tuig nga stretch halin sang 2014 tubtub 2022 kun sa diin apat ang ila nadag-an.
english: They also made five consecutive NBA Finals appearances from 2014 to 2019, and six Finals appearances in the eight-year stretch from 2014 to 2022 where they won four.

english: The Warriors also are considered almost the closest to a dynasty in the league following Los Angeles’ three-peat in the late 1990s and early 2000s.

english: Major General Jon Aying who is running for mayor of Sara, Iloilo.

text: Ini matapos ang pagresponde sang Sara PNP kag Philippine Army sa Brgy.
english: This was after the response of Sara PNP and Philippine Army in Brgy.

text: Ardemil bangud sa ginapahayag pagpasirado ni Barangay Kagawad Evelyn “Belen” Peñaflor sa gymnasium kun sa diin kun tani hiwaton ang caucus sang grupo ni Aying.
english: Ardemil due to the alleged closure of the gymnasium where the caucus of Aying's group was supposed to be held.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Asencion Ortizo, hepe sang Sara Municipal Po lice Station,   iya ginpahayag nga gilayon sila nga nagresponde sa nasambit nga lugar matapos nga makabaton sang impormasyon nga wala ginpahanugutan sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Asencion Ortizo, chief of the Sara Municipal Police Station, said they immediately responded to the area after receiving information that Brgy.

english: Kagawad to hold the caucus.

text: Santo sa pagkahibalo ni Ortizo, nagpangayo sang permit si Aying apang wala ini gin-aktuhan sang Barangay Council.
english: According to Ortizo, Aying asked for a permit but the Barangay Council did not act on it.

text: Santo sa pagsulundan sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC), kun indi maaktuhan sang Barangay Council ang permit application sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw, ini ang makabig nga ‘deemed as approved’ ukon automatic nga may pahanugot na ang isa ka pulitiko ukon partido nga makapatigayon sang political activities.
english: According to the rules of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC), if the Barangay Council does not process the permit application within three days, it is considered 'deemed as approved' or automatically that a politician or party has permission to conduct political activities.

text: Nangin madinalag-on ang ginpatigayon sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Region 6 nga NEO PLUS Program: Transformative Leadership for Elevated Governance – Refresher Course.
english: The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Region 6 conducted the NEO PLUS Program: Transformative Leadership for Elevated Governance – Refresher Course.

text: Ini para sa mga reelected local officials sa bug-os nga rehiyon.
english: This is for reelected local officials across the region.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Lambunao Vice Mayor Arvin Losaria nga nagaserbe nga interim national chairman sang Vice Mayors’ League of the Philippines, iya ginpahayag nga mayor nga katuyuan sang kahiwatan amo nga mapasangkad pa ang ihibalo sang mga opisyal sa ila katungdanan sa ila pumuluyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Lambunao, Vice Mayor Arvin Losaria, who serves as interim national chairman of the Vice Mayors' League of the Philippines, said the main purpose of the event is to increase the awareness of officials on their duties to their people.

text: Isa sa mga speakers amo Si Ronald R. Barcena nga nag-highlight sang balor sang efficient local legislatures paagi sa pagtudlo tuhoy sa parliamentary rules, quasi-judicial functions, kag procedural aspects sang local legislation.
english: One of the speakers was Ronald R. Barcena who highlighted the value of efficient local legislatures by teaching about parliamentary rules, quasi-judicial functions, and procedural aspects of local legislation.

text: Gintalakay naman ni Jerome Rojo-Eslabra ang transformative leadership in action agud engganyuhon ang mga opisyal nga hatagan sang madalom nga kahulugan ang ila posisyon.
english: Jerome Rojo-Eslabra discussed transformative leadership in action to encourage officials to give deep meaning to their positions.

text: Suno pa kay Losaria, ini nagamarka sang padayon nga pagtinguha sang mga opisyal nga mas dedikaran ang ila serbisyo agud madul-ong ang pinakamaayo nga panghimanwa kag pagpamuno.
english: According to Losaria, this marks the continuous efforts of the officials to dedicate their services to deliver the best citizenship and leadership.

text: Nagtambong ang duha ka mga konsehal sang siyudad sang Iloilo-Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia kag Councilor Nene Dela Llana sa people’s meeting ukon pagsinapol nga ginpangunahan ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Jam-Jam Baronda.
english: Two Iloilo City councilors-Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia and Councilor Nene Dela Llana attended the people’s meeting led by Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Jam-Jam Baronda.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa nauna na nga mga people’s meeting nga ginpatigayon, naga-monitor na sa livestream ni Baronda si Councilor Sarabia suno sa iya.
english: It was learned that in previous people's meetings held, Councilor Sarabia was already monitoring Baronda's livestream, he said.

text: Madumdoman nga sa iya privilege speech sa regular session kaina,nagsiling ini nga General statement lamang ang ginasabat sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kag ni Baronda sa problema sa pagbaha.
english: It can be recalled that in his privilege speech in the regular session yesterday, he said that the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) and Baronda are only responding to the flooding problem in a general statement.

text: Sa ila pagtambong subong dala na nila ang ila man nga mga pamangkutanon sa DPWH-ICDEO kag sa kongresista.
english: In their attendance, they have brought their questions to the DPWH-ICDEO and the congressman.

english: A member of the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) in Brgy.
