text: Siyam ang napatay samtang iban ang pilason matapos ang drayber sang isa ka salakyan nag-arado sa kadam-an samtang nagakinasadya sa tion sang Lapu-Lapu Day Festival sa Vancouver, Canada.
english: Nine people were killed while others were injured after the driver of a car plowed into a crowd while reveling during the Lapu-Lapu Day Festival in Vancouver, Canada.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bombo Kenneth John Benedicto Leo, Bombo International Correspondent sa Vancouver, Canada, iya ginpahayag nga ginkakibot lang nila ang pag-arado sang isa ka salakyan sa kadam-an samtang nagatipon para sa Lapu Lapu Day Block Party, isa ka masinadyahon nga kapiestahan sa street sang mga Pilipino.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Bombo Kenneth John Benedicto Leo, Bombo International Correspondent in Vancouver, Canada, said they were surprised when a vehicle plowed into the crowd while gathering for the Lapu Lapu Day Block Party, a lively Filipino street festival.

text: Suno kay Leo, natabo ang insidente malapit sa East 41st Avenue kag Fraser Street, nga nagresulta sa madamo nga kamatayon kag pila ka mga pilason.
english: Leo said the incident occurred near East 41st Avenue and Fraser Street, resulting in multiple deaths and several injuries.

text: Ginreport sang mga otoridad nga ang isa ka itom nga SUV nag-arado sa mga nagatambong sa festival, nga nagtuga man sang kagamo kag kakugmat sa linibo ka mga nagtambong.
english: Authorities reported that a black SUV plowed into festival-goers, also causing chaos and panic among thousands of attendees.

text: Nadakpan na ang driver kag nagapabilin sa kustodiya sang kapulisan samtang nagapadayon ang imbestigasyon.
english: The driver has been arrested and remains in police custody while investigations continue.

text: Sa subong, wala pa ginbuyagyag sang mga opisyal ang posible nga motibo sa likod sang aksidente.
english: So far, officials have not revealed a possible motive behind the crash.

text: Ginlaragway sang mga nakasaksi sa lugar ang ginhimo sang SUV nga isa ka “erratic” antes ini nagbunggo sa kadam-an.
english: Witnesses at the scene described the SUV’s actions as an “erratic” one before it crashed into the crowd.

text: Madasig naman nga nagresponde ang mga emergency services kag naghatag sang bulig medical.
english: Emergency services quickly responded and provided medical assistance.

text: Si Vancouver Mayor Ken Sim kag Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney ang nagpalab-ot naman sang ila pagpakig-unong sa mga biktima kag sa ila pamilya, nga nagpasalig sang isa ka maid-id nga imbestigasyon.
english: Vancouver Mayor Ken Sim and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney expressed their condolences to the victims and their families, promising a thorough investigation.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Lapu Lapu Day festival nga opisyal nga ginkilala sa British Columbia humalin sang 2023 ang nagaselebrar sang Filipino heritage kag kaisog sang indigenous leader nga si Lapu Lapu.
english: It is known that the Lapu Lapu Day festival officially recognized in British Columbia from 2023 celebrates the Filipino heritage and courage of the indigenous leader Lapu Lapu.

text: Ginpamatbatan nga guilty si anay Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo sang Pasig Regional Trial Court Branch 167 kaangot sa kaso nga Qualified Trafficking in Persons.
english: Former Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo was found guilty by the Pasig Regional Trial Court Branch 167 in connection with the case of Qualified Trafficking in Persons.

text: Ang pamatbat may kaangtanan sa operasyon sang Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) sa Bamban kun sa diin ginatos nga mga obreros ang na-rescue sa isa ka raid.
english: The explanation is related to the operation of the Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO) in Bamban where hundreds of workers were rescued in a raid.

text: Gindagdag sang korte ang silot nga reclusion perpetua ukon pagkapreso samtang nagakabuhi.
english: The court added the penalty of reclusion perpetua or life imprisonment.

text: Si Guo ang nangin sentro sang kontrobersiya matapos naggwa ang mga alegasyon sa iya kaangtanan sa mga Chinese nationals kag sa iligal nga POGO hub.
english: Guo became the center of controversy after allegations surfaced of his ties to Chinese nationals and the illegal POGO hub.

text: Magapanguna ang 39-anyos nga all-time leading scorer sa NBA nga si LeBron James kag ang reigning most valuable player nga si Joel Embiid sa all-star lineup sang United States of America para sa men’s basketball sa Paris Olympics.
english: 39-year-old all-time leading scorer in the NBA LeBron James and reigning most valuable player Joel Embiid will lead the United States of America’s all-star lineup for men’s basketball at the Paris Olympics.

text: Sa announcement sang USA Basketball, yara man sa linyada ang teammate ni James nga si Anthony Davis, ang Phoenix Suns three-time Olympic champion nga si Kevin Durant kag ang Golden State Warriors superstar nga si Stephen Curry.
english: In USA Basketball’s announcement, James’ teammate Anthony Davis, Phoenix Suns three-time Olympic champion Kevin Durant and Golden State Warriors superstar Stephen Curry are also in the lineup.

text: Ginhingadlan man nga makaupod sa squad sanday Bam Adebayo (Miami Heat), Devin Booker (Phoenix Suns), Anthony Edwards (Minnesota Timberwolves), Tyrese Haliburton (Indiana Pacers), Jrue Holiday (Boston Celtics), Kawhi Leonard (L.A. Clippers) kag Jayson Tatum (Boston Celtics).
english: Also named to join the squad are Bam Adebayo (Miami Heat), Devin Booker (Phoenix Suns), Anthony Edwards (Minnesota Timberwolves), Tyrese Haliburton (Indiana Pacers), Jrue Holiday (Boston Celtics), Kawhi Leonard (L.A. Clippers) and Jayson Celtics (Boston Celtics).

text: Ang 12 nga myembro sang Paris “Dream Team” ang lunsay man nangin NBA All-Stars kun sa diin nalakip man ang apat ka NBA MVPs kag anum ka NBA champions.
english: The 12 members of the Paris “Dream Team” have all become NBA All-Stars, including four NBA MVPs and six NBA champions.

text: Na-grupo ang US sa Group C kun sa diin makasumpong sini ang Serbia, South Sudan kag ang winner sang qualifying tournament sa Puerto Rico sa Agusto 3.
english: The US is grouped in Group C where it will face Serbia, South Sudan and the winner of the qualifying tournament in Puerto Rico on August 3.

text: Ini na ang ikaapat nga Olympiada para kay James kun sa diin nadag-an sini ang bronze sang 2004 kag ang gold sang 2008 kag 2012.
english: This is James' fourth Olympiad where he won bronze in 2004 and gold in 2008 and 2012.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, apisar sang decorated career ni Curry, ini ang iya mangin labing-una nga pagtapak sini sa Olympics.
english: On the other hand, despite Curry's decorated career, this will be his first time in the Olympics.

text: Balantayan man kun makahimo sang maragtas si Durant sa Paris.
english: It remains to be seen if Durant can make history in Paris.

text: Siya kag si Carmelo Anthony lamang ang nakadaog sang tatlo ka gold medals sa men’s basketball sa Olympiada, kag pananglitan magdaog ang US subong nga tuig, si Durant ang mangin labing-una sa maragtas nga maka-apat na ka bulawan nga medalya sa men’s basketball.
english: He and Carmelo Anthony alone have won three gold medals in men’s basketball at the Olympics, and if the US wins this year, Durant will become the first in history to win four gold medals in men’s basketball.

text: Magaserbe nga coach ang Warriors head coach nga si Steve Kerr.
english: Warriors head coach Steve Kerr will serve as coach.

text: Siya ang nagpungko nga assistant sang 2021 kun sa diin nakuha sang team ang gold sa Tokyo Summer Games.
english: He was the assistant in 2021 when the team won gold at the Tokyo Summer Games.

text: Nakatalana ang Paris Olympics sa Hulyo 26-Agusto 11.
english: The Paris Olympics are scheduled for July 26-August 11.

text: (Courtesy: USA Basketball/X)
english: (Courtesy: USA Basketball/X)

text: Liwat nga ginpamatud-an sang Bombo Radyo Philippines nga nagapangibabaw ini sa patag sang broadcasting.
english: Bombo Radyo Philippines has once again proven that it is dominant in the field of broadcasting.

text: Ini matapos nagdaog sang tatlo ka major awards kag nakabaton sang duha ka special citations sa prestihiyoso nga 47th Catholic Mass Media Awards ukon CMMA.
english: This is after winning three major awards and receiving two special citations at the prestigious 47th Catholic Mass Media Awards or CMMA.

text: Ginhingadlan ang flagship newscast sang network nga Bombo Network News bilang Best News Program.
english: The network’s flagship newscast Bombo Network News was named the Best News Program.

text: Isa ini ka back-to-back recognition matapos nakuha man sang amo nga programa ang nasambit man nga pasidungog sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is a back-to-back recognition after the program also won the same award last year.

text: Nakakuha man sang major award ang Bombo Special Report nga ginkilala nga Best Business News.
english: Bombo Special Report also won a major award as Best Business News.

text: Samtang ang Pinoy Memories sang Star FM Iloilo nga nagdaog bilang Best Entertainment Program.
english: Meanwhile, Pinoy Memories of Star FM Iloilo which won as Best Entertainment Program.

text: Nakabaton man ang Bombo Radyo Philippines sang duha ka espesyal nga citation.
english: Nakabaton man ang Bombo Radyo Philippines sang duha ka espesyal nga citation.

text: Ini amo ang Bombo Lifestyle para sa Best Public Service Program kag ang “Istoryang Pasada: Takbo” sang Star FM Manila para sa Best Counseling Program.
english: These are Bombo Lifestyle for Best Public Service Program and Star FM Manila’s “Istoryang Pasada: Takbo” for Best Counseling Program.

text: Sa sini nga 47th Catholic Mass Media Awards, nag-qualify bilang finalists ang mga programa sang Bombo Radyo Philippines sa siyam tanan ka mga kategorya.
english: In this 47th Catholic Mass Media Awards, the programs of Bombo Radyo Philippines qualified as finalists in all nine categories.

text: Ini sa ka pamatuod sang madinalag-on kag masangkad nga presensya sang network sa balita, public affairs, kag entertainment programming.
english: This is in evidence of the network's successful and extensive presence in news, public affairs, and entertainment programming.

text: May iban pa nga programa sang Bombo Radyo nga ginkilala bilang finalists.
english: Other Bombo Radyo programs were recognized as finalists.

text: Finalist ang Bombo News and Views Morning Edition  sang Bombo Radyo Cebu para sa Best News Program.
english: Bombo News and Views Morning Edition of Bombo Radyo Cebu is a finalist for Best News Program.

text: Nalakip man sa finalists ang Bombohanay sa Udto sang Bombo Radyo Cebu para sa Best News Commentary Program.
english: Also among the finalists is Bombohanay sa Udto of Bombo Radyo Cebu for the Best News Commentary Program.

text: Yara man sa listahan  ang Bombo Special Report sang Bombo Radyo Philippines kag The Seven Last Words sang Bombo Radyo Cauayan para sa Best Educational Program.
english: Bombo Radyo Philippines' Bombo Special Report and Bombo Radyo Cauayan's The Seven Last Words are also on the list for Best Educational Program.

text: Nalakip man sa finalists ang It’s All for You in the Morning sang Star FM Bacolod para sa Best Entertainment Program.
english: Star FM Bacolod's It's All for You in the Morning is also among the finalists for Best Entertainment Program.

text: Ang Good Morning Philippines sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Bombohanay Ed Ugto sang Bombo Radyo Dagupan, kag It’s All for You in the Morning sang Star FM Dagupan ang lunsay finalists para sa Best News Feature.
english: Good Morning Philippines of Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Bombohanay Ed Ugto of Bombo Radyo Dagupan, and It's All for You in the Morning of Star FM Dagupan are all finalists for Best News Feature.

text: Ang Sarming Ti Biag sang Bombo Radyo Cauayan finalist man para sa Best Drama Program.
english: Sarming Ti Biag of Bombo Radyo Cauayan is also a finalist for Best Drama Program.

text: Ang Catholic Mass Media Awards gin-establisar sang tuig 1978 ni anay Archbishop Jaime Cardinal Sin.
english: The Catholic Mass Media Awards were established in 1978 by former Archbishop Jaime Cardinal Sin.

text: Ini nga award-giving body nagahatag sang pasidungog sa mga indibidwal kag institusyon nga nagagamit sang media sa pagpasanyog sang kamatuoran.
english: This award-giving body honors individuals and institutions who use the media to promote the truth.

text: Ginahalad sang Bombo Radyo Philippines ini nga mga kadungganan sa tanan nga mga tagpalamati kag tumalan-aw diri sa Pilipinas kag sa iban nga pungsod.
english: Bombo Radyo Philippines offers these awards to all listeners and viewers here in the Philippines and abroad.

text: Kamo ang padayon nga nagahatag inspirasyon sa 32 ka fully digitalized stations nga magdul-ong sang masaligan nga balita, serbisyo publiko, kag mga programa nga nagabulig sa komunidad.
english: You continue to inspire 32 fully digitalized stations to deliver trusted news, public service, and programs that help the community.

text: Nahidlaw ka na bala sa Barbadian pop superstar nga si Rihanna?
english: Have you ever missed Barbadian pop superstar Rihanna?

text: Nakahibalo ka bala nga bisan naka-maternity leave ang 35-anyos nga singer, todo gihapon ang iya team sa pag-“Work, Work, Work!“?
english: Did you know that even though the 35-year-old singer is on maternity leave, her team is still focused on “Work, Work, Work!”?

text: May reports nga nagaguwa nga nagaplano ang hit singer sang iya makahalawat-hawat nga comeback—lakip na ang world tour kag duha ka albums—sa idalom sang ‘million-dollar contract’!
english: Reports are surfacing that the hit singer is planning a spectacular comeback—including a world tour and two albums—under a ‘million-dollar contract’!

text:
Photo: AXELLE/BAUER-GRIFFIN/FILMMAGIC

Ginpahayag nga gina-trabaho ini subong sang iya creative team sa Los Angeles.
english:
Photo: AXELLE/BAUER-GRIFFIN/FILMMAGIC

It is reportedly currently being worked on by his creative team in Los Angeles.

text: Kun matandaan, pito ka tuig ang ginhulat sang fans antes nakit-an liwat si Rihanna sa live show sang Pebrero paagi sa iya nga Super Bowl halftime performance.
english: Fans waited seven years before seeing Rihanna again on a live show in February with her Super Bowl halftime performance.

text: Pagkatapos sang amo nga set, ginkumpirma man sang iya team nga nagabusong ang award-winning singer kag ila ginwelcome ang amo nga baby nga si Riot Rose Mayers sang Agusto.
english: After the set, her team also confirmed that the award-winning singer was pregnant and they welcomed the baby, Riot Rose Mayers, in August.

text: Kilala si Rihanna bilang singer-songwriter, businesswoman, kag actress kag popular sa iya mga ambahanon nga Diamonds, Umbrella, Rude Boy, Work, Don’t Stop the Music, kag madamo nga iban pa.
english: Rihanna is known as a singer-songwriter, businesswoman, and actress and is popular for her songs Diamonds, Umbrella, Rude Boy, Work, Don’t Stop the Music, and many others.

text: Maga-sugod na ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) sa Septyembre subong nga tuig sa pag-apprehend sang mga nagabaligya sang indi rehistrado nga vape products.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will start apprehending sellers of unregistered vape products in September this year.

text: Suno kay Assistant Secretary Amanda Nograles sang Consumer Protection Group sang ahensya, dapat nga subong pa lang, magpa-rehistro na ang vape manufacturers kag importers bangud kun wala sang ICC applications ang produkto ukon ukon wala sang PS license ang manufacturer, ini nga produkto ang indi pagpasudlon sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Assistant Secretary Amanda Nograles of the agency's Consumer Protection Group, vape manufacturers and importers should register now because if the product does not have ICC applications or if the manufacturer does not have a PS license, the product will not be allowed to enter the Philippines.

text: Tubtub Septyembre ang ginhatag nga tyempo — buot silingon, sa amo nga bulan, dapat nabaligya na tanan ang daan nga inventory.
english: The deadline is September — that is, by that month, all the old inventory must have been sold.

text: Sang Abril, matandaan nga nag-report ang ahensya nga naka-kumpiskar ini sang illegal vape products nga naglab-ot sa balor nga P31 million.
english: In April, the agency reported that it had seized illegal vape products worth P31 million.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagapakig-angot man ang ahensya sa local government units kag civil organizations agud nga mas mapahibalo sa publiko ang risgo nga dala sang vapes.
english: Meanwhile, the agency is also working with local government units and civil organizations to raise public awareness of the risks posed by vapes.

text: Kasunod ini sang na-report nga may isa ka menor de edad nga napatay bangud sa severe lung injury nga resulta sang paggamit sini sang vape sa sulod sang duha ka tuig.
english: This follows the reported death of a minor due to severe lung injury resulting from his use of vape for two years.

text: ILOILO – Ginabantayan sang Philippine National Police (PNP) ang ‘vote buying’ sa Western Visayas samtang nagahilapit ang May 13 midterm election.
english: ILOILO – The Philippine National Police (PNP) is monitoring vote buying in Western Visayas as the May 13 midterm election approaches.

text:
Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Brigadier General John Bulalacao, Director sang Police Regional Office (PRO) 6, iya ginpahayag nga magluwas sa ‘intense political rivalry’ kag presensya sang New People’s Army (NPA) kag Private Armed

Groups, sakop man sa ila katungdanan amo ang pagbantay kun bala sanday sin-o nga mga pulitiko ang nagapamakal sang boto.
english:
In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Brigadier General John Bulalacao, Director of the Police Regional Office (PRO) 6, said that besides the 'intense political rivalry' and the presence of the New People's Army (NPA) and Private Armed

Groups, also included in their duty is to monitor which politicians are buying votes.

text: Ginpahayag ni Bulalacao nga may yara siya sang nabaton nga impormasyon nga may mga pulitiko nga nagapamakal sang boto paagi sa paghatag sang groceries kag kwarta nga may dala pa nga sample ballots.
english: Bulalacao said he has received information that some politicians are buying votes by giving groceries and money with sample ballots.

text: Nagpamalibad ang Regional Director nga ihingadlan kun ano nga mga lugar ang may yara sang madata nga ‘vote buying’.
english: The Regional Director declined to name which areas have the most vote buying.

text: Panugyan ni Bulalacao sa publiko, batunon lang ang ginahatag sang pulitiko apang botohon ang nahamut-an nga kandidato.
english: Bulalacao advised the public to accept what the politician gives them but vote for the candidate they like.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag sang natungdan sa isa ka Press Conference nga iya ipausisa ang ginapahayag pagpamakal sang boto sang pamilya Garin sang 1st district kag Biron sang 4th District sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Earlier, he said in a press conference that he will investigate the alleged vote buying of the Garin family of the 1st district and the Biron family of the 4th district in Iloilo province.

text: Santo sa nagalapta nga laragway, makit-an ang campaign materials ni Iloilo 4th District Cong.
english: According to the circulating picture, the campaign materials of Iloilo 4th District Cong.

text: Ferjenel Biron kag anay Department of Health (DOH) Sec.
english: Ferjenel Biron and former Department of Health (DOH) Sec.

text: Janette Garin nga ginpadukot sa bihon samtang ginpadukot naman sa sardinas ang campaign material ni Vice Gov.
english: Janette Garin who was attached to the bihon while the campaign material of Vice Gov.

text: Christine Garin.
english: Christine Garin.

text: Nahibaluan nga una na nga ginpahayag sang COMELEC nga hugot nga ginadumili-an ang vote buying paagi sa paghatag sang groceries, kwarta ukon anu man nga butang kabaylo sang boto.
english: It is known that the COMELEC earlier said that vote buying by giving groceries, money or anything else in exchange for votes is strictly prohibited.

text:
Yari ang nauna nga pahayag ni Bulalacao sa Press Conference tuhoy sa ginapahayag vote buying sang pamilya Garin kag Brion:

Samtang, yari naman ang pahayag ni Bulalacao tuhoy sa pagbantay sa vote buying:
english:
Here is Bulalacao's earlier statement at the Press Conference on the alleged vote buying of the Garin and Brion families:

text: Pilason ang konduktor sang EDSA Bus Carousel matapos ginkagat sang makapila ka beses sang pasahero nga may mental disorder sa Guadalupe, Makati City.
english: The conductor of the EDSA Bus Carousel was injured after being bitten several times by a passenger with a mental disorder in Guadalupe, Makati City.

text: Suno sa konduktor nga si Ricky De Guzman, naghalin sa Quezon City ang pasahero.
english: According to conductor Ricky De Guzman, the passenger was coming from Quezon City.

text: Pag-abot sa Guadalupe, nakit-an niya nga ginhanaan nga kagton sang pasahero ang isa ka bata nga pasahero gani iya ini ginpalapitan apang siya ang ginkagat sa butkon kag likod.
english: When he arrived in Guadalupe, he saw that the passenger was trying to bite a child passenger so he approached him but he was bitten in the arm and back.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginpahibalo sang konduktor sa mga tinawo sang Coast Guard ang hitabo kag pa-abot sa bus stop, nagresponde ang mga ini apang madasig nga nagdalagan agud magpalagyo ang lalaki.
english: The conductor immediately informed the Coast Guard personnel of the incident and upon arrival at the bus stop, they responded but the man quickly ran away.

text: Nagpadulong naman si De Guzman sa ospital para magpatublok sang rabies vaccine.
english: De Guzman went to the hospital to get a rabies vaccine.

text: Ginkumpirma naman sang pamilya sang lalaki nga siya man ang nag-viral sadto bangud sa pagpangagat sa sulod man sang bus.
english: The man's family confirmed that he also became viral because of the bite inside the bus.

text: Nagpamatok gid ang transport cooperatives kag taxi operators sa Iloilo City sa pagpasulod sang mga Blue Taxis sa syudad.
english: Transport cooperatives and taxi operators in Iloilo City have strongly opposed the entry of Blue Taxis into the city.

text: Ini matapos gin-grant sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang operasyon sa syudad sang kapin 100 units sang taxi sang duwa ka Davao -based companies.
english: This is after the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) granted the operation in the city of more than 100 units of taxis to two Davao-based companies.

text: Suno sa mga asosasyon sang mga taxi operators, ginkibot lang sila sa desisyon kag wala sila ginkonsulta antes gin-aprobahan ang aplikasyon sang Blue Taxis.
english: Taxi operators’ associations said they were taken by surprise by the decision and were not consulted before Blue Taxis’ application was approved.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo Parcon, Chairman sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC), indi sila magpasugot sa pagsulod sang Blue Taxis bangud damo na ang mga existing taxis sa Iloilo City kag amo man ang presensya sang mga Grab units.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raymundo Parcon, Chairman of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC), said they will not allow the entry of Blue Taxis because there are many existing taxis in Iloilo City and also the presence of Grab units.

text: Nagpabutyag man ang iban nga transport cooperatives nga naga-operate kaangay sang PUJ (public utility jeepneys), bangud posible nga maapektuhan ang ila biyahe kag pangabuhian.
english: Other transport cooperatives that operate such as PUJ (public utility jeepneys) also expressed concern that their travel and livelihood may be affected.

text: Suno kay Parcon, kung padayunon pa ang pagdugang sang mga bag-o nga taxi units, mas mangin mabudlay para sa mga kasubong nila nga traditional taxi operators nga maki-pagkompetensya bangud nagakaapektuhan ang transport sectors sa syudad.
english: According to Parcon, if the addition of new taxi units continues, it will be more difficult for their fellow traditional taxi operators to compete because the transport sectors in the city will be affected.

text: ILOILO – Gina-engganyo sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) ang tanan nga magboto sa May 13 midterm elections.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) is urging everyone to vote in the May 13 midterm elections.

text: Sa intrerview sang Bombo Radyo kay COMELEC-6 Regional Director Atty. Jose Nick Mendros, iya ginpahayag nga ang pagboto ang isa ka sagrado nga kinamatarong sang tanan nga tawo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, COMELEC-6 Regional Director Atty. Jose Nick Mendros, he said that voting is a sacred right of all people.

text: Sa adlaw sang May 13, ang mga polling precints ang magabukas 6:00 sang aga kag magatakop 6:00 sang hapon.
english: On May 13, polling precincts will open at 6:00 am and close at 6:00 pm.

text: Mas makapaayo suno kay Mendros kun magpadulong sa polling precints sa mas temprano kag indi na paghulaton ang hapon sa pagboto.
english: Mendros said it would be better to go to the polling precincts earlier and not wait for the afternoon to vote.

text: Kadungan sini, nagpahanumdom man si Atty. Mendros tuhoy sa vote buying ukon pagpamakal sang boto.
english: At the same time, Atty. Mendros about vote buying.

text: Ginpahayag ni Mendros nga ginadumili-an ang vote buying apang nakadepende naman sa mga botante kun magpadala sa ginatanyag sang pulitiko.
english: Mendros said vote buying is prohibited but it is up to the voters whether to give in to the politician's offer.

text: Sa ulihi suno sa Regional Director ang mga pumuluyo man sa gihapon ang maga-agunto bangud sa sala nga pulitiko nga ginboto sa adlaw sang eleksyon.
english: In the end, according to the Regional Director, the people will still suffer because of the wrong politician voted for on election day.

text: Ginakabig nga sideline sang pila ka mga pumuluyo ang pagpaminta sa mga pantyon sa Tanza Public Cemetery sa tion sang pista minatay.
english: Some residents consider it a sideline to paint the graves at the Tanza Public Cemetery during the feast of the dead.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Devon, naga-sideline paminta sa nasambit nga patyo kag residente sang Zone 2, Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Devon, a resident of Zone 2, Brgy.

text: Tanza-Timawa, City Proper, iya ginpahayag nga isa gid siya ka pintor sang mga condominium kun sa diin kada hapon magtapos ang iya ubra nagaderikta ini sa patyo agud buligan ang iya amay nga magpinta sang mga pantyon bilang dugang man sa iya income.
english: Tanza-Timawa, City Proper, he said he is a painter of condominiums where every afternoon after his work he goes straight to the courtyard to help his father paint the graves as an addition to his income.

text: Pahayag niya, 20 na ka tuig nila ginahimo sang iya amay ang pagpaminta sa mga patyo.Suno sa iya, isa ka libo ang ila sukot sa kada pantyon apang nakadepende pa ini kun may yara pa gid sang dugang nga ipaubra ang ila customer.
english: He said he and his father have been painting the cemeteries for 20 years. He said they charge 1,000 pesos for each grave but it depends on whether their customer has anything else to do.

text: Dugang niya nga indi man daku ang ila gid nga kita sa pagpaminta bangud nga tuman na gid ka mahal ang mga materyales kag indi man sila ka pataas pa gid sa presyo sa labor kay wala man sang mapahimu sa ila.
english: He added that they do not have much income from painting because the materials are very expensive and they cannot increase the price of labor because there is nothing to do with them.

text: Sa separado naman nga interview kay Ian, isa man nga naga-sideline paminta sa nasambit nga patyo, iya ginpahayag nga lima na ka tuig niya ini ginahimu bilang dugang man sa iya nga kita.
english: In a separate interview with Ian, another sideline pepper grower in the said cemetery, he said he has been doing this for five years as an additional income.

text: Pahayag niya nga magtapos ang pista minatay, mabalik naman ini siya sa pagbaligya sang mga prutas sa City Proper.
english: He said that after the festival of the dead, he will return to selling fruits in City Proper.

text: Apang, ginpahayag sini nga sa subong magamay pa lang ang ila kita bangud nga wala pa gid sang madamo nga nagabisita sa patyo kag nagapaubra sa ila.
english: However, he said that at present their income is still small because there are not many people who visit the cemetery and employ them.

text: Dugang pa niya, may yara man sila sang mga suki nga nagabalik-balik sa ila kada tuig.
english: He added that they also have repeat customers every year.

text: Ginalauman gid sang mga sepulturero kag pintor sa nasambit nga patyo nga magadamo pa ang ila kita subong nga tuig sang pista minatay.
english: The gravediggers and painters in the cemetery are hoping to increase their income this year during the feast of the dead.

text: Magluwas sa mga sepulturero kag pintor, may yara man sang mga kabataan sa patyo nga naga-sideline panglimpyo para sa ila pangkaon ukon dugang sa ila balon sa eskwelahan.
english: Besides the gravediggers and painters, there are also children in the courtyard who sideline cleaning for their food or to supplement their school supplies.

text: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂
english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂

text: Nangin ultimate head-turner ang Brazilian-Filipino beauty queen nga si Nikki de Moura sa evening gown kag swimsuit segments sang Miss Grand International 2023 preliminaries!
english: Brazilian-Filipino beauty queen Nikki de Moura became the ultimate head-turner in the evening gown and swimsuit segments of the Miss Grand International 2023 preliminaries!

text: Suksok sang Filipina beauty queen ang deep neckline trumpet gown nga creation ni Rian Fernandez kun sa diin featured ang lain-lain nga shades sang pink, glitters, kag sheer overskirt.
english: The Filipina beauty queen wore a deep neckline trumpet gown created by Rian Fernandez which featured different shades of pink, glitters, and a sheer overskirt.

text:
Photo: Miss Grand International (Live)

Sa detalye, ginpahayag nga ang duag sang gown ang nagapakita sang “majesty kag femininity.”

Nagdugang pa sa katahum sang long gown ni Nikki ang iya suksok nga dangling earrings, smokey eye makeup, kag ang signature curly hair nga amo man ang bida diri sa Miss Grand-Philippines.
english:
Photo: Miss Grand International (Live)

In detail, it was stated that the color of the gown reflected “majesty and femininity.”

Adding to the beauty of Nikki's long gown were her dangling earrings, smokey eye makeup, and signature curly hair that is also the heroine of Miss Grand-Philippines.

text: Sa swimwear competition, nagapangibabaw man si Nikki sa amo gihapon nga accessories, makeup, kag hairstyle.
english: In the swimwear competition, Nikki also dominates with the same accessories, makeup, and hairstyle.

text: Patigayunon ang Miss Grand International coronation sa Oktubre 25 sa Vietnam kun sa diin igatugyan ni Isabella Menin sang Brazil ang iya nga korona sa iya mangin successor.
english: The Miss Grand International coronation will be held on October 25 in Vietnam where Isabella Menin of Brazil will hand over her crown to her successor.

text: Wala pa nakaagi daog ang Pilipinas sang “golden crown” halin sang nagsugod ang amo nga Thailand-based international pageant sang 2013.
english: The Philippines has not won the golden crown since the Thailand-based international pageant began in 2013.

text: Ang highest placers sang pungsod sa amo nga event amo sanday Nicole Cordoves kag Samantha Bernardo nga pareho nga nangin first runner-up sang 2016 kag 2021.
english: The country’s highest placers in the event were Nicole Cordoves and Samantha Bernardo who were both first runner-up in 2016 and 2021 respectively.

text: Isa ka van nga magadul-ong kuntani sang karga sini nga bangkay ang nagkalayo samtang yara sa karsada sa Amlan, Negros Oriental.
english: A van that was supposed to carry his body caught fire while on the road in Amlan, Negros Oriental.

text: Una diri, madasig nga nagpanaog ang mga sakay sini matapos nga nag-aso ang salakyan kag makaligad ang pila ka minutos, nagkalayo na ini.
english: Earlier, the occupants quickly got out after the vehicle caught fire and minutes later, it was on fire.

text: Natigayon naman nga mapapanaog ang bangkay bag-o ginlamon sang kalayo ang salakyan.
english: The body was lowered before the vehicle was engulfed in flames.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga battery sang sasakyan ang ginhalinan sang sunog.
english: Investigation revealed that the fire was caused by a vehicle battery.

text: Ginahulat sang Chairman sang Committee on Transportation sa Iloilo City Council ang sabat sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) sa iya ginpadala nga sulat kaangot sa mga blue taxi sa siyudad.
english: The Chairman of the Committee on Transportation in the Iloilo City Council is waiting for the response of the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) to his letter regarding blue taxis in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, iya ginpahayag nga luyag niya mahibaluan kun ano kag paano na-determine sang amo nga opisina nga kinahanglan pa sang siyudad sang dugang nga mga taxi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Sedfrey Cabaluna, he said he wants to know what and how the office determined that the city needs more taxis.

text: Suno kay Cabaluna, ulihi na niya nahibaluan nga may 100 ka mga unit sang blue taxi nga magaabot sa siyudad bangud wala sang natabo nga koordinasyon sa iya opisina kag Local Government Unit (LGU).
english: According to Cabaluna, he later learned that there are 100 units of blue taxis that will arrive in the city because there was no coordination between his office and the Local Government Unit (LGU).

text: Dugang ni Cabaluna, isa ini sa mga ginakabalak-an sang Association of Taxi Operators of Panay (ATOP) kag iban pa nga mga sektor sang transportasyon nga mahimo makaapekto sa ila palangabuhian.
english: Cabaluna added that this is one of the concerns of the Association of Taxi Operators of Panay (ATOP) and other transportation sectors that could affect their livelihoods.

text: Nagpaguwa ang Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) sang pagsulundan sang swelduhanay sa private sector employees kadungan sang pag-obserbar sang Eid’l Adha subong nga adlaw, Hunyo 17.
english: The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) has issued salary guidelines for private sector employees in conjunction with the observance of Eid'l Adha today, June 17.

text: Sa idalom sang Labor Advisory Number 08, ang mga empleyado nga maga-report sa trabaho subong nga adlaw ang makabaton sang doble ukon 200 percent sang ila sweldo sa nauna nga walo ka oras.
english: Under Labor Advisory Number 08, employees who report to work today will receive double or 200 percent of their salary for the previous eight hours.

text: Kun maglapaw, magabayad ang employer sang dugang nga 30% sa rate sang kada oras sa amo nga adlaw.
english: If exceeded, the employer will pay an additional 30% of the hourly rate for that day.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, makabaton naman sang 100% sang sweldo ang mga indi magtrabaho subong nga adlaw sa kondisyon nga naka-report sa trabaho ukon naka-file sang leave of absence with pay sa adlaw antes ang regular holiday.
english: On the other hand, those who will not work today will receive 100% of their salary on condition that they report to work or file leave of absence with pay on the day before the regular holiday.

text: Pananglitan rest day subong sang empleyado, mahimo ini nga basic wage x 200 percent x 130 percent.
english: For example, the employee's current rest day, this could be basic wage x 200 percent x 130 percent.

text: Ang Eid’l Adha isa sa duha ka importante nga tion sa Muslim calendar nga amo ang nagamarka sang pagtakop sang holy fast sa bulan sang Ramadan.
english: Eid’l Adha is one of two important times in the Muslim calendar that marks the end of the holy fast in the month of Ramadan.

text: Gindeklarar ini ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: This was declared by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga isa ka regular holiday sa bilog nga pungsod paagi sa Proclamation 579, Series of 2024.
english: which is a regular holiday nationwide through Proclamation 579, Series of 2024.

text: Napilian ang Pilipinas nga mag-host sang 2024 Asian Volleyball Confederation (AVC) Challenge Cup for Women sa Mayo 22-29.
english: The Philippines has been selected to host the 2024 Asian Volleyball Confederation (AVC) Challenge Cup for Women on May 22-29.

text: 11 ka Asian teams lakip na ang Pilipinas bilang host nation ang magapaindis-indis sa Challenge Cup.
english: 11 Asian teams including the Philippines as the host nation will compete in the Challenge Cup.

text: Ulihi ini nga nadag-an sang Vietnam sang 2022 kag una nga nadag-an sang Hong Kong sa inaugural staging sang tournament sang 2021.
english: It was last won by Vietnam in 2022 and first won by Hong Kong in the inaugural staging of the tournament in 2021.

text: Bangud nagapadayon pa subong ang professional kag collegiate volleyball tournaments sa pungsod, ginalauman nga mahingadlan ang women’s national team roster sinemana antes ang kumpetisyon.
english: With professional and collegiate volleyball tournaments still ongoing in the country, the women’s national team roster is expected to be named a week before the competition.

text: Indi pa subong klaro kun ang magabug-os sa Philippine team ang lunsay halin sa kolehiyo ukon may pilion man halin sa Premier Volleyball League (PVL) stars ukon kumbinasyon sang mga estudyante kag professional.
english: It is not yet clear whether the Philippine team will be composed of college players or Premier Volleyball League (PVL) stars or a combination of students and professionals.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, hiwaton ang Challenge Cup sa Rizal Memorial Coliseum sa Manila.
english: According to initial information, the Challenge Cup will be held at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum in Manila.

text: Madumduman nga sa labing-una nga pagpasakop sang Pilipinas sang nagligad nga tuig, ang Akari Chargers nga ginpangunahan sang anay national team head coach nga si Jorge Souza de Brito ang gin-tap agud magtiglawas sa pungsod nga may reinforcements halin sa iban nga professional volleyball players kag collegiate teams.
english: It can be recalled that in the Philippines' first participation last year, the Akari Chargers led by former national team head coach Jorge Souza de Brito were tapped to represent the country with reinforcements from other professional volleyball players and collegiate teams.

text: Tatlo ka daog ang nakuha sang nationals kag apat ka kalutusan, lakip ang four-set win batok sa Uzbekistan agud makuha ang pagpito nga pwesto sa 11-team field.
english: The nationals had three wins and four losses, including a four-set win over Uzbekistan to take seventh place in the 11-team field.

text: CARLES, ILOILO – Gin-akusaran sang isa ka mayoralty candidate sa Carles, Iloilo nga ginagamit sang incumbent mayor ang Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4P’s) sang gobyerno sa pamulitika.
english: CARLES, ILOILO – A mayoralty candidate in Carles, Iloilo has accused the incumbent mayor of using the government's Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4P's) in politics.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay mayoralty candidate Merly Tupas sang nasambit nga banwa, iya ginpahayag nga dapat indi magpagamit ang mga 4P’s beneficiary sa pulitiko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, mayoralty candidate Merly Tupas of the said town said that 4P's beneficiaries should not use politics.

text: May yara sang  parent leaders suno kay Tupas nga nagapanghatag sang mga sample ballot kag ginapa-shade ang numero ni Mayor Siegfredo ‘Salagunting’ Betita.
english: Tupas said there are parent leaders who distribute sample ballots and shade the number of Mayor Siegfredo 'Salagunting' Betita.

text: Suno kay Tupas, ang nasambit nga tikang ang kaangay sang mind conditioning sa mga botante.
english: According to Tupas, the move is like mind conditioning among voters.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, ang paggamit sang 4Ps sa pamulitika ang indi nagakadapat bangud indi man ini programa sang pulitiko sa baylo iya sang gobyerno.
english: He added that the use of 4Ps in politics is not appropriate because it is not a politician's program but the government's.

text: Gina-sigurado na sang Department of Energy (DOE) nga indi magpalya ang power distribution facilities bilang preparasyon sa La Niña sa Pilipinas sa masunod nga binulan.
english: The Department of Energy (DOE) is ensuring that power distribution facilities will not fail in preparation for La Niña in the Philippines next month.

text: Bangud sa ginalantaw nga indi kinaandan nga pagbubo sang ulan, posible suno kay Energy Secretary Raphael Lotilla nga maapektuhan gid sang baha ang distribution facilities.
english: Due to the expected unusual rainfall, Energy Secretary Raphael Lotilla said it is possible that distribution facilities will be severely affected by flooding.

text: Suno naman kay DOE Assistant Secretary Mario Marasigan, indi mangin problema ang power supply apang ang transmission kag ang distribution facilities ang makabig nga vulnerable sa sini nga sahi sang extreme weather conditions.
english: DOE Assistant Secretary Mario Marasigan said power supply will not be a problem but transmission and distribution facilities are vulnerable to this type of extreme weather conditions.

text: Gin-ako man sang opisyal nga may kabudlayan man sila sa pagbalik sa suplay sang kuryente kun may baha bangud mas ginahatagan sang prayoridad ang safety kag nagasunod lamang ang energization.
english: The official also acknowledged that they also have difficulty in restoring electricity supply during floods because safety is given more priority and energization follows.

text: Isa naman sa ginalantaw nga benepisyo sang tag-ulan amo nga mapuno sang ulan ang reservoirs sang hydroelectric plants nga nagnubo anay ang mga lebel bangud sa El Niño.
english: Another expected benefit of the rainy season is that rain will fill the reservoirs of hydroelectric plants whose levels have dropped due to El Niño.

text: Ginalantaw suno kay Marasigan nga 15,000 megawatts ang mangin available kun magbalik na sa normal nga operasyon ang ininga hydroelectric plants.
english: Marasigan said it is expected that 15,000 megawatts will be available when these hydroelectric plants return to normal operation.

text: Bangud nga amat-amat naman nagabugnaw ang temperaturakasunod sang deklarasyon nga nagsugod na ang rainy season, may nakit-an man ang ahensya nga pagnubo sa electricity demand.
english: As the temperature gradually cooled following the declaration of the beginning of the rainy season, the agency also saw a decrease in electricity demand.

text: Madumduman nga madamo nga power plants ang naka-eksperyensya sang outage nga rason sang yellow kag red alerts sang naglinigad nga binulan.
english: It can be recalled that many power plants experienced outages due to yellow and red alerts last month.

text: Ini nga mga planta ang nagbalik na sa serbisyo sandig pa sa anunsyo sang energy department.
english: These plants have returned to service according to the announcement of the energy department.

text: Handa si former Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen.
english: Handa is former Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III nga arestuhon ang iya former boss nga si Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa kun manduan siya sang isa ka opisyal ukon kun halin pa sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ang mando.
english: Nicolas Torre III to arrest his former boss Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa if he is ordered by an official or if the order comes from the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Suno kay Torre, bilang isa ka professional police officer, nagatrabaho siya agud magsunod sa kun ano ang ginasugo sa iya.
english: Torre said that as a professional police officer, he works to follow what he is ordered to do.

text: Ini nga pahayag ni Torre ang may kaangtanan sa ginsiling ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla nga nakabaton na ini sang kopya sang ICC arrest warrant batok kay dela Rosa bangud sa ginaalegar krimen nga naangot sa drug war sang siya pa ang Davao City police official kag nangin PNP chief sa idalom ni former president Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Torre's statement comes in response to Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla's statement that he has received a copy of the ICC arrest warrant against dela Rosa for alleged crimes related to the drug war when he was a Davao City police official and became PNP chief under former president Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala pa nakahimo sang iya public appearance si dela Rosa humalin sang naggwa ang report angot sa warrant halin sa ICC.
english: It is known that dela Rosa has not made his public appearance since the report on the warrant from the ICC came out.

text: Nagapanguna si Robert Bolick sang NLEX Road Warriors sa karera para sa Best Player of the Conference sa 2024 PBA Philippine Cup.
english: Robert Bolick leads the NLEX Road Warriors in the race for Best Player of the Conference in the 2024 PBA Philippine Cup.

text: Siya man subong ang best scorer kag playmaker sa liga nga may average nga 29.5 points kag 7.2 assists, kun sa diin nabulsa sini ang 49.2 statistical points agud pangunahan ang iban nga basketball stars sa amo nga kategorya.
english: He is also currently the best scorer and playmaker in the league with an average of 29.5 points and 7.2 assists, where he pocketed 49.2 statistical points to lead other basketball stars in that category.

text: Nagapangaduha si Arvin Tolentino sang NorthPort nga may 43.6 statistical points matapos nakatipon sang 24.0 points, 7.6 rebounds, kag 5.0 assists per outing sa lima ka mga hampang.
english: NorthPort’s Arvin Tolentino is second with 43.6 statistical points after compiling 24.0 points, 7.6 rebounds, and 5.0 assists per outing in five games.

text: Iban pa sa balantayan nga pangalan amo ang star rookie sang TerraFirma nga si Stephen Holt; ang seven-time PBA Most Valuable Player nga si June Mar Fajardo; kag ang Rain or Shine stalwart nga si Leonard Santillan.#
english: Other names to watch include TerraFirma star rookie Stephen Holt; seven-time PBA Most Valuable Player June Mar Fajardo; and Rain or Shine stalwart Leonard Santillan.#

text: Nagbungguanay sa Opo Wharf sa Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu ang duha ka barko.
english: The two ships collided at Opo Wharf in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu.

text: Ini amo ang M/V Star Zamboanga sang Roble Shipping Inc.
english: This is the M/V Star Zamboanga of Roble Shipping Inc.

text: kag M/V Filipinas Dapitan sang Cokaliong Shipping Lines.
english: and M/V Filipinas Dapitan of Cokaliong Shipping Lines.

text: Ginpahayag nga nadulaan sang kontrol ang cargo vessel nga M/V Star Zamboanga nga nangin rason kun nga nabungguan sini ang RORO Passenger Vessel na M/V Filipinas Dapitan.
english: The cargo vessel M/V Star Zamboanga reportedly lost control and collided with the RORO Passenger Vessel M/V Filipinas Dapitan.

text: Wala naman sang na-report nga napilasan sa insidente.
english: No injuries were reported in the incident.

text:
Nagtaliwan na bangud sa cancer ang 76-anyos nga American football great nga si Orenthal James Simpson ukon mas kilala nga si O.J.

Isa si Simpson ka cultural icon nga kilala sa football field kag sang ulihi pati na sa mga pelikula kag mangin sa commercials.
english:
76-year-old American football great Orenthal James Simpson or better known as O.J.

Simpson was a cultural icon known on the football field and later in movies and even in commercials.

text: Apang sang 1994, natabo ang mas nagpalakaak pa sang iya pangalan — ang kamatayon sang iya anay asawa nga si Nicole Brown Simpson kag iya abyan nga si Ronald Goldman.
english: But in 1994, something happened that tarnished his name even more — the deaths of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ronald Goldman.

text: Si O.J. ang gintudlo nga suspek sang amo nga tion apang gin-acquit sa Los Angeles jury — isa ka hitabo nga ginalaragway sang kadam-an nga “trial of the century” bangud sa tuman ka interesante nga kaso nga gintutukan sang minilyon nga mg Amerikano.
english: The O.J. the designated suspect at the time but was acquitted in a Los Angeles jury — an event widely described as the “trial of the century” due to the extremely interesting case that millions of Americans focused on.

text: Sa amo nga kaso naglibot ang istorya sang halos tanan nga media sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika: isa ka manggaranon nga celebrity defendant; Black man nga gin-akusahan sa pagpatay sa iya maputi nga anay asawa bangud sa pagpangimon; misis nga ginpatay bangud sa pag-file sang divorce sa mister nga nagasakit sa iya; ang “dream team” sang charismatic nga defense lawyers; kag ang daku nga kahuy-anan sa prosecutors.
english: In such a case revolved the story of almost all the media in the United States of America: a wealthy celebrity defendant; Black man accused of killing white ex-wife out of jealousy; wife killed for filing for divorce from abusive husband; the “dream team” of charismatic defense lawyers; kag ang daku nga kahuy-anan sa prosecutors.

text: Sang amo nga tion, madamo nga Black Americans ang nag-selebrar sang pag-acquit sa iya sang korte bangud nagapati sila nga gin-frame lamang si O.J. sang puti nga “racist” nga mga pulis; samtang ginkaakig naman ini sang white Americans.
english: At the time, many Black Americans celebrated the court’s acquittal because they believed O.J. sang puti nga “racist” nga mga pulis; while white Americans were outraged.

text: Masobra isa ka dekada matapos ang amo nga kaso, napreso man gihapon si Simpson sa sulod sang siyam ka tuig sa Nevada matapos na-convict sang 2008 sa 12 counts sang armed robbery kag kidnapping sa duha ka sports memorabilia dealers sa gunpoint sa Las Vegas hotel.
english: More than a decade after that case, Simpson is still in prison for nine years in Nevada after being convicted in 2008 of 12 counts of armed robbery and kidnapping of two sports memorabilia dealers at gunpoint in a Las Vegas hotel.

text: Napaguwa siya sang 2017 paagi sa parole kag ginsaylo sa bantay-sarado gihapon nga lugar sa Las Vegas.
english: He was released in 2017 on parole and transferred to the still-guarded Las Vegas facility.

text: Nahatagan ini sang temprano nga release sang 2021 sa edad nga 74 bangud sa iya maayo nga paggawi samtang ginabantayan sang otoridad.
english: He was granted early release in 2021 at the age of 74 for his good behavior while in law enforcement custody.

text: Ang mga hitabo sa iya kabuhi ang nakabutang sa Oscar-winning 2016 documentary nga “O.J.: Made in America” amo man sa nagkalain-lain nga TV dramatizations.#
english: Events from his life were featured in the Oscar-winning 2016 documentary “O.J.: Made in America” as well as in various TV dramatizations.#

text: Lima ka adlaw na nga wala naka-kontak sa iya pamilya ang Miss Grand Philippines 2023 candidate nga si Catherine Camilon.
english: Miss Grand Philippines 2023 candidate Catherine Camilon has not been able to contact her family for five days.

text: Nagpangayo sang bulig ang iya utod nga si Chin-Chin agud nga makit-an ang 26-anyos nga beauty queen.
english: Her brother Chin-Chin asked for help to find the 26-year-old beauty queen.

text: Ginpahayag nga Oktubre 12 pa ini ulihi nga naka-communicate sa iya pamilya kag naglisensya nga makadto sa Batangas City para may tabuon.
english: He reportedly last communicated with his family on October 12 and gave permission to go to Batangas City for a meeting.

text: Naka-update ini nga yara na siya sa gasolinahan sa Bauan, Batangas, apang makaligad ang pila ka oras, indi na ini matawagan kag patay na ang cellphone.
english: He was updated that he was at the gas station in Bauan, Batangas, but after a few hours, he could not be called and the cellphone was dead.

text: Sa Miss Grand Philippines 2023 pageant, gintiglawas ni Camilon ang Tuy, Batangas, kag ang ginkoronahan naman amo si Nikki de Moura sang Cagayan de Oro.
english: In the Miss Grand Philippines 2023 pageant, Camilon represented Tuy, Batangas, while Nikki de Moura of Cagayan de Oro was crowned.

text: Magluwas nga beauty queen, isa man si Camilon ka model kag public school teacher sa Batangas.#
english: Besides being a beauty queen, Camilon is also a model and public school teacher in Batangas.

text: BAROTAC NUEVO, ILOILO — Nauwi sa trahedya ang pagtatalo ng magkapatid matapos barilin ng isang lalaki ang kanyang kakambal sa Sitio Dawis, Barangay Lagubang, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.
english: BAROTAC NUEVO, ILOILO — A man shot his twin brother in Sitio Dawis, Barangay Lagubang, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.

text: Kinilala ang suspek na si Alfonso, 56 taong gulang, residente ng Barangay Tubungan sa nasabing bayan.
english: The suspect was identified as Alfonso, 56 years old, resident of Barangay Tubungan in the said town.

text: Ang biktima naman ay kinilalang si Zaldy.
english: The victim was identified as Zaldy.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Jersey Besas, Officer-in-Charge ng Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station, sinabi niyang nagtungo si Zaldy sa kanilang ancestral house matapos mabalitaan na naroon si Alfonso.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Captain Jersey Besas, Officer-in-Charge of Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station, said Zaldy went to their ancestral house after hearing that Alfonso was there.

text: Nagkaroon umano ng mainitang pagtatalo ang magkapatid na nauwi sa pisikal na komprontasyon.
english: The brothers allegedly had a heated argument that ended in a physical confrontation.

text: Matapos ang sagupaan, umalis si Alfonso, kumuha ng baril sa loob ng bahay, at saka binaril ang kapatid sa ulo at dibdib.
english: After the fight, Alfonso left, got a gun inside the house, and then shot his brother in the head and chest.

text: Agad namang isinugod ang biktima sa ospital ngunit idineklarang dead on arrival ng mga doktor.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital but was declared dead on arrival by doctors.

text: Ayon sa imbestigasyon, nag-ugat ang alitan ng magkapatid sa isyu ng poste ng Wi-Fi na umano’y itinayo sa lupang pag-aari ng kanilang pamilya.
english: According to the investigation, the quarrel between the brothers stemmed from the issue of a Wi-Fi pole that was allegedly erected on land owned by their family.

text: Nahaharap na si Alfonso sa kasong homicide, at posibleng madagdagan pa ito ng kasong illegal possession of firearms habang patuloy ang imbestigasyon ng mga awtoridad.
english: Alfonso is already facing charges of homicide, and it is possible that he will be charged with illegal possession of firearms while the investigation of the authorities continues.

text: Ginpakita sang Vatican ang itsura sang pantyon ni Pope Francis sa Basilica of St.
english: The Vatican has revealed the appearance of Pope Francis' tomb in the Basilica of St.

text: Mary Major, ang Roman Basilica nga ginhingyo sang Santo Papa sa iya last will nga amo ang iya mangin katapusan nga palahuwayan.
english: Mary Major, the Roman Basilica that the Pope requested in his last will to be his final resting place.

text: Simple lamang ang lulubngan nga human sa materyales halin sa rehiyon sang Liguria sa Italya.
english: The tomb was simple, made of materials from the Ligurian region of Italy.

text: May nakabutang sa pantyon nga pangalan nga “Franciscus” kag reproduction sang pectoral cross sang nagtaliwan nga 88-anyos nga Santo Papa.
english: The tomb bears the name “Franciscus” and a reproduction of the pectoral cross of the late 88-year-old Pope.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa Cogorno sa Liguria region sa Italya nagdaku ang great grandfather ni Pope Francis nga si Vincenzo Sivori.
english: Pope Francis' great grandfather, Vincenzo Sivori, grew up in Cogorno in the Liguria region of Italy.

english: The Department of Science and Technology-Industrial Technology Development Institute (DOST-ITDI) has developed flavored salt and seasoning as part of measures to revive the salt industry in the country.

text: Suno kay Dr. Anabelle Briones, director sang institute, ang katuyuan sang ila pag-develop sang mga makina amo nga mapadasig ang produksyon sang asin kag pataason pa ang value sini paagi sa nagkalain-lain nga flavor.
english: According to Dr. Anabelle Briones, director of the institute, the purpose of their development of the machines is to speed up the production of salt and increase its value through different flavors.

english: Among the ingredients used by the agency are umami tastants that are locally available such as green seaweed or lato, shitake mushrooms, and the shrimp head.

text: Ini nga ingredients suno kay Briones ang manggaranon sa glutamic acid nga amo ang nagapanami sa sabor.

text: Naghingyo si Veronica “Kitty” Duterte sa Korte Suprema nga resolbahon na ang mga pending petition kaangot sa pagdala-pauli sa iya amay nga si former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Naka-detain si Duterte sa The Hague, Netherlands matapos gindakop sang Marso 11, 2025 sa gahum sang arrest warrant sang International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Duterte is detained in The Hague, Netherlands after being arrested on March 11, 2025 under an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Sa 26 ka pahina nga mosyon, ginhingyo man ni Kitty sa Supreme Court nga manduan na ang gobyerno nga maghulag kag i-proseso ang pagpabalik sa iya amay sa Pilipinas sa labing-madali nga panahon.
english: In a 26-page motion, Kitty also asked the Supreme Court to order the government to act and process the return of her father to the Philippines as soon as possible.

text: “Petitioner implores this Honorable Court to exercise similar resolve here to ensure that constitutional violations do not go unremedied or unpunished, even if the ruling could influence the country’s political landscape,” kabahin sang mosyon.
english: “Petitioner implores this Honorable Court to exercise similar resolve here to ensure that constitutional violations do not go unremedied or unpunished, even if the ruling could influence the country’s political landscape,” part of the motion.

text: Suno sa kampo ni Kitty, ginbutang nila sa mosyon nga resolbahon gilayon ang mga petisyon agud malikawan nga maglain pa gid ang sitwasyon sang ikaayong-lawas sang amay nga Duterte kag malikawan ang kamatayon samtang yara sa kustodiya sang iban nga nasyon.
english: According to Kitty's camp, they put in motion to resolve the petitions immediately to avoid further deterioration of the health situation of Duterte's father and avoid death while in foreign custody.

text: “At bare minimum, urgent judicial relief will spare the nation the ignominy of having a beloved former President – expelled from his homeland without due process of law – suffer an undignified death in the custody of his foreign captors, with this Honorable Court not lifting a finger to intervene,” suno pa sa mosyon sang agot nga anak sang former president.
english: “At bare minimum, urgent judicial relief will spare the nation the ignominy of having a beloved former President – ​​expelled from his homeland without due process of law – suffer an undignified death in the custody of his foreign captors, with this Honorable Court not lifting a finger to intervene,” the motion of the former president’s son-in-law added.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang kampo sang anay presidente nga nagamalipaton na ini kag indi na makadumdom sang pika ka mga hitabo, mga lugar, mga petsa, kag mangin sa mga myembro sang iya pamilya.
english: Earlier, the former president's camp said he was amnesiac and could not remember certain events, places, dates, and even members of his family.

text: Nagmandu naman ang ICC sang medical examination agud nga ma-determina kun masarangan bala ni Duterte ang trial.
english: The ICC has ordered a medical examination to determine whether Duterte can handle the trial.

text: Suno kay DTI Secretary Fred Pascual, ginadiskusyunan na sang ahensya ang proactive measures kag may mga konsultasyon na sa nasambit nga social media platforms bilang official partner sang gobyerno sa e-commerce.
