english: In a statement, the secretary said that TikTok has a great influence on local businesses in the country.

text: “TikTok’s influence in empowering local micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) is undeniable, and their accelerated adoption of e-commerce is crucial for revolutionizing production sectors, generating high-quality employment opportunities, and elevating the competitiveness of Philippine products on the global stage,” kabahin sang pahayag ni Pascual.
english: “TikTok’s influence in empowering local micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) is undeniable, and their accelerated adoption of e-commerce is crucial for revolutionizing production sectors, generating high-quality employment opportunities, and elevating the competitiveness of Philippine products on the global stage,” Pascual said in a statement.

text: Magluwas sa e-commerce, plano sang DTI nga mag-implementar sang Safety Enforcement Tool (TSET) sa Tiktok.
english: In addition to e-commerce, the DTI plans to implement a Safety Enforcement Tool (TSET) on Tiktok.

text: Ini naman amo ang maga-hatag sang proteksyon sa consumers paagi sa portal nga ginhimo para sa verified government agencies kag law enforcement representatives nga maka-access kag monitor sa progress sang pagkakas sang delikado nga content halin sa platform.
english: It will provide protection to consumers through a portal created for verified government agencies and law enforcement representatives to access and monitor the progress of removing dangerous content from the platform.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang TikTok ang isa man sa major sponsor para sa patigayunon nga Cashless Expo, isa ka daku nga exhibition para sa local businesses nga may kolaborasyon sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) kag Department of Agriculture (DA) agud mag-promote sang digital payments sa agriculture, trade, kag sa private sector.
english: TikTok is also one of the major sponsors for the upcoming Cashless Expo, a large exhibition for local businesses in collaboration with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and Department of Agriculture (DA) to promote digital payments in agriculture, trade, and the private sector.

text: Ginlutos sang Asian powerhouse nga South Korea ang women’s football team sang Pilipinas, 3-0, sa una nga friendly match nga ginpatigayon sa Icheon City Stadium, Abril 5.
english: Asian powerhouse South Korea defeated the Philippine women’s football team, 3-0, in the first friendly match held at Icheon City Stadium, April 5.

text: Pareho nga wala sang skor ang duha ka teams sa first half, apang sang 17-minutos na lamang ang nabilin antes magtakop ang full time, asud-asud ang goals sang kasumpong paagi kanday Choe Yuri, Ji Soyun kag Jang Selgi.
english: Both teams were scoreless in the first half, but with 17 minutes left before the end of full time, the opponent scored in succession through Choe Yuri, Ji Soyun and Jang Selgi.

text: Magakit-anay liwat ang duha ka teams 6:00 sang gab-i sa Lunes (oras sa Pilipinas) sa amo gihapon nga venue para sa isa pa ka friendly match nga amo naman ang maga-kumpleto sa sini nga international window.
english: The two teams will meet again at 6:00 pm on Monday (Philippine time) at the same venue for another friendly match that will complete this international window.

text: Ini na ang ika-apat nga match subong nga tuig nga nalutos ang Filipinas sa idalom ni Coach Mark Torcaso kun sa diin lunsay man superior teams ang nakaatubang sang national team bilang preparasyon sa mga sambuwa sa 2025 lakip na ang AFF Women’s Championship kag ang Thailand Southeast Asian Games.
english: This is the fourth match this year that the Philippines lost under Coach Mark Torcaso where both superior teams faced the national team in preparation for the matches in 2025 including the AFF Women's Championship and the Thailand Southeast Asian Games.

text: Kun matandaan, ginpierde man sang South Korea ang Pilipinas sa semifinals sang 2022 AFC Women’s Asian Cup kag sa Hangzhou Asian Games group stage sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: South Korea also defeated the Philippines in the semifinals of the 2022 AFC Women's Asian Cup and the Hangzhou Asian Games group stage last year.

text: Sa world ranking, nagapang-20 ang South Korea samtang pang-39 naman ang team sang Pilipinas.
english: In the world ranking, South Korea is ranked 20th while the Philippine team is ranked 39th.

text: Patuloy na nananatili sa evacuation center ang mga residente ng Sitio Morobuan, Barangay Compo, San Enrique, Iloilo matapos bahain ang kanilang lugar dahil sa walang tigil na pagbuhos ng malakas na ulan.
english: Residents of Sitio Morobuan, Barangay Compo, San Enrique, Iloilo continue to stay in the evacuation center after their area was flooded due to heavy rains.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Jovylen Paca-oncis, isa sa mga residente ng nasabing sitio, sinabi niyang umabot na sa lebel ng ulo ng tao ang taas ng tubig, dahilan upang kailanganin nilang ilikas ng mga awtoridad para maiwasan ang anumang disgrasya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Jovylen Paca-oncis, one of the residents of the said sitio, said the water level has reached the level of the head of the person, which is why they need to be evacuated by the authorities to avoid any accident.

text: Ibinahagi rin ni Paca-oncis na tuwing umaapaw ang tubig mula sa ilog at sapa papunta sa Jalaur River, nagdudulot ito ng biglaang pagtaas ng tubig sa kanilang komunidad.
english: Paca-oncis also shared that every time the water from the river and stream flows into the Jalaur River, it causes a sudden rise in water in their community.

text: Ayon pa sa kanya, labis na naapektuhan ng baha ang kanilang mga pananim at iba pang produktong pang-agrikultura.
english: According to him, the floods have severely affected their crops and other agricultural products.

text: Tinatayang mahigit 100 katao ang pansamantalang nanunuluyan sa evacuation center habang patuloy na mino-monitor ng mga awtoridad ang sitwasyon sa lugar.
english: It is estimated that more than 100 people are temporarily sheltered in the evacuation center while authorities continue to monitor the situation in the area.

text: Gin-file sa Kamara ang isa ka resolution agud nga magpatawag sang congressional inquiry kaangot sa insidente kun sa diin nabalda ang 17-anyos nga taekwondo practitioner matapos ang sparring batok sa isa ka black belter.
english: A resolution was filed in the House to call for a congressional inquiry into the incident in which a 17-year-old taekwondo practitioner was injured after sparring against a black belter.

text: Suno kay House Deputy Majority Leader Erwin Tulfo nga amo ang author sang House Resolution 1670, bangud sa sini nga insidente, dapat man nga bukaron ang safety protocols, supervision, kag mga regulasyon sa bilog nga taekwondo community ilabi na ang nagakaigu nga match-ups sa tunga sang bag-uhan pa lamang.
english: According to House Deputy Majority Leader Erwin Tulfo who is the author of House Resolution 1670, because of this incident, safety protocols, supervision, and regulations should also be lifted in the entire taekwondo community especially the appropriate match-ups among beginners.

text: Ginsaad pa sa resolution nga dapat nga may katungdanan ang coach nga siguruhon nga ang training sessions sang mga menor de edad ang ginapatigayon sa paagi nga indi man sila makaangkon sang injury.
english: The resolution also states that the coach should have a duty to ensure that the training sessions of the minors are conducted in a way that they do not get injured.

text: Matandaan nga sang damlag lang nag-agaw sang atensyon ang kaso sang 17-anyos nga babaye nga yellow-belt taekwondo athlete nga nakaangkon sang madamo nga injuries matapos nga gin-set up ini sang iya coach nga mag-spar sa isa ka black belter nga 20 kilos nga mas mabug-at sa iya.
english: It can be recalled that recently the case of a 17-year-old female yellow-belt taekwondo athlete who sustained multiple injuries after her coach set her up to spar with a black belter who was 20 kilos heavier than her caught the attention.

text: Bangud sa amo nga sparring session, nahalitan ang ilong sang bata, may facial contusion, nagpalamanog ang ibabaw nga bahin sang iya nga bibig, kag nagapalanakit ang bag-ang.
english: As a result of the sparring session, the child sustained a damaged nose, facial contusion, swollen upper lip, and sore throat.

text: Sa affidavit sang bata, nakasaad man nga ginbatas sini ang ginhimo sang iya coach bangud gusto sini nga indi madula ang iya nga scholarship sa Jesus is Lord Colleges Foundation, Inc.
english: In the affidavit of the boy, he also promised that he endured the actions of his coach because he wanted not to lose his scholarship to the Jesus is Lord Colleges Foundation, Inc.

text: sa Bocaue, Bulacan.#
english: in Bocaue, Bulacan.#

text: Nagapabilin sa evacuation center ang mga pumuluyo sang Sitio Morobuan, Barangay Compo, San Enrique, Iloilo matapos ginbaha ang ila lugar bangud sa wala untat nga pagbubo sang mamunog nga ulan.
english: Residents of Sitio Morobuan, Barangay Compo, San Enrique, Iloilo are remaining in the evacuation center after their area was flooded due to continuous heavy rains.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jovylen Paca-oncis, residente sang nasambit nga lugar, iya ginpahayag nga naglab-ot na sa lebel sang ulo sang tawo ang tubig, kabangdanan nga kinahanglanan na sila i-rescue sang mga otoridad agud malikawan ang disgrasya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jovylen Paca-oncis, a resident of the said area, said the water reached the level of the head of the man, causing them to be rescued by the authorities to avoid accidents.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Paca-oncis nga kun magtabuay ang tubig halin sa suba kag sapa padulong sa Jalaur River, nagatuga ini sang pagtaas sang tubig sa ila komunidad.
english: Paca-oncis also said that when the water from the river and stream meets the Jalaur River, it causes the water to rise in their community.

text: Pahayag pa ni niya, tuman nga naapektuhan sang tubig-bah ang ila mga talamnan kag produkto sa agrikultura.
english: He said the flood waters have severely affected their crops and agricultural products.

text: Ginabulubanta masobra 100 ka mga indibidwal ang nagapabilin sa evacuation center samtang padayon ang pag-monitor sang mga otoridad sa mga nasambit nga lugar.
english: More than 100 individuals are estimated to remain in the evacuation center while authorities continue to monitor the areas.

text: Wala sa options ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: None of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s options.

text: ang mag-resign kasunod sang mga alegasyon nga ginpangbuy-an sang iya mismo utod nga si Senator Imee Marcos.
english: to resign following allegations released by his own sister, Senator Imee Marcos.

text: Suno kay Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, ang mga nagapanawagan lamang nga mag-resign si Marcos amo ang mga taga-suporta ni Vice President Sara Duterte agud nga magtaas ang pwesto sini kag magbulos bilang presidente.
english: According to Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, the only ones calling for Marcos' resignation are supporters of Vice President Sara Duterte so that he can rise to the position and take over as president.

text: Pahayag ni Castro, atubangon ni Marcos kun ano man ang problema sa Pilipinas.
english: Castro said Marcos will face whatever problems the Philippines faces.

text: Kun sin-o man ang nagagahod subong suno kay Castro, magapabilin lamang sila bilang gahod.
english: Whoever is making noise now, Castro said, will remain as noise.

text: “The President is still working and keeps on working for the country so hindi po option sa administrasyon, sa Pangulo ang pagbibitiw,” suno sa Palace Press Officer.
english: “The President is still working and keeps on working for the country so it is not an option for the administration, it is for the President to resign,” according to the Palace Press Officer.

text: “Ang Pangulo ay matapang na haharapin kung anuman ang suliranin ng bansa at silang mga nag-iingay, sila ay ingay lamang,” dugang niya.
english: “The President is brave enough to face whatever the country's problems and those who are making noise, they are just making noise,” he added.

text: Matandaan nga sa speech ni Imee sa rally sang Iglesia Ni Cristo (INC) sang Lunes sang gab-i, nagpanawagan ini sa iya manghod nga magpauli na.
english: In her speech at the Iglesia Ni Cristo (INC) rally on Monday night, Imee called on her brother to go home.

text: Ini matapos gin-akusaran sini ang presidente nga isa ka long-time illegal drug user.
english: This is after he accused the president of being a long-time illegal drug user.

text: Sabat naman ni Castro, ang mga alegasyon ni Imee ang lunsay parte sang naratibo nga nagatuyo nga gub-on ang presidente kag proteksyunan ang iya kaalyado.
english: Castro responded that Imee's allegations are all part of a narrative aimed at destroying the president and protecting his ally.

text: “Kitang-kita ninyo na ang Pangulo ang gusto niyang sirain pero ang pinuproteksiyunan niya ay iyong may issue tungkol sa korapsiyon na si Bise Presidente,” suno sa Palace official.
english: “You can see that the President is the one he wants to destroy but the one he is protecting is the one who has an issue about corruption, the Vice President,” the Palace official said.

text: “Hindi man lang niya iningayan ang patungkol sa issue ng confidential funds, hindi rin niya iningayan ang pagpapadala sa dating Pangulong Duterte sa ICC – ang iningay niya dito ay pabor pa mismo sa taong umaming siya ay murderer,” pahayag pa sini.
english: “He didn't even talk about the issue of confidential funds, he didn't talk about sending former President Duterte to the ICC – his talk here is in favor of the person who admitted he was a murderer,” he said.

text:
Dugang niya: “So kita ninyo naman kung saan siya patungo kaya wala siyang gagawin kung hindi isang desperadong aksiyon – sirain ang Pangulo para proteksiyunan ang kaniyang mga kaalyado.”

Wala pa man sang plano ang Malacañang nga mag-file sang kaso batok kay Imee.
english:
He added: “So you see where he is heading so he will do nothing but a desperate action – destroy the President to protect his allies.”

Malacañang has no plans to file a case against Imee.

text: Pahayag ni Castro, i-check anay ang tanan nga mga statement sang senadora, kag nakadepende na sa Department of Justice ukon sa Ombudsman kun may tikang sila nga himuon kaangot sa amo nga mga pahayag sang presidential sister.
english: Castro said all the statements of the senator will be checked first, and it is up to the Department of Justice or the Ombudsman if they will take any action regarding the statements of the presidential sister.

text: Napaslawan ang weightlifting icon sang Pilipinas nga si Hidilyn Diaz nga maka-qualify para sa 2024 Paris Olympics matapos nga ginlutos sang isa pa ka Pinay nga si Elreen Ando sa women’s 59-kilogram category sa World Cup sa Phuket, Thailand.
english: Philippine weightlifting icon Hidilyn Diaz failed to qualify for the 2024 Paris Olympics after being defeated by another Filipina, Elreen Ando, ​​in the women’s 59-kilogram category at the World Cup in Phuket, Thailand.

text: Nasarangan ni Diaz ang 99kg sa snatch apang wala na nakalampas sa ikaduha kag ikatatlo nga attempt sa clean and jerk kag naka-tally lamang sang 222kg, mas manubo sa kabug-usan nga 229-kilograms nga nadala naman ni Ando.
english: Diaz managed 99kg in the snatch but failed in the second and third attempts in the clean and jerk and tallied only 222kg, less than the total of 229-kilograms brought by Ando.

text: Ang amo nga event sa Thailand amo ang katapusan nga qualifier para sa Paris Summer Games.
english: That event in Thailand is the final qualifier for the Paris Summer Games.

text: Pareho nga nag-compete sanday Ando kag Diaz sa women’s 59-kilogram class kun sa diin santo sa pagsulundan, isa lamang ka spot ang mahimo makuha sang kada pungsod sa kada weightlifting division.
english: Both Ando and Diaz competed in the women’s 59-kilogram class where according to the rules, only one spot can be won by each country in each weightlifting division.

text: Ang 32-anyos nga si Diaz nga bugal sang Zamboanga amo ang una kag naga-isahanon nga gold medalist sang Pilipinas sa maragtas sang Olympiada matapos ini nagpangibabaw sa 55-kg category sa Tokyo Olympics sang 2021.
english: The 32-year-old Diaz who is the pride of Zamboanga is the Philippines’ first and only gold medalist in the history of the Olympiad after she dominated the 55-kg category at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021.

text: Apang bangud wala na sang 55-category sa Paris Summer Games, nagtinguha ini nga magsaka sa 59kg subong nga tuig kun sa diin kun nagmadinalag-on sa iya target, ini na kuntani ang iya ikalima nga sunod-sunod nga appearance sa Olympics matapos nga nakapasakop man ini sa Olympics sa Beijing kag London antes nakuha ang silver sa Brazil kag ang gold sa Japan.
english: However, since there will be no 55-category at the Paris Summer Games, he tried to move up to 59kg this year where if he succeeded in his target, it would have been his fifth consecutive appearance at the Olympics after he also competed in the Olympics in Beijing and London before winning silver in Brazil and gold in Japan.

text: Ang mas bataon naman nga si Ando nga naga-edad pa lamang sang 25-anyos ang madugay na nga myembro man sang national team sang Pilipinas kag ini na ang iya ikaduha nga Olympic appearance matapos nagpang-pito sa 2020 Tokyo Olympics sa Women’s 64kg category.
english: The younger Ando, ​​who is only 25 years old, is also a long-time member of the Philippine national team and this is her second Olympic appearance after finishing seventh in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in the Women's 64kg category.

text: Si Ando man ang ikaduha nga Pinoy weightlifter nga nakakuha sang ticket para sa Summer Games matapos nga nakabulsa man sang spot si John Ceniza sa men’s 61kg class.
english: Ando is also the second Filipino weightlifter to get a ticket for the Summer Games after John Ceniza also pocketed a spot in the men’s 61kg class.

text: Ipaguwa sang International Weightlifting Federation ang final kag official ranking list sa Mayo antes ang Olympiada nga magasugod sa Hulyo.
english: The International Weightlifting Federation will release the final and official ranking list in May before the Olympiad which starts in July.

text: Ang iban pa nga delegates sang Pilipinas nga kuwalipikado sa Paris (as of April 3) amo sanday EJ Obiena, Carlos Yulo, Aleah Finnegan, Eumir Marcial, Nesthy Petecio, kag Aira Villegas.#
english: Other Philippine delegates eligible for Paris (as of April 3) are EJ Obiena, Carlos Yulo, Aleah Finnegan, Eumir Marcial, Nesthy Petecio, and Aira Villegas.#

text:
“Wala sang kapatawaran kun wala sang restitution.”

Ini ang ginhatagan sang igtalupangod sa misa sang director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center nga si Msgr.
english:
“There is no forgiveness without restitution.”

This was highlighted during the mass by the director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center, Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso alas syete kaina sang aga sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.
english: Meliton Oso at 7 am yesterday at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.

text: Gindala ni Oso sa iya homily ang tatlo ka sahi sang sinsero nga paghinulsol sa sala nga amo ang: una, malig-on nga desisyon nga untatan ang makasasala nga buluhaton kag batasan.
english: Oso brought in his homily three types of sincere repentance of sin namely: first, firm decision to stop sinful activity and habit.

text: Ikaduha amo ang malig-on nga handum kag desisyon nga mangin masinulundon sa Ginuo kag likawan ang paglalis sa Iya kabubut-on.
english: Second is a firm desire and resolve to be obedient to the Lord and avoid contradicting His will.

text: Ang ikatatlo amo ang restitution nga amo ang panawagan sang simbahan sa mga kurap nga nagbulsa sang binilyon ka pesos nga para kuntani sa flood control projects.
english: The third is restitution which is the church's call to the corrupt who pocketed billions of pesos that were supposed to be for flood control projects.

text: Buot silingon sini, dapat nga ibalik kun ano ang ginkawat halin sa pondo sang gobyerno.
english: This means that what was stolen from government funds must be returned.

text: “Wala sila siguro diri, pero basi may kilala kamo, hambala ninyo nga gin-sermon ni Msgr.
english: “They are probably not here, but maybe you know someone, say that Msgr.

text: Oso nga budlayan ka makapalangit kun indi ka mag-repent kag mag-restitute,” suno kay Oso.
english: Oso that it will be difficult for you to get to heaven if you do not repent and restitute,” Oso said.

text: Ginbalikan sini ang ginhimo nga anti-corruption protests sang nagligad nga Septyembre 21.
english: He recalled the anti-corruption protests held last September 21.

text: Ini nga mobilisasyon ang patigayunon pa gid liwat sa Nobyembre 30.
english: This mobilization will be held again on November 30.

text: “We want you to realize that stealing public money is a very great sin and that is stealing from the poor.
english: “We want you to realize that stealing public money is a very great sin and that is stealing from the poor.

text: STEALING FROM THE POOR,” pahayag sang JASAC Director.
english: STEALING FROM THE POOR,” the JASAC Director said.

text:
ANG TATLO KA SAHI SANG KAWATAN

Ginpatpat man ni Oso kun ano ang tatlo ka sahi sang kawatan nga nagapakuno-kuno lang sa pagbulig sa iban nga tawo agud tabunan kun ano ang ila kinawatan.
english:
THE THREE TYPES OF THIEVES

Oso also explained the three types of thieves who pretend to help other people to cover up what they stole.

text: Ang una amo amo ang Good Samari-THIEF nga makawat kag kurap, apang palasimba.
english: The first is the Good Samaritan-THIEF who is a thief and a corrupt, but religious man.

text: Ang ikaduha amo ang Holy Chari-THIEF nga kawatan apang nagabulig sa mga imol.
english: The second is Holy Chari-THIEF thief but helps the poor.

text: Ang ikatatlo amo ang Philanthro-THIEF nga kawatan apang nagpahimo sang simbahan kag kapilya.
english: The third was the Philanthro-THIEF thief but had the church and chapel built.

text: Gin-mensyonar pa ni Oso sanday Ako Bicol Representative Zaldy Co, Curlee Discaya, kag iban pa nga amo ang major donors sang Nuestra Señora de Salvacion Church sa Bachawan, San Agustin, Romblon nga ginkilala bilang Parokya sang Pebrero 2024.
english: Oso also mentioned Ako Bicol Representative Zaldy Co, Curlee Discaya, and others as major donors of Nuestra Señora de Salvacion Church in Bachawan, San Agustin, Romblon which was recognized as a parish in February 2024.

text: Si Co ang na-implicate sa flood control corruption samtang si Discaya ang isa naman ka kontraktor nga sentro man sang imbestigasyon bangud sa kurapsyon.
english: Co is implicated in flood control corruption while Discaya is another contractor who is also under investigation for corruption.

text: Nagpaandam si Oso sa mga kurap nga bisan magbulig pa sa iban, magsimba, ukon magdonar sang simbahan, wala man gihapon sang kapatawaran kun wala sang restitution ukon kun wala ginabalik ang kinawatan.
english: Oso warned the corrupt that even if they help others, go to church, or donate to the church, there is still no forgiveness if there is no restitution or if the stolen goods are not returned.

text: “Loudly, therefore, we call on you, REPENT AND RESTITUTE.
english: “Loudly, therefore, we call on you, REPENT AND RESTITUTE.

text: REPENT AND RESTITUTE!
english: REPENT AND RESTITUTE!

text: Indi kita makapalangit kun indi kita maghinulsol kag mag-restitute,” pahayag pa ni Oso sa iya nga homily.
english: We cannot go to heaven unless we repent and restitute,” Oso said in his homily.

text: Binanatan ni Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson si Senadora Imee Marcos matapos umano nitong siraan ang sariling kapatid na si Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson lashed out at Senator Imee Marcos after she allegedly destroyed her own brother, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa harap ng libo-libong dumalo sa ikalawang araw ng kontra-katiwalian rally ng Iglesia ni Cristo (INC) sa Quirino Grandstand kagabi.
english: in front of thousands of people who attended the second day of the anti-corruption rally of the Church of Christ (INC) at the Quirino Grandstand last night.

text: Sa naturang pagtitipon, sinabi ni Sen.
english: During the meeting, Sen.

text: Imee ang alegasyon na gumagamit umano ng ilegal na droga ang Pangulo at ang First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos — isang paratang na hindi suportado ng anumang opisyal na ebidensya at nananatiling hindi beripikado.
english: Imee the allegation that the President and First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos are allegedly using illegal drugs — an accusation that is not supported by any official evidence and remains unverified.

text: Ayon kay Lacson, nabawasan ang kanyang respeto kay Sen.
english: According to Lacson, his respect for Sen.

text: Imee dahil sa paglalabas nito ng mabibigat na akusasyon laban sa sariling kapatid sa isang pampublikong pagtitipon.
english: Imee for making serious accusations against his own brother in a public meeting.

text: “Hindi Pilipino ang ganoon,” ani Lacson, na iginiit na ang mga personal na alitan o hindi pagkakasunduan sa loob ng pamilya ay dapat inaayos sa pribadong paraan, at hindi inilalantad sa harap ng malaking bilang ng tao.
english: “It's not Filipino to do that,” said Lacson, stressing that personal disputes or disagreements within the family should be settled in a private manner, and not exposed in front of a large number of people.

text: Nang tanungin naman hinggil sa posibleng motibo ng senadora, sinabi ni Lacson na pulitika lamang ang nakikita niyang dahilan.
english: When asked about the possible motive of the senator, Lacson said he sees only politics as the reason.

text: “Pulitika, wala nang iba.
english: “Politics, nothing else.

text: Wala akong makitang ibang motibo.
english: I see no other motive.

text: Bakit mo sisiraan ang sarili mong kapatid sa harap ng daan-daang libong tao?” pahayag ng senador.
english: Why would you destroy your own brother in front of thousands of people?” stated the senator.

text: Patuloy namang umaani ng reaksyon ang insidente mula sa publiko at iba’t ibang sektor, habang wala pang opisyal na tugon mula sa Malacañang hinggil sa mga pahayag ni Sen.
english: The incident continues to draw reactions from the public and various sectors, while there is no official response from Malacañang regarding the statements of Sen.

text: Imee.
english: Imee.

text: Ginpagwa na ni Secretary of State Marco Rubio ang first stage sang mayor nga plano para sa pag-reorganize sa US State Department paagi sa mga pagbag-o nga magakakas sang 132 domestic offices, magasipa sa kapin 700 positions sa Washington, DC, kag magasirado sa mga opisina nga naga-focus sa war crimes kag global conflict.
english: Secretary of State Marco Rubio has released the first stage of a major plan to reorganize the US State Department with changes that will eliminate 132 domestic offices, kick off more than 700 positions in Washington, DC, and close offices focused on war crimes and global conflict.

text: Ginpanindugan sang State Department nga kinahanglan ini nga mga pagbag-o agud mapabilin ang pagkaepektibo kag relevance sini.
english: The State Department insisted that these changes were necessary to maintain its effectiveness and relevance.

text: Suno sa isa ka senior State Department official, bloated ang department organization chart subong kag may indi maayo nga epekto sa foreign policy kag relevance sang departamento.
english: According to a senior State Department official, the department organization chart is currently bloated and has an adverse effect on the foreign policy and relevance of the department.

text: Suno pa sa senior State Department official, indi man magresulta sa gilayon nga pag- layoff ini nga tikang apang magapatimaan ini nga madulaan sang trabaho ang mga opisyal.
english: According to the senior State Department official, the move will not result in immediate layoffs but will mean that the officials will lose their jobs.

text: Bilang kabahin sang reorganization, 700 positions sa sulod sang Washington headquarters ang ginalauman ng dulaon.
english: As part of the reorganization, 700 positions within the Washington headquarters are expected to be eliminated.

text: Kabahin man sang plano amo nga ang Under Secretaries ang magapasal sang plano sang pagbuhin sang mga empleyado sang 15 percent, bilang pagsunod sa President’s Workforce Optimization Initiative.
english: Also part of the plan is that the Under Secretaries will pass a plan of reduction of employees by 15 percent, in compliance with the President’s Workforce Optimization Initiative.

text: Ini ang panindugan ni Sen.
english: This is the position of Sen.

text: Ping Lacson kasunod sang mga akusasyon ni Sen.
english: Ping Lacson following the accusations of Sen.

text: Imee Marcos batok sa utod sini nga si Pres.
english: Imee Marcos against her brother Pres.

text: Bongbong Marcos.
english: Marcos Wall.

text: “Sa akin, I can only say for myself: Mas nakaramdam ako ng awa kay Pres.
english: “For me, I can only say for myself: I felt more sorry for Pres.

text: Bongbong Marcos,” pahayag ni Lacson.
english: Bongbong Marcos,” Lacson said.

text: “Mayroong ibang forum para diyan.
english: “There is another forum for that.

text: ‘Wag doon sa harap ng daanlibong tao na hayagan mong sisiraan — totoo man o hindi,” dugang pa niya.
english: 'Don't be there in front of thousands of people that you're going to openly destroy — true or not,” he added.

text: Nauna man nga gin-akusaran sang Senadora sanday Pres.
english: Earlier, the senator also accused Pres.

text: Marcos, First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, kag Ilocos Rep.
english: Marcos, First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, and Ilocos Rep.

text: Sandro Marcos nga naga-gamit sang iligal nga droga, bagay nga ginpanginwala sang Palasyo.
english: Sandro Marcos who uses illegal drugs, something the Palace denied.

text: Ginpalayas ni Sorsogon Governor Edwin “Boboy” Hamor ang OPM band nga Kamikazee kag ginkakas na sa lineup sa festival sang probinsya bangud sa ginpahayag “attitude problem” sang banda.
english: Sorsogon Governor Edwin “Boboy” Hamor has expelled the OPM band Kamikazee and removed it from the lineup at the provincial festival due to the band’s alleged “attitude problem”.

text: Sa iya speech sa atubang sang Sorsoganons, ginpahayag pa mismo sang gobernador nga indi na niya pagpabalikon sa Sorsogon ang amo nga banda.
english: In his speech in front of Sorsoganons, the governor himself said that he will not allow the band to return to Sorsogon.

text: “Inuulit ko, bayad yun.
english: “I repeat, it’s a fee.

text: Kasi bago mag-perform sila dapat bayad.
english: Because before they perform they have to pay.

text: Pero pinauwi ko na, hindi ko na patitirahin yun sa Residencia.
english: But I sent it home, I won't let it stay in the Residence.

text: Pinauwi ko na sa airport, dun sila mag-umaga.
english: I took them home to the airport, they were there to dry.

text: Okay?
english: Okay?

text: “Inuulit ko, hindi tayo puwedeng bastusin ang mga taga-Sorsogon.
english: “I repeat, we cannot abuse the people of Sorsogon.

text: Pinipilit ko na itaas ang dignidad ng bawat Sorsoganon, pero huwag ganun.
english: I try to raise the dignity of every Sorsoganon, but don't do that.

text: Huwag ganun na tayo’y bastusin.
english: Let’s not be so rude.

text: Okay?,” kabahin sang pahayag sang gobernador.
english: Okay?,” part of the governor's statement.

text:
Photo Courtesy: Kamikazee/Facebook

Pahayag pa sini, magabawi siya kag imbitaron sanday Vice Ganda kag Sarah Geronimo sa selebrasyon.
english:
Photo Courtesy: Kamikazee/Facebook

He said he will recover and invite Vice Ganda and Sarah Geronimo to the celebration.

text: Wala sang ginmensyonar ang gobernador kun ano gid ang problema sa Kamikazee apang sang ulihi nadiskubrehan nga nagpangindi ang banda nga magpa-picture sa attraction nga gintawag nga “16,000 Blue Roses” nga human sa LED flowers.
english: The governor did not mention what the problem was with the Kamikazee but it was later discovered that the band refused to take pictures at the attraction called “16,000 Blue Roses” made of LED flowers.

text: Ginpahayag sang Provincial Government of Sorsogon nga una nagsugot ang banda sa amo nga photoshoot apang nag-atras na sa ila nga scheduled date.
english: The Provincial Government of Sorsogon said the band initially agreed to the photoshoot but withdrew from their scheduled date.

text: Sikat nga Filipino band ang Kamikazee nga nag-debut sa music industry paagi sa pag-release sang ila hit single nga “Narda” sang 2006.
english: Kamikazee is a popular Filipino band that made its debut in the music industry with the release of their hit single “Narda” in 2006.

text: Sila man ang nag-release sang Halik, Huling Sayaw, kag Unang Tikim.#
english: They also released Halik, Huling Sayaw, and Unang Tikim.#

text: Pareho nga istorya sang “redirection” ang ginpakigbahin sang duha ka mga Ilonggo nga nangin topnotchers sa October 2025 Foresters Licensure Examination.
english: The same story of “redirection” was shared by two Ilonggos who became topnotchers in the October 2025 Foresters Licensure Examination.

text: Ini amo sanday Jade Micah Lebuna Bangeles, residente sang Barangay Pasig, Lambunao, Iloilo, Rank 5, nga may rating nga 93.50%; kag Bobby Jamili Maderse, residente sang Yabon, Janiuay, Iloilo, Rank 6, nga may rating 93.35%.
english: They are Jade Micah Lebuna Bangeles, resident of Barangay Pasig, Lambunao, Iloilo, Rank 5, with a rating of 93.50%; and Bobby Jamili Maderse, resident of Yabon, Janiuay, Iloilo, Rank 6, with a rating of 93.35%.

text: Pareho sila nga mga produkto sang West Visayas State University-College of Agriculture and Forestry (WVSU-CAF).
english: They are both products of the West Visayas State University-College of Agriculture and Forestry (WVSU-CAF).

text: Sa interview sa Good Morning Philippines program, ginpahayag nanday Bangeles kag Maderse nga pareho nila nga indi first choice ang Forestry kag pareho man sila nga naghandum anay nga makasulod kuntani sa engineering program.
english: In an interview with the Good Morning Philippines program, Bangeles and Maderse said that both of them did not first choose Forestry and both of them dreamed of entering the engineering program.

text: Sa bahin ni Bangeles nga ika-lima sa walo ka mag-utod, ginpakigbahin sini nga indi masarangan sang iya ginikanan ang tuition fee, magluwas pa nga diri gid ini sa syudad kinahanglan mag-eskwela kun lagson sini ang engineering.
english: As for Bangeles, the fifth of eight children, he shared that his parents cannot afford the tuition fee, besides that he has to study in the city if he wants to pursue engineering.

text: Ini ang rason suno sa iya nga ginpili sini nga mangin practical kag gintun-an ang Forestry.
english: This is why he chose to be practical and study Forestry.

text: “Naisip ko man nga nami man [ang Forestry], kag gusto ko man nga mag-dig deeper kun ano ja.
english: “I thought [Forestry] was good, and I wanted to dig deeper into what it was.

text: Indi man sa napiritan ako kag ginbuol ko jang course nga ja.
english: I wasn't forced to take this course.

text: Waay man ko nag-expect nga mapalangga ko ang course ko as time goes by,” pahayag sini.
english: I didn't expect to love my course as time goes by,” he said.

text: Antes naman nag-eskwela sa WVSU-CAF, duha ka beses nga napaslawan si Maderse nga makasulod sa engineering.
english: Before attending WVSU-CAF, Maderse failed twice to get into engineering.

text: Sa una nga tuig, wala ini nakapasar bangud sa lain nga strand sa Senior High School; kag sa ikaduha nga tion pagkasunod nga tuig, wala gihapon ini makasulod sa amo nga program.
english: In the first year, he failed due to a different strand in Senior High School; and the second time the following year, it still did not get into that program.

text: Apang kun may bilin man si Maderse sa pareho sini nga kabataan, indi gid dapat madulaan sang paglaum sa tion sang kapaslawan.
english: But if Maderse has a legacy for children like these, one should never lose hope in times of failure.

text: “May mga bagay nga indi naton makuha — like ang imo nga dream course.
english: “There are things we can’t get — like your dream course.

text: Indi man abi tanan naton nga plano, nagakasunod.
english: Not all of our plans are successful.

text: Maayo lang kay gina-redirect kita sang God nga may mayad nga opportunity nga matabo kanimo sa imo kabuhi.
english: Fortunately, God redirects us to a good opportunity that will happen to you in your life.

text: Grateful kami sa amon nga journey,” suno sa iya.
english: We are grateful for our journey,” he said.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sini kun ano kadaku ang bulig sang Forestry sa komunidad.
english: He also shared how much Forestry helps the community.

text: “Basi isipon da nga forestry man lang da, tanum-tanum lang, wala man may gina-obra.
english: “They might think it's just forestry, just planting, nothing to do.

text: Indi ninyo pag-i-underestimate ang forestry, kay bangud sini, may environmental conservation kita.
english: Don't underestimate forestry, because because of it, we have environmental conservation.

text: Indi niyo pag-ikahuya ang course niyo nga forestry, kay daku ang bulig sini sa aton nga environment kag sa aton nga economy,” dugang sini.
english: Don't be ashamed of your forestry course, because it will help our environment and our economy,” he added.

text: Nagdugang naman si Bangeles nga indi kinahanglan nga i-pressure gid ang kaugalingon.
english: Bangeles added that there is no need to pressure yourself.

text: “Kung una, indi mo gusto ang gin-take mo nga course, i-try mo gid ang best mo nga palanggaon kung ano ang may diyan ka subong.
english: “If at first, you don't like the course you took, try your best to love what you have now.

text: Kay hambal da gani, gina-redirect kita sang Ginuo sa something nga better… Indi pag-i-pressure ang kaugalingon; spend time nga makapahuway man para nga indi matam-an,” pahayag sini.
english: Because as they say, the Lord redirects us to something better... Don't pressure yourself; spend time to rest so as not to be overwhelmed,” he said.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa sini nga pasinawan nga gin-administer sang Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), nagpangaduha ang WVSU-CAF sa Top Performing Schools (with 50 or more examineees) kun sa diin 49 sa 56 ka mga estudyante sini ang nakapasar.
english: It is known that in this examination administered by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), WVSU-CAF came second in the Top Performing Schools (with 50 or more examineees) where 49 of its 56 students passed.

text: Para kay Dr. Joel Araquil, campus administrator, produkto ini sang mapag-on nga kolaborasyon sang eskwelahan, mga estudyante, kag mga manunudlo.
english: For Dr. Joel Araquil, campus administrator, said it is the product of a strong collaboration between the school, students, and faculty.

text: “We are very happy.
english: “We are very happy.

text: It’s because of the collaborative efforts of everybody, especially our University President, Dr. Joselito Villaruz, the heads of the College, the faculty who really give their best nga mabuligan ang mga estudyante from the time nga na-enrol sila, up to maka-graduate sila, up to the time nga naga-review sila,” pahayag sang campus administrator.#
english: It’s because of the collaborative efforts of everyone, especially our University President, Dr. Joselito Villaruz, the heads of the College, the faculty who really give their best to help the students from the time they enroll, up to they graduate, up to the time they review,” said the campus administrator.

text: Hindi masasagot ng simpleng pagpapalit ng Executive Secretary at Budget Secretary ang patuloy na isyu ng korapsyon at anomalya sa mga flood control project ng bansa, ayon sa ekonomistang si Prof.
english: A simple replacement of Executive Secretary and Budget Secretary will not solve the ongoing issue of corruption and anomalies in the country's flood control projects, according to economist Prof.

text: Emmanuel Leyco.
english: Emmanuel Leyco.

text: Ayon kay Leyco, nakaugat ang problema sa mismong sistema ng pamahalaan, isang sistemang nagbibigay-daan sa ghost projects at maling paggamit ng pondo ng bayan.
english: According to Leyco, the problem is rooted in the system of government itself, a system that gives way to ghost projects and misuse of public funds.

text: “Ang pagpapalit ng mga opisyal ay maaaring magbigay lamang ng impresyon na may repormang isinusulong, pero hindi nito natutugunan ang ugat ng problema sa korapsyon,” paliwanag niya.
english: “The replacement of officials may only give the impression that reform is being promoted, but it does not address the root cause of the corruption problem,” he explained.

text: Lumabas kamakailan ang mga alegasyon ng iregularidad sa mga flood control project ng Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), kung saan bilyon-bilyong piso ang umano’y nagastos ngunit kwestiyonable ang implementasyon.
english: There have been allegations of irregularities in the flood control projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), where billions of pesos have been allegedly spent but the implementation is questionable.

text: Mariin namang itinanggi ng ilang mambabatas ang kanilang umano’y pagkakasangkot sa mga naturang anomalya.
english: Some lawmakers denied their alleged involvement in the alleged anomalies.

text: Para kay Leyco, kinakailangan ang sistematikong reporma, mas mahigpit na auditing, at mas matibay na mga institusyon upang matiyak na ang pera ng taumbayan ay napupunta sa tama at makabuluhang proyekto.
english: For Leyco, systemic reform, stricter auditing, and stronger institutions are needed to ensure that the people's money is spent on the right and meaningful projects.

text: “Ang tunay na solusyon ay ang pag-ayos ng sistema, hindi lang pagpapalit ng tao,” diin ni Leyco.
english: “The real solution is to fix the system, not just replace people,” Leyco said.

text: Padayon pa ang pag-re-evaluate sang Iloilo City Engineer’s Office (CEO) sa kontrobersyal nga P4.1-million nga San Rafael Overpass Improvement Project sa Diversion Road, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: The Iloilo City Engineer’s Office (CEO) is still re-evaluating the controversial P4.1-million San Rafael Overpass Improvement Project on Diversion Road, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Dianaline Señoron, head sang Iloilo CEO, iya ginpahayag nga posible nga magdangat na lang sa P2.8-million tubtub P2.9-million ang kabug-usan nga balor sang proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Dianaline Señoron, head of the Iloilo CEO, said the total value of the project is likely to reach P2.8-million to P2.9-million.

text: Kun balikan, sa breakdown sang P4.1 million nga pondo para sa improvement sang overpass, ang pinakamataas amo ang para sa atop kag roof framing nga nagalakip sang pagpinta nga nagalab-ot sa P1.4-million.
english: In the breakdown of the P4.1 million fund for the improvement of the overpass, the highest is for the roof and roof framing which includes painting which amounts to P1.4-million.

text:
Sa kabug-usan, yari ang breakdown:

I. A. Temporary facilities, electrical system, signages, security, project site enclosure—P280,600.00I.
english:
In summary, here’s the breakdown:

I. A. Temporary facilities, electrical system, signage, security, project site enclosure—P280,600.00I.

text: B. Construction Safety and Health Program—P195,200.00II.
english: B. Construction Safety and Health Program—P195,200.00II.

text: Scaffolding and Safety Precaution—P461,763.90III.
english: Scaffolding and Safety Precaution—P461,763.90III.

text: Roof and Roof Framing including Painting works—P1,418,170.70IV.
english: Roof and Roof Framing including Painting works—P1,418,170.70IV.

text: Steel Works—P659,044.00V.
english: Steel Works—P659,044.00V.

text: Tile Works—P412,689.40VI.
english: Tile Works—P412,689.40VI.

text: Repainting Works (existing steel railings)—P137,506.20VII.
english: Repainting Works (existing steel railings)—P137,506.20VII.

text: Plumbing and Sanitary Lines—P100,723.20VIII.
english: Plumbing and Sanitary Lines—P100,723.20VIII.

text:
Electrical Works (LED lights)—P450,000.00

Suno kay Señoron, posible nga sa reevaluation, kuhaon na lang ang plumbing kag sanitary lines nga nagadangat sa balor nga P100,700 sa original nga contract price.
english:
Electrical Works (LED lights)—P450,000.00

According to Señoron, it is possible that in the reevaluation, the plumbing and sanitary lines, which amount to P100,700 from the original contract price, will be removed.

text: Posible man nga magbuhin ang budget sa steel works nga subong nagadangat sa P659,000.
english: The budget for steel works, which currently stands at P659,000, is also likely to be reduced.

text: Matandaan nga nagmandu si Mayor Raisa Treñas sang full review ukon pagrepaso sa amo nga proyekto sa tunga sang pagkwestyon sang mga pumuluyo sang tuman ka daku nga budget.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas ordered a full review of the project amid questions from residents over the huge budget.

text: Ginpa-review man ang halos P800,000 nga balor nga proyekto nga waiting shed sa Katilingban, Molo, Iloilo City kun sa diin nagtupa na lang sa P586,600 ang balor sang proyekto sandig sa pag-evaluate sang Iloilo CEO.
english: The nearly P800,000 worth of waiting shed project in Katilingban, Molo, Iloilo City was also reviewed where the value of the project dropped to P586,600 based on the evaluation of the Iloilo CEO.

text: Nagsaka sang P40 kada kilo ang presyo sang tamudyos bangud sa epekto sang Bagyo Aghon.
english: The price of turkey rose by P40 per kilo due to the impact of Typhoon Aghon.

text: Suno sa Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR), sa inisyal nga reports, ang bagyo ang nag-damage sang P1-milion nga balor sang sini nga isda.
english: According to the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR), in initial reports, the typhoon damaged P1-million worth of this fish.

text: Sa monitoring sang ahensya, nahimo na nga P240 ang presyo nga yara lang anay sa P200 per kilo.
english: According to the agency's monitoring, the price has been reduced to P240 from P200 per kilo.

text: Apisar sini, ginapahayag nga estable gihapon ang suplay sang isda sa pungsod bangud indi man locally sourced ang tanan nga isda nga ginabaligya sa merkado.
english: Despite this, the fish supply in the country is said to be stable as not all fish sold in the market is locally sourced.

text: Ginahulat pa sang BFAR ang reports sa bilog nga damage ang nabilin sang bagyo sa fisheries sector.
english: The BFAR is still waiting for reports on the entire damage left by the typhoon in the fisheries sector.

text: Sandig sa National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), yara sa P21,651,548 ang balor sang kahalitan sang amo nga bagyo sa bug-os nga sector sang agrikultura.
english: According to the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC), the typhoon caused P21,651,548 in damage to the entire agricultural sector.

text: Nag-qualify na ang Filipino weightlifter nga si Rosegie Ramos para sa 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: Filipino weightlifter Rosegie Ramos has qualified for the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Siya ang ika-pito sa Pilipinas nga nakaangkon sang ticket para sa Olympiada subong nga tuig kag una naman halin sa weightlifting team.
english: He is the seventh Philippine to win a ticket to the Olympiad this year and the first from the weightlifting team.

text: Nahimo ini sang 20-anyos nga Pinay matapos nagpangibabaw sa women’s 49kg Group B sa 2024 IWF World Cup sa Thailand nga amo ang katapusan nga qualifying event para sa Paris Summer Games.
english: The 20-year-old Filipina did this after dominating the women’s 49kg Group B at the 2024 IWF World Cup in Thailand, the final qualifying event for the Paris Summer Games.

text: Nahakwat sini ang 87kgs sa snatch kag 103kgs sa clean and jerk nga may kabug-usan nga 190kg kag amo ang nahingadlan nga best athlete sa amo nga kategorya.
english: He lifted 87kgs in the snatch and 103kgs in the clean and jerk for a total of 190kg and was named the best athlete in that category.

text: Si Ramos ang pakaisa sang weightlifting icon kag labing-una nga Olympic gold medalist sang Pilipinas nga si Hidilyn Diaz nga yara man subong sa Thailand para mag-compete.
english: Ramos is the cousin of weightlifting icon and the Philippines' first Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz who is also in Thailand to compete.

text: Madugay na ini nga myembro sang national team nga nakabulsa na sang madamo nga medalya sa regional kag continental events kaangay sang gold sa 2022 kag 2023 editions sang Asian Junior Championships.
english: He is a long-time member of the national team who has already pocketed many medals in regional and continental events such as gold in the 2022 and 2023 editions of the Asian Junior Championships.

text: Nakadaog man ini sang bronze medal sa Southeast Asian Games sang 2021.
english: She also won a bronze medal at the Southeast Asian Games in 2021.

text: Antes kay Ramos, una na nga nangin kuwalipikado para sa Olympiada sa France ang Filipino athletes nga sanday EJ Obiena sa pole vault; Carlos Yulo kag Aleah Finnegan sa gymnastics; kag Eumir Marcial, Nesthy Petecio, kag Aira Villegas sa boxing.
english: Before Ramos, Filipino athletes EJ Obiena in the pole vault had previously qualified for the Olympics in France; Carlos Yulo and Aleah Finnegan in gymnastics; and Eumir Marcial, Nesthy Petecio, and Aira Villegas in boxing.

text: Hindi masolusyunan sang pag-ilis sang Executive Secretary kag Budget Secretary ang anomalya sa flood control projects kag isyu sang korapsyon sa pungsod, suno sa ekonomista nga si Prof.
english: The replacement of the Executive Secretary and Budget Secretary will not solve the anomalies in flood control projects and the issue of corruption in the country, according to economist Prof.

text: Emmanuel Leyco.
english: Emmanuel Leyco.

text: Panindugan niya, nakaugat ang problema sa mismo nga Sistema sang gobyerno nga nagapahanugot sa ghost projects kag sala nga paggamit sang pondo.
english: He insisted that the problem is rooted in the government system itself that allows ghost projects and misuse of funds.

text: Ang pag-ilis sang mga opisyal ang possible magahatag sang impression sang reporma apang indi ini masabat ang problema sa korapsyon.
english: The replacement of officials is likely to give the impression of reform but it will not solve the problem of corruption.

text: Nagtuhaw man ang alegasyon sang iregularidad sa flood control projects sang DPWH kun sa diin binilyon ka pesos nga pondo ang ginapahayag nga naggasto.
english: There were also allegations of irregularities in the flood control projects of the DPWH where billions of pesos were allegedly spent.

text: Hugot naman nga ginpanginwala sang pila ka mga lawmakers ang pagkaulamid sa mga anomaliya.
english: Some lawmakers have strongly denied involvement in the anomalies.

text: Para kay Leyco, ang nmatuod nga solusyon amo ang sistematiko nga reporma, mas hugot nga auditing, kag mas mapag-on nga institusyon agud masiguro na ang pondo sang publiko makadto sa insakto nga proyekto.
english: For Leyco, the real solution is systemic reform, stricter auditing, and stronger institutions to ensure that public funds go to the right projects.

text: JANIUAY ILOILO- Naghatag sang iya kaugalingon nga panan-awan ang isa ka abogado may kaangtanan sa desisyon  sa kaso ni anay Janiuay Mayor Frankie Locsin kun sa diin ginkwestyon ang bidding kag procurement sang mga bulong.
english: JANIUAY ILOILO- A lawyer gave his own view on the decision in the case of former Janiuay Mayor Frankie Locsin where the bidding and procurement of medicines was questioned.

text: Sa interview sang  Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Rene Villa, ang abogado nga ginpangayuan sang alkalde  sang  legal opinion, iya ginpahayag nga duha ka kaso kag duha man sa GR numbers ang ginpasaka kag ini ang ginalakipan sang  petition for review of certiorari sa demurrer to evidence sa diin ini ang gindeny kag ang conviction sa kaso.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Rene Villa, the lawyer who was asked by the mayor for a legal opinion, said that two cases and two in GR numbers were filed and this includes a petition for review of certiorari on the demurrer to evidence where it was denied and the conviction in the case.

text: Suno kay  Villa ang gindeny lang kag ang gin-isyuhan sang entry of judgement ang sa bahin sang demurer apang ang sa bahin sang conviction ang wala pa nadesisyunan sa diin may yara pa sang nabilin nga mga incidents.
english: Villa said the demurrer was denied and the entry of judgment was issued but the conviction has not been decided yet.

text: Nagapati si Villa nga kun ang sa demurer lang ang gindeny  indi pa disqualified bilang kandidato si Locsin.
english: Villa believes that if only the demurer had been denied, Locsin would not have been disqualified as a candidate.

text: Pahayag pa ni Villa , kun wala pa mabatun sang abogado sang duha ka partido, indi pa ini pinal bangud kinahanglan pa nila ini batunon.
english: Villa said that if the lawyers of the two parties have not yet accepted it, it is not final because they still need to accept it.

text: Dugang pa niya, kun indi pa makapagwa sang order ukon deklarasyon ang Commission on Elections (Comelec) nga disqualified na si Locsin , kwalipikado man ini sa gihapon kag ang tanan nga boto nga makuha pabor kay Locsin ang makabig nga counted.
english: He added that if the Commission on Elections (Comelec) does not issue an order or declaration that Locsin is disqualified, he is still eligible and all votes obtained in favor of Locsin will be considered counted.

text: Ang Comelec lang suno kay  Villa ang makahibalo kun bala magapabilin pa nga kandidato sa piniliay ang isa ka pulitiko ukon indi na.
english: Villa said only the Comelec can know whether a politician will remain a candidate in the election or not.

text: Entitled man suno sa iya si Locsin sang substitution apang kun wala pa ini nabatun sang kampo mismo sang natungdan kag sang abogado sini, indi matigayun ang substitution sang candiates.

text: Gintapos na ni Melvin Jerusalem ang malawig-lawig man nga world championship drought sang Pilipinas sa pro boxing matapos ginlutos ang Japanese fighter nga si Yudai Shigeoka paagi sa split decision kag naagaw ang trono bilang World Boxing Council (WBC) minimumweight champion!
english: Melvin Jerusalem ended the Philippines' long world championship drought in pro boxing after defeating Japanese fighter Yudai Shigeoka by split decision to seize the throne as World Boxing Council (WBC) minimumweight champion!

text: Ginpatigayon ang sambuwa sa International Conference Hall sa Nagoya, Japan kadungan sang Easter Sunday kun sa diin duha ka beses nga gintumba sang Pinoy si Shigeoka — isa sa third kag isa sa sixth round.
english: The fight was held at the International Conference Hall in Nagoya, Japan on Easter Sunday where the Filipino knocked out Shigeoka twice — one in the third and one in the sixth round.

text: Apisar sang duha ka knockdowns, nangin masandukot ang 12-round bout kun sa diin pareho nga 114-112 ang gin-skor sang judges nga sanday Jae Bong Kim kag Barry Lindenman pabor sa Bukidnon pride samtang naghatag naman si Malcolm Bulner sang 114-113 pabor kay Shigeoka.
english: Despite the two knockdowns, the 12-round bout was a tight one with judges Jae Bong Kim and Barry Lindenman scoring 114-112 in favor of Bukidnon pride while Malcolm Bulner gave 114-113 in favor of Shigeoka.

text: Nagsaka na sa 22-3 ang rekord ni Jerusalem nga may 12 knockouts, samtang ini naman ang labing-una nga kalutusan ni Shigeoka sa iya karera nga subong may 8-1 record kun sa diin lima ang knockouts.
english: Jerusalem's record has risen to 22-3 with 12 knockouts, while this is the first defeat of Shigeoka's career, which now has an 8-1 record with five knockouts.

text: Ang kadalag-an sang 28-anyos nga Pinoy boxer ang nagpabalik sa iya sa ibabaw sang minimumweight division.
english: The 28-year-old Filipino boxer's victory brought him back to the top of the minimumweight division.

text: Ini man ang naghatag sa Pilipinas sang una kag nagaisahanon sang world title sa boksing matapos ang asud-asud nga kapaslawan sang Filipino fighters.
english: It also gave the Philippines its first and only world title in boxing after a series of failures by Filipino fighters.

text: Antes ang hampang ni Jerusalem, daw kaangay nga sumpa sa Pinoy boxers ang sambuwa sa Japan — kaangay kanday Marlon Tapales kag Jerwin Ancajas nga pareho nga nalutos sa kamot sang mag-utod nga sanday Naoya kag Takuma Inoue sa Japan.
english: Before Jerusalem's match, the fight in Japan seemed like a curse to Filipino boxers — like Marlon Tapales and Jerwin Ancajas who both lost at the hands of brothers Naoya and Takuma Inoue in Japan.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, matandaan nga nadag-an man ni Jerusalem ang iya labing-una nga world title (WBA minimumweight belt) sa Japan sang ginpierde sini ang Japanese champion nga si Masataka Taniguchi sa Osaka.#
english: Last year, Jerusalem also won his first world title (WBA minimumweight belt) in Japan when he defeated Japanese champion Masataka Taniguchi in Osaka.

text: Mahimo mabuhinan sang tubtub sa singko pesos kada kilo ang presyo sang bugas kun panubuon man ang taripa sa rice imports.
english: The price of rice could be reduced by up to five pesos per kilo if the tariff on rice imports is also reduced.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Assistant Secretary kag spokesman Arnel de Mesa, kun mabuhinan ang rice tariffs sang mas manubo sa 35%, ang retail prices sang bugas ang mabuhinan sang P4 to P5 per kilo.
english: According to Agriculture Assistant Secretary and spokesman Arnel de Mesa, if the rice tariffs are reduced by less than 35%, the retail prices of rice will be reduced by P4 to P5 per kilo.

text: Antes sini, nauna na nga ginpahayag ni Finance Undersecretary Domini Velasquez nga ginalantaw sang gobyerno nga panubuon pa ang rice tariffs sa ginabanta 15 to 20 percent ipaanggid sa present rate nga 35 percent.
english: Earlier, Finance Undersecretary Domini Velasquez said the government is considering raising rice tariffs by an estimated 15 to 20 percent compared to the present rate of 35 percent.

text: Mangin si Finance Secretary Ralph Recto ang nagpahayag man nga gusto sang gobyerno nga panubuan ang rice tariffs para mabutong man panubo ang retail prices sang bugas sang mas madasig.
english: Even Finance Secretary Ralph Recto said the government wants to lower rice tariffs to bring down retail prices of rice more quickly.

text: Suno kay Velasquez, handa ang Department of Finance nga makaangkon sang revenue losses sang P10 billion halin sa rice tariff reduction bilang kabaylo sang pagpahagan-hagan sang inflation sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Velasquez, the Department of Finance is ready to incur revenue losses of P10 billion from the rice tariff reduction in exchange for easing inflation in the Philippines.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang rice imports ang naga-account sang ginabanta 20 percent sang total staple supply sa Pilipinas.
english: Rice imports account for approximately 20 percent of the total staple supply in the Philippines.

text: Sa Spiritual of Testament nga gin-release kaina man sang kaagahon oras sa Pilipinas, nagpahayag ang Santo Papa nga ilubong siya sa iya pinalangga nga basilica sa Roma nga amo ang Santa Maria Maggiore.

english: He also requested that his grave be simple, without decorations, and named Franciscus.

text: Ginsiling sini nga sa iya bilog nga kabuhi kag sa iya ministry bilang pari kag obispo, ginsalig gid niya ang iya kabuhi sa Blessed Virgin Mary.
english: He said that throughout his life and in his ministry as a priest and bishop, he trusted his life to the Blessed Virgin Mary.

text: Ginbalikan man sini nga masami gid siya nagakadto sa ancient Marian sanctuary sa kada pag-umpisa kag pagtakop sang iya Apostolic Journey, bangud ginapalab-ot niya ang iya intensyon sa Immaculate Mother, kag nagapasalamat man sa iya pagtatap bilang isa ka Iloy.
english: He also recalled that he often went to the ancient Marian sanctuary at the beginning and end of his Apostolic Journey, because he conveyed his intention to the Immaculate Mother, and also thanked her for her care as a Mother.

text: Partikular man sini nga ginhingyo nga ibutang ang iya bangkay sa tunga sang Pauline Chapel (Chapel of the Salus Populi Romani) kag Sforza Chapel of the Basilica.

english:
Vista Alegre, Bacolod City on Saturday night.

english: According to Police Captain Dax Santillan, station commander of Bacolod Police Station 7, they received information that there was a shooting incident that occurred in the said area.

text: Suno kay Santillan, gilayon man nila nga ginrespondehan ang lugar kag naabtan ang biktima nga gilayon man gindala sa ospital matapos nga makaangkon sang igo sang bala sa dughan.

english: The suspect was identified as alias Duncan Ramos and resident of the said Barangay.

english: Recovered from the suspect were 12 grams of suspected shabu with a street value of P81,600; a caliber .45 pistol, with a magazine and a loaded bullet used to shoot the victim.

text: Ginpangunahan nanday Anthony Davis kag LeBron James ang Los Angeles Lakers nga mahimo ang ila nga highest-scoring performance sa sulod sang 37 ka tuig paagi sa paglutos sa Indiana Pacers.
english: Anthony Davis and LeBron James led the Los Angeles Lakers to their highest-scoring performance in 37 years by beating the Indiana Pacers.

text: Daog ang Lakers, 150-145, kun sa diin 36 puntos kag 16 rebounds ang halin kay Davis samtang nagdugang naman si James sang 26 puntos kag 10 assists.
english: The Lakers won, 150-145, with Davis scoring 36 points and 16 rebounds while James added 26 points and 10 assists.

text: Nagdugang pa kuntani ang Indiana sang 46 puntos sa katapusan nga quarter apang nagbubo man ang Lakers sang 10 sa last minute nga amo ang rason sang ila ikatatlo nga sunod-sunod nga kadalag-an.
english: Indiana would have added another 46 points in the final quarter but the Lakers also poured in 10 in the last minute for their third straight victory.

text: Nagapang-siyam ang Lakers sa Western Conference kag may 11 pa ka mga hampang nga nabilin sa 82-game regular season.
english: The Lakers are ninth in the Western Conference with 11 games remaining in the 82-game regular season.

text: Ang top six amo ang maka-qualify para sa end-of season play-offs, samtang ang nagapang-pito tubtub 10 amo ang magasulod sa play-in tournament.
english: The top six will qualify for the end-of-season play-offs, while the seventh to 10th will advance to the play-in tournament.

text: Ang Pacers naman ang nagapang-anum sa Eastern Conference kag may 10 pa ka mga hampang nga nabilin.
english: The Pacers are sixth in the Eastern Conference with 10 games remaining.

text:

english:
Their game last night was the first time they met on the court again since the Lakers also defeated the Pacers, 123-109, in Las Vegas to clinch the championship in the first-ever In-Season Tournament last December 2023.#

text: Ginpadal-an na sang sulat sang mga legal counsel sang mga myembro sang Sangguniang Panlunsod nga nag-boycott sang tinalikdan nga mga session ang mga executive offices sa Iloilo City Hall agud magpaathag sa rason sa ila pagpamalabag sa pagdeklarar sang state of calamity sa Syudad sang Iloilo.

english: It is known that if the peso continues to weaken, the price of imports such as crude oil and rice will also become more expensive because more pesos will need to be converted into dollars to buy these necessities.

text: Nagpagwa sang statement ang presidential son nga si House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos nahanungod sa statement sang iya tiya nga si Senador Imee Marcos batok sa presidente kag sa first lady.
english: Presidential son House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos issued a statement regarding his aunt Senator Imee Marcos' statement against the president and the first lady.

text: Suno kay Sandro, indi batasan sang isa ka matuod nga utod ang ginpakita sang iya tiya.
english: According to Sandro, his aunt's behavior was not the behavior of a true brother.

text: Pahayag pa niya, ang pagtraidor ni Imee sa ila pamilya ang tuman ka sakit para kay Sandro ilabi na nga ang tiya man niya nga senadora amo ang naghatag sa iya sang panugod sa publiko nga kabuhi.
english: Pahayag pa niya, ang pagtraidor ni Imee sa ila pamilya ang tuman ka sakit para kay Sandro ilabi na nga ang tiya man niya nga senadora amo ang naghatag sa iya sang panugod sa publiko nga kabuhi.

text: Matandaan nga ginbuyagyag ni Imee nga nagagamit sang iligal nga druga si Presidente Marcos kag amo man si first lady Liza.
english: Imee revealed that President Marcos and First Lady Liza are using illegal drugs.

text: Ipa-guwa mangin sa mga sinehan sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang pelikula nga ‘A Very Good Girl’ kun sa diin bida sanday Kathryn Bernardo kag Golden Globe nominee nga si Dolly de Leon.
english: The film 'A Very Good Girl' starring Kathryn Bernardo and Golden Globe nominee Dolly de Leon will also be released in theaters in the United States of America.

text: Maga-umpisa ang showing sini sa US cinemas sa Oktubre 13.
english: It will start showing in US cinemas on October 13.

text: Excited si De Leon nga mapakita sa North America ang produkto sang Pilipinas bangud world-class suno sa iya ang kalidad sini nga maapresyar gid sang filmgoers.
english: De Leon is excited to showcase Philippine products in North America because he said the quality is world-class and will be appreciated by filmgoers.

text: Bag-uhan naman para kay Kathryn ang balatyagon nga ipalantaw sa mas daku nga audience ang iya abilidad, kag nagalaum siya nga magbukas ang dugang nga oportunidad para sa iban nga Filipino films.
english: For Kathryn, the feeling of showcasing her skills to a larger audience is new, and she hopes that it will open up more opportunities for other Filipino films.

text: Malantaw ang “A Very Good Girl” sa Philippine theaters umpisa sa Septyembre 27.
english: “A Very Good Girl” will be released in Philippine theaters starting September 27.

text: Sa idalom sang direksyon ni Petersen Vargas, bida man diri sanday Jake Ejercito kag Angel Aquino.
english: Under the direction of Petersen Vargas, it also stars Jake Ejercito and Angel Aquino.

text: Ang bag-o nga pope ang dapat pilion sang most senior officials sang Catholic Church nga ginatawag nga College of Cardinals.
english: The new pope must be chosen by the most senior officials of the Catholic Church called the College of Cardinals.

text: Sila tanan ang gin-appoint sang Pope, kag masami sila ang gin-ordinahan nga mga obispo.
english: They are all appointed by the Pope, and they are often ordained bishops.

text: May yara subong sang 252 Catholic cardinals, 138 sa ila ang eligible sa pagboto para sa bag-o nga santo papa.
english: There are currently 252 Catholic cardinals, 138 of whom are eligible to vote for the new pope.

text: Ang iban nga lapaw ang edad sa 80, ang nagakahulugan nga indi sila makapakigbahin sa eleksyon apang makaintra sa debate kun sin-o ang dapat pilion.
english: Others are over the age of 80, which means they cannot participate in the election but can participate in the debate on who should be elected.

text: Gintumba sang Pinoy boxer nga si Eumir Marcial ang Thai nga kasumpong nga si Theodsak Sinam sa iya labing-una nga pro boxing fight subong nga 2024.
english: Pinoy boxer Eumir Marcial knocked out Thai opponent Theodsak Sinam in his first pro boxing fight this 2024.

text: Left uppercut ni Marcial ang nagtupa kay Sinam sa fourth round nga wala sini nasarangan kag wala gid nakabangon sa atubang sang Pinoy boxing fans sa Ninoy Aquino Stadium sa Malate, Manila.
english: Marcial's left uppercut landed Sinam in the fourth round but he couldn't get up in front of the Filipino boxing fans at the Ninoy Aquino Stadium in Malate, Manila.

text: Bangud sa pag-untat sang hampang uno minuto kag 33 segundos makaligad sa ika-apat nga round, nagsaka na sa 5-0 ang matinlo nga rekord ni Marcial sa professional boxing kun sa diin tatlo ang knockouts.
english: With the fight stopping one minute and 33 seconds after the fourth round, Marcial's clean record in professional boxing rose to 5-0 with three knockouts.

text: Nadagdag naman ang rekord ni Sinam sa 23-14 nga may 19 ka knockouts.
english: Sinam improved his record to 23-14 with 19 knockouts.

text: Magluwas nga ini ang imbukada nga hampang ni Marcial subong nga 2024 nga espesyal bangud personal nga ginsaksihan ini sang mga Pinoy fans, ini man ang katapusan nga sambuwa antes ang pagsabak sa 2024 Paris Olympics kun sa diin tuyo sini nga makuha ang gold medal sa light heavyweight.
english: Besides being Marcial's opening fight this 2024 which is special because it was personally witnessed by Filipino fans, it is also the last fight before the 2024 Paris Olympics where he aims to win the gold medal in the light heavyweight category.

text: Sandig sa local officials, makaupod sang Zamboangueño pride ang Philippine Team sa paghanas didto sa training camp sa Colorado Springs, USA.
english: According to local officials, the Philippine Team will join the Zamboangueño pride in training at the training camp in Colorado Springs, USA.

text: Nagaplano ang National Food Authority (NFA) Region VI nga magbakal sang 13 ka mga truck para sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The National Food Authority (NFA) Region VI plans to purchase 13 trucks for next year.

text: Tuyo sini nga tikang nga malab-ot ang malayo ukon maligwin nga mga lugar kag madasig kag direkta nga makabakal sang humay sa mga mangunguma.
english: The initiative aims to reach remote or isolated areas and quickly and directly purchase rice from farmers.

text: Sa ginhiwat nga pagtilipon sang mga asosasyon sang mga mangunguma sa Iloilo, ginpaathag ni Dr. Glenda Paz, branch manager sang NFA Iloilo Branch, nga pamatuod ini nga wala nagakatulog ang ahensya kundi ginasabat ang kinahanglanon sang mga mangunguma.
english: At a meeting of farmers' associations in Iloilo, Dr. Glenda Paz, branch manager of the NFA Iloilo Branch, said this is proof that the agency is not sleeping but is responding to the needs of the farmers.

text: May tatlo man ka mga daku nga bodega nga ginpatukod sa Jaro, Iloilo City kag mga banwa sang Dumangas kag Dueñas sa idalom sang Masagana Agri-Food Infrastructure Modernization program ukon MAFIM.
english: Three large warehouses were also built in Jaro, Iloilo City and the towns of Dumangas and Dueñas under the Masagana Agri-Food Infrastructure Modernization program or MAFIM.

text: Ini nga programa ang ginhimo paagi sa kolaborasyon sang NFA kag Department of Agriculture (DA) agud mangin moderno ang agricultural infrastructure para nga mapataas ang productivity, mabuhinan ang pyerde sa post-harvest, kag ma-improve ang food security.
english: This program was developed in collaboration with the NFA and the Department of Agriculture (DA) to modernize agricultural infrastructure to increase productivity, reduce post-harvest losses, and improve food security.

text: Magluwas diri suno kay Paz, may iga-dugang pa nga proyekto sa Quinto Distrito agud nga mas madamo nga mga mangunguma ang malab-ot sang serbisyo sang NFA sa Panay.
english: Besides, Paz said, there will be more projects in the Fifth District so that more farmers can be reached by the NFA's services in Panay.

text: Una na nga ginklaro sang ahensya nga wala sila nag-untat sa pagpamakal sang humay halin sa mga lokal nga mangunguma, apang limitado ang kapasidad bangud puno na ang mga warehouse kag kulang sa dryer equipment.
english: Earlier, the agency clarified that they have not stopped buying rice from local farmers, but the capacity is limited because the warehouses are full and there is a lack of dryer equipment.

text: Sakay sa nasambitan nga dump truck ang 24 ka mga Job Order casuals gikan sa Silay City Government nga nagpatigayon sang tree planting activity sa Sitio Patag sa nasambit nga siyudad.
english: Aboard the said dump truck were 24 Job Order casuals from the Silay City Government who conducted a tree planting activity in Sitio Patag in the said city.

text: Suno kay Lina Andrade, Job Order Casual kag asawa sang isa sa mga nasamaran, sa pagpasaka pa lamang sa lugar sang aga, nagabisyo na ang mini dump truck.
english: According to Lina Andrade, Job Order Casual and wife of one of the injured, when they got to the scene in the morning, the mini dump truck was already driving.

text: Suno diri, makapila magpatay- patay ang makina sang salakyan, gani may pila nga mga sakay ang naglumpat, apang nagbalik man sang makasaka na sa ibabaw.
english: According to him, the engine of the vehicle turned off several times, so some passengers jumped, but returned when they climbed to the top.

text: Pahayag sini nauna ang mini dump truck sa pagpauli kag sila ang wala pa makahalin sa tree planting site sang ginpahibalo tuhoy sa aksidente.
english: He said the mini dump truck was returning home earlier and they had not yet left the tree planting site when they were informed about the accident.

text: Tuman naman ang kakugmat sini bangod sakay sa nasambitan nga salakyan ang iya bana nga si Aaron Andrade, street cleaner sang ciudad.
english: She was shocked because her husband, Aaron Andrade, a street cleaner in the city, was riding in the vehicle.

text: Wala naman natam-an ang iya bana kag nag-angkon lamang sang minor injuries.
english: Her husband was not seriously injured and sustained minor injuries.

text: Sa ikatatlo nga tion, “divorce” sa gihapon ang resulta sang pagpakasal sang 41-anyos nga American pop superstar nga si Britney Spears.
english: For the third time, the result of the marriage of 41-year-old American pop superstar Britney Spears is still “divorce”.

text: Ini matapos nag-file na sang petition sa Los Angeles Superior Court ang iya 29-anyos nga bana nga si Sam Asghari agud nga tapuson na ang ila pag-asawahay nga naglawig lamang sang 14 ka bulan.
english: This comes after her 29-year-old husband, Sam Asghari, filed a petition in the Los Angeles Superior Court to end their marriage, which lasted only 14 months.

text: Na-engage ang duha sang Septyembre 2021, kag ginhiwat ang star-studded ceremony sang Hunyo 2022.
english: The two got engaged in September 2021, and held the star-studded ceremony in June 2022.

text: Wala pa sang ginpaguwa nga pahayag sanday Britney kag Sam, apang sandig sa gin-file nga petition, gin-saad nga rason ang ila mga kinalain nga amo ang rason sang ila indi paghangpanay.
english: Britney and Sam have not yet released a statement, but according to the petition filed, they promised to cite their differences as the reason for their misunderstanding.

text:
Si Sam, isa ka Iranian-American actor, model kag fitness trainer, ang nangin co-star anay ni Britney sa iya music video sa iya single nga “Slumber Party.”

Kun madumduman, una nga nagpakasal si Britney sa iya childhood friend sa Kentwood, Louisiana nga si Jason Alexander sang 2004 apang naglawig lamang sang 55 ka oras ang ila pag-asawahay.
english:
Sam, an Iranian-American actor, model and fitness trainer, previously co-starred with Britney in her music video to her single “Slumber Party.”

Britney first married her childhood friend Jason Alexander in Kentwood, Louisiana in 2004 but their marriage lasted only 55 hours.

text: Nagpakasal man ini sa dancer nga si Kevin Federline, nag-angkon sang duha ka anak, apang nag-file man sang divorce sang 2006.
english: She also married dancer Kevin Federline, had two children, but also filed for divorce in 2006.

text: Mabatyagan na sang Indonesia ang pwersa ni Justin Brownlee matapos nga nagpirma na ini sa Pelita Jaya sa Indonesian Basketball League.
english: Indonesia will feel the force of Justin Brownlee after he signed with Pelita Jaya in the Indonesian Basketball League.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini sang club Myerkules sang gab-i pila ka adlaw matapos ginkumpirma sang 35-anyos nga basketball veteran nga mahampang ini anay sa luwas sang pungsod samtang nga wala pa sang obligasyon para sa national team nga Gilas Pilipinas kag sa Barangay Ginebra nga amo ang iya team sa Philippine Basketball Association (PBA).
english: The club announced this Wednesday night, a few days after the 35-year-old basketball veteran confirmed that he will play abroad while he has no obligation for the national team Gilas Pilipinas and Barangay Ginebra, which is his team in the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA).

text: Una na nga ginsiling ni Gilas kag Ginebra Coach Tim Cone nga suportado sini si Brownlee kag nagapati siya nga makabulig man ini sa kapagros kag income sang Gilas star samtang nga nagapreparar para sa Olympic qualifiers.
english: Earlier, Gilas and Ginebra coach Tim Cone said he supports Brownlee and believes it will also help the Gilas star's health and income while preparing for the Olympic qualifiers.

text: Sa Hunyo liwat nga magatipon ang Gilas para sa 2024 FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament.
english: In June the Gilas will meet again for the 2024 FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament.

text: Subong naman ginapatigayon sang PBA ang All-Filipino Conference.
english: The PBA is currently holding the All-Filipino Conference.

text: Sa Pelita Jaya naman, isa ka star-studded roster ang makaupod ni Brownlee nga naga-feature sa Indonesian team standout nga si Brandon Jawato, former PBA TNT import nga si KJ McDaniels, kag ex-NBA player nga si Thomas Robinson.
english: Meanwhile in Pelita Jaya, Brownlee will be joined by a star-studded roster featuring Indonesian team standout Brandon Jawato, former PBA TNT import KJ McDaniels, and ex-NBA player Thomas Robinson.

text: Sa subong, nagapang-lima ang amo nga team sa nagapadayon nga hinampang sa Indonesian league nga may 7-1 win-loss record.
english: The team is currently fifth in the ongoing Indonesian league with a 7-1 win-loss record.

text: ESTANCIA, ILOILO – Nagsabat si Estancia Mayor Rene Cordero may kaangtanan sa akusasyon nga may yara siya sang goons kag nagapang-harass.
english: ESTANCIA, ILOILO – Estancia Mayor Rene Cordero has responded to the accusation that he has goons and harassment.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Cordero sang nasambit nga banwa, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang kamatuoran ang nasambit nga akusasyon kag ginapasibangdan lang siya sang mga kasumpong sa pulitiko.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Cordero of the said town said there is no truth in the accusation and he is being blamed by his political opponents.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno kay Cordero, ang kampo ni mayoralty candidate Melina Requinto ang may yara sang madamo nga goons.
english: In fact, Cordero said, the camp of mayoralty candidate Melina Requinto has many goons.

text: Pahayag pa ni Cordero, sa caucus ni Requinto, ginpahayag sang iya kasumpong nga sang una, napatyan sila sang miyembro kag sa subong sila naman ang magapamatay.
english: Cordero said that in Requinto's caucus, his opponent said that in the past, they were killed by members and now they will kill.
