text: Nahibaluan nga nagpa-blotter sa Estancia Municipal Police Station ang kampo ni Requinto bangud sa ginapahayag duha ka makaduluda nga tawo nga nagaluyong sa  balay sang nasmabit nga mayoralty candidate.
english: Requinto's camp filed a blotter at the Estancia Municipal Police Station over the alleged presence of two suspicious men lurking in the mayoralty candidate's house.

text: Gin-utod sang MORE Power ang kuryente sa barangay hall, day care center, health center, covered gym, kag tanod outpost sang Brgy.
english: MORE Power cut off power to the barangay hall, day care center, health center, covered gym, and tanod outpost of Brgy.

text: Alalasan, Lapuz bangud sa utang nga naglab-ot sa kapin P686,000.
english: Alalasan, Lapuz due to a debt of more than P686,000.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PB Jofel Ladiet, iya ginpahayag nga ang gupliyada nga pag-utod sang kuryente sa mga nasambit nga mga pasilidad sa ila lugar ang makabig niya nga isa ka dako nga palamangkutanon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, PB Jofel Ladiet said that the frequent power cuts in these facilities in their area is a big question mark.

text: Suno kay Ladiet, naglab-ot sa masobra P500,000 ang penalty halin sa illegal connection nga ginbilin sang nagligad nga administrasyon.
english: According to Ladiet, the penalty from the illegal connection left by the previous administration amounted to more than P500,000.

text: Samtang P100,000 naman ang regular bill.
english: Meanwhile, the regular bill is P100,000.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang utang ang naghalin pa sang tuig 2021 tubtob 2023 sa panahon ni anay PB Maricon Sumpio.
english: The debt dates back to 2021 to 2023 during the tenure of former PB Maricon Sumpio.

text: Nakigsapol na si PB Ladiet sa barangay council sa subong nga administrasyon para sa pagbayad sang utang apang nagpamalibad ang mga ini kag indi mag ako sang responsibilidad bangud indi sila ang responsable sa amo nga illegal connection.
english: PB Ladiet has already met with the barangay council of the current administration to pay the debt but they refused and will not accept responsibility because they are not responsible for the illegal connection.

text: Sa subong, apektado ang serbisyo sa barangay bangud wala sang kuryente.
english: Currently, the service in the barangay is affected due to the lack of electricity.

text: Gintugutan naman sang Iloilo City Government nga makabayad ang barangay sang masobra P95,000 para sa bill halin Hunyo tubtob Nobyembre 2023 sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The Iloilo City Government has allowed the barangay to pay more than P95,000 for the bill from June to November 2023 next year.

text: Humiling ang kampo ni dating pangulong Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC) na agad siyang palayain nang walang kondisyon, kasabay ng paghahain ng apela laban sa desisyong nagpapatibay sa hurisdiksiyon ng ICC sa Pilipinas kahit umalis na ang bansa sa Rome Statute.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's camp has asked the International Criminal Court (ICC) to release him immediately without conditions, while filing an appeal against the decision that strengthens the ICC's jurisdiction over the Philippines even after the country withdraws from the Rome Statute.

text: Sa 21-pahinang apela na inihain nitong Biyernes, iginiit ng mga abogado ni Duterte na nagkamali ang Pre-Trial Chamber sa interpretasyon ng batas at mga pangyayari nang magpasya nitong Oktubre na maaaring ipagpatuloy ng ICC ang mga proseso nito kaugnay ng Pilipinas.
english: In a 21-page appeal filed on Friday, Duterte's lawyers insisted that the Pre-Trial Chamber erred in its interpretation of the law and the events that decided in October that the ICC could continue its proceedings against the Philippines.

text: Ayon sa depensa, ginamit umano ng Chamber ang isang “bago at walang batayang interpretasyon” ng Article 127(2) ng Rome Statute at itinuturing umano itong mas pinapairal kaysa Article 12, na siyang pangkalahatang alituntunin sa hurisdiksiyon ng korte.
english: According to the defense, the Chamber allegedly used a “new and unfounded interpretation” of Article 127(2) of the Rome Statute and allegedly considered it more applicable than Article 12, which is the general rule of court jurisdiction.

text: “Mahirap unawain kung paano nagawa ng Pre-Trial Chamber na magpasya na ‘ang Article 127(2) ng Statute ay nagbibigay-daan sa Korte na ipagpatuloy ang paggamit ng hurisdiksiyon kung ang isyu ay nasimulan nang dinggin bago maging epektibo ang pag-alis ng isang estado,’” ayon sa kampo ni Duterte.
english: "It is difficult to understand how the Pre-Trial Chamber could decide that 'Article 127(2) of the Statute allows the Court to continue the exercise of jurisdiction if the issue has already been heard before the withdrawal of a state becomes effective,'" according to the Duterte camp.

text: Kasalukuyang nakakulong si Duterte sa pasilidad ng ICC dahil sa kasong crimes against humanity kaugnay ng madugong giyera kontra droga ng kanyang administrasyon.
english: Duterte is currently detained at the ICC facility on charges of crimes against humanity in connection with his administration's bloody anti-drug war.

text: Tinuligsa rin ng apela ang paggamit ng ICC ng konseptong “subsequent practice,” at iginiit na hindi maaaring bigyang-kahulugan ang naging kilos ng Pilipinas matapos ang pagkalas nito bilang pagsang-ayon na may kapangyarihan pa rin ang korte.
english: The appeal also challenged the ICC's use of the concept of “subsequent practice,” and stressed that the Philippines' actions after its abolition cannot be interpreted as an acknowledgment that the court still has jurisdiction.

text: Dagdag pa ng depensa, walang probisyon sa tratado na nagbibigay hurisdiksiyon sa ICC sa isang bansang hindi na kasapi.
english: In addition, there is no provision in the treaty that gives the ICC jurisdiction over a non-member country.

text: “Ang ‘subsequent practice’ ng Pilipinas ay hindi maaaring gamiting gabay sa interpretasyon, lalo’t malinaw na ipinakita ng kabuuang kilos ng Pamahalaan ng Pilipinas ang pagtutol sa kakayahan ng Korte na gamitin ang hurisdiksiyon nito,” ayon sa dokumento.
english: “The subsequent practice of the Philippines cannot be used as a guide to interpretation, especially since the overall actions of the Philippine Government have clearly shown resistance to the Court's ability to exercise its jurisdiction,” the document said.

text: Alinsunod sa Rome Statute, maaaring ipagpatuloy ng ICC ang pag-imbestiga sa mga krimeng naganap habang miyembro pa ang isang bansa.
english: Under the Rome Statute, the ICC can continue to investigate crimes committed while a country is still a member.

text: Nagsimula ang drug war noong 2016.
english: The drug war began in 2016.

text: Umalis ang Pilipinas sa tratado noong 2018 at naging epektibo ang pagkalas noong 2019.
english: The Philippines withdrew from the treaty in 2018 and the withdrawal became effective in 2019.

text: Nadag-an sang Pilipinas ang bidding sa pag-host sang Federation Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB) Men’s World Championship sa masunod nga tuig!
english: The Philippines has won the bid to host the Federation Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB) Men’s World Championship next year!

text: Patigayunon ang daku nga hinampang sa Septyembre 12-28, 2025 kun sa diin personal nga masaksihan sang mga Pinoy ang pag-abot kag pagpaindis-indis sang 32 ka best men’s team sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: The big game will be held on September 12-28, 2025 where Filipinos will personally witness the arrival and competition of 32 best men's teams from around the world.

text: Sanday Senator Pia Cayetano kag Philippine National Volleyball Federation president Ramon Suzara ang nagpanguna sa bidding delegation sang Pilipinas sang gin-award na ang bidding rights sa official ceremony sa FIVB general headquarters sa Lausanne, Switzerland, Myerkules sang gab-i (oras sa Pilipinas).
english: Senator Pia Cayetano and Philippine National Volleyball Federation president Ramon Suzara led the bidding delegation of the Philippines when the bidding rights were awarded in an official ceremony at the FIVB general headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland, Wednesday night (Philippine time).

text: Suno kay FIVB president Dr. Ary Graca, ini nga prestihiyoso nga event ang wala lamang nagatuyo nga maka-inspire sa masunod nga henerasyon sang atleta kundi ma-engganyo man ang partisipasyon sa sports sa tanan nga lebel sa Pilipinas kag sa mas masangkad nga mga rehiyon.
english: According to FIVB president Dr. Ary Graca, this prestigious event not only aims to inspire the next generation of athletes but also to encourage participation in sports at all levels in the Philippines and in the wider regions.

text: “We are confident that the Philippines, supported by our innovative Volleyball Empowerment programme, will host an extraordinary World Championship that will leave a lasting legacy and help to cultivate an even brighter future for our sport globally,” dugang ni Graca.
english: “We are confident that the Philippines, supported by our innovative Volleyball Empowerment program, will host an extraordinary World Championship that will leave a lasting legacy and help to cultivate an even brighter future for our sport globally,” Graca added.

text: Nagsabat naman ang Pilipinas paagi kay Suzara nga preparado ang team sang pungsod nga mag-host sang championship.
english: The Philippines responded through Suzara that the country's team is ready to host the championship.

text: “For this, I am ready, our team is ready, the Philippines is ready to boldly face the challenge and to fulfil the dream, as we work collectively to serve volleyball.
english: “For this, I am ready, our team is ready, the Philippines is ready to boldly face the challenge and to fulfill the dream, as we work collectively to serve volleyball.

text: If you love volleyball then you will surely love the Philippines.
english: If you love volleyball then you will surely love the Philippines.

text: See you all in 2025,” pahayag ni Suzara.
english: See you all in 2025,” Suzara said.

text: Matandaan nga pormal nga ginlunsar sang Pilipinas ang bid sini sang nagligad nga Pebrero kasunod sang hosting sang Volleyball Nations League (VNL) sang 2022 kag 2023 sa Smart Araneta Coliseum kag Mall of Asia Arena — venues nga amo man ang posible gamiton para sa World Championship.
english: It can be recalled that the Philippines formally launched its bid last February following the hosting of the Volleyball Nations League (VNL) in 2022 and 2023 at the Smart Araneta Coliseum and Mall of Asia Arena — venues that are also likely to be used for the World Championship.

text: Liwat nga ginaengganyo ni Presidential Communications Office Sec.
english: Presidential Communications Office Sec.

text: Dave Gomez si anay Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co nga magpauli sa pungsod kag atubangon ang imbestigasyon sa maanomalya nga flood control projects.
english: Dave Gomez urged former Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co to return to the country and face the investigation into anomalous flood control projects.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa ikaduha nga video ni Co nga ginpagguwa sa iya Facebook page subong nga Sabado, Nov.
english: This is in connection with Co's second video released on his Facebook page this Saturday, Nov.

text: “We may begin to sound like a broken record.
english: “We may begin to sound like a broken record.

text: What he is saying is a bunch of hearsay.
english: What he is saying is a bunch of hearsay.

text: Sabi nito, sabi ni ano,” pahayag ni Gomez.
english: It says this, it says what,” Gomez said.

text: “Hindi nag rewrite ng script sa second video kahit na kanal na yung una.”
english: "I didn't rewrite the script for the second video even though the first one was cancelled."

text: Naghabuyanay sang akusasyon ang Russia kag Ukraine batok sa isa kag isa nga mansig lapas ang mga ini sa ginpatuman nga isa ka adlaw nga ceasefire.
english: Russia and Ukraine have accused each other of violating the one-day ceasefire.

text: Suno kay Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, nagapakuno-kuno lang ang Moscow nga naga-obserbar ini sang kalinong sa Easter.
english: According to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, Moscow is only pretending that it is observing peace on Easter.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa iya, 46 assaults ang ginlunsar sang Russians lakip na ang heavy weapons.
english: In fact, he said, the Russians launched 46 assaults including heavy weapons.

text: Suno naman sa Russian Defense Ministry, ang Kyiv amo ang wala nagsunod sa ginhambalan, bangud masobra 1,000 ka beses ini nga naglapas sa ceasefire nga rason sang halit sa imprastraktura kag pagkapatay sang mga sibilyan.
english: According to the Russian Defense Ministry, Kyiv has violated the ceasefire more than 1,000 times, causing damage to infrastructure and civilian casualties.

text: Gindugang sang ministry nga 444 ka beses nga gin-igu sang Ukraine ang Russian positions kag masobra 900 ang ila drone attacks lakip na ang pag-atake sa Crimea kag Russian border areas sang Bryansk, Kursk kag Belgorod regions.
english: The ministry added that Ukraine struck Russian positions 444 times and carried out more than 900 drone attacks, including strikes in Crimea and Russian border areas of the Bryansk, Kursk and Belgorod regions.

text: Matandaan nga si Russian President Vladimir Putin ang nagdeklarar sang isa ka adlaw nga untat-away kadungan sang pag-obserbar sang Domingo sang pagkabanhaw — buot silingon, wala sang military activity sa front lines tubtub nga magtakop ang Domingo.
english: It can be recalled that Russian President Vladimir Putin declared a one-day ceasefire in conjunction with the observance of Easter Sunday — that is, no military activity on the front lines until the end of Sunday.

text: Nalakip ang bugal sang Pilipinas nga si Efren ‘Bata’ Reyes sa inductees sa ginpatigayon nga inaugural World Billiards Hall of Fame sa Yushan, China.
english: The pride of the Philippines, Efren 'Bata' Reyes, was among the inductees at the inaugural World Billiards Hall of Fame in Yushan, China.

text: Nalakip man sa ginpasidunggan sa amo nga seremonya amo ang pinaka-popular nga pangalan sa pool history kaangay sa Chinese snooker star nga si Ding Junhui nga amo ang gin-kilala nga nagpasikat sini nga hampang sa Asia.
english: Also honored at the ceremony were the most popular names in pool history such as Chinese snooker star Ding Junhui who is credited with popularizing the game in Asia.

text: Yara man ang seven-time world champion nga si Ronnie O’Sullivan kag ang female veteran nga si Allison Fisher.
english: Also on hand were seven-time world champion Ronnie O’Sullivan and female veteran Allison Fisher.

text: May yara man sang World Billiards Museum nga ginpakita na sa publiko sa Yushan kasunod sang Hall of Fame inauguration.
english: There is also the World Billiards Museum which has already been shown to the public in Yushan following the Hall of Fame inauguration.

text: Tuman ka daku ini nga pagkilala bangud ang selection process para sa Hall of Fame ang nagalakip sa Nomination Committee kag Evaluation Committee nga ginabug-usan sang representatives halin sa international kag regional snooker organizations.
english: This is a very big recognition because the selection process for the Hall of Fame involves a Nomination Committee and an Evaluation Committee made up of representatives from international and regional snooker organizations.

text: Ang mga nagpartisipar sa Hall of Fame evaluation amo ang World Confederation of Billiards Sports (WCBS), International Billiards & Snooker Federation (IBSF), World Union of Billiards (UMB), World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association (WPBSA) kag ang World Pool-Billiard Association (WPBA).
english: Participants in the Hall of Fame evaluation were the World Confederation of Billiards Sports (WCBS), International Billiards & Snooker Federation (IBSF), World Union of Billiards (UMB), World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association (WPBSA) and the World Pool-Billiard Association (WPBA).

text: Ang 69-anyos nga Filipino billiards icon nga kilala nga “The Magician” ukon “Bata” ang ginbun-ag sa Pampanga kag na-induct man anay sa Billiard Congress of America’s Hall of Fame.
english: The 69-year-old Filipino billiards icon known as “The Magician” or “Bata” was born in Pampanga and was also inducted into the Billiard Congress of America’s Hall of Fame.

text: Nagdaog siya sang masobra 100 ka international title — lakip ang tion sa tunga-tunga sang 1999 ka 2004 sang ginkilala siya bilang 9-ball kag 8-ball world champion.
english: He won more than 100 international titles — including the time between 1999 and 2004 when he was recognized as the 9-ball and 8-ball world champion.

text: Sang 2003, ang nasambit nga pool wizard ang nagpangatlo sa masobra 400 participants sa one-pocket tournament sang Derby City Classic sa Indiana, United States.
english: In 2003, the said pool wizard placed third among more than 400 participants in the one-pocket tournament of the Derby City Classic in Indiana, United States.

text: Napahayag man sini anay nga indi na sini madumduman kun pila ka beses na ini nga nagpasakop sa Southeast Asian Games apang sandig sa rekord, nakabulsa siya sang pito ka gold medaks, duha ka silver, kag 11 ka bronze sa 10 ka mga edisyon sa English billiards, snooker, carom, pool kag rotation.#
english: He also said that he does not remember how many times he has participated in the Southeast Asian Games but according to the record, he has pocketed seven gold medals, two silver, and 11 bronze in 10 editions in English billiards, snooker, carom, pool and rotation.

text: Magabalik sa isa ka stage para sa reunion concert ang popular nga former on- and off-screen partners nga sanday Sharon Cuneta kag Gabby Conception!
english: Popular former on- and off-screen partners Sharon Cuneta and Gabby Conception will return to the same stage for the reunion concert!

text: Patigayunon ang Dear Heart nga konsyerto sa Oktubre 27 kag mangin available naman ang tickets umpisa sa Agusto 15.
english: The Dear Heart concert will be held on October 27 and tickets will be available starting August 15.

text: Una nga nangin bida sanday Sharon kag Gabby sa 1981 feature film nga “Dear Heart” antes sila nangin bantog nga pares sa pelikula man ukon sa matuod nga kabuhi.
english: Sharon and Gabby first starred in the 1981 feature film “Dear Heart” before becoming a famous couple either on film or in real life.

text: Nagpakasal sila sa Manila Cathedral sang 1984, nakaangkon sang anak nga si KC Conception, nangin legally separated sang 1987, kag na-annul ang kasal sang 1993.
english: They married in the Manila Cathedral in 1984, had a daughter, KC Conception, became legally separated in 1987, and had the marriage annulled in 1993.

text: All-set na ang Pinoy boxer nga si Eumir Marcial para sa sambuwa sini batok kay Thoedsak Sinam sang Thailand sa Ninoy Aquino Stadium sa Marso 23.
english: Filipino boxer Eumir Marcial is all-set for his fight against Thoedsak Sinam of Thailand at the Ninoy Aquino Stadium on March 23.

text: Halin sang nakabalik si Marcial gikan sa duha ka bulan nga training sa Las Vegas, Nevada, todo-hanas man ini gihapon sa Tagaytay Combat Sports Center agud nga preparahan ang iya away.
english: Since Marcial returned from two months of training in Las Vegas, Nevada, he has been training at the Tagaytay Combat Sports Center to prepare for his fight.

text: Pati ang ila nga boxing fight ang makabig man nga preparasyon para kay Marcial para sa nagahilapit nga Paris Olympics.
english: Even their boxing fight is also considered a preparation for Marcial for the upcoming Paris Olympics.

text: Wala nagakumpyansa si Marcial bangud may 24 ka daog kag 19 knockouts man ang iya kasumpong nga boksingero.
english: Marcial is not confident because his opponent has 24 wins and 19 knockouts.

text: Daku man ang pagpati sini nga nakabulig gid ang iya lain-lain nga sparring partners sa Amerika agud nga handaan ang Olympiada.
english: He also believes that his various sparring partners in America have helped him to prepare for the Olympics.

text: Excited man si Marcial nga masaksihan gid sang Filipino boxing fans ang iya nga away sa masunod nga inadlaw.
english: Marcial is also excited that Filipino boxing fans will be able to witness his fight in the coming days.

text: Kasunod sining pro-fight sa Manila, full blast na ang preparasyon ni Marcial para lagson ang iya handum nga makuha ang Olympic gold sa Paris nga tatlo ka tuig halin sang nakuha sini ang bronze medal sa Tokyo Olympics.#
english: Following this pro-fight in Manila, Marcial's preparations are full blast to pursue his dream of winning Olympic gold in Paris, three years after he won the bronze medal at the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Nadayon ang special session sang Sangguniang Panlunsod may kaangatanan sa pagdeklarar sang state of calamity sa Syudad sang Iloilo.
english: The special session of the Sangguniang Panlunsod was held regarding the declaration of a state of calamity in Iloilo City.

text: Ini apisar nga wala nagtambong sa session ang mga kaalyado ni Iloilo City Lone District Cong.
english: This is despite the fact that the allies of Iloilo City Lone District Cong.

text: Jerry Treñas nga sanday  Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon, Councilors Love Baronda, Ely Estante, Leila Luntao, Armand Parcon kag Jay Trenas.
english: Jerry Treñas that Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon, Councilors Love Baronda, Ely Estante, Leila Luntao, Armand Parcon and Jay Trenas.

text: Lakip naman sa mga nagtambong sa session amo sanday  City Councilors Liezl Joy Zulueta-Salazar, Candice Tupas, Eduardo Peñaredondo, Plaridel Nava, Joshua Alim, Lyndon Acap kag Mandrei Malabor.
english: Among those who attended the session were City Councilors Liezl Joy Zulueta-Salazar, Candice Tupas, Eduardo Peñaredondo, Plaridel Nava, Joshua Alim, Lyndon Acap and Mandrei Malabor.

text: Nagserbe naman bilang presiding officer si Konsehal R Leone Gerochi.
english: Councilor R Leone Gerochi served as the presiding officer.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes maka quorum, kinahanglan nga present ang walo ka mga konsehal.
english: It is known that before a quorum, eight councilors must be present.

text: Nangin dinapit naman nga bisita sa special session si Donna Magno, pinuno sang City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO).
english: Donna Magno, head of the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), was the guest of honor at the special session.

text: Ini ang panawagan sang Ombudsman kay anay Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co, magpauli na sa Pilipinas kag mag-agi sa husto nga proseso angot sang imbestigasyon sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: The Ombudsman called on former Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co to return to the Philippines and go through the proper process regarding the investigation into anomalous flood control projects.

text: Kasunod ini sang pagpanghangkat sang kongresista kay Ombudsman Boying Remulla nga imbestigaran sanday Pres.
english: This follows the congressman's challenge to Ombudsman Boying Remulla to investigate Pres.

text: Bongbong Marcos kag anay House speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Bongbong Marcos and former House speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan sa ginapahayag nga P100 billion nga insertion sa 2025 national budget.
english: This is in connection with the alleged P100 billion insertion in the 2025 national budget.

text: Ginapanindugan sang Ombudsman nga madugay na nga bukas ang ila talatapan para sa Co.
english: The Ombudsman insists that its office has been open for a long time for Co.

text: Handa man sila nga hatagan sang nagakaigo nga proteksyon ang anay kongresista.
english: They are also ready to provide appropriate protection to the former congressman.

text: “Kung tunay na layunin ninyo ang hustisya, dito iyon magsisimula — hindi sa ingay, kundi sa tamang proseso.”
english: “If you really want justice, it starts here — not with noise, but with due process.”

text: Positibo ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nga matapos na sini ang negosasyon sa free trade agreement (FTA) kaupod sa European Union (EU) antes pa man ang 2027 nga target.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) is positive that it will complete the negotiations on the free trade agreement (FTA) with the European Union (EU) before the 2027 target.

text: Suno kay Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual kadungan sang European-Philippine Business Dialogue, may ginasundan na nga model bangud ang negosasyon anay sa Philippine-European (FTA) ang nagkinahanglan lang sang isa ka tuig antes makumpleto.
english: According to Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual during the European-Philippine Business Dialogue, there is already a model being followed because the previous negotiations with the Philippine-European (FTA) took only one year to complete.

text: “We hope to be able to align the FTA to our goals of achieving the upper middle income status and moving behind the EU Generalized Scheme of Preference (GSP) framework.
english: “We hope to be able to align the FTA to our goals of achieving the upper middle income status and moving behind the EU Generalized Scheme of Preference (GSP) framework.

text: We hope to be able to graduate into the FTA,” pahayag sini.
english: We hope to be able to graduate into the FTA,” it said.

text: Sa subong, benepisyaryo ang Pilipina sang EU Generalized Scheme of Preference (GSP) Plus kun sa diin ginatugutan ang pagsulod sang 6,274 products sa bloc.
english: Currently, the Philippines is a beneficiary of the EU Generalized Scheme of Preference (GSP) Plus which allows 6,274 products to enter the bloc.

text: Ini nga benepisyo ang sarang lamang ma-enjoy sang mga pungsod nga na-classify sang World Bank nga below upper middle income.
english: This benefit can only be enjoyed by countries classified by the World Bank as below upper middle income.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni National Economic and Development Authority Secretary Arsenio Balisacan nga on track ang Pilipinas agud mangin isa na ka upper middle income economy sa 2025.#
english: Earlier, National Economic and Development Authority Secretary Arsenio Balisacan said the Philippines is on track to become an upper middle income economy by 2025.#

text: Nag-qualify para sa Paris Olympics subong nga tuig ang Filipino-Ivorian fencer nga si Maxine Esteban nga ginwigit anay sang Pilipinas sa national team apisar nga wala sang notice ukon pagpaathag nga ginhatag.
english: Filipino-Ivorian fencer Maxine Esteban, who was previously pulled by the Philippines from the national team, qualified for the Paris Olympics this year despite no notice or explanation being given.

text: Sa maabot nga Olympiada, indi man Pilipinas kundi Ivory Coast ang itiglawas ni Esteban.
english: In the upcoming Olympics, Esteban will represent not the Philippines but Ivory Coast.

text: Nakuha sini ang Olympic ticket matapos ang 2024 Absolute Fencing Gear FIE Foil Grand Prix sa Washington, United States kun sa diin ang iya pwesto ang nagpabilin sa iya sa Olympic qualifying race para sa nasambit nga African continental zone.
english: He earned his Olympic ticket after the 2024 Absolute Fencing Gear FIE Foil Grand Prix in Washington, United States where his place kept him in the Olympic qualifying race for the said African continental zone.

text: Todo-pasalamat man ang 23-anyos nga anay Ateneo standout sa sini nga “second chance” nga ginhatag sa iya.
english: The 23-year-old former Ateneo standout is also grateful for this “second chance” given to him.

text: Makatalandog-balatyagon man ang pagdedikar sini sang kadalag-an sa duha ka pungsod — sa Ivory Coast nga amo ang nagbaton sa iya; kag sa Pilipinas nga una naghatag sang kalain sang buot sa iya apang padayon niya nga ginapalangga.
english: Also touching was its dedication of the victory to two countries — to Ivory Coast which hosted him; and in the Philippines that first gave him a grudge but he continues to love.

text: “This is for Cote d’Ivoire, the country that embraced me, believed in me and supported me all the way, and for the Philippines, the country my heart will always beat proud of,” pahayag sini.
english: “This is for Cote d’Ivoire, the country that embraced me, believed in me and supported me all the way, and for the Philippines, the country my heart will always beat proud of,” it said.

text: Nangin kontrobersyal si Esteban sang nagligad nga tuig bangud sa pag-switch sini sang nationalities agud lagson ang iya handum nga makasaka sa Olympiada.
english: Esteban became controversial last year for switching nationalities to pursue his dream of qualifying for the Olympics.

text: Walo ka tuig siya nga kabahin sang Philippine national fencing team apang masakit ang ending sang iya istorya sa Pilipinas.
english: He was part of the Philippine national fencing team for eight years but his story in the Philippines had a painful ending.

text: Ginpakigbahin sini anay sang Nobyembre 2023 nga ginkakas siya sa national team kag “nabastos” gid siya bangud wala man lang sang pahibalo nga ginhatag antes ini nawigit.
english: He previously shared in November 2023 that he was removed from the national team and was very “rude” because no notice was given before he was dragged.

text: “I did not give up on my country, I gave up on the federation because they gave up on me first.
english: “I did not give up on my country, I gave up on the federation because they gave up on me first.

text: The reality is, sobra akong nabastos because I was removed from the national team roster without even being given the courtesy of a written nor a face-to-face notice and I was a member of the national team for eight years with good standing,” pahayag sini sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The reality is, I was so rude because I was removed from the national team roster without even being given the courtesy of a written nor a face-to-face notice and I was a member of the national team for eight years with good standing,” he said last year.

text: Gin-report nga sang amo nga tion, naga-recover pa lang siya sa injury nga naangkon sini sa world championships rason nga nagsampaw-sampaw ang kalain sang iya buot.
english: It was reported that at the time, he was still recovering from an injury he sustained in the world championships, which caused him to become very angry.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nagprangka man si Esteban nga may double-standard sa federation sa Pilipinas ukon indi patas ang pagtratar sa ila.
english: At the time, Esteban also opened up that there is a double-standard in the federation in the Philippines or they are not treated fairly.

text: “Mayroon din mga hindi sumali na mga nasa national team pa rin hanggang ngayon.
english: “There are also those who did not participate who are still in the national team until now.

text:
The law should apply to all, if not, then none at all.”

Ginsugid man sini anay nga makapila ka beses siya nga nagsulat sa federation agud magpangayo sang paathag kag naghingyo man nga makaatubangay sila para maathagan siya sang sitwasyon apang wala ginsabat ang iya request.#
english:
The law should apply to all, if not, then none at all.”

He said he had written to the federation several times to ask for an explanation and requested to meet with them to clarify the situation but his request was not answered.

text: SAN DIONISIO, ILOILO – Ginapausisa ni anay San Dionisio Mayor Peter Paul Lopez ang ginapahayag tuman ka damu nga job hire sang Local Government Unit sang San Dionisio, Iloilo nga ginagamit sa pagpangampanya sang mga kandidato para sa May 13 Midterm Elections.
english: SAN DIONISIO, ILOILO – Former San Dionisio Mayor Peter Paul Lopez is investigating the alleged excessive number of job hires of the Local Government Unit of San Dionisio, Iloilo used to campaign by candidates for the May 13 Midterm Elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lopez, iya ginpahayag nga santo sa iya nakita nga mga laragway sa social media kag sa iya mismo nasaksihan, ang mga job hire sang ila banwa ang nagapakigbahin sa pagpangampanya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lopez said that based on the pictures he saw on social media and what he personally witnessed, the job hires of their town are participating in the campaign.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno kay Lopez, indi man makita ang madamu nga mga job hire nga nagatrabaho sa palibot sang banwa kag sa baylo, makita lamang sila sa tion nga inughatag na sang sweldo.
english: In fact, according to Lopez, many job hires are not seen working around the town and instead, they are only seen during the time of salary payment.

text: Santo sa iya ihibalo, ang mga job hire ang ginbaton umpisa sang Enero tubtub Marso subong nga tuig.
english: According to him, the job hires were accepted from January to March this year.

text: Bangud sini, iya na nga ginpadal-an sang sulat si Mayor Larry Villanueva lakip na ang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) kag ang Civil Service Commission (CSC) agud nga magpatigayon sang imbestigasyon tuhoy diri.
english: He has already sent a letter to Mayor Larry Villanueva as well as the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) and the Civil Service Commission (CSC) to conduct an investigation into the matter.

text: Samtang, suno naman kay Mayor Villanueva sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ang mga ginatumod ni Lopez nga mga job hire ang boluntaryo nga nagresign agud nga makabulig sa pagpangampanya sa mga pulitiko bilang utang nga kabalaslan.
english: Meanwhile, Mayor Villanueva said in an interview with Bombo Radyo, the job hires Lopez referred to voluntarily resigned to help campaign for politicians as a debt of repayment.

text: Sa pihik sini, ginpromisa ni Villanueva nga hatagan si Lopez sang detalye tuhoy sa mga job hire sang San Dionisio agud nga mahibaluan kun bala ang mga nakita nga nagapangampanya amo ang existing job hire sang banwa.
english: Meanwhile, Villanueva promised to give Lopez details about the job hires of San Dionisio to find out whether those seen campaigning are the existing job hires of the town.

text: Lima na ang kumpirmado nga patay sa probinsya sang Capiz bangud sang lapnagon nga pagbaha nga dala sang Bagyo Ramil.
english: Five people have been confirmed dead in Capiz province due to widespread flooding caused by Typhoon Ramil.

text: Sandig sa data sang Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), ang mga ginbawian sang kabuhi amo sanday Rizaldo Balgos, 44 anyos sang Barangay Dinginan, Roxas City kag Mary Mae Urdelas, 22 anyos nga content creator sang Barangay Malocloc Sur, Ivisan nga pareho nga napatay bangud sa pagkalunod.
english: According to the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), the deceased were identified as Rizaldo Balgos, 44, of Barangay Dinginan, Roxas City and Mary Mae Urdelas, 22, content creator of Barangay Malocloc Sur, Ivisan.

text: May isa naman ka lalaki nga nakuryente sa Barangay Dulangan, Pilar.
english: Another man was electrocuted in Barangay Dulangan, Pilar.

text: Magluwas sa ila, may duha pa ka mga indibidwal nga na-report nga napatay sa Roxas City.
english: Besides them, two other individuals were reported dead in Roxas City.

text: Sa latest report sang Bombo Radyo Roxas halin sa data nga ginsumite sang awtoridad, nagdangat na sa 17,418 ka mga pamilya ukon katumbas sa 61,305 ka mga indibidwal ang apektado bangud sa lapnagon nga pagbaha.
english: According to the latest report of Bombo Radyo Roxas from data submitted by the authorities, 17,418 families or equivalent to 61,305 individuals have been affected by the widespread flooding.

text: Kahapon, Oktubre 18, sang gin-anunsyo nga ginpaidalom na ang Roxas City sa state of calamity sa idalom sang Resolution 263-2025 nga gin-aprubahan sang city council paagi sa special session.
english: Yesterday, October 18, it was announced that Roxas City has been placed under a state of calamity under Resolution 263-2025 approved by the city council through a special session.

text: Sa sini nga resolution, gina-invoke ang probisyon sang Local Government Code of 1991 kag Republic Act 10121 ukon ang Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act kun sa diin ginahatagan sang awtoridad ang local governments nga magdeklarar sang state of calamity agud nga mapadasig ang relief, recovery, kag rehabilitation efforts.#
english: The resolution invokes the provisions of the Local Government Code of 1991 and Republic Act 10121 or the Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act which authorizes local governments to declare a state of calamity to expedite relief, recovery, and rehabilitation efforts.

text: Bukas ang mga manufacturers kag ang retailers sa voluntary price freeze sa essential goods sa tunga sang ginapaabot nga posible pagsaka sa presyo bangud sang epekto sang El Niño phenomenon.
english: Manufacturers and retailers are open to a voluntary price freeze on essential goods amid expected possible price increases due to the impact of the El Niño phenomenon.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) kasunod sang meeting sang manufacturers kag retailers kay Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) said this following a meeting of manufacturers and retailers with Trade Secretary Alfredo Pascual.

text: Suno sa ahensya, nagapadayon pa ang diskusyon sa posible nga price freeze.
english: The agency said discussions on a possible price freeze are still ongoing.

text: Sa idalom sang Price Act, ang presyo sang basic necessities ang insigida na nga “frozen” tubtub sa 60 ka adlaw kun ang area ang napaidalom sa state of calamity.
english: Under the Price Act, the price of basic necessities is immediately frozen for up to 60 days if the area is under a state of calamity.

text: Ginpasalig man sang ahensya nga nagapadayon ini sa pag-monitor sa market conditions, ginaduso ang consumer rights, kag padayon nga ginagiyahan ang nasyon sa tunga sang sini nga mga pagpanghangkat.
english: The agency also assured that it continues to monitor market conditions, promote consumer rights, and continue to guide the country amid these challenges.

text: Matandaan nga una na nga ginduso ni Senator Francis Tolentino ang pagdeklarar sang national state of calamity para nga ma-apply sa bilog nga pungsod ang nakabutang sa Price Act ukon ang pag-freeze sang presyo sang nagapanguna nga mga balaklon.
english: Senator Francis Tolentino had earlier proposed the declaration of a national state of calamity so that the Price Act or the freezing of prices of basic commodities could be applied nationwide.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa government data, ang tatlo sa pinakaapektado nga mga rehiyon bangud sa El Niño amo ang Mimaropa, ang Cordillera Administrative Region, kag ang Western Visayas.#
english: Based on government data, the three most affected regions due to El Niño are Mimaropa, the Cordillera Administrative Region, and Western Visayas.

text: ILOILO CITY— Ginhangkat ni Iloilo City Mayor  Jose Espinosa III  ang bilas sini nga si  Iloilo City Lone District Congressman Jerry Trenas nga aku-on nga siya ang utok sang pagboycott sang mga konsehal sa sesyon sang  Sangguniang Panlungsod sa diin ang mayor nga  agenda amo ang pagdeklarar sang state of calamity sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: ILOILO CITY— Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III challenged his brother-in-law, Iloilo City Lone District Congressman Jerry Trenas, to admit that he was the mastermind behind the boycott of the Sangguniang Panlungsod session where the main agenda was to declare a state of calamity in Iloilo City.

text: Lakip sa mga wala nakatambong sa sesyon amo sanday  Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon, Councilors Love Baronda, Ely Estante, Leila Luntao, Armand Parcon kag Jay Trenas ng lunsay kaalyado sang  kongresista.
english: Among those who did not attend the session were Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon, Councilors Love Baronda, Ely Estante, Leila Luntao, Armand Parcon and Jay Trenas, all allies of the congressman.

text: Samtang lakip naman sa nagtambong sa sesyon amo sanday city councilors Liezl Joy Zulueta-Salazar, Candice Tupas, Eduardo Peñaredondo, Plaridel Nava, Joshua Alim, R Leone Gerochi, kag Lyndon Acap.
english: Meanwhile, those who attended the session were city councilors Liezl Joy Zulueta-Salazar, Candice Tupas, Eduardo Peñaredondo, Plaridel Nava, Joshua Alim, R Leone Gerochi, and Lyndon Acap.

text: Naka-leave naman si Councilor Mandrie Malabor, nga kaalyado naman ni Espinosa.
english: Councilor Mandrie Malabor, who is also an ally of Espinosa, is on leave.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Espinosa nga indi dapat magpang-init ukon maakig si  Treñas sa baylo akuon nalang nga  ginhambalan niya ang mga kaalyado nga konsehal nga indi magtambong sa sesyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Espinosa said Treñas should not be angry or angry but should admit that he told his allied councilors not to attend the session.

text: Samtang  sa interview  naman sang Bombo Radyo  ginsabat ni Treñas  ang akusasyon ni Espinosa.
english: Meanwhile, in an interview with Bombo Radyo, Treñas responded to Espinosa's accusation.

text: Suno kay Treñas, wala siya naka-istorya sa mga kaalyado nga konsehal  nga magboycott sa sesyon.
english: Treñas said he has not spoken to allied councilors to boycott the session.

text: Positibo nga ginapanan-aw ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga sarang mabaligya ang P30/kilo nga bugas sa pili nga mga lugar sa pungsod sa maabot nga bulan sang Hulyo.
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez is positive that P30/kilo rice can be sold in selected areas of the country by July.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Romualdez kasunod sang meeting kay Department of Agriculture (DA) Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Romualdez said this following a meeting with Department of Agriculture (DA) Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: sa House of Representatives, Mayo 6.
english: in the House of Representatives, May 6.

text: Ini nga pagsinapol ang kasunod man sang pahayag ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The meeting also follows the statement of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga gusto sini padasigon ang amendment sa Rice Tariffication Law (RTL) ukon ang Republic Act (RA) No.11203.
english: that it wants to expedite the amendment to the Rice Tariffication Law (RTL) or Republic Act (RA) No.11203.

text: Suno sa house speaker, gina-identify na sang DA ang areas kun sa diin pwede mahatag sa publiko ang barato apang well-milled nga bugas.
english: According to the house speaker, the DA is already identifying areas where cheap but well-milled rice can be provided to the public.

text: “Although we cannot yet achieve this throughout the entire country, we can start in selected areas identified by the Department of Agriculture.
english: “Although we cannot yet achieve this throughout the entire country, we can start in selected areas identified by the Department of Agriculture.

text: We hope that this initiative will soon reach all parts of the country, especially after the amendment of the Rice Tariffication Law,” pahayag sini.
english: We hope that this initiative will soon reach all parts of the country, especially after the amendment of the Rice Tariffication Law,” it said.

text: Mahimo ini suno sa iya mabaligya sa manubo nga presyo paagi sa National Food Authority (NFA) nga ipaagi man sa Kadiwa centers.
english: He said it can be sold at low prices through the National Food Authority (NFA) which will also be distributed through Kadiwa centers.

text: “Kasama din natin ang [National Irrigation Administration] Administrator [Eduardo] Guillen, with full support sa irrigation program, we will work together hand-in-hand para mapaaga ang goal natin na ibababa natin ang presyo ng bigas at ibang mga commodities po,” dugang ni Romualdez.
english: “We are also with [National Irrigation Administration] Administrator [Eduardo] Guillen, with full support for the irrigation program, we will work together hand-in-hand to achieve our goal of lowering the price of rice and other commodities,” Romualdez added.

text: Sandig sa latest monitoring report sang DA, ang pinakabarato nga bugas sa merkado as of April 27 amo ang local commercial rice nga yara sa P49.44 per kilo nga P19 nga mas mahal ipaanggid sa target sang Kamara.
english: According to the latest monitoring report of the DA, the cheapest rice in the market as of April 27 is local commercial rice at P49.44 per kilo which is P19 more expensive compared to the House target.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang mga lideres sa lower chamber sang Kongreso nga target nila nga mapasar ang amendments sa RTL sa sulod sang tatlo ka semana.
english: Earlier, leaders in the lower chamber of Congress said they target to pass the amendments to the RTL within three weeks.

text: Ini nga layi amo ang naga-restrict sa NFA nga direkta nga magbaligya sang bugas sa public markets kag gin-limitahan lamang ang function sini sa pagpasigurado sang buffer stocks nga amo ang gamiton sa tion sang kalamidad.#
english: This law restricts the NFA from directly selling rice in public markets and limits its function to ensuring buffer stocks to be used in times of disaster.

text: ILOILO CITY-Indi magnubo sa 40 ka mga mamalidha gikan sa House of Representatives ang magahampang sa Philippine Olympic Committee Golf Cup II, nga nagatuyo nga ma-boost ang National Athletes’ Trust Fund.
english: ILOILO CITY-At least 40 lawmakers from the House of Representatives will play in the Philippine Olympic Committee Golf Cup II, which aims to boost the National Athletes’ Trust Fund.

text: Ang event nga gin-organize sang Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) ang patigayunon sa Valley Golf and Country Club sa Cainta, Rizal subong nga adlaw.
english: The event, organized by the Philippine Olympic Committee (POC), will be held at the Valley Golf and Country Club in Cainta, Rizal today.

text: Ang ginalauman nga maga- compete sa Golf Cup amo sanday Leyte, 4th District Reps Richard Gomez , Isabela, 5th District Rep.
english: Expected to compete in the Golf Cup are Leyte, 4th District Reps Richard Gomez, Isabela, 5th District Rep.

text: Faustino Michael Carlos Dy, kag Cavite 8th District Rep.
english: Faustino Michael Carlos Dy, and Cavite 8th District Rep.

text: Aniela Tolentino.
english: Aniela Tolentino.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang una nga Golf Cup ang ginpatigayon sang Nobyembre 27 sa Luisita Golf and Country sa Tarlac.
english: The first Golf Cup was held on November 27 at Luisita Golf and Country in Tarlac.

text: Suno kay Philippine Olympic Committee President Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino, ang trust fund maga- provide sang incentives kag bonuses sa mga atleta nga makakuha sang medalya sa Paris Olympics sa Hulyo kag Agusto.
english: According to Philippine Olympic Committee President Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino, the trust fund will provide incentives and bonuses to athletes who win medals at the Paris Olympics in July and August.

text: Nahibaluan nga anom na ka Filipino athletes ang naka-secure sang ila spots sa 2024 Summer Games sa Paris nga amo sanday Nesthy Petecio, Aira Villegas kag Eumir Marcial sa boxing.
english: Six Filipino athletes have already secured their spots in the 2024 Summer Games in Paris, namely Nesthy Petecio, Aira Villegas and Eumir Marcial in boxing.

text: Amo man ang pole vaulter nga si EJ Obiena, kag gymnasts nga sanday Carlos Yulo kag Aleah Finnegan.
english: So did pole vaulter EJ Obiena, and gymnasts Carlos Yulo and Aleah Finnegan.

text: Ginpaiway ni Pope Francis ang pagtambong sa tuigan nga prusisyon nga ginapatigayon sa Vatican kadungan sang Byernes Santo.
english: Pope Francis has canceled the annual procession held at the Vatican on Good Friday.

text: Ini bangud nagapadayon pa sa pag-recover ang 88-anyos nga Santo Papa gikan sa ginsuprer sini nga double pneumonia kag gin-abisuhan man sang iya mga doctor nga magpahuway anay kag maglikaw sa dalagku nga mga pagtilipon.
english: The 88-year-old Pope is still recovering from double pneumonia and has been advised by his doctors to rest and avoid large gatherings.

text: Ginhiwat ang prusisyon sa Colosseum sa Roma, isa ka outdoor ceremony nga naga-marka sang pagdumdom sang mga Kristyano sa paglansang kay Hesus sa Krus.
english: The procession was held at the Colosseum in Rome, an outdoor ceremony that marks the Christian commemoration of the crucifixion of Jesus.

text: Ang Via Crucis sa Colosseum — nga ginapatihan nga lugar sang martyrdom sa early Christians — amo ang re-enactment sang kamatayon ni Hesukristo.
english: The Via Crucis in the Colosseum — believed to be the site of martyrdom among early Christians — is the re-enactment of the death of Jesus Christ.

text: Nagbulos-bulos ang mga partisipante sa pag-uyat sang krus samtang nagalakat sila sa dumaan nga Roman arena, kag nagapundo sa pagpangamuyo kag agud pamatian ang mga meditasyon.
english: Participants took turns holding the cross as they walked through the ancient Roman arena, and stopping to pray and to listen to meditations.

text: Kun matandaan, masobra isa ka bulan nga na-ospital si Pope bangud sa double pneumonia kun sa diin diutayan pa ini napatay samtang ginabulong.
english: It can be recalled that Pope was hospitalized for more than a month due to double pneumonia where he almost died while being treated.

text: Wala man ini anay nagtambong sa amo nga Colosseum event sang 2023 kag 2024.
english: It also previously did not attend that Colosseum event in 2023 and 2024.

text: Apang suno sa Vatican, si Pope ang personal nga nagsulat sang meditations sa seremonya subong nga tuig.
english: But the Vatican said the Pope personally wrote the meditations at this year's ceremony.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga tuig sa iya 12-year papacy nga ginhimo niya ini.
english: This is the second year in his 12-year papacy that he has done so.

text: Wala pa sang dugang nga impormasyon kun magatambong ang Santo Papa sa Easter services sa weekend.#
english: There is no further information on whether the Pope will attend Easter services over the weekend.

text: Magaupod sa Dugong Bombo 2025: “A Little Pain, A Life to Gain” ang mga myembro sang Tresmanos Fraternity and Sorority.
english: Members of Tresmanos Fraternity and Sorority will join Dugong Bombo 2025: “A Little Pain, A Life to Gain”.

text: Ang commitment sang grupo ang ginpabutyag nanday Yle Talaman, Council President sang Tresmanos Guimaras, kag Leo Padios, Jr., President, Tresmanos Grand Kappan – Alimodian Chapter.
english: The commitment of the group was expressed by Yle Talaman, Council President of Tresmanos Guimaras, and Leo Padios, Jr., President, Tresmanos Grand Kappan – Alimodian Chapter.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Talaman nga naka-upod man sa 2023 nga edisyon sang Dugong Bombo, ginpahayag sini nga prayoridad gid sang ila grupo ang pagserbisyo sa komunidad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Talaman, who is also involved in the 2023 edition of Dugong Bombo, said that the group's priority is to serve the community.

text: Suno kay Talaman, may yara man sila sang tuigan nga bloodletting event nga nakabutang man sa Philippine Red Cross, apang kun may yara sang imbitasyon, ginakadtuan gid nila ini agud makabulig man sa iban.
english: Talaman said they also have an annual bloodletting event that is also organized by the Philippine Red Cross, but if there is an invitation, they go to it to help others.

text: Suno naman kay Padios, bisan pa sang kasakuon sang kada myembro, ginahatagan gid nila sang prayoridad ang mga bloodletting activities.
english: Padios said that despite the busy schedule of each member, they give priority to bloodletting activities.

text: Pahayag sini, mabudlay magpangita sang dugo ilabi na subong nga uso ang mga balatian.
english: He said it is difficult to find blood especially now that diseases are in vogue.

text: Bilidhon kag indi mabayaran suno sa iya, kag nahangpan gid nila kun ano ini ka-importante para sa isig-kapareho.
english: It is precious and priceless, he said, and they understand how important it is for their fellow human beings.

text: Ang “Dugong Bombo: A Little Pain, A Life to Gain” amo ang pinakadako nga one-day bloodletting drive sa pungsod.
english: “Dugong Bombo: A Little Pain, A Life to Gain” is the biggest one-day bloodletting drive in the country.

text: Dululungan ini nga patigayunon sa Nobyembre 15, 2025, Sabado, sa 25 key areas nationwide, kun sa diin naga-operate sang 32 fully digitalized AM and FM stations sang Bombo Radyo Philippines.
english: It will be held simultaneously on November 15, 2025, Saturday, in 25 key areas nationwide, where 32 fully digitalized AM and FM stations of Bombo Radyo Philippines operate.

text: Sa Iloilo area, hiwaton ini sa Iloilo Science and Technology University ukon ISAT-U sa La Paz.#
english: In the Iloilo area, it will be held at the Iloilo Science and Technology University or ISAT-U in La Paz.#

text: Lunsay nag-qualify ang mga Filipina boxers nga sanday Nesthy Petecio kag Aira Villegas para sa 2024 Paris Olympics!
english: Filipina boxers Nesthy Petecio and Aira Villegas both qualified for the 2024 Paris Olympics!

text: Natabo ini sang ginlutos ni Villegas si Genadieva Chukanova Zlatislava sang Bulgaria sa quarterfinal bout sa 1st World Olympic Qualifiying Tournament sa Italya kaina gid lamang nga kaagahon (oras sa Pilipinas).
english: This happened when Villegas defeated Genadieva Chukanova Zlatislava of Bulgaria in the quarterfinal bout of the 1st World Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Italy this morning (Philippine time).

text: Nangin mabudlay para kay Villegas nga makuha ang kadalag-an sa women’s 50kg class kun sa diin tatlo sa lima ka judges ang nag-settle pa para sa tie samtang duha naman ang nagpabor sa Pinay.
english: It was difficult for Villegas to win the women's 50kg class where three of the five judges settled for a tie while two favored the Filipina.

text: Nadag-an ni Villegas ang nauna nga duha ka rounds apang nabuhinan ini sang isa ka point bangud sa holding; kag nadugangan pa sang natumba ini sa ikatatlo nga round matapos ang right straight halin sa kasumpong nga nag-igu gid sa iya ulo.
english: Villegas won the first two rounds but was reduced by one point due to holding; and it was compounded when he fell in the third round after a right straight from his opponent that hit him hard in the head.

text: Nagbangon ang Leyte pride tubtub nga nakabawi kag nabulsa ang ticket para sa iya labing-una nga pagtapak sa Olympic.
english: Leyte pride rose until he recovered and pocketed the ticket for his first Olympic step.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, pila ka minutos lamang matapos nabulsa ni Villegas ang isa ka Olympic spot, ginpasagunsunan ini ni Petecio matapos nga ginlutos si Esra Yildiz Kahraman sang Turkey via split decision sa ila nga semifinal bout.
english: On the other hand, just minutes after Villegas pocketed an Olympic spot, Petecio followed it up after defeating Esra Yildiz Kahraman of Turkey via split decision in their semifinal bout.

text: Ini pa lamang ang nagaisahanon nga split decision victory para kay Petecio sa tournament bangud nadag-an sini ang nauna nga apat ka sambuwa via unanimous decision kag stoppage.
english: This is the only split decision victory for Petecio in the tournament as he won the previous four fights via unanimous decision and stoppage.

text: Magluwas nga may ticket na sa Olympics, magatungtong man si Petecio sa gold medal round sa women’s 57kg category.
english: Besides having a ticket to the Olympics, Petecio will also compete in the gold medal round in the women’s 57kg category.

text: Silver medalist ang nasambit nga boksidor sa 2020 Olympics sa Japan.
english: The boxer is a silver medalist at the 2020 Olympics in Japan.

text: Una na sini ginsiling nga indi siya mag-untat tubtob indi makuha ang gold medal sa Olympida.
english: He has previously said that he will not stop until he wins the gold medal at the Olympics.

text: Magluwas kanday Villegas kag Petecio, nauna na ang Pinoy boxer nga si Eumir Marcial sa pag-qualify para sa Olympics 2024 matapos ini nagtapak sa final round sa Asian Games sa China.
english: Besides Villegas and Petecio, Filipino boxer Eumir Marcial has already qualified for the 2024 Olympics after he reached the final round of the Asian Games in China.

text: ILOILO CITY -Pamulitika ang motibo sang paghingadlan ni Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III sa duha ka mga Punong Barangay sa syudad nga amo ang utok sa ginapahayag kilkilanay nga nagakatabo sa Iloilo Terminal Market.
english: ILOILO CITY -Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III has named two Punong Barangays in the city as the masterminds of the alleged fight at the Iloilo Terminal Market.

text: Ini ang nangin reaksyon ni Punong Barangay Alain Rey Depatillo sang Rizal Pala-Pala 1, Iloilo City matapos nga naulamid sila ni Punong Barangay Noel Soliman sang Rizal Pala-Pala 2, Iloilo City sa ginapahayag ‘sindikato’ sa nasambit nga merkado.
english: This was the reaction of Punong Barangay Alain Rey Depatillo of Rizal Pala-Pala 1, Iloilo City after he and Punong Barangay Noel Soliman of Rizal Pala-Pala 2, Iloilo City were involved in an alleged 'syndicate' in the said market.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Depatillo, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang kamatuoran ang pahayag ni Mayor Espinosa batok sa ila ni Soliman.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Depatillo said there is no truth in Mayor Espinosa's statement against Soliman.

text: Wala na sang may naisip nga motibo si Depatillo magluwas sa pulitika bangud nga ila ginasuportahan si Iloilo City Cong.
english: Depatillo said he has no motive other than politics because they support Iloilo City Cong.

text: Jerry Treñas nga mangin kasumpong ni Espinosa sa pagka-alkalde sa May midterm elections.
english: Jerry Treñas to be Espinosa's mayoral opponent in the May midterm elections.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa Punong Barangay, kilala sila nga supporters ni Espinosa sadto apang subong nagdesisyon sila nga magsaylo sa kampo ni Treñas.
english: In fact, according to the Punong Barangay, they were known to be supporters of Espinosa but now they have decided to move to Treñas' camp.

text: Mahimo suno sa natungdan nga nagabalos lang si Mayor Espinosa rason nga ginapatu patu-an sila ni Soliman.
english: He said it is possible that Mayor Espinosa is just retaliating and that is why Soliman is making them believe.

text: Ginplastar ni Msgr.
english: Placed by Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center, ang iya mga panawagan agud nga mapa-preso ang mga kurap kag mapasabat sa ila nga mga kasal-anan apisar nga mataas pa ang ila ranggo ukon posisyon sa sosyudad.
english: Meliton Oso, director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center, his calls for the corrupt to be imprisoned and held accountable for their crimes despite their high rank or position in society.

text: Sa iya homily sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral 7:00 kaina sang aga, nag-apelar si Oso kay Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla nga magpreparar sang mapag-on nga kaso batok sa mga kurap nga opisyal.
english: In his homily at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral at 7:00 this morning, Oso appealed to Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla to prepare a strong case against corrupt officials.

text: Suno kay Oso, kun manabaw lamang ang preparasyon sang kaso, pat-od nga mabasura ini gilayon kag wala sang may mahatag nga hustisya.
english: According to Oso, if the preparation of the case is superficial, it will surely be dismissed immediately and no justice will be given.

text: “Kun wala mapreparahan sang husto, wala sang hustisya,” suno sa JASAC director.
english: “If not properly prepared, there is no justice,” the JASAC director said.

text: Ikaduha, nag-apelar man ini nga maghanda man sang todo ang prosecution.
english: Second, he also appealed for the prosecution to prepare thoroughly.

text: Kaangot diri, nagpanawagan si Oso kay President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: In this regard, Oso called on President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: nga magpili sang prosecutor ukon huwes nga may integridad, may kahadlok sa Diyos, kag indi mabakal sang kuwarta.
english: to choose a prosecutor or judge who has integrity, fears God, and cannot be bought with money.

text: Ini nga mga panawagan ni Oso ang kasunod sang iya ginaduso nga dapat masilutan gid ang kawatan bisan myembro pa ini sang Kongreso, kontraktor, ukon katapo man sang Department of Public Works and Highways kag Commission on Audit.
english: Oso's calls follow his proposal that thieves should be punished whether they are members of Congress, contractors, or members of the Department of Public Works and Highways and the Commission on Audit.

text:
GAHUM SANG OMBUDSMAN

Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang Konstitusyon, ang Office of the Ombudsman nga subong ginapamunuan ni Remulla ang may yara sang gahum nga magmato-mato sa pag-imbestigar.
english:
POWERS OF THE OMBUDSMAN

Under the Constitution, the Office of the Ombudsman, now headed by Remulla, has the power to investigate.

text:
Mahimo man ini mag-imbestigar kun may complaint nga ginpasaka ang isa ka indibidwal batok sa public official ukon empleyado kaangot sa mga akto nga ginadudahan nga “illegal, unjust, improper, or inefficient.”

Sa subong, isa ang Ombudsman sa mga ahensya nga naga-imbestigar sa mga anomaliya sa flood control projects sa bilog nga pungsod paagi sa special panel sang prosecutors.
english:
It may also investigate whether a complaint has been filed by an individual against a public official or employee regarding acts suspected of being “illegal, unjust, improper, or inefficient.”

Currently, the Ombudsman is one of the agencies investigating anomalies in flood control projects nationwide through a special panel of prosecutors.

text: Ginabusisi sini ang mga iregularidad kaupod ang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), Department of Justice, Kamara, kag Senado.#
english: It is investigating irregularities with the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), Department of Justice, House of Representatives, and Senate.

text: Matawhay sa gihapon ang banwa sang San Dionisio, Iloilo kun sitwasyon sang pulitika ang istoryahan.
english: The town of San Dionisio, Iloilo is still calm when it comes to the political situation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay  San Dionisio Mayor Larry Villanueva, iya ginpahayag nga ini sa pihak sang pagkalakip sang banwa sa Yellow Category sang Election Areas of Concern sa diin may yara sang election related violence kag may intense political rivalry.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, San Dionisio Mayor Larry Villanueva said this is despite the town's inclusion in the Yellow Category of Election Areas of Concern where there is election related violence and intense political rivalry.

text: Suno kay Villanueva, sa subong wala pa sang na-report nga may aktibo nga private armed groups (PAG’s) apang gin-ako niya nga may pulitiko gid man sadto nga nagahupot sang kaangay nga grupo.
english: Villanueva said there have been no reports of active private armed groups (PAG's) but he acknowledged that there were politicians who held such groups.

text: Gin-ako naman sang opisyal nga ginalauman niya nga mangin mainit ang mayoralty race sa San Dionisio bangud apat ang nagapadalagan nga ginalakipan nanday Lydia Antonio (Independent); mag-utod nga Eusebio Lopez (Independent) kag Peter Paul Lopez (LP); kag si incumbent Mayor Larry Villanueva (NP).
english: The official acknowledged that he expects the mayoralty race in San Dionisio to be hot because four candidates are Lydia Antonio (Independent); brothers Eusebio Lopez (Independent) and Peter Paul Lopez (LP); and incumbent Mayor Larry Villanueva (NP).

text: Tag-isa ka daog na lang ang kinahanglan sang duha ka Pinoy boxers sa 1st World Olympic Qualifying Tournament sa Burto Arsizio, Italy agud nga makasulod sa Paris Olympics 2024!
english: Two Filipino boxers need only one win each in the 1st World Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Burto Arsizio, Italy to qualify for the Paris Olympics 2024!

text: Isa diri amo si Nesthy Petecio nga nag-abanse na sa semifinals sang women’s 57kg kaina sang kaagahon (oras sa Pilipinas) paagi sa paglutos kay Maud Van Der Toorn sang Netherlands via unanimous decision.
english: One of them is Nesthy Petecio who advanced to the semifinals of the women's 57kg yesterday morning (Philippine time) by defeating Maud Van Der Toorn of the Netherlands via unanimous decision.

text: Sa amo nga sambuwa, diutayan lang nga wala makuha ni Petecio ang kadalag-an bangud nagkadto kay Van Der Toorn ang Round 1.
english: In that fight, Petecio almost didn't get the victory as Round 1 went to Van Der Toorn.

text: Nagbawi ang Pinay paagi sa iya nga counter attacks sa masunod nga duha ka rounds.
english: The Filipina recovered with her counter attacks in the next two rounds.

text: Nag-abanse naman ang Pinay boxer nga si Aira Villegas sa quarterfinals sa women’s 50kg category sa amo man nga qualifying tournament matapos ginlutos si Sofie Vinter Rosshaug sang Denmark via unanimous decision.
english: Filipino boxer Aira Villegas advanced to the quarterfinals in the women's 50kg category in the same qualifying tournament after defeating Sofie Vinter Rosshaug of Denmark via unanimous decision.

text: Pananglitan magdaog diri si Villegas, maga-martsa man ini padulong sa Paris Olympics.
english: Pananglitan magdaog diri si Villegas, maga-martsa man ini padulong sa Paris Olympics.

text: Wala naman ginpalad ang Olympian nga si Rogen Ladon matapos nalutos ini sa Round of 16 sa men’s 51kg class sa kamot ni Kiaran MacDonald sang Great Britain via 4-1 split decision.
english: Olympian Rogen Ladon was unlucky after losing in the Round of 16 in the men’s 51kg class to Kiaran MacDonald of Great Britain via 4-1 split decision.

text: Nahibaluan nga 10 ka boksidor ang ginpadala sang Association of Boxing Alliances in the Philippines (ABAP) agud mag-compete sa amo nga qualifiers.
english: It was learned that 10 boxers were sent by the Association of Boxing Alliances in the Philippines (ABAP) to compete in the qualifiers.

text: As of press time, ang mga kuwalipikado pa lamang nga makatiglawas sa Pilipinas sa Paris Games amo sanday Eumir Marcial sa boxing; EJ Obiena sa polen vault; kag Carlos Yulo kag Aleah Finnegan sa gymnastics.#
english: As of press time, the only athletes still qualified to represent the Philippines at the Paris Games are Eumir Marcial in boxing; EJ Obiena in the pollen vault; and Carlos Yulo and Aleah Finnegan in gymnastics.#

text: Ginakabig ni Senate President Pro Tempore Ping Lacson nga narration ukon estorya lang ang pahayag ni anay Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co batok kay Pres.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Ping Lacson considers the statement of former Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co against Pres.

text: Bongbong Marcos.
english: Marcos Wall.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: This is in connection with anomalous flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Lacson, possible nga pahanagutan sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee si Co nga magkadto sa embahada ukon konsulado sang Pilipinas para didto makatestigo under oath.
english: Lacson said the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee may allow Co to go to the Philippine embassy or consulate to testify under oath.

text: Gin-athag ni Lacson nga wala niya gina-apinan si Marcos apang mabudlay lamang mag-speculate.
english: Lacson clarified that he is not defending Marcos but it is difficult to speculate.

text: Ginpanindugan ni Lacson nga nagapadayon lamang nga “narration” ang mga alegasyon ni Co tubtob nga wala ini nagsumpa.
english: Lacson insisted that Co's allegations continued to be “narrative” until he was sworn in.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga possible magpagguwa ang komite sang subpoena bangud sa wala pagtambong ni Co sa hearing sang blue ribbon committee kahapon, Nobyembre 14.
english: He also said the committee may issue a subpoena because Co did not attend the hearing of the blue ribbon committee yesterday, November 14.

text: Suportado sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang tikang ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez ang amyendaran ang Rice Tariffication Law (RTL) agud pahanugutan ang National Food Authority (NFA) nga magbaligya sang bugas sa mga mercado.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) supports House Speaker Martin Romualdez's move to amend the Rice Tariffication Law (RTL) to allow the National Food Authority (NFA) to sell rice in the markets.

text: Suno kay DA Assistant Secretary and spokesman Arnel de Mesa, importante nga nga may intervention kun tuman ka taas ang retail price sang bugas.
english: According to DA Assistant Secretary and spokesman Arnel de Mesa, it is important to have an intervention if the retail price of rice is too high.

text: Ginpaathag man sini nga sa idalom sang Section 10 sang Price Act, ang DA ang dapat nga magpatunga agud nga ma-address ang mataas nga retail prices sang agricultural products.
english: He also explained that under Section 10 of the Price Act, the DA should intervene to address the high retail prices of agricultural products.

text: Matandaan nga ginpahayag ini ni Romualdez matapos ang una nga hearing sa mga ginaduso nga hagna agud nga amyendaran ang RTL antes isalang sa House committee on agriculture and food.
english: Romualdez said this after the first hearing of the proposed bills to amend the RTL before being submitted to the House committee on agriculture and food.

text: Ini nga layi amo ang nagatugot sa mga estudyante nga mag-import sang bugas sa tuyo nga mapanubo ang presyo sang bugas kun madamo na ang suplay sa merkado bagay nga wala man natabo bangud mataas man gihapon ang presyo sang nagapanguna nga mga produkto sa Pilipinas.
english: This law allows students to import rice in order to lower the price of rice when there is a lot of supply in the market which did not happen because the price of basic products in the Philippines is still high.

text: Lakip sa probisyon sang RTL ang pagdumili sa NFA nga magbakal sang imported rice kag ibaligya ini sa merkado nga amo anay ang ginahimo sini.
english: Among the provisions of the RTL is to prohibit the NFA from buying imported rice and selling it in the market where it used to do so.

text: Sa baylo, sa idalom sang RTL, ginasugo ang NFA nga sa local nga mga mangunguma magbakal sang bugas kag ibutang sa storage para masiguro nga indi pagkulangon ang suplay sa Pilipinas ilabi na sa tion sang kalamidad.
english: Instead, under the RTL, the NFA is instructed to local farmers to purchase rice and put it in storage to ensure that there is no shortage of supply in the Philippines especially in times of disaster.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa ulihi nga government data, ang mataas nga presyo sang bugas ang rason kun ngaa nagsaka man ang inflation rate sa pungsod.
english: Based on the latest government data, the high price of rice is the reason why the inflation rate in the country has also increased.

text: Lakip man sa ginatun-an sang DA subong suno kay De Mesa amo ang posibilidad sang pagpatuman sang labeling sang bugas sa commercial outles ukon himuon nga mandatory sa mga retailers ang pag-inform sa mga consumers kun ang bugas ang imported ukon locally produced.
english: De Mesa said the DA is also studying the possibility of implementing rice labeling in commercial outlets or making it mandatory for retailers to inform consumers whether rice is imported or locally produced.

text: Base sa latest data sang Philippine Statistics Authority, ang total rice stocks sa first quarter sang 2024 ang nagnubo sang 100,000 metric tons halin sa 4.78 million MT sang 2023 pakadto sa 4.68 million MT sa amo man nga period sang 2024.#
english: Based on the latest data of the Philippine Statistics Authority, total rice stocks in the first quarter of 2024 decreased by 100,000 metric tons from 4.78 million MT in 2023 to 4.68 million MT in the same period of 2024.#

text: Magaupod ang Pinay volleyball star nga si Jaja Santiago sa training sang women’s volleyball team sang Japan samtang nga ginapreparahan ang Paris Olympics.
english: Pinay volleyball star Jaja Santiago will join the training of Japan's women's volleyball team as they prepare for the Paris Olympics.

text: Base sa anunsyo sang Japanese Volleyball Association, lakip si Santiago kag ang Cuban spiker nga si Melissa Valdes sa original 24-woman training pool nga ginpili sang head coach nga si Masayoshi Manabe.
english: Based on the announcement by the Japanese Volleyball Association, including Santiago and Cuban spiker Melissa Valdes in the original 24-woman training pool selected by head coach Masayoshi Manabe.

text: Nahibaluan nga pila ka tuig na halin sang gintanyagan ang nasambit nga 6-foot-5 Pinay middle blocker sang Japanese citizenship bangud sa iya dalayawon nga performance sa Japan V. League Division 1 apang sa subong, wala pa ini nahimo nga naturalized player.
english: It is known that it has been several years since the said 6-foot-5 Filipina middle blocker was offered Japanese citizenship due to his outstanding performance in Japan V. League Division 1 but so far, he has not become a naturalized player.

text: Nag-umpisa ini sa paghampang sa Japan para sa Saitama Ageo Medics sang 2018 kag nag-upod sa amo nga squad tubtub sang 2023 samtang nga gina-tunga-tunga ang tyempo sini sa pagbulig man sa Premier Volleyball League sa Pilipinas.
english: He started playing in Japan for Saitama Ageo Medics in 2018 and joined the squad until 2023 while splitting his time to help the Premier Volleyball League in the Philippines.

text: Si Santiago ang kilala nga anay standout sa National University Lady Bulldogs kag isa sa finest players sa V.League kun sa diin nadag-an sini ang Best Spiker kag Best Blocker kag sulod man sa Best Six sang nagligad nga season.
english: Santiago is known as a former standout for the National University Lady Bulldogs and one of the finest players in the V.League where she won Best Spiker and Best Blocker and was also in the Best Six last season.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, pananglitan maka-qualify ang Japanese women’s volleyball team sa Olympics, ini na ang ila ika-anum nga sunod-sunod nga pagpasakop sa Olympiada.
english: On the other hand, if the Japanese women's volleyball team qualifies for the Olympics, it will be their sixth consecutive Olympiad appearance.

text: Nagpangibabaw si Iloilo City Councilor Love Love Baronda sa mga ginapilian sa pagka konsehal sa Syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Love Love Baronda topped the councilor elections in Iloilo City.

english: This is according to the over-all results of the latest survey in Random Access Consultants, Inc.

english: It has a sample size of 600 respondents and a margin of error of ±4%.
