text: Ginahangkat ni Iloilo 3rd District Board Member Jason Gonzales ang mga opisyales sa iya distrito kag mga pumuluyo nga magpadulong sa iya opisina kun may nasiplatan sila nga problema ukon kwestyonable nga flood control projects sa ila lugar.
english: Iloilo 3rd District Board Member Jason Gonzales challenged officials in his district and residents to come to his office if they see any problems or questionable flood control projects in their area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Gonzales nga suportado niya ang kawsa ni Board Member Rolex Suplico nga magpatigayon sang imbestigasyon batok sa mga iregularidad nga proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Gonzales said he supports the cause of Board Member Rolex Suplico to conduct an investigation against irregular projects.

text: Apang, iya ginpunto nga kinahanglan gihapon sang kontexto ukon motivating party sa amo nga projects, antes magpatigayon sang investigations.
english: However, he pointed out that there is still a need for a context or motivating party in such projects, before conducting investigations.

text: Suno pa sa iya, sa subong wala pa siya sang may nakit-an nga flood control project sa ila distrito nga nagakinahanglan sang imbestigasyon.
english: He said he has not yet seen any flood control project in his district that requires investigation.

text: Bangud sini, nagapanawagan si Gonzales sa tanan nga mga pumuluyo sang ila distrito nga magdala sang ebidensya sa iya opisina kun may makita sila nga kwestyonable nga proyekto.
english: Gonzales appealed to all residents of his district to bring evidence to his office if they see any questionable projects.

text: Ginpaathag man ni Gonzales nga wala siya nagapamalabag sa plano ni Suplico nga mag-usisa sa mga proyekto.
english: Gonzales also explained that he does not object to Suplico's plan to investigate the projects.

text: Matandaan nga ginkatingala ni Suplico ang kadamuon sang mga flood control projects sa iya distrito nga wala nalakip sa listahan sang mga proyekto nga ginpaguwa sa “Sumbong sa Pangulo” website.
english: Suplico was surprised by the number of flood control projects in his district that were not included in the list of projects released on the “Sumbong sa Pangulo” website.

text: Tuman ang kaugot sang isa ka barbero matapos nga ang iya customer nga nagpagunting, magluwas nga wala nagbayad, gintaban pa ang iya motorsiklo.
english: A barber was furious after his customer who had a haircut, besides not paying, also stole his motorcycle.

text: Natabo ini sa Bacolod City.
english: This happened in Bacolod City.

text: Nakuhaan sang CCTV ang paggwa sang suspek kag makaligad ang pila ka segundos, ginpaandar niya ang nakaparada nga motorsiklo kag ginpaburhot palayo.
english: CCTV caught the suspect coming out and after a few seconds, he started the parked motorcycle and drove away.

text: Wala na gin-report sang amo nga barbero sa pulis ang natabo.
english: The barber did not report the incident to the police.

text: Nagadangat sa 46 ka mga Punong Barangay ang pasakaan sang kaso sang Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) bangud sa pagpangampanya sa mga kandidato nga nagapadalagan sa national kag local elections.
english: A total of 46 Punong Barangays will be charged by the Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) for campaigning for candidates running in the national and local elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay DILG Undersecretary Epimaco Densing III, iya ginpahayag nga santo sa ginpirmahan nga joint memorandum sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) kag sang Civil Service Commission (CSC), hugot nga ginadumilian ang mga civil servants nga mapangampanya sa mga kandidato.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, DILG Undersecretary Epimaco Densing III said that according to the joint memorandum signed by the Commission on Elections (Comelec) and the Civil Service Commission (CSC), civil servants are strictly prohibited from campaigning for candidates.

text: Nagpanawagan man si Densing sa publiko nga gilayon nga i-report sa DILG ang mga barangay officials nga maaktuhan nga nagapangampanya.
english: Densing also appealed to the public to immediately report to the DILG any barangay officials caught campaigning.

text: Suno kay Densing, mahimo nga kuhaan sang picture kag video ang mga barangay officials nga nagapangampanya.
english: According to Densing, pictures and videos can be taken of barangay officials who are campaigning.

text: Ini ang mahimo nga ipadala sa email sang DILG nga bantaykorapsyon.dilg@gmail.com kag nagakadapat nga butangan sang caption, petsa kag lugar.
english: It can be sent to the DILG email bangunkorapsyon.dilg@gmail.com and should include a caption, date and place.

text: Gin-athag sang opisyal nga ang 46 ka mga barangay officials nga pasakaan sang kaso ang kabahin pa lang sang 1st batch kag madamo pa sila sang mga pasakaan sang kaso.
english: Gin-athag sang opisyal nga ang 46 ka mga barangay officials nga pasakaan sang kaso ang kabahin pa lang sang 1st batch kag madamo pa sila sang mga pasakaan sang kaso.

text: Ang nasambit nga mga barangay officials ang naghalin sa Quezon City, Taguig, Misamis Oriental kag Parañaque.
english: The said barangay officials are from Quezon City, Taguig, Misamis Oriental and Parañaque.

text: Nagnubo sang malapit dos porsyento ang utang sang Pilipinas sa katapusan sang Marso base sa ulihi nga report sang Bureau of the Treasury.
english: The Philippines' debt fell by nearly 2 percent at the end of March based on the latest report by the Bureau of the Treasury.

text: Halin sa P15.18-trillion nga utang sang katapusan sang Pebrero, nahimo ini nga P14.93-trillion sa end-March bangud nga nagbayad ang gobyerno sang pila ka obligasyon sa local kag foreign lenders.
english: From P15.18-trillion debt at the end of February, it rose to P14.93-trillion at end-March as the government paid off some obligations to local and foreign lenders.

text: Sa nabilin nga utang sang pungsod, 68.86 percent ang domestic debt samtang 31.14 percent naman ang foreign debt.
english: Of the country's remaining debt, 68.86 percent is domestic debt while 31.14 percent is foreign debt.

text: Nakit-an man sa report sang Treasury nga nagnubo ang domestic debt apang may pagsaka sa foreign debt bangud mas madamo ang utang sang national government sa luwas sang pungsod kag nagluya man ang balor sang peso kontra sa dolyar.
english: The Treasury report also showed that domestic debt decreased but there was an increase in foreign debt due to more foreign debt of the national government and the weakening of the peso against the dollar.

text: Kun balikan naman halin sang pamuno subong nga 2024, nagsaka sang P259.56 billion ukon 2.59 percent ang sa domestic debt; samtang may pagsaka naman sa external debt nga P49.89 billion ukon 1.09 percent.
english: From the beginning of 2024, the domestic debt increased by P259.56 billion or 2.59 percent; while there was an increase in external debt of P49.89 billion or 1.09 percent.

text: Nalubog ang pila ka mga balay sa banwa sang Estancia, Iloilo matapos ang pagbubo sang mamunog nga ulan kahapon nga adlaw, Oktubre 18.
english: Several houses were flooded in Estancia town, Iloilo after heavy rains fell yesterday, October 18.

text: Suno kay Leon Rogador, Officer-in-Charge sang Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) sa Estancia, gulpiyada nga nagtaas ang lebel sang tubig sa lugar matapos ang mabaskog nga ulan nga nagdugay sang tatlo ka oras.
english: According to Leon Rogador, Officer-in-Charge of the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) in Estancia, the water level in the area suddenly rose after heavy rains that lasted for three hours.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Rogador nga ang pagdula sang madamo nga mga kahoy sa kabukiran amo ang isa sa mga ginatudlo nga rason sang masami nga pagbaha sa ila banwa.
english: Rogador said the removal of many trees in the mountains is one of the alleged reasons for the frequent floods in their town.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, madasig naman ang pagresponde sang Estancia Fire Station personnel sa pagpanguna ni Acting Municipal Fire marshal SFO4 Allan John S Catalan, kaupod ang MDDRMO Estancia kag Edert Rescue-058.
english: Meanwhile, Estancia Fire Station personnel led by Acting Municipal Fire marshal SFO4 Allan John S Catalan, along with MDDRMO Estancia and Edert Rescue-058, responded quickly.

text: Padayon naman ang pag-monitor sang MDRRMO sa mga apektado nga lugar samtang ginahingyo man ang mga pumuluyo nga magbantay kag maghalong ilabi na kun may mga indi maayo nga kondisyon sang panahon.
english: The MDRRMO continues to monitor the affected areas while urging residents to be vigilant and cautious especially in case of adverse weather conditions.

text: Ginpakita  ni anay Special Assistant to the President  (SAP) Bong Go ang iya likod sa media.
english: Former Special Assistant to the President (SAP) Bong Go showed his back to the media.

text: Ini ang kaangot sa panibag-o na naman nga gina-alegar naangot sa drug syndicate sa pungsod santu sa video nga ‘Ang Tototong Narcolist’ episode 3.
english: This is in connection with the new alleged drug syndicate in the country based on the video 'The True Narcolist' episode 3.

text: Gintumod sa video nga gina-alegar naangot sa sindikato amo ang may alyas nga “COATLIBRA-0018” kag “TESOROGOLF-TSG002” amo ang  anay Special Assistant to the President  Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Tesoro Go.
english: The video allegedly linked to the syndicate is identified as “COATLIBRA-0018” and “TESOROGOLF-TSG002” as former Special Assistant to the President Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Tesoro Go.

text: Gina-alegar mataas ang posisyon niya sa sindikato bangud may yara siya sang duha ka mga code names.
english: He is alleged to have a high position in the syndicate because he has two code names.

text: Suno kay Bikoy nga anay nagatrabaho sa isa ka drug syndicate, masami niya nga makit-an si Bong Go nga nagabisita sa operations center sang mga sindikato.
english: According to Bikoy, who used to work for a drug syndicate, he often saw Bong Go visiting the operations center of the syndicates.

text: May yara man ini dugang pa ni Bikoy sang dragon nga tattoo sa likod sa diin nasaad man ang iya nga codename.
english: Bikoy also has a dragon tattoo on his back with his codename.

text: Santu sa mga dokumento, kaangay ni presidential son Paolo “Polong” Duterte, may yara man sang apat ka mga bank accounts si Bong Go kag iya lang nga ginagamit nga dummy ang iya himata.
english: Santu sa mga dokumento, kaangay ni presidential son Paolo “Polong” Duterte, may yara man sang apat ka mga bank accounts si Bong Go kag iya lang nga ginagamit nga dummy ang iya himata.

text: Nagadangat sa P3.07  -billion ang nagasulod nga iligal nga kwarta kay Go humalin sang tuig 2010 tubtob 2018.
english: From 2010 to 2018, Go received P3.07 billion in illegal money.

text: Ginpahayag man sa video nga ang kwarta nga ginagamit ni Bong Go ang kwarta halin sa mga sindikato.
english: The video also revealed that the money Bong Go was using was money from syndicates.

english: This after failing to pocket a medal and finishing only ninth out of 11 pole vaulters at the recently concluded World Athletics Indoor Championships in Glasgow, Scotland.

text: Ginalantaw nga posible magtupa sa 3.5 to 4.3 percent ang inflation rate sa Pilipinas sa Abril halin sa 3.7 percent sang Marso.
english: The inflation rate in the Philippines is expected to fall to 3.5 to 4.3 percent in April from 3.7 percent in March.

text: Daku man ang posibilidad nga malapawan sini ang four percent target sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).
english: It is also likely to exceed the four percent target of the Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP).

text: Pananglitan magtupa sa 4.3%, amo na ini ang mangin pinakamataas sa sulod sang lima ka bulan matapos nga na-rekord ang 4.9 sang nagligad nga Oktubre 2023.
english: If it falls to 4.3%, it will be the highest in five months after recording 4.9 last October 2023.

text: Suno sa BSP, ang padayon nga pagsaka sa presyo sang bugas kag karne amo man sa gasoline kag ang pagluya sang balor sang peso amo ang nagapanguna nga sources sang pagsaka sang price pressure sa Abril.
english: According to the BSP, the continued rise in rice and meat prices as well as gasoline and the depreciation of the peso are the main sources of rising price pressure in April.

text: Una nanan nga ginpahayag ni BSP Governor Eli Remolona Jr nga ang inflation sa pungsod ang posible nga maglapaw sa target kag magpabilin nga mas mataas sa four percent sa masunod nga duha ka quarters.
english: Earlier, BSP Governor Eli Remolona Jr. said inflation in the country is likely to exceed the target and remain above four percent in the next two quarters.

text: Ginalantaw naman nga possible nga magabalik ini sa target sa second half sang tuig.
english: It is expected to return to target in the second half of the year.

text: Pilason ang 23 ka tawo samtang kritikal ang isa ka mag-iloy sang ginbungguan sang isa ka Sports Utility Vehicle (SUV) nga ginamaneho ang 13-anyos nga dalagita ang isa ka van nga may sakay nga mga turista sa La Union.
english: Twenty-three people were injured while a mother and daughter were critically injured when a Sports Utility Vehicle (SUV) driven by a 13-year-old girl hit a van carrying tourists in La Union.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa national highway sa Barangay Ili Sur, San Juan, La Union.
english: The incident occurred on the national highway in Barangay Ili Sur, San Juan, La Union.

text: Ginpahayag nga nang-agaw sang linya ang SUV sa kurbadahon nga porsyon sang dalan gani nabungguan sini ang van.
english: The SUV reportedly took the lane on the curved portion of the road and hit the van.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga ginpalagyo lang sang dalagita ang SUV kag wala naglisensya sa ila balay.
english: Investigation revealed that the girl just fled the SUV and did not leave her house.

text: Nag-angkon man ang dalagita sang mga pilas kag amo man ang kaupod niya nga isa man ka menor de edad.
english: The girl also sustained injuries and so did her companion, who is also a minor.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang City Social Welfare and Development ang dalagita nga driver.
english: The driver is now in the custody of the City Social Welfare and Development.

text: Ginlabo sang isa ka amay ang iya anak nga naghangkat sa iya sang patyanay.
english: A father stabbed his son who challenged him to murder.

text: Natabo ini sa Palanas, Masbate kun sa diin ang biktima amo ang 35-anyos nga anak samtang ang suspek naman ang ginkilala nga si alyas Jose.
english: The incident occurred in Palanas, Masbate where the victim was identified as his 35-year-old son while the suspect was identified as alias Jose.

text: Suno sa suspek, masami siya nga ginahangkat sang iya anak sang patyanan kun mahubog ini tubtob nga wala na ini nakapugong.
english: According to the suspect, his son often challenged him to kill him when he was drunk until he could not control himself.

text: Pahayag niya, wala man siya nagkulang sa paglaygay sa anak ilabi na kun hubog ini.
english: He said he did not fail to advise his son especially when he was drunk.

text: Gin-ako naman sang amay nga nakainom siya sang ginlabo niya ang iya anak.
english: The father admitted that he was under the influence of alcohol when he stabbed his son.

text: Ginadumilian nga ipaguwa sa mga sinehan sa Vietnam ang upcoming movie nga Barbie bangud sa mga eksena nga may mapa nga nagapakita sang nine-dash line area nga gina-claim sang China.
english: The upcoming movie Barbie is banned from being released in theaters in Vietnam due to scenes with a map showing the nine-dash line area claimed by China.

text: Ini nga fantasy comedy film sa idalom sang direksyon ni Greta Gerwig kag sa pagpanguna sang stars nga sanday Margot Robbie kag Ryan Gosling ang natalana kuntani nga ipaguwa sa Vietnam sa Hulyo 21.
english: This fantasy comedy film under the direction of Greta Gerwig and led by stars Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling was supposed to be released in Vietnam on July 21.

text: Apang indi na ini matabo bangud nag-desisyon na ang gobyerno nga kakason ang performance shedule sini sa websites sang major cinema chains sa pungsod kag i-ban na ang screening sang movie bangud sa pag-feature sini sa nine-dash line.
english: However, this will not happen because the government has decided to remove its performance schedule from the websites of major cinema chains in the country and ban the screening of the movie due to its featuring on the nine-dash line.

text: Nahibaluan nga madugay na ginagamit sang China ang nine-dash line agud i-ilustrar kun ano ang ila nasakpan sa teritoryo nga naga-overlap naman sa exclusive economic zone claims sang Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, Pilipinas, Taiwan, kag Vietnam.
english: China has long used the nine-dash line to illustrate its territorial claims, which overlap with the exclusive economic zone claims of Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Taiwan, and Vietnam.

text: Ginpahayag nga makapila ka beses gid nagguwa ang nine-dash line sa pelikula kag wala nakalusot sa censors sang Vietnam nga amo ang nagasala sa content nga may gratuitous violence, suggestive sex scenes, ukon politically-sensitive nga material.
english: The nine-dash line reportedly appeared several times in the film and did not escape Vietnamese censors who filter content for gratuitous violence, suggestive sex scenes, or politically-sensitive material.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi ini ang una nga pelikula nga gin-ban sa Vietnam bangud sa amo nga rason.
english: It turns out that this is not the first film to be banned in Vietnam for that reason.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, gin-ban man ang “Uncharted,” ang action-and-adventure movie nga bida si Tom Holland, bangud man sa pag-feature sa nine-dash line.
english: Last year, “Uncharted,” the action-and-adventure movie starring Tom Holland, was also banned for featuring on the nine-dash line.

text: Sang 2018, ginpakakas man sang Vietnam ang eksena sa romantic comedy nga “Crazy Rich Asians” kun sa diin nakit-an ang designer bag nga may mapa sang kalibutan nga makit-an ang disputed South China Sea islands sa idalom sang kontrol sang China.
english: In 2018, Vietnam also removed a scene from the romantic comedy “Crazy Rich Asians” where a designer bag was found with a world map showing the disputed South China Sea islands under Chinese control.

text: Sang 2019, wala man nakalusot sa Hanoi ang animated DreamWorks film nga “Abominable” bangud sa amo nga isyu.
english: In 2019, the animated DreamWorks film “Abominable” also failed to make it to Hanoi due to the same issue.

text: Sang 2022, ginpakakas man sa Netflix ang episodes sa Australian spy drama nga “Pine Gap” bangud sa amo gihapon nga rason.
english: In 2022, episodes in the Australian spy drama “Pine Gap” were also removed from Netflix for the same reason.

text: Nagsaka ang Gilas Pilipinas sang isa ka spot sa world rankings sang FIBA.
english: Gilas Pilipinas rose one spot in the FIBA ​​world rankings.

text: Sa latest rankings nga gin-release sang basketball federation, nagapang-37 na ang Gilas kasunod sang una nga window sang FIBA continental qualifiers.
english: In the latest rankings released by the basketball federation, the Gilas are now 37th following the first window of the FIBA ​​continental qualifiers.

text: Sa amo nga hinampang sang Pebrero, gin-lutos sang Gilas ang Hong Kong nga may 30 nga abanse, kag ang Chinese Taipei nga gintambakan sang 53-puntos nga abanse.
english: In that February game, the Gilas defeated Hong Kong with a 30-point lead, and Chinese Taipei with a 53-point lead.

text: Nagapanguna man ang Pilipinas sa Group B kasunod sang amo nga mga sambuwa kag nagahulat sa masunod nga window sang qualifiers nga matabo pa sa Nobyembre.
english: The Philippines is also leading Group B following these matches and is waiting for the next window of qualifiers which will take place in November.

text: Sa kabug-usan nga Asya, nagapang-walo ang Pilipinas kun sa diin nagasunod ini sa Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Iran, Lebanon, China kag Jordan.
english: In Asia, the Philippines ranks eighth, followed by Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Iran, Lebanon, China and Jordan.

text: Ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika gihapon ang nagapanguna sa ranking sa bilog nga kalibutan; nagapangaduha ang Espanya, FIBA World Cup champion Germany bilang pangatlo; kag ginasundan sang Serbia kag Australia.
english: The United States of America still tops the rankings worldwide; Spain second, FIBA ​​World Cup champion Germany third; followed by Serbia and Australia.

text: Ang nagakumpleto sang Top 10 amo ang Latvia, Canada, Argentina, France kag Lithuania.#
english: Completing the Top 10 are Latvia, Canada, Argentina, France and Lithuania.#

text: Wala sang “merry” sa Christmas sang madamo nga mga indibiwal nga may kahilabtanan sa kurapsyon sa flood control projects.
english: There is no “merry” at Christmas for many individuals involved in corruption in flood control projects.

text: Suno kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., antes pa man ang Paskuwa, may yara na sang makasuhan, gani nga may mapreso gid kag didto sila maligaran sang Christmas sa likod sang rehas.
english: According to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., even before Easter, someone will be prosecuted, so that someone will be imprisoned and they will spend Christmas behind bars.

text: “Bago magpasko, marami dito sa napangalanan dito ay palagay ko ay matatapos na ‘yung kaso, buo na ‘yung kaso nila.
english: “Before Christmas, many of those named here, I think the case will be over, their case will be complete.

text: Makukulong na sila.
english: They’re going to jail.

text: Wala silang Merry Christmas.
english: They don't have a Merry Christmas.

text: Before Christmas, makukulong na sila,” suno kay Marcos.
english: Before Christmas, they will be in jail,” Marcos said.

text: Base sa Malacañang, 37 ka mga indibidwal lakip ang mga mamalidha, kontraktor, kag iban pa nga opisyal sang gobyerno ang pasakaan sang kaso-kriminal kag kaso-administratibo.
english: According to Malacañang, 37 individuals including lawmakers, contractors, and other government officials will face criminal and administrative charges.

text: Nagpromisa ang Palasyo nga pangalanan kun sanday sin-o ang 37 nga ini, apang base sa inisyal nga lista, wala ang pangalan sang pakaisa ni Marcos nga si former House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.
english: The Palace promised to name the 37, but based on the initial list, the name of Marcos' cousin, former House Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez, was not included.

text: Sang ginpamangkot ang presidente, sabat sini: “Not as of yet.
english: When asked, the president replied: “Not as of yet.

text:
If something else comes out, then he (Romualdez) might be answerable to something.”

“Provide us the evidence and we will file cases against them… Bigyan ninyo kami ng lahat ng ebidensya na mayroon kayo para magamit namin,” suno sa iya.
english:
If something else comes out, then he (Romualdez) might be answerable to something.”

“Provide us the evidence and we will file cases against them… Give us all the evidence you have so we can use it,” he said.

text:
Ginsulit sini nga wala sang exempted sa imbestigasyon: “Walang immune sa investigation na ito, walang exempted.”

Wala sang timeline ang gobyerno kun san-o sini matapos ang imbestigasyon kag ang pag-file sang kaso sa mga indibidwal sa involved sa flood control project scandal.
english:
He reiterated that no one is exempt from the investigation: “No one is immune to this investigation, no one is exempt.”

The government does not have a timeline for when it will complete the investigation and the filing of cases against individuals involved in the flood control project scandal.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag ni Marcos nga dapat solid ang mga ebidensya kag dapat ma-id-id ang imbestigasyon agud masiguro nga madulot gid ang kaso kag wala na sang basulay nga matabo pananglitan mabasura ini sa korte.
english: Marcos earlier said that the evidence must be solid and the investigation must be thorough to ensure that the case is brought to justice and that there will be no blame if it is dismissed in court.

text: “Ang ayaw namin ay yung mga kasabwat dito ay makakalusot because of a legal technicality… Titiyakin namin na kapag kami ay nagsampa ng kaso, yang kaso na yan ay matibay hanggang dulo….
english: “What we don't want is for the accomplices here to escape because of a legal technicality... We will make sure that when we file a case, that case will be strong to the end….

text: at kung huhusgahan sila ng korte ay makukulong sila,” kabahin sang pahayag ni Marcos.
english: and if the court judges them, they will be imprisoned,” Marcos said.

text: Matandaan nga may na-file naman nga reklamo ang Department of Public Works and Highways kag ang National Bureau of Investigation batok sa pila ka former DPWH officials kag contractors sa Office of the Ombudsman kag sa Department of Justice.#
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways and the National Bureau of Investigation have filed complaints against several former DPWH officials and contractors with the Office of the Ombudsman and the Department of Justice.

text: Nagpanguna si Kharam Baricaua Molbog sang University of Santo Tomas (UST) sa lista sang topnotchers sa October 2025 Physician Licensure Examination.
english: Kharam Baricaua Molbog of the University of Santo Tomas (UST) topped the list of topnotchers in the October 2025 Physician Licensure Examination.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga tion nga nagpangibabaw siya sa pasinawan matapos nga nangin Rank 1 man anay sa Medical Technologist Licensure Exam sang Agusto 2022.
english: This is the second time he has topped the examination after also becoming Rank 1 in the Medical Technologist Licensure Exam in August 2022.

text: Suno sa Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), ang 25-anyos nga alumnus sang UST amo ang may pinakamataas nga score nga 91.17 percent sa 4,570 ka mga examinees nga nakapasar sa doctors’ exam.
english: According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), the 25-year-old UST alumnus scored the highest with 91.17 percent among the 4,570 examinees who passed the doctors’ exam.

text: Ginpatigayon ang test sang Oct.
english: The test was conducted on Oct.

text: 4, 5, 11 kag 12 sa Metro Manila kag iban pa nga test centers sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: 4, 5, 11 and 12 in Metro Manila and other test centers nationwide.

text: Tumandok sang Quezon, Solano, Nueva Vizcaya ang nasambit nga back-to-back topnotcher.
english: The back-to-back topnotcher is a native of Quezon, Solano, Nueva Vizcaya.

text: Nag-gradwar siya bilang summa cum laude meritissimus sa UST nga may outstanding 99.17 percent sa iya medical course.
english: He graduated summa cum laude meritissimus from UST with an outstanding 99.17 percent in his medical course.

text: Lipod sa ihibalo sang kadam-an, “late bloomer” man si Molbog, santo mismo sa iya panaysayon.
english: Unbeknownst to the public, Molbog is also a “late bloomer”, according to his own testimony.

text: Suno sa iya, indi siya gani standout student sang elementary kag high school sa St.
english: He said he was not even a standout student in elementary and high school in St.

text: Louis School sa Solano.
english: Louis School in Solano.

text: Napaslawan man siya nga makapasar sa University of the Philippines College Admission Test (UPCAT) sang 2014, apang sa baylo nga malingkang, nareyalisar niya nga maghimakas pa kag himuon ang mga bagay nga may madalom nga determinasyon.
english: He also failed to pass the University of the Philippines College Admission Test (UPCAT) in 2014, but instead of being discouraged, he realized to fight harder and do things with deep determination.

text: “I kept working hard in college and med school, so that perseverance finally paid off when I topped both licensure exams,” pahayag sini.
english: “I kept working hard in college and med school, so that perseverance finally paid off when I topped both licensure exams,” it stated.

text: Plano sini nga mag-specialize sa cardiology ukon radiation oncology.
english: She plans to specialize in cardiology or radiation oncology.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sini nga himuon sini ang iya responsibilidad bilang doctor agud mahatagan sang igtalupangod ang problema sa kakulangan sang medical professionals sa Nueva Vizcaya nga may yara gid lamang sang duha ka cardiologists.
english: He also shared that he will do his responsibility as a doctor to address the problem of lack of medical professionals in Nueva Vizcaya which has only two cardiologists.

text: ILOILO CITY – Dominado ni Iloilo City Cong.
english: ILOILO CITY – Dominated by Iloilo City Cong.

text: Jerry Treñas ang voter’s preference sa pagka alkalde sang syudad sang Iloilo sa nagkalain-lain nga age group, highest educational attainment kag socio-economic status.
english: Jerry Treñas the voter's preference for mayor of Iloilo City in different age groups, highest educational attainment and socio-economic status.

english: The survey was conducted by Random Access Consultants In.c (RACI) from March 30 to 31, 2019, with a sample size of 600 respondents and a margin of error of ±4%.

text: Gintiro sang wala pa makilal-an nga indibidwal ang former broadcaster sa isa ka radio station sa General Santos City.
english: An unidentified individual shot dead the former broadcaster at a radio station in General Santos City.

text: Ang biktima amo si Ali Macalintal.
english: The victim was identified as Ali Macalintal.

text: Natabo ang pagpangluthang samtang yara ini sa sulod sang ginapanag-iyahan sini nga spa sa Calina Street, Barangay Lagao, Gensan.
english: The shooting occurred while he was inside his spa in Calina Street, Barangay Lagao, Gensan.

text: Madasig nga gindala sa ospital ang biktima apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Ginpahayag nga may isa ka lalaki nga nagsulod sa spa kag gintiro ang biktima.
english: A man reportedly entered the spa and shot the victim.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan sa insidente.
english: Police are still investigating the incident.

text: May igabutang nga graphic health warnings sa pakete sang electronic cigarettes kag vapes nga ibaligya sa mga physical kag online stores sa Pilipinas.
english: Graphic health warnings will be placed on the packages of electronic cigarettes and vapes sold in physical and online stores in the Philippines.

text: Ini kaangay sa nakabutang sa mga suludlan sang sigarilyo agud nga indi ma-engganyo ang mga Pinoy ilabi na ang mga kabataan nga gamiton ini nga makahalalit nga mga produkto.
english: This is similar to what is written on cigarette packages so as not to encourage Filipinos especially children to use these harmful products.

text: Suno sa Department of Health (DOH), ini nga polisa ang mangin epektibo sa Mayo 12 kag para ini sa tanan nga vaporized nicotine kag non-nicotine products kag novel tobacco products lakip na ang vapes.
english: According to the Department of Health (DOH), this policy will be effective on May 12 and will apply to all vaporized nicotine and non-nicotine products and novel tobacco products including vapes.

text: Suno pa sa health agency, ang graphic warnings ang halos katunga gid sang packaging material sang vapes.
english: According to the health agency, graphic warnings are almost half of the packaging material of vapes.

text: Makit-an diri ang halit nga matuga sa lawas kun padayon ang paggamit sa nasambit nga produkto.
english: This shows the damage that can be caused to the body if the product continues to be used.

text: Sa idalom sang RA 11900 ukon ang Vaporized Nicotine and Non-Nicotine Products Regulation Act, ang duly registered e-cigarettes kag vape products nga may applicable GHWs amo lamang ang pahanugutan nga ibaligya, i-advertise, kag i-distribute sa pungsod.
english: Under RA 11900 or the Vaporized Nicotine and Non-Nicotine Products Regulation Act, only duly registered e-cigarettes and vape products with applicable GHWs will be allowed to be sold, advertised, and distributed in the country.

text: Ang manufacturers, distributors, importers kag retailers sang vaporized nicotine kag non-nicotine products kag novel tobacco products nga indi makasunod sa layi ang mahimo mapreso sang tubtub anum ka tuig kag posible nga dagdagan sang multa nga P5 million.
english: Manufacturers, distributors, importers and retailers of vaporized nicotine and non-nicotine products and novel tobacco products who fail to comply with the law can be jailed for up to six years and possibly fined P5 million.

text: Gin-ban sa isa ka hampang kag gindagdagan pa sang multa ang Portuguese football superstar nga si Cristiano Ronaldo bangud sa ginpahayag “bastos” sini nga sabat sa fans sa isa ka match sang Saudi Pro League.
english: Portuguese football superstar Cristiano Ronaldo has been banned for one game and fined for his allegedly “rude” response to fans during a Saudi Pro League match.

text: Natabo ini kadungan sang hampang sang iya club nga All Nassr kun sa diin nagdaog ini, 3-2, batok sa Al-Shabab nga naka-base sa Riyadh.
english: This happened during the match of his club All Nassr where he won, 3-2, against Al-Shabab based in Riyadh.

text: Ang aktwasyon sang 39-anyos nga All Nassr star amo ang iya sabat sa mga fans sang Al Shabab nga nagasinggitan sang pangalan sang world champion kag long-time rival ni Ronaldo nga si Lionel Messi.
english: The 39-year-old All Nassr star’s action was his response to Al Shabab fans chanting the name of world champion and Ronaldo’s long-time rival Lionel Messi.

text: Samtang nagasinggit sang “Messi, Messi” ang mga tawo sa stands, nagliso si Ronaldo, ginbutang ang iya kamot sa iya dulunggan, kag sunod nga sulit-sulit ang iya gesture sa iya nga atubangan ukon sa pelvic area nga gintawag naman sang iban nga bastos.
english: As the crowd chanted “Messi, Messi” in the stands, Ronaldo turned around, put his hand to his ear, and then repeated a gesture to his front or pelvic area that some called rude.

text: Suno sa Saudi Arabian Football Federation, ginlapas ni Ronaldo ang Article 57-1 sang Discipline and Ethics Regulations.
english: According to the Saudi Arabian Football Federation, Ronaldo violated Article 57-1 of the Discipline and Ethics Regulations.

text: Magluwas sa suspensyon, magabayad ini sang $2,666 (ginabanta P150,000 ) sa football federation kag dugang nga $5,333 (ginabanta P300,000 ) sa Al-Shabab para sa complaint filing fees.
english: In addition to the suspension, he will pay $2,666 (approximately P150,000) to the football federation and an additional $5,333 (approximately P300,000) to Al-Shabab for complaint filing fees.

text: Gin-athag man sang Saudi Arabian Football Federation nga indi na pwede maka-apelar si Ronaldo sa amo nga desisyon — apisar nga siya ang ginakabig pinakadaku nga football player sa amo nga pungsod.
english: The Saudi Arabian Football Federation also clarified that Ronaldo cannot appeal the decision — despite being considered the greatest football player in the country.

text: Matandaan nga si Ronaldo, isa ka five-time Balon d’Or winner, ang nagsulod sa Al-Nassr kasunod sang iya paghalin sa Manchester United sang katapusan sang 2022.
english: It will be noted that Ronaldo, a five-time Balon d’Or winner, joined Al-Nassr following his exit from Manchester United at the end of 2022.

text: Naka-skor siya sang 14 goals sa iya 16 ka league appearances sang nagligad nga tuig kag amo ang top scorer sa liga subong nga may 22 goals sa 20 sini ka mga pagpakita sa hampang.
english: He scored 14 goals in his 16 league appearances last year and is currently the top scorer in the league with 22 goals in 20 of his game appearances.

text: Indi ini ang una nga tion nga nabutang ang pangalan sang amo nga Portuguese star sa kontrobersiya halin sang nagsaylo ini sa Saudi Arabia.
english: This is not the first time the Portuguese star's name has been thrown into controversy since his move to Saudi Arabia.

text: Sini lang nga bulan, nakit-an man nga ginpulot sini ang Al Hilal scarf nga ginhaboy sa iya halin sa stands, ginbutang sa sulod sang iya nga shorts, kag ginhaboy ini samtang nga nagapasulod siya sa tunnel matapos nga nalutos ang Al Nassr, 2-0, sa Riyadh Season Cup final.#
english: Earlier this month, he was also seen picking up an Al Hilal scarf thrown at him from the stands, putting it inside his shorts, and throwing it as he entered the tunnel after Al Nassr lost 2-0 in the Riyadh Season Cup final.

text: Gin-ako sang Pinoy boxer nga si Jerwin Ancajas nga nagnubo gid ang iya nga morale kag nadula ang kumpyansa sa kaugalingon matapos natumba sa kamot sang Japanese fighter nga si Takuma Inoue nga amo gihapon ang naga-uyat sang WBA bantamweight title.
english: Filipino boxer Jerwin Ancajas admitted that he lost his morale and self-confidence after falling to Japanese fighter Takuma Inoue who still holds the WBA bantamweight title.

text: Sabado sang nag-atubangay sa title bout ang duha sa Tokyo, Japan, apang pag-abot sa round nine, natumba ang Pinoy boxer kag wala na naka-recover.
english: The two faced each other in a title bout in Tokyo, Japan, on Saturday, but in round nine, the Filipino boxer fell and did not recover.

text: Suno naman sa 32-anyos nga anay world champion, ginatugyan na lang sini sa Ginuo kun ano ang masunod sa iya nga karera.
english: The 32-year-old former world champion said he is leaving it to the Lord to decide what comes next in his career.

text: Pahayag sini, ini ang labing-una sa iya nga career kag mangin sa sparring nga natumba siya bangud sa body shot.
english: He said this is the first time in his career and it will be in sparring that he fell due to a body shot.

text: Bangud sa natabo, si Ancajas nga lima ka tuig anay nga ginkilala bilang International Boxing Federation super flyweight champion ang naka-rekord na sang tatlo ka kalutusan sa iya apat ka ulihi nga mga hampang.
english: As a result of the incident, Ancajas, who was recognized as the International Boxing Federation super flyweight champion for five years, has recorded three losses in his last four fights.

text: Nadagdag man sa 32-4 ang rekord sini nga may 23 ka knockouts; samtang si Takuma — manghod sang top pound-for-pound fighter nga si Naoya — ang nagsaka na sa 19-1 nga rekord nga may lima ka na-knockout sa iya pro career nga nagsugod 11 ka tuig pa lamang ang nagligad.
english: His record with 23 knockouts also increased to 32-4; while Takuma — younger brother of top pound-for-pound fighter Naoya — has already risen to a 19-1 record with five knockouts in a pro career that began just 11 years ago.

text: Pangunahan ni Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Eduardo M. Año bilas tiglawas ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte ang kahiwatan subong nga adlaw sang Araw ng Kagitingan ukon Day of Valor sa Mt.
english: Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Eduardo M. Año bilas President Rodrigo Duterte will lead the event today on the Day of Valor at Mt.

text: Samat National Shrine, Pilar, Bataan, las-9:00 subong nga aga.
english: Samat National Shrine, Pilar, Bataan, at 9:00 this morning.

text: Ang tema subong nga tuig amo ang ‘Sakripisyo ng Beterano ay Gunitain, Gawing Tanglaw ng Kabataan Tungo sa Kaunlaran’.
english: This year's theme is 'Veterans' Sacrifice is Sustained, Youth's Sacrifice for Development'

text: Kaupod ni Año sanday Ambassador of Japan Koji Haneda kag Deputy Chief of Mission of the United States of America John Law sa wreath-laying rites ukon paghalad sang bulak.
english: Año was accompanied by Ambassador of Japan Koji Haneda and Deputy Chief of Mission of the United States of America John Law for the wreath-laying rites.

text: Si Bataan Governor Albert S. Garcia naman ang magahatag sang welcome remarks samtang magahatag sang mensahe amo si Ambassador Haneda kag Mr. Law.
english: Bataan Governor Albert S. Garcia will deliver welcome remarks while Ambassador Haneda and Mr. Law.

Briones, Department of National Defense-Undersecretary for Civil, Veterans and Retiree Affairs, Philippine Retiree Mappino Mappin. Veterans Affairs Office Administrator Ernesto G. Carolina, and President of the Veterans Federation of the Philippines Justice Manuel Pamaran.

english: Department of National Defense Undersecretary for Civil, Veterans and Retiree affairs Reynaldo Mapagu will introduce DILG Secretary who will deliver the keynote address.

text: Ginpasa na sa Philippine National Police-Anti-Cybercrime Group (PNP-ACG) ang lista sang social media influencers nga nakit-an nga naga-promote sang illegal online gambling.
english: The list of social media influencers found promoting illegal online gambling has been submitted to the Philippine National Police-Anti-Cybercrime Group (PNP-ACG).

text: Suno ini kay Department of Information and Communications Technology-Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) chief Undersecretary Renato “Aboy” Paraiso sa isa ka press conference subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 13.
english: This was announced by Department of Information and Communications Technology-Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) chief Undersecretary Renato “Aboy” Paraiso in a press conference today, November 13.

text: Pahayag sini, naka-monitor ang Threat Monitoring Team (TMC) kag ang advocacy group nga Digital Pinoys sang dugang nga 30 ka influencers nga naga-promote sa gihapon sini nga iligal nga buluhaton.
english: He said the Threat Monitoring Team (TMC) and the advocacy group Digital Pinoys have monitored an additional 30 influencers who are still promoting this illegal activity.

text: Suno kay Paraiso, 1.1 million tubtub sa 9.2 million ang followers sang top 15 influencers nga naga-post sa gihapon sang content nga naga-unod sang promotions sang illegal online gambling websites.
english: According to Paraiso, 1.1 million to 9.2 million followers of the top 15 influencers who still post content containing promotions of illegal online gambling websites.

text:

Gin-endorso ang lista sa pulis para mapasakaan sang kaso.
english:

text: Antes sini suno sa CICC, nahatagan na sang tyansa ang influencers nga kakason nila ang ila nga content, apang wala sila nag-comply, rason nga ipaagi na lang sa kaso.
english: Earlier, CICC said, the influencers were given a chance to remove their content, but they did not comply, so they will go through the case.

text: Ang endorsement sa PNP-ACG amo ang magasugod sang proseso sang case build-up batok sa influencers.
english: The endorsement to the PNP-ACG will begin the process of case build-up against the influencers.

text: Lakip sa mahimo nalapas sang sini nga influencers amo ang Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012, Presidential Decree No.
english: Among the possible violations of these influencers are the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012, Presidential Decree No.

text: 1602 (Prescribing Stiffer Penalties on Illegal Gambling), kag ang Article 315 sang Revised Penal Code sa estafa.
english: 1602 (Prescribing Stiffer Penalties on Illegal Gambling), and Article 315 of the Revised Penal Code on estafa.

text: Ginalantaw man sang ahensya nga sa padayon nga imbestigasyon, posible nga matukiban ang “grand conspiracy” ukon ang large-scale syndicated estafa nga nagalakip sang influencers.
english: The agency also believes that in the ongoing investigation, it is possible to discover a “grand conspiracy” or a large-scale syndicated estafa involving influencers.

english: The 16 senators formally showed support for the establishment of the Independent People’s Commission (IPC) which could replace the Independent Commission on Infrastructure (ICI).
