text: Pila sa mga wala nagpirma sa committee report amo ang wala nakatambong sa plenaryo sang Senado sang ginpalibot ini agud pirmahan.
english: Some of those who did not sign the committee report were those who did not attend the plenary session of the Senate when it was circulated for signature.

text: Pahayag ni Pangilinan, hatagan sang gahum ang IPC nga magdagdag sang subpoena, mag-freeze sang assets, mag-contempt sang indibidwal kag mga entity, magkanselar sang professional licenses, mag-grant sang witness immunity kag protection, magpaguwa sang lookout orders, kag iban pa.
english: Pangilinan said the IPC will be empowered to issue subpoenas, freeze assets, contempt individuals and entities, cancel professional licenses, grant witness immunity and protection, issue lookout orders, and others.

text: Mahimo man ini makapaguwa sang order sang immediate preventive suspension (subject to constitutional limitation) sang government officials nga gina-imbestigaran.
english: It can also issue an order of immediate preventive suspension (subject to constitutional limitation) of government officials under investigation.

text: Matandaan nga ang ICI nga amo subong ang nagahulag sa imbestigasyon sa flood control amo ang gintukod ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The ICI, which is currently investigating the flood control, was established by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: paagi sa Executive Order 94 sang Septyembre.
english: through Executive Order 94 in September.

text: Pananglitan matukod naman ang IPC, magalawig ang mandato sini tubtub sa Hulyo 30, 2028 magluwas lang kun palawigon ini paagi sa gahum sang layi.#
english: If the IPC is established, its mandate will last until July 30, 2028 unless extended by law.

text: Nagapabilin na lang nga nagabaligya sa kilid sang dalan ang mga vendors sa Iloilo Terminal Market matapos nga gin-demolish ang ila pwesto.
english: Vendors in the Iloilo Terminal Market remain selling on the side of the road after their stalls were demolished.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay alyas Bebeng, iya ginpahayag nga sila mismo nakibot nga gin-demolish na ang ila pwesto matapos nga una ginhambal sa ila nga sa October 20 pa bak-bakon ang ila pwesto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Bebeng said they were surprised that their place was demolished after they were first told that their place would be demolished on October 20.

text: Pahayag niya nga wala pa gid sang pinal nga adlaw kun sano sila pwede makasaylo sa bago nga human nga merkado rason nga ginhambalan sila nga mapahuway na lang anay sa duwa ka semana ukon mansig pangita na lang sang ila pwesto nga pwede mabaligyaan.
english: He said there is no final date when they can move to the newly completed market so they were told to rest for two weeks or immediately find a place to sell.

text: Rason nga sa higad sang dalan na lang sila nagabaligya sang ila produkto bangud nga kun magpahuway sila wala sila sang kita ukon kwaan sa adlaw-adlaw nga palangabuhian kag maguba man ang ila nga mga paninda.
english: The reason why they sell their products on the side of the road is because if they rest they have no income or money for their daily livelihood and their goods will be destroyed.

text: Suno kay alyas Bebeng, matapos nga ma-demolished ang ila pwesto madamo sang problema sila nga gina-atubang pareho sang tyempo nga tuman kainit para sa ila magbaligya kun aga kun sa diin ginpahayag niya nga basi kada gab-i na lang sila mabaligya apang indi man ini mahimu bangud maapektohan man ang ila kita.
english: According to alias Bebeng, after their place was demolished, they faced many problems such as the weather being too hot for them to sell in the morning.

text: Bangud nga sa kilid sang dalan na lang sila nagabaligya, gina-pangtagpi-tagpi na lang sang mga vendors ang mga trapal para may ara lang sang masilungan pareho sang gulpi nga pagbubu sang ulan kaina sang hapon.
english: Because they are only selling on the side of the road, the vendors are just folding the tarpaulins so that there is shelter like the sudden rain yesterday afternoon.

text: Dugang pa niya, ginahatag na lang nila ang ila paninda sa manubo nga presyo para lang maubos ang ila paninda bangud wala sila sang pwesto nga mabutangan sang ila bilin nga mga paninda.
english: He added that they are just giving their goods at low prices just to run out of goods because they have no place to put their remaining goods.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni alyas Bebeng, bisan ginpangguba ang ila pwesto tani ginhatagan man sila sang temporaryo nga pwesto bangud nga daw naga gwa sila nga bulante nga nagabaligya sa higad sang dalan.
english: Bebeng said that even if their place was destroyed, they should have been given a temporary place because they are like volunteers selling on the side of the road.

text: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂
english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂

text: Nadula kag ginapatihan nga ginkawat ang security plan para sa Paris 2024 Olympics.
english: Missing and presumed stolen security plan for Paris 2024 Olympics.

text: Suno sa Paris prosecutor’s office, nadula sang City Hall Engineer ang bag nga nagaunod sang computer kag duha ka memory sticks nga amo ang may data sa seguridad nga kinahanglan para sa Olympiada sa France.
english: According to the Paris prosecutor's office, the City Hall Engineer lost the bag containing the computer and two memory sticks that contained the security data needed for the Olympiad in France.

text: Natabo ini sa Gare du Nord railway station sa Paris sang nagligad nga Pebrero 26.
english: It happened at the Gare du Nord railway station in Paris last February 26th.

text: Gintugyan na sa pulis ang imbestigasyon kasunod sang amo nga insidente.
english: The investigation following the incident has been handed over to the police.

text: Ginklaro man sang opisina nga ang professional USB memory stick ang nagaunod lamang sang notes nga naangot sa traffic sa Paris kadungan sang Olympic Games, apang wala man didto nakabutang ang sensitive security plans.
english: The office also clarified that the professional USB memory stick only contained notes related to traffic in Paris during the Olympic Games, but did not contain sensitive security plans.

text: Balantayan ang Paris Olympics sa Hulyo 26 tubtub sa Agusto 11.
english: Watch the Paris Olympics from July 26 to August 11.

text: Ginalauman nga 30,000 nga mga myembro sang pulis ang ipadala kadungan sang hinampang kun sa diin 300,000 ang ginalauman naman nga magatambong sa opening ceremony sa River Seine.
english: It is expected that 30,000 police personnel will be deployed during the games while 300,000 are expected to attend the opening ceremony on the River Seine.

text: Gin-areso ang isa ka 16-anyos nga solterito kag iya mga kaupod matapos nga nagsaot ini nga hublas kag nagpakita pa sang kinatawo samtang nagakabit sa nagadalagan nga tricycle sa Antipolo City.
english: A 16-year-old boy and his companions were arrested after he danced naked and showed his genitals while clinging to a moving tricycle in Antipolo City.

text: Ginpakita niya ang iya kinatawo sa mga tiangge nga baligyaan sang pasalubong.
english: He displayed his genitals in gift shops.

text: Apisar nga may tabon ang iya nawong, nakuhaan sang plaka ang tricycle gani ginpatawag ang driver kag ginpatawag ang mga pasahero kalakip na ang nagsaot nga hublas nga ginkilala nga is alyas Carl.
english: Despite the fact that his face was covered, the tricycle was stripped of its license plate and the driver was summoned and the passengers were summoned including the naked dancer identified as Carl.

text: Nag-ako naman ang mga ini sa ila gin-ubra.
english: They confessed to what they had done.

text: Yara na sa paghinakop sang DSWD ang exhibitionist nga si Carl.
english: The exhibitionist, Carl, is now in the custody of the DSWD.

text: Natalana naman nga pasakaan sang panumbungon ang iban nga kaupod sini nga yara na sa legal ang edad.
english: His other companions, who are of legal age, are scheduled to face charges.

text: Ginpaathag ni Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Eli Remolona Jr.
english: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Eli Remolona Jr. explained.

text: nga ang pagnubo sang balor sang peso ang wala nagakahulugan nga mahina ang performance sang local currency kundi bangud mabaskog lang gid ang dolyar ukon ang US currency.
english: that the depreciation of the peso does not mean that the performance of the local currency is weak but because the dollar or the US currency is very strong.

text: Ang P57 nga baylo sang US dollar sang Martes amo na ang pinakamanubo sa sulod sang 17 ka bulan, apang kahapon, Myerkules, naghulag pa ini sa P57.18.
english: The P57 against the US dollar on Tuesday was the lowest in 17 months, but yesterday, Wednesday, it moved to P57.18.

text: Gina-angot ni Remolona ini nga pagluya sang peso sa geopolitical tensions kag espekulasyon sa masunod nga mga tikang sang US Federal Reserve.
english: Remolona attributes this weakening of the peso to geopolitical tensions and speculation on the next moves by the US Federal Reserve.

text: Ang pagnubo suno pa sa iya ang posible nga reaksyon sa signal ni Fed Chairman Jerome Powell nga ang rate cuts sa US ang posible nga maulihi ipaanggid sa ginalauman.
english: He said the decline is likely a reaction to Fed Chairman Jerome Powell's signal that rate cuts in the US are likely to be later than expected.

text: “I wouldn’t say it is performing poorly.
english: “I wouldn’t say it is performing poorly.

text: I would say it’s adjusting to some events initially weakened along with other emerging market currencies because of what’s going on in the Middle East,” pahayag sini.
english: I would say it’s adjusting to some events initially weakened along with other emerging market currencies because of what’s going on in the Middle East,” it stated.

text: “So it’s not a case of a weak peso.
english: “So it’s not a case of a weak peso.

text:
It’s a case of a strong dollar.”

Wala man nakit-an ni Remolona nga ang pagluya sang peso ang maka-waraant sang pag-adjust sang interest rates.
english:
It’s a case of a strong dollar.”

Remolona also did not see the weakening of the peso as warranting an adjustment in interest rates.

text: Nahibaluan nga duha ka magkasunod na nga bulan nga may pagsaka sa inflation rate, apang suno sa BSP chief, indi tuman ka daku ang adjustment sa peso agud nga maapektuhan ang inflation expectations.#
english: It is known that there has been an increase in the inflation rate for two consecutive months, but according to the BSP chief, the adjustment in the peso is not too large to affect inflation expectations.

text: Nagapangayo sang paghangop kag bulig ang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) sa mga pulitiko nga mangin responsable sa pagsunod sang guidelines tuhoy sa pagpaskil sang campaign poster.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) is seeking the understanding and assistance of politicians who will be responsible for following the guidelines regarding the posting of campaign posters.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jonathan  Sayno, Assistant City Election Officer sang City COMELEC, iya ginpahayag nga kulang ang personnel sang COMELEC rason nga indi man nila maid-iran ang tanan nga lugar agud  pangkakson ang mga illegally posted campaign materials.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jonathan Sayno, Assistant City Election Officer of the City COMELEC, said the COMELEC lacks personnel which is why they cannot cover all areas to remove illegally posted campaign materials.

text: Ginpahayag ni Sayno nga kun tani, sundon sang mga pulitiko ang tanan nga guidelines agud nga wala lang sang problema.
english: Sayno said he hopes that politicians will follow all the guidelines so that there will be no problems.

text: Kun ginpangkakas na ang mga illegally posted nga campaign materials, kun tani suno kay Sayno, indi na pag-itakod liwat sang mga pulitiko.
english: If the illegally posted campaign materials have been removed, Sayno said, the politicians should not re-post them.

text: Magluwas sa lugar, dapat nga sundon man sang pulitiko ang gintalana nga size sang campaign materials nga 2×3 feet.
english: Besides the location, the politician must also follow the prescribed size of campaign materials of 2×3 feet.

text: Padayon sa subong ang imbentaryo sang ahensya kun sin-o nga mga pulitiko ang malakip sa listahan sang violators kag mahimo nga makasuhan bangud sa paglapas sa pagsulundan.
english: The agency is currently conducting an inventory of which politicians will be included in the list of violators and may be prosecuted for violating the rules.

text: Naglunsar sang apelar ang United Nations nga buligan ini nga makatipon sang $275 million ukon P15.68-billion para mahatagan sang ayuda ang masobra isa ka milyon nga mga tawo nga apektado sang 7.7 magnitude nga linog sa Myanmar.
english: The United Nations has launched an appeal to help it raise $275 million or P15.68-billion to provide relief to more than one million people affected by the 7.7 magnitude earthquake in Myanmar.

text: Suno sa organisasyon, sa $1.1 billion ukon P62.70-billion nga kinahanglan para sa humanitarian aid plan sa 5.5-million ka mga tawo, singko porsyento pa gid lamang ang napondohan subong.
english: According to the organization, of the $1.1 billion or P62.70-billion needed for the humanitarian aid plan for 5.5-million people, only five percent is currently funded.

text: Sa bag-o nga appeal sang UN, ang target nga mabuligan amo ang 1.1-million nga ginakabig nga pina-vulnerable lakip na ang mga babaye kag kabataan nga may mataas nga risgo nga mag-atubang sang gender-based violence, food insecurity, kag kakulangan sang access sa reproductive health.
english: In the new UN appeal, the target to be helped is 1.1-million who are considered the most vulnerable including women and children who are at high risk of facing gender-based violence, food insecurity, and lack of access to reproductive health.

text: Sandig sa report sang UN, masobra sa 6.3 million ka tawo ang may urgent need sang assistance sa areas nga gin-igo sang magnitude 7.7 nga linog sang Marso 28 kun sa diin masobra sa 3,600 ang napatay.
english: According to the UN report, more than 6.3 million people are in urgent need of assistance in areas hit by the magnitude 7.7 earthquake on March 28, which killed more than 3,600.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa subong, may duha pa ka nabilin nga missing nga mga Pinoy sa Mandalay bangud sa amo man nga linog.
english: It is known that there are still two missing Filipinos in Mandalay due to the same earthquake.

text: Duha sa ila kaupdanan nga Filipino teachers ang kumpirmado na nga napatay bangud sa pag-collapse sang ila ginatiniran nga building.
english: Two of their fellow Filipino teachers have been confirmed dead in the collapse of their building.

text: Matapos nga ginpangunahan ang Gilas Pilipinas sa hampang batok sa Hong Kong kag Chinese Taipei sa first window sang FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers, atenderon anay ni Justin Brownlee ang mga tanyag sa iya nga maghampang sa guwa sang pungsod.
english: After leading Gilas Pilipinas against Hong Kong and Chinese Taipei in the first window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers, Justin Brownlee will first attend to offers to play abroad.

text: Suno kay Gilas Coach Tim Cone nga amo man ang coach ni Brownlee sa Barangay Ginebra, gina-check na subong sang 35-anyos nga naturalized import ang mga offer sa iya sang overseas nga mga liga apang wala man ini sang kaso bangud All-Filipino ang mga sambuwa sa idalom sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) nga magasugod subong nga semana.
english: According to Gilas Coach Tim Cone, who is also Brownlee's coach in Barangay Ginebra, the 35-year-old naturalized import is now checking the offers to him from overseas leagues but it does not matter because the All-Filipino matches under the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) that start this week.

text: Sa bahin sang Gilas Pilipinas, malawig man ang pahuway bangud sa Hunyo pa ang masunod nga hampang bilang preparasyon sa Paris Olympic Qualifying Tournament batok sa Latvia kag Georgia.
english: For the Gilas Pilipinas, the break is also long as the next match is in June in preparation for the Paris Olympic Qualifying Tournament against Latvia and Georgia.

text: “There are offers for him to go play overseas since it is All-Filipino.
english: “There are offers for him to go play overseas since it is All-Filipino.

text: We’re perfectly fine with that.
english: We’re perfectly fine with that.

text: We’re all for him going out, and staying in shape.
english: We’re all for him going out, and staying in shape.

text: He’s already locked in for us next season so we’ll see him here,” pahayag ni Cone.
english: He’s already locked in for us next season so we’ll see him here,” stated Cone.

text: Matandaan nga ang hampang ni Brownlee batok sa Chinese Taipei sang Domingo, Pebrero 25, amo man ang una sini nga pagtapak sa home court sa sulod sang 10 ka bulan.
english: Brownlee's game against Chinese Taipei on Sunday, February 25, was also his first time on home court in 10 months.

text: Ini bangud wala man siya nakahampang para sa Barangay Ginebra sa PBA Commissioner’s Cup bangud gindagdagan ini sang suspensyon sang naglagbong ini sa doping test kasunod sang gold medal win sa Asian Games sang Oktubre 2023.
english: This is because he did not play for Barangay Ginebra in the PBA Commissioner's Cup because he was suspended when he failed a doping test following his gold medal win at the Asian Games in October 2023.

text: Naka-upod anay si Brownlee sa players sang Mexico, Italy, France, kag Lebanon antes ini nakasulod sa Ginebra sa PBA kag nagahampang na sa atubang sangPinoy fans sa sulod sang halos isa ka dekada.
english: Brownlee played with players from Mexico, Italy, France, and Lebanon before joining Geneva in the PBA and has been playing in front of Pinoy fans for nearly a decade.

text: Sampaw-sampaw na ang kadalag-an sang Filipino pride nga si Lea Salonga, apang may panibag-o pa gid nga nagdugang sa iya listahan: ang mangin isa ka producer sa Broadway!
english: Filipino pride Lea Salonga's success is overwhelming, but there's something new added to her list: becoming a producer on Broadway!

text: Ginpakigbahin ini sang legendary singer-actress kaupod sa screenshot sang Broadway playbill kun sa diin mabasa ang malip-ot nga introduction sa iya bilang “co-producer” sang musical show nga “Here Lies Love”.
english: The legendary singer-actress shared this with a screenshot of the Broadway playbill where you can read a brief introduction to her as the “co-producer” of the musical show “Here Lies Love”.

text: Ang Here Lies Love isa ka disco-pop musical nga base sa concept music album ni David Byrne kag inspired sa iya research sa kabuhi ni former first lady Imelda Marcos, ang ginbansagan nga “Iron Butterfly”.
english: Here Lies Love is a disco-pop musical based on David Byrne’s concept music album and inspired by his research into the life of former first lady Imelda Marcos, the nicknamed “Iron Butterfly”.

text: Magluwas nga co-producer, maga-perform man si Lea sa play bilang si Aurora Aquino, ang iloy ni former Senator Ninoy Aquino.
english: Besides being a co-producer, Lea will also perform in the play as Aurora Aquino, the mother of former Senator Ninoy Aquino.

text: Bilang isa ka Filipina artist, espesyal para sa Tony winner ang iya nga partisipasyon sa musical bangud masaksihan ini sang audiences sa entablado kun sa diin natabo man ang iya Broadway debut bilang si Kim sa “Miss Saigon” sang 1991.
english: As a Filipina artist, her participation in the musical is special for the Tony winner because the audience will witness it on stage where she also made her Broadway debut as Kim in “Miss Saigon” in 1991.

text: Balantayan sa sini nga Broadway production ang all-Filipino cast kun sa diin featured man sanday Arielle Jacobs bilang si Imelda Marcos, si Jose Llana bilang Ferdinand Marcos Sr., kag si Conrad Ricamora bilang si Ninoy Aquino.
english: Balantayan sa sini nga Broadway production ang all-Filipino cast kun sa diin featured man sanday Arielle Jacobs bilang si Imelda Marcos, si Jose Llana bilang Ferdinand Marcos Sr., kag si Conrad Ricamora bilang si Ninoy Aquino.

text: Yara man ang Grammy-winning musician nga si H.E.R. bilang kabahin sang producing team.
english: Yara man ang Grammy-winning musician nga si H.E.R. as part of the producing team.

text: Nag-umpisa ang previews sang play sang Hunyo 17 kag sa Hulyo 20 naman ang official opening schedule.
english: Previews of the play began on June 17 and the official opening schedule is on July 20.

text: Ginsulit lang sang Chairman sang Committee on Market and Slaughterhouse sa Iloilo City Council ang rason sang Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) kun ngaa gin-demolish ang pila sa mga stall sa Iloilo Terminal Market ukon Super antes pa man ang opening sang bag-o nga merkado.
english: The Chairman of the Committee on Market and Slaughterhouse in the Iloilo City Council reiterated the reason of the Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) why some of the stalls in the Iloilo Terminal Market or Super were demolished before the opening of the new market.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Mandrie Malabor, iya ginpahayag nga santo sa iya nahibaluan sa LEEO, may areas nga gin-demolish bangud kinahanglan para sa “finishing” sang Super.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Mandrie Malabor said that as far as he knows in the LEEO, there are areas that were demolished because they were needed for the finishing of the Super.

text: Suno kay Malabor, nagpasalig man ang talatalapan nga may temporaryo nga sayluhan ang vendors nga nagatinir sa gin-demolish nga stalls.
english: Malabor said the office also assured that the vendors who were staying in the demolished stalls will be temporarily relocated.

text: “From what I gathered sa aton nga LEEO Department Head, may mga areas nga gin-demolish kay kinahanglanon bala.
english: “From what I gathered from our LEEO Department Head, there are areas that were demolished because it was necessary.

text: Pero not all.
english: But not all.

text: Ang gin-demolish necessary para sa finishing sang aton nga Terminal Market.
english: The demolition is necessary for the finishing of our Terminal Market.

text: And from what I heard sa aton nga Department Head, may sayluhan temporarily ang gin-remove [nga vendors], kay ang iban nga stalls, from what I heard, indi man siya actively naga-operate,” pahayag sang konsehal.
english: And from what I heard from our Department Head, the removed [vendors] will be relocated temporarily, because the other stalls, from what I heard, he is not actively operating,” the councilor said.

text: Ginklaro man ni Malabor nga ang iya komitiba sa City Council ang nakatutok lamang sa pagpasar sang mga ordinansa nga naangot sa mga mercado.
english: Malabor also clarified that his committee in the City Council is only focused on passing ordinances related to markets.

text: Suno sa iya, may separado naman nga market committee nga ginapangunahan sang local chief executive nga amo ang naga-deliberate kag naga-sentro sa implementasyon sang ordinansa.
english: He said there is a separate market committee headed by the local chief executive that deliberates and focuses on the implementation of the ordinance.

text: Matandaan nga kun basehan ang mga vendors, wala sang klaro nga direktiba halin sa lokal nga gobyerno kon sa diin sila makapadayon sang ila palangabuhian.
english: It can be recalled that based on the vendors, there is no clear directive from the local government on where they can continue their livelihood.

text: Ila man ginbalikan ang pasalig sang LEEO nga Oktubre 20 ang target nga petsa sang demolisyon apang antes sini nga petsa, ginakuhaan na sila sang kuryente kag ginapahalin.
english: They also reiterated the LEEO's assurance that October 20 is the target date for demolition but before this date, they are being cut off from electricity and evicted.

text: Sa bahin ni Malabor, ginplastar sini nga mahingagaw-bukas sa Oktubre 30 ang bag-o lang gin-develop nga Iloilo Central Market kag Iloilo Terminal Market santo man sa schedule nga gin-anunsyo sang Iloilo City Government.#
english: For his part, Malabor said the newly developed Iloilo Central Market and Iloilo Terminal Market will be opened on October 30 according to the schedule announced by the Iloilo City Government.

text: Ibinunyag ni Senadora Imee Marcos na posibleng bumaligtad ang ilang testigo sa nagpapatuloy na imbestigasyon ng Senate Blue Ribbon Committee kaugnay ng umano’y korapsyon sa mga flood control project ng pamahalaan.
english: Senator Imee Marcos revealed that some witnesses may have reversed the ongoing investigation of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee into alleged corruption in the government's flood control projects.

text: Ayon kay Marcos, may mga ulat na ilang testigo ang nakararanas ng pananakot at matinding pressure upang bawiin ang kanilang naunang mga pahayag.
english: According to Marcos, there are reports that some witnesses are experiencing intimidation and intense pressure to recant their previous statements.

text: Bagaman hindi siya nagbanggit ng mga pangalan, tinukoy ng senadora na kabilang dito si dating Philippine Marines Technical Sergeant Orly Regala Guteza, na aniya ay may “pinakamabigat na testimonya” laban sa mga sangkot sa isyu.
english: Although she did not mention names, the senator pointed out that among them is former Philippine Marines Technical Sergeant Orly Regala Guteza, who she said has the “heaviest testimony” against those involved in the issue.

text: Si Guteza ay unang ipinakilala bilang “surprise witness” ni Senador Rodante Marcoleta.
english: Guteza was first introduced as a “surprise witness” by Senator Rodante Marcoleta.

text: Sa kanyang naunang salaysay, sinabi niyang nagsilbi siyang Marine at security consultant ni dating Congressman Elizaldy Co.
english: In his previous account, he said he served as a Marine and security consultant to former Congressman Elizaldy Co.

text: Ikinuwento rin umano ni Guteza na nagdala siya ng mga maleta ng pera—na tinawag niyang “basura”, patungo sa mga bahay nina Co at dating House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Guteza also allegedly brought suitcases of money—which he called “garbage”, to the homes of Co and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Mariin namang itinanggi ni Romualdez ang paratang.
english: Romualdez denied the allegation.

text: Dagdag pa ni Marcos, may mga testigo rin umanong pinipigilan na makadalo o makapagsalita sa mga pagdinig ng komite.
english: Marcos added that there are also witnesses who are allegedly prevented from attending or speaking at the committee's hearings.

text: Giit ng senadora, may mga taong “todo-todo” ang pananakot upang hindi lumabas ang katotohanan.
english: The senator said there are people who “todo-todo” the threat so that the truth does not come out.

text: Tumanggi si Marcos na tukuyin kung sino ang nasa likod ng umano’y intimidasyon, ngunit tiniyak niyang sa huli ay mabubunyag din ang katotohanan.
english: Marcos declined to identify who was behind the alleged intimidation, but assured that the truth would eventually be revealed.

text: Samantala, nabanggit din ng senadora na may impormasyon siyang ang kanyang pinsan na si dating House Speaker Martin Romualdez ang inaasahang “star witness” sa susunod na pagdinig.
english: Meanwhile, the senator also mentioned that she has information that her cousin, former House Speaker Martin Romualdez, is the expected “star witness” in the next hearing.

text: Gayunman, hindi pa tiyak ni Marcos kung dadalo ito sa imbestigasyon sa Biyernes.
english: However, Marcos is not sure if he will attend the investigation on Friday.

text: Nag-manifest si Iloilo City Councilor Nene Dela Llana nga importante ang paglantaw sa “interes sang publiko” kag “mga ebidensya” kun bukaron man kag isapubliko ang mga “sikreto” sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Nene Dela Llana manifested that it is important to look at the “public interest” and “evidence” when it comes to revealing and making public the “secrets” of Iloilo City.

text: Kaangot ini sa privilege speech sang nagligad nga Oktubre 15 nga gin-deliver ni Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog sa session sang konseho.
english: This is in connection with the privilege speech last October 15 delivered by Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog during the council session.

text: Sa amo nga speech nga may tig-ulo “No Secrets in Iloilo City”, ginpabutyag ni Mabilog ang freedom of information sa pag-sabat sa mga pamangkot nga naangot sa mga proyekto sa syudad — kaangay sang flood control, pagpa-atop sa overpass sa Diversion Road sa Mandurriao, kag waiting shed sa Katilingban sa Molo nga nagalab-ot sa halos P800,000 ang balor.
english: In the speech entitled “No Secrets in Iloilo City”, Mabilog expressed the freedom of information in answering questions related to projects in the city — such as flood control, roofing of the overpass on Diversion Road in Mandurriao, and waiting shed in Katilingban in Molo worth almost P000,000.

text: Sa manipestasyon ni Dela Llana, ginklaro sini nga suportado niya ang panawagan sa transparency sa syudad.
english: In his manifesto, Dela Llana made it clear that he supports the call for transparency in the city.

text: Apang dugang niya, indi lang simple nga pagbulgar ang tinaga nga “transparency” kundi dapat nga tun-an, kag dapat nga nahangpan ang impormasyon kag kun paano ini gina-manage.
english: But he added that the word “transparency” is not just a simple disclosure but should be studied, and information should be understood and how it is managed.

text: “I know a lot of secrets here in Iloilo City.
english: “I know a lot of secrets here in Iloilo City.

text: Pero ginabutang ko gid pirme sa ulo ko: ang sikreto nga ina bala, may ebidensya ka?
english: But I always put it in my head: is that secret, do you have evidence?

text: Ang sikreto na bala, is it of national interest?,” pahayag sini.
english: The secret is, is it of national interest?,” he said.

text: “May secret ko nga nabal-an nga may isa ka public official, may bata pero wala tatay.
english: “I know a secret that there is a public official, who has a child but no father.

text: Pero wala kita labot da, because as long as indi concubinage or wala sang kaso, indi na ya of public interest.
english: But we don't care, because as long as it's not concubinage or there's no case, it's not in the public interest.

text: Wala kita da labot because indi na ya public interest,” suno pa sa konsehal.
english: We have nothing to do with it because it is not in the public interest,” the councilor said.

text: Suno kay Dela Llana, madamo sang sikreto sa syudad, apang kinahanglan nga sala-on kag lantawon man kun may interes bala diri ang publiko ukon ang mga Ilonggo.
english: According to Dela Llana, there are many secrets in the city, but it is necessary to filter and see if there is an interest in the public or the Ilonggos.

text: “We must try to understand nga ang sikreto, although ibunyag ta, importante na bala nga dapat ibunyag?
english: “We must try to understand that the secret, although we baptize, is it important to baptize?

text: Is it of national interest?,” suno sa iya.
english: Is it of national interest?,” he said.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong nga semana, ginpasar man sang Iloilo City Council sa una nga pagbasa ang proposed Freedom of Information (FOI) Ordinance.
english: This week, the Iloilo City Council also passed on first reading the proposed Freedom of Information (FOI) Ordinance.

text: Isa ini ka landmark measure agud nga mangin bukas ang records sang Iloilo City Hall para mapisa-pisa man sang publiko kaangay sang government documents, kontrata kag spending records.#
english: This is a landmark measure to make the records of Iloilo City Hall open to the public such as government documents, contracts and spending records.

text: Nagpasalig ang Global tech giant nga Google nga buligan sini ang micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) sa Pilipinas para sa ila nga presensya online kag agud nga mas maka-konekta sila sa iban nga mga negosyo.
english: Global tech giant Google has pledged to help micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in the Philippines for their online presence and to better connect with other businesses.

text: Ginpasalig man ang training sa masobra 100,000 ka kabataan kag ila ginikanan kaangot sa responsable nga paggamit sang teknolohiya.
english: Training was also promised to more than 100,000 children and their parents on the responsible use of technology.

text: Kadungan ini sang meeting ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: This coincides with the meeting of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: kay Google global vice president Karan Bhatia kun sa diin iya ginpahayag nga magapadayon sila sa pagbulig sa mga magagmay nga negosyo sa digital landscape paagi sa partnership sa Department of Trade and Industry (DTI).
english: to Google global vice president Karan Bhatia where he said they will continue to help small businesses in the digital landscape through a partnership with the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI).

text: Una na nga ginpaguwa sang kumpaniya ang Google Career Certificates (GCC) sa virtual campuses sang DTI kun sa diin covered ang 1,300 ka Negosyo Centers sa 16 ka mga rehiyon sa Pilipinas.
english: The company has already released the Google Career Certificates (GCC) in the virtual campuses of the DTI where 1,300 Business Centers in 16 regions in the Philippines are covered.

text: Nakahatag man ini sang 40,000 ka GCC scholarships sa mga kabataan nga Pinoy, mga nagapangita sang trabaho, magagmay nga entrepreneurs, kag civil servants kaangay sa project management, cybersecurity, IT support, data analytics, UX design, kag digital marketing.
english: It has also awarded 40,000 GCC scholarships to Filipino children, job seekers, small entrepreneurs, and civil servants in project management, cybersecurity, IT support, data analytics, UX design, and digital marketing.

text: Plano man sang kumpaniya suno kay Bhatia nga pasangkaron pa ang ila nga operasyon sang negosyo sa Pilipinas halin sa 50,000 ka mga empleyado sa pungsod halin sang nagsugod ini sang 2013.
english: Bhatia said the company also plans to expand its business operations in the Philippines from 50,000 employees in the country since it started in 2013.

text: Ini nga meeting ni Marcos kag Bhatia ang kadungan sang Trilateral Leaders Summit sa Amerika kaupod kay US President Joe Biden kag Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.#
english: The meeting between Marcos and Bhatia coincides with the Trilateral Leaders Summit in the United States with US President Joe Biden and Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida.

text: POLAND – May nagkalain-lain nga tradisyon nga ginahimo sa tion sang Palm Sunday sa Poland.
english: POLAND – There are various traditions practiced during Palm Sunday in Poland.

text: Suno kay Bombo Neva Kessler, international correspondent sa Poland, ang Palm Sunday sa ila pungsod ang ginatawag nga Niedziela Palmowa, sa diin ini ang isa ka importante nga bahin sang Semana Santa.
english: According to Bombo Neva Kessler, international correspondent in Poland, Palm Sunday in their country is called Niedziela Palmowa, where it is an important part of Holy Week.

text: Ginasaulog ini bilang pagdumdom sa pagsulod ni Hesus sa Jerusalem, sa diin ginsugata ini sang mga tawo nga may dala nga lukay.
english: It is celebrated to commemorate Jesus' entry into Jerusalem, where he was greeted by people carrying palm branches.

text: Sa baylo nga matuod nga dahon sang palma, nagahimo sang mga tao sa nasambit nga pungsod sang colorful nga lukay halin sa laya nga tanom, bulak, sanga sang willow, kag mga ribbons.
english: Instead of real palm leaves, people in the country make colorful lukay from dried plants, flowers, willow branches, and ribbons.

text: May mga kumpetisyon man sa iban nga rehiyon sa diin may mga lukay nga nagadangat sa tubtob 10 meters ang kataason.
english: There are also competitions in other regions where there are lukay that reach up to 10 meters in height.

text: Ginadala naman sang mga tawo ang ila lukay sa simbahan sa diin ginabendisyunan ini sang pari.
english: People bring their lukay to the church where the priest blesses it.

text: Matapos ang misa, ginabutang ini sa balay sa pagpati nga taming ini sa kalainan ukon malas.
english: After the mass, it is placed in the house in the belief that it is a shield against evil or bad luck.

text: Nagwangal ang pila sa mga manugbaligya sa Iloilo Terminal Market ukon sa Super nga mapatay na sila sa gutom antes pa man ang pagbukas sang newly-developed nga merkado sa Oktubre 30.
english: Some of the vendors at the Iloilo Terminal Market or the Super complained that they would starve to death even before the opening of the newly-developed market on October 30.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jun nga may yara sang kapehan sa temporary stall sa amo nga market, iya ginpahayag nga wala sila sang sayluhan kag pat-od nga ma-penitensya sila kasunod sang pag-demolish sa ila pwesto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jun, who owns a coffee shop in a temporary stall in the market, said they have no place to move and will surely be punished following the demolition of their position.

text: Suno sa iya, wala gid sila sang mangin income tubtub nga indi sila makaplastar sa bag-o nga merkado.
english: He said they will have no income until they can establish themselves in the new market.

text: Pahayag sini, wala man lang sila napahibalo sang maayo antes ang demolisyon.
english: He said they were not even informed before the demolition.

text: “Mapatay kami anay guro antes kami butangan sang pwesto,” suno kay Jun.
english: “We will probably die before we are appointed,” Jun said.

text: “Tan-awa bala sitwasyon namon hu.
english: “Look at our situation.

text: Mapenitensya gid guro kami ni anay,” pahayag pa sini.
english: I think we will be very sorry,” he said.

text: Ginsugid man sini nga indi kuntani magnubo sa P600 ang iya income sa kada adlaw kag amo lang ini ang iya palangabuhian.
english: He also said that his income should not be less than P600 per day and this is his only livelihood.

text: Ang demolisyon sang mga stalls nagsugod sang Oktubre 14 kun sa diin ginpang-kakas ang mga atop kag istruktura agud mapreparar ang lugar para sa pagbukas sang merkado.
english: The demolition of the stalls began on October 14 with the removal of roofs and structures to prepare the area for the opening of the market.

text: Una na nga gin-anunsyo sang Iloilo City Government nga patigayunon sa Oktubre 30 ang opening sa gin-develop nga Terminal Market kag Central Market.#
english: Earlier, the Iloilo City Government announced that the opening of the developed Terminal Market and Central Market will be held on October

text: Wala sang kaluoy nga gintambakan sang Gilas Pilipinas sang 53 ka puntos nga abanse ang pangayaw nga Chinese Taipei sa ikaduha nga hampang sa first window sang FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers.
english: Gilas Pilipinas mercilessly piled up a 53-point lead over Chinese Taipei in the second game of the first window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers.

text: Ginhimo sang Gilas ang 106-53 nga kadalag-an sa atubang sang linibo ka Pinoy basketball fans sa PhilSports Arena kagab-i, Pebrero 25.
english: The Gilas scored a 106-53 victory in front of thousands of Filipino basketball fans at the PhilSports Arena last night, February 25.

text:
Ini ang labing-una nga hampang ni Justin Brownlee sa pungsod sa sulod sang 10 ka bulan rason nga wala gid sini ginpaslaw ang fans paagi sa iya 26 puntos, 13 ka rebounds, lima ka assists, duha ka blocks, kag isa ka steal nga amo ang nagpanguna sa national team nga makuha ang 2-0 record sa Group B.

Ginpakita ni Brownlee ang kahidlaw sini sa hampang paagi sa pagbubo sang 11 puntos sa imbukada nga quarter kun sa diin ginhapo na ang kasumpong nga malagas ang double-digit lead, 26-13, sa pagtapos sang una nga frame.
english:
This was Justin Brownlee's first game in the country in 10 months, so he did not disappoint the fans with his 26 points, 13 rebounds, five assists, two blocks, and one steal to lead the national team to a 2-0 record in Group B.

Brownlee showed his longing for the game by pouring in 11 points in the opening quarter where the opponent was tired of chasing a double-digit lead, 26-13, at the end of the first frame.

text: Halin didto, wala sang bulu-balikid ang Gilas tubtub sa fourth quarter.
english: From there, the Gilas didn't look back until the fourth quarter.

text: Kaangay sa hampang batok sa Hong Kong, nagpangaduha si Kai Sotto kay Brownlee sa puntos kun sa diin nakapaulan ini sang 18 puntos, 10 ka rebounds, lima ka assists, kag tatlo ka blocks.
english: As in the game against Hong Kong, Kai Sotto finished second to Brownlee in points with 18 points, 10 rebounds, five assists, and three blocks.

text: Magluwas sa duha ka players, double-digit man ang na-skor nanday Calvin Oftana, Carl Tamayo, kag Kevin Quiambao.
english: In addition to the two players, Calvin Oftana, Carl Tamayo, and Kevin Quiambao also scored double-digits.

text:
Pareho sa Gilas, wala man sang kalutusan ang New Zealand sa una nga window sang Group B.

Balantayan ang masunod nga window sang qualifiers sa bulan sang Nobyembre.#

The Scores:

Philippines 106 – Brownlee 26, Sotto 18, Oftana 13, Ramos 12, Tamayo 11, Quiambao 10, Aguilar 8, Perez 4, Newsome 2, Thompson 2.
english:
Like the Gilas, New Zealand were unbeaten in the first window of Group B.

Stay tuned for the next window of qualifiers in November.

The Scores:

Philippines 106 – Brownlee 26, Sotto 18, Oftana 13, Ramos 12, Tamayo 11, Quiambao 10, Aguilar 8, Perez 4, Newsome 2, Thompson 2.

text: Chinese Taipei 53 – Liu 13, S. Lin 8, Z. Hsieh 6, Wang 6, Chang 4, B. Lin 3, C.C. Lin 3, Chen 2,C. Lin 2, Gao 2, Yu 2, Y. Hsieh 2.
english: Chinese Taipei 53 – Liu 13, S. Lin 8, Z. Hsieh 6, Wang 6, Chang 4, B. Lin 3, C.C. Lin 3, Chen 2,C. Lin 2 , Gao 2 , Yu 2 , Y. Hsieh 2 .

text: Ginbulgar ni Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky nga indi lang North Korean soldiers ang nagabulig sa Russia sa gyera sa Ukraine kundi pati mga Chinese nationals.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has revealed that not only North Korean soldiers are helping Russia in the war in Ukraine but also Chinese nationals.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang Ukrainian leader kadungan sang pagtilipon sang mga hepe sang military sa Brussels, Belgium.
english: The Ukrainian leader made the remarks during a meeting of military chiefs in Brussels, Belgium.

text: Suno kay Zelensky, nakabaton siya sang impormasyon nga ginatos ka mga Chinese ang yara sa patag-awayan bilang parte sang occupation forces sang Russia.
english: Zelensky said he had received information that hundreds of Chinese were on the battlefield as part of Russia’s occupation forces.

text: Dugang niya, nagakahulugan ini nga tuyo gid sang Moscow nga palawigon pa ang gyera nga subong tatlo na ka tuig.
english: He added that this means that Moscow intends to prolong the war, which is now three years old.

text: “As of now, we have information that at least several hundred Chinese nationals are fighting as part of Russia’s occupation forces,” suno sa Ukrainian leader.
english: “As of now, we have information that at least several hundred Chinese nationals are fighting as part of Russia’s occupation forces,” according to the Ukrainian leader.

text:
“This means Russia is clearly trying to prolong the war — even by using Chinese lives.”

Antes sini nga pahayag, may nauna na nga statement ang Kyiv nga may nadakpan sila nga duha ka Chinese nationals sa eastern Donetsk region nga nagapakig-away para sa Russia.
english:
“This means Russia is clearly trying to prolong the war — even by using Chinese lives.”

Prior to this statement, Kyiv had previously stated that it had captured two Chinese nationals in the eastern Donetsk region who were fighting for Russia.

text: Ini nga statement ang nagbukad sang alegasyon ni Zelensky nga gina-upod naman sang Moscow ang Beijing sa gyera.
english: This statement sparked Zelensky's allegation that Moscow is joining Beijing in the war.

text: Ginpanginwala naman sang Kremlin ini nga alegasyon, kag nagpaandam naman ang China batok sa mga partido nga nagahimo suno sa ila sang iresponsable nga mga pahayag.
english: The Kremlin has denied the allegation, and China has warned against parties making what it says are irresponsible statements.

text: Kaangot diri, liwat man nga nagpanawagan si Zelensky sang dugang nga air defense systems matapos ang insidente sang nagligad nga semana sa iya hometown sa Kryvyi Rig kun sa diin may ginpalupad nga Russian ballistic missile nga nagpatay sang 19 ka mga tawo lakip na ang siyam ka kabataan.
english: In this regard, Zelensky once again called for more air defense systems after last week's incident in his hometown of Kryvyi Rig where a Russian ballistic missile was launched that killed 19 people including nine children.

text: Antes naglutaw ang gina-alegar partisipasyon sang Chinese nationals, nauna na gin-claim sang South Korean military nga nagdugang pa gid ang North Korea sang 3,000 ka mga soldado agud magbulig sa Russia.
english: Before the alleged participation of Chinese nationals surfaced, the South Korean military had previously claimed that North Korea had added 3,000 more troops to help Russia.

text: Magluwas pa ina sa 11,000 ka mga tropa nga nauna na ginpadala sang Pyongyang suno sa South Korea Joint Chiefs of Staff kun sa diin 4,000 na ang gin-alegar nga napatay kag nasamaran sa tunga sang gyera.
english: That's in addition to the 11,000 troops previously sent by Pyongyang, according to the South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff, where 4,000 have been allegedly killed and wounded in the midst of the war.

text: ILOILO CITY–Wala sang may nabaton ang kampo ni Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III nga kopya sang compormised deal ni Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava tuhoy sa wala pa sa gihapon maswelduhan nga mga job hire sang Iloilo City Government.
english: ILOILO CITY – The camp of Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III has not received a copy of the compromised deal of Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava regarding the unpaid job hires of the Iloilo City Government.

text: Ini matapos ang ginpatigayon nga legislative inquiry kun sa diin ginduso ni Nava kay Iloilo City Treasurer Jinny Hermano nga hatagan sang sweldo ang mga job hire kabaylo sang pagduso kay Espinosa nga ibalik ang pangalan sang City Treasurer kag sang City Budget Officer nga magapirma sa job order.
english: This follows the legislative inquiry where Nava proposed to Iloilo City Treasurer Jinny Hermano to pay the job hires in exchange for proposing to Espinosa to return the names of the City Treasurer and the City Budget Officer who will sign the job order.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Adminstrator Atty. Hernando Galvez, iya gainpahayag nga wala pa siya ukon si Mayor Espinosa sang

may nabaton nga kopya sang nasambit nga compromised deal gikan kay Nava nga chairman sang Committee on Appropriations.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Iloilo City Administrator Atty. Hernando Galvez, he said that neither he nor Mayor Espinosa has

received a copy of the said compromised deal from Nava who is chairman of the Committee on Appropriations.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno kay Galvez, wala sang legal nga basehan ang ginaduso nga Nava magluwas lang kun may yara sang bag-o nga addendum nga ginpaguwa.
english: In fact, Galvez said, there is no legal basis for the proposed Nava unless there is a new addendum issued.

text: Magluwas diri, ginpahayag ni Atty. Galvez nga indi niya luyag nga pangunahan ang alkalde sa pagdesisyon.
english: Besides, Atty. Galvez said he did not want to lead the mayor in making the decision.

text: Kadungan sini, ginpahayag man sang City Administrator nga wala sang tinaga nga ‘excess job hire’ bangud nga indi matuod nga nagasobra ang job hire sa City Government.
english: Meanwhile, the City Administrator also said that there is no word 'excess job hire' because it is not true that the job hire in the City Government is excessive.

text: Ginakabig ni Galvez nga ang pagpalapta nga nagasulubra ang job hire sang City Government ang makabig nga pagpangsabotahe lamang.
english: Galvez considers the rumor that the City Government's job hire is excessive to be considered sabotage.

text: Nagnubo sa 1.8-million ang numero sang mga Pinoy nga wala sang trabaho sang Pebrero halin sa 2.15-million nga na-rekord sang Enero.
english: The number of unemployed Filipinos fell to 1.8-million in February from 2.15-million recorded in January.

text: Suno sa pinakaulihi nga report sang Philippine Statistics Authority, katumbas ini sang unemployment rate nga 3.5 percent nga mas manubo ipaanggid sa 4.5 percent nga napagkit sa pungsod sang Enero subong nga tuig.
english: According to the latest report of the Philippine Statistics Authority, this is equivalent to an unemployment rate of 3.5 percent which is lower compared to the 4.5 percent recorded in the country in January this year.

text: Sa amo man nga report, nakabutang nga 6.08-million ka mga Pinoy ang underemployed sang Pebrero nga mas manubo sa 6.39 million sang una nga bulan.
english: The same report said 6.08-million Filipinos were underemployed in February, down from 6.39 million in the first month.

text: Kun ibutang sa porsyento, 12.4 percent ang underemployment rate sa Pebrero halin sa 13.9 percent sang Enero.
english: In percentage terms, the underemployment rate was 12.4 percent in February from 13.9 percent in January.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang National Economic and Development Authority nga mas ginapabaskog pa sang Marcos administration ang mga lihok agud nga mataytayan ang industriya, academe, kag public sector agud nga mabuhin-buhinan ang problema sa skill mismatches sa labor market.
english: Earlier, the National Economic and Development Authority said the Marcos administration is intensifying efforts to bridge industry, academe, and the public sector to reduce the problem of skill mismatches in the labor market.

text: (Photo Courtesy: IBON Foundation)
english: (Photo Courtesy: IBON Foundation)

text: Gintuad sang Tubungan Municipal Police Station nga antes pa man nila madakpan ang suspek nga si Aljohn Jalbuna nga nagpatay sa dalaga sa Ingay, Tubungan, madamo na sila sang nakuha nga impormasyon tuhoy diri base sa iya nga background.
english: The Tubungan Municipal Police Station admitted that even before they arrested the suspect, Aljohn Jalbuna, who killed the girl in Ingay, Tubungan, they had already obtained a lot of information about him based on his background.

text: Si Jalbuna amo ang nag-ako nga nagpatay sa 18-anyos nga si alyas Jeje, isa ka incoming first year college student.
english: Jalbuna confessed to killing 18-year-old alias Jeje, an incoming first year college student.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Neil Eric Goniabo, deputy commander sang Tubungan PNP, iya ginpahayag nga matapos sila nagtukod sang special team para magtutok sa kaso, na-validate nila nga kilala ang suspek nga nagapangsaka sang mga balay kag may record sang pagpangawat.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Neil Eric Goniabo, deputy commander of Tubungan PNP, said that after they formed a special team to focus on the case, they validated that the suspect was known to be robbing houses and had a record of theft.

text: Suno kay Goniabo, diri pa gid nagbakod ang ila pagduda sa suspek kag ginpadulungan nila ang puluy-an sini kag naabtan nila ini didto kag nakit-an ang mga pilas sa liog ni Jalbuna.
english: According to Goniabo, their suspicion of the suspect grew stronger and they went to his house and found him there and found wounds on Jalbuna's neck.

text: Sang ila ini gin-istorya, didto na nag-ako ang suspek.
english: When they talked to him, the suspect confessed.

text: Pahayag ni Goniabo, apisar wala man sang ginaako ang suspek nga may mga upod ini sang ginhimo ang krimen, wala ginadula sang otoridad ini nga posibilidad.
english: Goniabo said that although the suspect did not admit that he had companions when he committed the crime, the authorities do not rule out this possibility.

text: Ini bangud ginapanindugan sang suspek nga wala niya ginhimuslan ang biktima nga baliskad naman sa resulta sang autopsy nga nagakumpirma nga may natabo nga sexual abuse sa dalaga.
english: This is because the suspect insists that he did not rape the victim which is contrary to the results of the autopsy that confirms that there was sexual abuse of the girl.

text: Maga-sambuwa na subong nga adlaw ang Pinoy boxer nga si Jerwin Ancajas kag ang Japanese World Boxing Association (WBA) bantamweight champion nga si Takuma Inoue.
english: Pinoy boxer Jerwin Ancajas and Japanese World Boxing Association (WBA) bantamweight champion Takuma Inoue will fight today.

text: Balantayan ang hampang sa Kokugigan Arena sa Japan, 5:00 karon sa hapon oras sa Pilipinas.
english: Watch the match at the Kokugigan Arena in Japan, 5:00 pm Philippine time.

text: Apisar mas malawig na ang eksperyensya sang 32-anyos nga si Ancajas ukon Pretty Boy sa sulod sang ring, ginakabig ini nga underdog batok sa 28-anyos nga si Takuma nga manghod sang Japanese undisputed super-bantamweight king nga si Naoya Inoue.
english: Although 32-year-old Ancajas or Pretty Boy has more experience inside the ring, he is considered the underdog against 28-year-old Takuma, the younger brother of Japanese undisputed super-bantamweight king Naoya Inoue.

text: Sa official weigh-in kahapon nga adlaw, pareho nga 117.75 pounds ang kabug-aton sang duha ka boksidor.
english: At the official weigh-in yesterday, both boxers weighed 117.75 pounds.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang anay Pinoy world champion nga luyag niya nga takson ang pasensya ni Takuma bangud nakit-an niya nga naga-agresibo gilayon ini sa away sa tion nga maigu sang inumol.
english: Earlier, the former Filipino world champion said he wanted to test Takuma's patience because he saw that he immediately became aggressive in the fight when he was hit by a knife.

text: Si Ancajas ang naga-uyat anay sang International Boxing Federation junior bantamweight crown halin sang 2016 tubtub sang 2022 antes ini nalutos sang duha ka beses sa kamot ni Fernando Martinez sang Argentina.
english: Ancajas previously held the International Boxing Federation junior bantamweight crown from 2016 to 2022 before losing twice to Fernando Martinez of Argentina.

text: Naga-uyat ini sang rekord nga 34-ka daog kun sa diin 23 ang knockouts, 3-ka kalutusan, kag 2-ka draw, samtang may 18 ka daog kag isa ka kalutusan si Takuma kun sa diin apat ang iya na-knockout.
english: He holds a record of 34 wins with 23 knockouts, 3 losses, and 2 draws, while Takuma has 18 wins and one loss with four knockouts.

text: Wala nagpromisa ang Pinoy boxer nga matumba sini ang Japanese fighter apang nagpasalig sini nga ibubo niya ang tanan agud nga indi na maglab-ot pa sa 12 ka rounds ang ila sambuwa sa atubang sang Japanese fans.
english: The Filipino boxer did not promise to knock out the Japanese fighter but assured that he will pour everything so that their fight will not reach more than 12 rounds in front of the Japanese fans.

text: Pananglitan magdaog si Ancajas, may world champion na liwat ang Pilipinas sa patag sang boksing.
english: If Ancajas wins, the Philippines will have another world champion in boxing.

text: Una nga na-schedule ang away sang duha sang Nobyembre 2023 apang na-postpone bangud sa injury ni Takuma sa training.#
english: The fight between the two was initially scheduled for November 2023 but was postponed due to Takuma’s training injury.#

text: Nag-update ang Holy See Press Office nga nagapadayon ang pag-improve sang health condition ni Pope Francis kag mas gamay na lang nga oxygenation ang ginagamit sini subong.
english: The Holy See Press Office updated that Pope Francis' health condition continues to improve and he is now using less oxygenation.

text: Nagaapayo ang Santo Papa sa iya ginapuy-an sa Vatican nga amo ang Casa Santa Marta matapos ang masobra isa ka bulan nga pagtinir sa ospital sa Roma bangud sa polymicrobial infection nga nag-resulta sa bilateral pneumonia.
english: The Pope is recovering at his Vatican residence, Casa Santa Marta, after spending more than a month in a hospital in Rome due to a polymicrobial infection that resulted in bilateral pneumonia.

text: Ginpaguwa si Pope sang Marso 23 apang gin-require ini sang medical team nga magpahuway sang duha ka bulan samtang yara sa Vatican.
english: Pope was released on March 23 but was required by the medical team to rest for two months while in the Vatican.

text: Suno pa sa Holy See, may gamay na nga respiratory, mobility, kag voice-related improvements, kag mayo man ang resulta sa blood tests sa 88-anyos nga Pope.
english: According to the Holy See, there have been minor respiratory, mobility, and voice-related improvements, and the results of blood tests on the 88-year-old Pope are also good.

text: Sa adlaw, makapalawig ini sa pagginhawa nga wala sang administered oxygen.
english: During the day, it can prolong breathing without administered oxygen.

text: Gin-athag man sang Press Office nga temprano pa subong agud diskusyunan kun ano ang mga partisipasyon sang Pope sa Holy Week liturgies.
english: The Press Office also clarified that it is too early to discuss what the Pope's participation in the Holy Week liturgies will be.

text: Ini nga latest update ang nagguwa kasunod sang pagbisita nanday British King Charles III kag Queen Camilla sa Casa Santa Marta.
english: This latest update follows the visit of British King Charles III and Queen Camilla to Casa Santa Marta.

text: Sorpresa man nga nagpakita ang Pope sa St.
english: The Pope also made a surprise appearance at St.

text: Peter’s Basilica nga nakasuksok sang itom nga pants sa baylo nga iya kinaandan nga tradisyonal nga papal attire.
english: Peter’s Basilica wearing black pants instead of his usual traditional papal attire.

text: Samtang sakay sa iya wheelchair kag nagatamyaw sa mga tumuluo sa Basilica, may nakabutang man sa pope nga striped blanket kag may gamay nga hose sa iya nga ilong.#
english: While riding in his wheelchair and greeting the faithful in the Basilica, the pope was also wearing a striped blanket and a small hose in his nose.

text: Gin-imbitar ni Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson ang 17 ka mga kongresista sa masunod nga hearing sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee kaangot sa flood control corruption scandal.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson invited 17 congressmen to the next hearing of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee on the flood control corruption scandal.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Lacson matapos naeleher liwat bilang chairman sang amo nga committee.
english: Lacson said this after being re-elected as chairman of the committee.

text: Pahayag sini, ini nga 17 amo ang ginpanglawag sang kontraktor nga sanday Curlee kag Sarah Discaya sa ila nga affidavit.
english: He said these 17 are the ones that contractors Curlee and Sarah Discaya were looking for in their affidavit.

text:
Kun balikan, ang gin-mensyonar sang mag-asawa nga Discaya sa ikatatlo nga hearing sa committee amo sanday:

Rep.
english:
Looking back, the Discaya couple mentioned in the third hearing to the committee are:

Rep.

english: Patrick Michael Vargas of Quezon CityRep.

english: Nicanor Briones of AGAP party-listRep.

english: Florida Robes of San Jose del Monte, BulacanRep.

english: Eleandro Jesus Madrona of RomblonRep.

english: Benjamin Agarao Jr.Rep.

english: Florencio Noel of An-waray party-listRep.

english: Reynante Arrogance of QuezonRep.

english: Antonieta Eudela of Zamboanga SibugayRep Dean Asistio of CaloocanRep.
