english:
Marivic Co-Pilar of Quezon City

Also invited were former speaker Leyte Rep.

text: Martin Romualdez, resigned Ako Bicol party-list congressman Zaldy Co kag Benguet Rep.
english: Martin Romualdez, resigned I am Bicol party-list congressman Zaldy Co and Benguet Rep.

text: Eric Yap nga lunsay gin-implicate sang former Marine and security consultant nga si Orly Guteza.
english: Eric Yap who were both implicated by former Marine and security consultant Orly Guteza.

text: Bangud yara sa luwas sang pungsod si Co, magatambong ini sa hearing paagi sa Zoom sa Philippine embassy ukon sa consulate.
english: Since Co is abroad, he will attend the hearing via Zoom at the Philippine embassy or consulate.

text: Patigayunon ang hearing sa Byernes, Nobyembre 14.
english: The hearing will be held on Friday, November 14.

text: Tatlo ka mga tawo ang napatay sa panibag-o nga pagtibusok sang eroplano nga natabo sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Three people were killed in a new plane crash in the United States of America.

text: Didto ini sa Boca Raton Airport sa Florida kun sa diin ang involved amo ang Cessna 310 aircraft nga pakadto kuntani sa Tallahassee International Airport sa amo man nga state.
english: It was at Boca Raton Airport in Florida where the Cessna 310 aircraft involved was bound for Tallahassee International Airport in the same state.

text: Nakit-an ang gamay nga eroplano nga nagtiyog-tiyog sa kahawaan antes nagbalik kuntani sa airport sa Boca Raton, apang nagsigabong, kag nag-crash.
english: The small plane was seen hovering in the air before returning to the airport in Boca Raton, but caught fire, and crashed.

text: Magluwas sa tatlo nga sakay nga napatay, may isa ka tawo sa idalom nga nasamaran man bangud sa insidente.
english: In addition to the three occupants killed, one person below was also injured as a result of the incident.

text: Padayon subong ang imbestigasyon sang National Transportation Safety Board kag sang Federal Aviation Administration, apang sa inisyal nga impormasyon, may yara sang natabo nga mechanical issues.
english: The investigation by the National Transportation Safety Board and the Federal Aviation Administration is ongoing, but initial information indicates that there were mechanical issues.

text: Sa statement matapos ang plane crash, nagpadala si Boca Raton Mayor Scott Singer sang mensahe sang simpatiya sa mga pamilya sang mga biktima, kag nagdayaw naman sa madasig nga pagresponde sang rescue teams.
english: In a statement after the plane crash, Boca Raton Mayor Scott Singer sent a message of sympathy to the families of the victims, and praised the quick response of the rescue teams.

text: “Our hearts are heavy today with this tragic loss of life.
english: “Our hearts are heavy today with this tragic loss of life.

text: Our thoughts and prayers go out to the families and all affected.
english: Our thoughts and prayers go out to the families and all affected.

text: As every day, we are grateful for the swift action of our Boca Raton Fire Rescue Department and Boca Raton Police Department,” suno kay Singer.
english: As every day, we are grateful for the swift action of our Boca Raton Fire Rescue Department and Boca Raton Police Department,” according to Singer.

text: “We are grateful for their continued work and our partnerships with other public safety agencies who have also responded.
english: “We are grateful for their continued work and our partnerships with other public safety agencies who have also responded.

text: Our community is caring, strong, and resilient, and we will be there to help all affected.”
english: Our community is caring, strong, and resilient, and we will be there to help all affected.”

text: Nagpang-pito sa listahan sang topnotchers ang isa ka produkto sang West Visayas State University (WVSU) La Paz sa ginpatigayon nga October 2025 Physicians Licensure Examination.
english: A product of West Visayas State University (WVSU) La Paz came seventh in the list of topnotchers in the October 2025 Physicians Licensure Examination.

text: Ini amo si Judah Elijah Manticahon Cagas nga may rating nga 89.08%.
english: This is Judah Elijah Manticahon Cagas with a rating of 89.08%.

text: Nakuha man sang College of Medicine sang nasambit nga unibersidad ang pang-lima nga pwesto sa Top 10 Performing Schools nga may 50-99 ka mga examinees.
english: The College of Medicine of the said university also took the fifth place in the Top 10 Performing Schools with 50-99 examinees.

text: Nalab-ot sang college ang overall passing rate nga 96.91% kun sa diin 94 sa 97 examinees ang nakapasar sa amo nga pasinawan.
english: The college achieved an overall passing rate of 96.91% with 94 out of 97 examinees passing the examination.

text: Sandig sa Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 4,570 sa 5,900 examinees ang kabug-usan nga nakapasar sa bilog nga Pilipinas sa ginpatigayon nga exam sang tinalikdan nga Oktubre 4, 5, 11 kag 12.
english: According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 4,570 out of 5,900 examinees passed the exam conducted on October 4, 5, 11 and 12.

text: Ginpasa na sa Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) ang nagalagaw subong nga lista sang mga government officials kag former generals nga amo ang ginaalegar yara sa likod sang destabilization plot batok kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) has submitted a circulating list of government officials and former generals allegedly behind the destabilization plot against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Suno kay Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, base sa militar, tun-an sang ila nga intelligence community ang amo nga alegasyon.
english: According to Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, based on the military, their intelligence community will study the allegation.

text: Matandaan nga ang columnist nga si Mon Tulfo ang nag-post sang listahan sa iya social media account.
english: Columnist Mon Tulfo posted the list on his social media account.

text: Gin-akusaran sini sanday Vice President Sara Duterte, Davao Rep.
english: He accused Vice President Sara Duterte, Davao Rep.

text: Paolo Duterte kag former Ilocos Sur Governor Chavit Singson nga amo ang naga-pondo sa destabilization plot.
english: Paolo Duterte and former Ilocos Sur Governor Chavit Singson who are funding the destabilization plot.

text: Lakip naman sa mga personalidad nga involved suno kay Tulfo sa reported destabilization amo sanday Atty. Ferdinand Topacio, former Executive Secretary Vic Rodriguez, Sen.
english: Among the personalities involved, Tulfo said, in the reported destabilization are Atty. Ferdinand Topacio, former Executive Secretary Vic Rodriguez, Sen.

text: Rodante Marcoleta, retired Gen.
english: Rodante Marcoleta, retired Gen.

text: Romeo Poquiz, kag Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong.
english: Romeo Poquiz, and Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong.

text: Indi magpanugid si Tulfo kun sa diin sini nakuha ang listahan.
english: Tulfo would not say where he got the list.

text: Una naman nagsabat si Magalong kag gintawag nga “wala sang basehan” ang pag-angot sa iya sa destabilization.
english: Magalong first responded and called the link to destabilization “unfounded”.

text: Sa bahin ni Vice President Duterte, gintawag sini nga tsismis ang mga impormasyon nga wala man sang mga ebidensya.
english: For his part, Vice President Duterte called the information without evidence rumors.

text: Indi ini ang una nga tion nga may mga huring-huring nga may destabilization plot batok sa administrasyon, apang nagapanindugan naman si Marcos nga mabakod ang iya liderato sa pihak sang mga istorya sang ginaalegar nga kudeta.
english: This is not the first time that there have been rumors of a destabilization plot against the administration, but Marcos insists that his leadership is strong despite talk of an alleged coup.

text: ILOILO CITY–‘Exempted’ sa election ban ang Pag-ulikid program ni Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III.
english: ILOILO CITY – Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III's Pag-ulikid program is 'exempt' from the election ban.

text: Ini ang panindugan ni Iloilo City Administrator Atty. Hernando Galvez tuhoy sa pahayag sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) nga mahimo may paglapas sa Omnibus Election Code ang pagpatigayon sang nasambit nga programa kun wala sang Certificate of Exemption ang  kampo sang alkalde.
english: This is the position of Iloilo City Administrator Atty. Hernando Galvez regarding the statement of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) that there may be a violation of the Omnibus Election Code in conducting the said program if the mayor's camp does not have a Certificate of Exemption.

text: Suno kay Atty. Galvez, ang Pag-ulikid program sang alkalde ang wala nalakip sa election ban.
english: According to Atty. Galvez, the mayor's Pag-ulikid program is not included in the election ban.

text: Ini bangud nga suno kay Galvez, may election man ukon wala, padayon ang pagpatigayon sang Pag-ulikid program sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: This is because, according to Galvez, whether there is an election or not, the Pag-ulikid program will continue in Iloilo City.

text: Sa pagpaathag naman ni COMELEC-6 Regional Director Atty. Jose Nick Mendros, ginadumili-an sa mga kandidato ukon political parties ang magpatigayon sang aktibidad nga mahimo malamuran sang pamulitika.
english: COMELEC-6 Regional Director Atty. Jose Nick Mendros, candidates or political parties are prohibited from conducting activities that may be politically motivated.

text: Mahimo lamang nga mapahanugutan sang COMELEC ang ka aktibidad kun may yara ini sang Certificate of Exemption.
english: The COMELEC can only allow the activity if it has a Certificate of Exemption.

text: Sa subong suno kay Mendros, indi pa sa gihapon matumod sang COMELEC en banc kun bala may yara sang Certificate of Exemption ang Pag-ulikid program ni Mayor Espinosa.
english: Mendros said the COMELEC en banc is still unable to determine whether Mayor Espinosa's Pag-ulikid program has a Certificate of Exemption.

text: Ginplastar ni Coach Tim Cone nga klaro ang gusto lab-uton sang Gilas Pilipinas kag ini amo ang pagtapak sa Olympiada.
english: Coach Tim Cone said that Gilas Pilipinas has a clear goal and that is to qualify for the Olympics.

text: Wala sang kasiguraduhan suno sa coach kun matabo ini sa Paris, France subong nga tuig ukon sa Los Angeles sa masunod nga edisyon, apang sa idalom sang iya pagpamuno, ang Olympics ang magapabilin nga ultimate goal sang team.
english: The coach said there is no certainty whether it will happen in Paris, France this year or in Los Angeles in the next edition, but under his leadership, the Olympics will remain the ultimate goal of the team.

text: “I’ve said it before, our goal, in my mind, is to make the Olympics.
english: “I’ve said it before, our goal, in my mind, is to make the Olympics.

text: I think that’s really our goal and whether it be Paris or whether it be LA in four years or five years, our goal is to make the Olympics,” suno sa coach.
english: I think that’s really our goal and whether it be Paris or whether it be LA in four years or five years, our goal is to make the Olympics,” said the coach.

text: Ang banas padulong sa sini nga handum ang maga-umpisa sa Huwebes kun atubangon na sang men’s basketball team sang Pilipinas ang Hong Kong sa una nga window sang 2025 FIBA Asia Cup qualifiers.
english: The path towards this dream begins on Thursday when the Philippine men’s basketball team faces Hong Kong in the first window of the 2025 FIBA ​​Asia Cup qualifiers.

text: Ini nga regional qualifiers ang kabahin sang apat ka tuig nga plano ni Cone para sa national team kun sa diin nalakip man ang pag-appoint sang iya permanente nga core team nga ginapangunahan sang naturalized import nga si Justin Brownlee.
english: These regional qualifiers are part of Cone's four-year plan for the national team which also includes the appointment of his permanent core team led by naturalized import Justin Brownlee.

text: Yara man sanday June Mar Fajardo, Scottie Thompson, Jamie Malonzo, Chris Newsome, CJ Perez, Calvin Oftana, Dwight Ramos, AJ Edu, Kai Sotto, Carl Tamayo, kag Kevin Quiambao.
english: Also in attendance were June Mar Fajardo, Scottie Thompson, Jamie Malonzo, Chris Newsome, CJ Perez, Calvin Oftana, Dwight Ramos, AJ Edu, Kai Sotto, Carl Tamayo, and Kevin Quiambao.

text: Sa imbukada sang kampanya sang Pilipinas sa sini nga hinampang, indi makapasakop sanday Fajardo kag Edu bangud sa ila gina-suprer nga injuries.
english: In the opening of the Philippines' campaign in this game, Fajardo and Edu will not be able to participate due to injuries they are suffering.

text: Ang Filipino-Cypriot nga si Edu ang nagakinahanglan pa sang isa ukon duha bulan matapos nga nakaangkon sang meniscus injury nga rason man kun ngaa nabangko ini sang Toyama Grouses sa Japanese B.League.
english: Filipino-Cypriot Edu still needs a month or two after suffering a meniscus injury that also led to him being benched by Toyama Grouses in the Japanese B.League.

text: Ang seven-time MVP naman sang PBA nga si Fajardo ang nakangkon man sang calf injury sa Game 4 sang Commissioner s Cup Finals.
english: Seven-time PBA MVP Fajardo also suffered a calf injury in Game 4 of the Commissioner's Cup Finals.

text: Bangud kulang na ang core team, ginpasulod si Japeth Aguilar nga amo ang maga-upod sa Hong Kong.
english: Due to the lack of core team, Japeth Aguilar was brought in to join Hong Kong.

text:
Sa sini nga regional qualifiers, nagtupa ang Gilas sa Group B kun sa diin makasumpong man sini ang New Zealand kag ang Chinese Taipei.#

Photo: REUTERS/Marko Djurica
english:
In these regional qualifiers, Gilas dropped into Group B where they will also face New Zealand and Chinese Taipei.

Photo: REUTERS/Marko Djurica

text: Magapadulong na sa Japan subong nga adlaw, Pebrero 18, ang Pinoy boxer nga si Jerwin Ancajas agud maghanda para sa sambuwa sini batok kay Japanese World Boxing Association (WBA) bantamweight champion Takuma Inoue sa Tokyo sa Pebrero 24.
english: Filipino boxer Jerwin Ancajas will leave for Japan today, February 18, to prepare for his fight against Japanese World Boxing Association (WBA) bantamweight champion Takuma Inoue in Tokyo on February 24.

text: Suno sa 32-anyos nga boksidor nga amo ang challenger sa sini nga hampang, nagalaum siya kag ang iya kampo nga indi na mag-ilis sang istilo si Takuma pag-abot sa hampang.
english: The 32-year-old boxer, who is the challenger in this match, said he and his camp hope that Takuma will not change his style when it comes to the match.

text: Pahayag pa sini, nakit-an niya nga indi malawig ang pasensya sang Japanese boxer pag-abot sa ring rason nga naga-agresibo gilayon sa tion nga maigu ini sang inumol.
english: He said he noticed that the Japanese boxer does not have much patience when he comes to the ring and becomes aggressive when he is hit by a punch.

text: Apisar nga underdog si Ancajas ukon si Pretty Boy sa sini nga sambuwa, nagalaum siya makuha ang titulo agud nga may world champion na liwat ang Pilipinas sa boksing.
english: Although Ancajas or Pretty Boy is an underdog in this fight, he hopes to win the title so that the Philippines will have a world champion in boxing again.

text: Si Ancajas ang naga-uyat anay sang International Boxing Federation (IBF) junior bantamweight crown halin sang 2016 tubtub sang 2022 antes ini nalutos sang duha ka beses sa kamot ni Fernando Martinez sang Argentina.
english: Ancajas previously held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) junior bantamweight crown from 2016 to 2022 before losing twice to Fernando Martinez of Argentina.

text: Si Takuma naman, 28, amo ang manghod sang Japanese undisputed super-bantamweight king nga si Naoya Inoue.
english: Takuma, 28, is the younger brother of Japanese undisputed super-bantamweight king Naoya Inoue.

text: May 18 ka daog kag isa ka kalutusan si Takuma kun sa diin apat ang iya na-knockout samtang mas eksperyensyado naman si Ancajas sa sulod sang ring nga may 34-3-2 rekord kun sa diin 23 ang na-knockout.
english: Takuma has 18 wins and one loss with four knockouts while Ancajas is more experienced inside the ring with a 34-3-2 record with 23 knockouts.

text: Una nga na-schedule ang away sang duha sang Nobyembre apang na-postpone bangud sa injury ni Takuma sa training.#
english: The fight between the two was originally scheduled for November but was postponed due to Takuma's training injury.#

text: ILOILO CITY–Gina amat-amat na sang kampo ni Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III nga ginatabunan ang laragway sang alkalde sa mga tarpaulin sa diin nakasaad ang campaign advocacy ni  Presidente Rodrigo Duterte tuhoy sa pagtapna sang illegal drugs, kriminalidad kag kurapsyon.
english: ILOILO CITY – The camp of Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III is gradually covering the mayor's picture with tarpaulins that feature President Rodrigo Duterte's campaign advocacy on the fight against illegal drugs, crime and corruption.

text: Sa nasambit nga tarpaulin, makita ang laragway nanday Espinosa kag Duterte nga naka ‘fist sign’ kag nakasaad ang mga tinaga nga: ‘Utos ni Presidente, Utos ni Mayor, No to illegal drugs, No to Criminality kag No to Corruption.
english: The tarpaulin features pictures of Espinosa and Duterte with fist signs and the words: 'President's Order, Mayor's Order, No to illegal drugs, No to Criminality and No to Corruption.

text: Ini matapos nga ginpadal-an sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) sang sulat si Mayor Espinosa bangud sa paglapas sa Omnibus Election Code.
english: This is after the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) sent a letter to Mayor Espinosa for violating the Omnibus Election Code.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jonathan Sayno, election officer 2 sang City COMELEC, iya ginpahayag nga wala man nagpamalabag si Mayor Espinosa sang mahibalu-an nga may paglapas sa Omnibus Election Code ang nasambit nga  tarpaulin.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jonathan Sayno, election officer 2 of the City COMELEC, said Mayor Espinosa did not object when he learned that the tarpaulin violated the Omnibus Election Code.

text: Ini bangud nga suno kay Sayno, ang nasambit nga campaign advocacy ang iya ni Presidente Duterte kag indi dapat paggamiton sang mga nagakandidato sa eleksyon.
english: This is because, according to Sayno, the campaign advocacy belongs to President Duterte and should not be used by election candidates.

text: Bangud nga nanugunan man si Mayor Espinosa nga pangkakson ang mga tarpaulin, iya ginpromisa nga tabunan na lang ang iya laragway kag ang makita na lang amo ang dagway ni Presidente Duterte.
english: Since Mayor Espinosa also ordered the removal of the tarpaulins, he promised to cover his picture and only see the face of President Duterte.

text: Gintawag ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga tsismis ang report nga isa siya sa mga naga-pondo para sa destabilization plot batok sa Marcos administration.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has called reports that he is one of the funders of the destabilization plot against the Marcos administration a rumor.

text: Matandaan nga ang columnist nga si Mon Tulfo ang nag-post sang listahan sa iya social media account.
english: Columnist Mon Tulfo posted the list on his social media account.

text: Gin-akusaran sini ang vice president, si Davao Rep.
english: He accused the vice president, Davao Rep.

text: Paolo Duterte, kag si former Ilocos Sur Governor Chavit Singson nga amo ang naga-pondo sa destabilization plot.
english: Paolo Duterte, and former Ilocos Sur Governor Chavit Singson who is funding the destabilization plot.

text: Magluwas diri, may nakalista man nga involved nga government officials kag former generals.
english: In addition, there are also listed involved government officials and former generals.

text: Sabat naman sang bise-presidente, tsismosa lang ang tawo nga nagapalapta sang impormasyon nga wala man sang ebidensya.
english: The vice-president said that people who spread information without evidence are just gossips.

text: “Kasi yung mga ganyan na kung napapansin nyo, ako ay hindi talaga ako nabibigay ng mga alegasyon kung wala akong ebidensya,” suno kay Duterte.
english: “Because those are the ones that if you notice, I don't really give allegations if I don't have evidence,” Duterte said.

text: “Yung mga ganyan, kapag meron kang alegasyon, wala kang ebidensya, ang tawag niyan ay chismis o ang tawag sa iyo ay chismosa,” dugang sini.
english: “Those people, when you have an allegation, you don't have evidence, it's called chismis or you're called chismosa,” he added.

text: Una naman nga nagsiling ang Malacañang nga ginpasa na sa Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) ang listahan para sa validation.
english: Earlier, Malacañang said the list had been submitted to the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) for validation.

text:
Yari sa Pilipinas ang Hollywood actor nga si Chris Hemsworth agud dugangan pa ang excitement sang iya Filipino fans sa nagahilapit nga pagpaguwa sang iya film nga “Extraction 2” sa Hunyo 16, ang sequel sa 2020 blockbuster action film sa Netflix nga “Extraction.”

Nagpakigkita ang 39-anyos nga actor sa iya fans kag nag-istorya sa iya papel sa pelikula bilang highly skilled commando nga si Tyler Rake.
english:
Hollywood actor Chris Hemsworth is in the Philippines to add to the excitement of his Filipino fans for the upcoming release of his film “Extraction 2” on June 16, the sequel to the 2020 blockbuster action film on Netflix “Extraction.”

The 39-year-old actor met with his fans and talked about his role in the film as highly skilled commando Tyler Rake.

text: Ginpahayag man sang Australian superstar nga siya mismo ang naghimo sang iya stunts sa isa ka scene kun sa diin nagahulag ang tren.
english: The Australian superstar also said that he did his own stunts in a scene where the train was moving.

text: Ginpakigbahin sini nga ginpreparahan niya ang papel paagi sa pag-train sa movements nga kinahanglan niya nga i-execute.
english: She shared that she prepared for the role by training on the movements she needed to execute.

text: Mangin si Sam Hargrave nga director sang “Extraction 2” ang wala man sang ihambal kundi pagdayaw para kay Chris nga naglaragway pa sa iya nga talented filmmaker magluwas nga isa ka action star.
english: Even Sam Hargrave, the director of “Extraction 2,” had nothing but praise for Chris, who described him as a talented filmmaker besides being an action star.

text: Bantog man ang nasambit nga aktor sa iya papel bilang Thor sa Marvel Cinematic Universe.
english: The actor is also famous for his role as Thor in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

text: Kaupod sini sa “Extraction 2” sanday Golshifteh Farahani, Adam Bessa, Olga Kurylenko, Daniel Bernhardt, kagTinatin Dalakishvili.
english: With it in “Extraction 2” are Golshifteh Farahani, Adam Bessa, Olga Kurylenko, Daniel Bernhardt, andTinatin Dalakishvili.

text: Ginpatigayon sang Iloilo City Government ang demolisyon sang 30 ka temporary stalls sa fish section sang Rizal Street bilang kabahin sang preparasyon para sa soft opening sang bag-o nga Terminal Market sa Oktubre 20.
english: The Iloilo City Government conducted the demolition of 30 temporary stalls in the fish section of Rizal Street as part of preparations for the soft opening of the new Terminal Market on October 20.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Efren Tuvilla, presidente sang mga nagabaligya sang isda sa merkado, suno sa iya:

Ang demolisyon sang mga stalls nagsugod sang Oktubre 14, kag ginpang-kakas ang mga atop kag istruktura agud mapreparar ang lugar para sa pagbukas sang merkado.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Efren Tuvilla, president of the fish vendors in the market, said:

Demolition of the stalls began on October 14, and roofs and structures were removed to prepare the site for the opening of the market.

text: Ginpahayag ni Tuvilla nga wala sang reklamo halin sa mga vendors bangud ginakabig nila nga ini para man sa ila kaayuhan.
english: Tuvilla said there were no complaints from the vendors because they considered it for their own good.

text: May pila ka mga vendors nga wala pa sang temporaryo nga masayluhan, apang ginbaton nila nga kabahin ini sang proseso para sa mas organisado nga pagplastar sang merkado.
english: There are some vendors who do not yet have a temporary place to relocate, but they accepted that this is part of the process for a more organized layout of the market.

text: Ginpasugtan sang Local Economic Enterprise Office nga magbaligya ang mga vendors sa side area halin las-12 sang tungang gab-i tubtob las-8 sang aga, samtang wala pa sang hapon nga baligyaanay.
english: The Local Economic Enterprise Office allowed vendors to sell in the side area from 12 midnight to 8 am, while there is no afternoon sale.

text: Wala sang pagsira sang dalan, pero magapangayo sang bulig sang Traffic Technical Management Office para sa pagdeleher sang trapiko.
english: There will be no road closures, but the assistance of the Traffic Technical Management Office will be sought for traffic diversion.

text: Dugang pa, igademolish man ang 20 ka stalls sa De Leon Street sa Oktubre 16, kag ang mga apektado nga vendors igasaylo sa Jalandoni Street.
english: In addition, 20 stalls on De Leon Street will also be demolished on October 16, and the affected vendors will be relocated to Jalandoni Street.

text: Ang soft opening sang Terminal Market nakatalana sa Oktubre 20, samtang ang grand opening naman sa Oktubre 30.
english: The soft opening of the Terminal Market is scheduled for October 20, while the grand opening is for October 30.

text: Nagpasalig ang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) nga “under control” pa gihapon ang nagatimbuok nga utang sang Pilipinas.
english: The National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) has assured that the Philippines' accumulating debt is still “under control”.

text: Suno ini kay NEDA Secretary Arsenio Balisacan matapos nga ginkumpirma sang Bureau of Treasury nga nagdangat na sa P15.18 trillion ang utang sang Pilipinas sa katapusan sang Pebrero 2024.
english: NEDA Secretary Arsenio Balisacan said this after the Bureau of Treasury confirmed that the Philippines' debt will reach P15.18 trillion by the end of February 2024.

text: Sa sini nga utang, 69.68% ang domestic debt samtang 30.32% naman ang hinulaman nga balor halin sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: Of this debt, 69.68% is domestic debt while 30.32% is borrowed value from abroad.

text: Kasunod sini nga announcement, gin-anunsyo man sang gobyerno ang revised target nga gross domestic product (GDP) nga yara sa 6 to 7 percent nga sang una yara sa 6.5 tubtub 7.5 percent.
english: Following this announcement, the government also announced a revised target gross domestic product (GDP) of 6 to 7 percent from 6.5 to 7.5 percent.

text: Paathag pa ni Balisacan, ang revision sang ila nga target ang wala sang labot sa record-high nga utang sang Pilipinas.
english: Balisacan explained that the revision of their target has nothing to do with the Philippines' record-high debt.

text: Ginhimo nila ini suno sa tiglikom agud mangin “realistic” kag “sustainable” ang target.
english: They did this, according to the secretary, to make the target “realistic” and “sustainable”.

text: “We are actually very… in a very good position.
english: “We are actually very… in a very good position.

text: The rule of thumb for emerging economies is 70% of GDP… that is threshold ‘no.
english: The rule of thumb for emerging economies is 70% of GDP… that is threshold ‘no.

text: We are moving from 60% which way below 60 to even lower ‘no of 55 – almost about 56% by the time we end the term of the current President,” paathag ni Balisacan sang iya ginsiling nga “under control” pa ang kautangan sang nasyon.
english: We are moving from 60% which way below 60 to even lower ‘no of 55 – almost about 56% by the time we end the term of the current President,” Balisacan explained when he said that the country’s debt is still “under control”.

text: Nahibaluan nga plano pa sang Marcos administration nga maghulam sang P2.46 trillion halin sa mga manugpautang (domestic kag abroad) subong nga 2024 agud nga malab-ot ang budget deficit nga ginalantaw magatupa sa P1.4 trillion subong nga tuig.#
english: The Marcos administration plans to borrow P2.46 trillion from creditors (domestic and foreign) in 2024 to meet the budget deficit that is expected to fall to P1.4 trillion this year.

text: Mahimo nga may yara sang bayolasyon ang mga aktibidad sang pag-ulikid program ni Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III, pananglitan nga wala ini nakafile sang Certificate of Exemption sa Commission on  Elections (Comelec).
english: There may be violations of the activities of the ulikid program of Iloilo City Mayor Jose Espinosa III, for example, he did not file a Certificate of Exemption with the Commission on Elections (Comelec).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo  Radyo kay  Mr. Jonathan Sayno,  Election Officer 2, sang City Comelec,  iya ginpahayag  nga kun wala naga-apply sang  exemption ang programa sang alkalde, nagalapas ini sa Omnibus Election Code.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jonathan Sayno, Election Officer 2, of the City Comelec, said that if the mayor's program does not apply for an exemption, it violates the Omnibus Election Code.

text: Suno kay Sayno, wala siya nakahibalo kun  bala nagpasa gid man sang application ang Pag-ulikid program bangud  ang nasambit nga exemption ang gina file mismo sa Regional Office sang Comelec.
english: Sayno said he does not know whether the Pag-ulikid program has submitted an application because the exemption is filed with the Regional Office of the Comelec.

text: Nagapatigayun sang nagkalain-lain nga serbisyo para sa mga pumuluyo ang Pag-ulikid program sa pila ka mga barangay sa distrito sang Jaro kag Molo.
english: The Pag-ulikid program is conducting various services for the people in several barangays in Jaro and Molo districts.

text: Samtang sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Jose  Nick Mendros, Regional Dircetor sang Comelec Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga indi siya sigurado  kun bala nag-apply kag kun naaprobahan ang certificate of exemption sang nasambit nga grupo.
english: Meanwhile, in an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Jose Nick Mendros, Regional Director of Comelec Region 6, said he is not sure whether the group applied and whether the certificate of exemption was approved.

text: Suno kay Mendros, naghatag sadto sang legal advice  sa grupo ang legal department  nga magfile sang exemption bangud sila ang nasakop  man sang banning.
english: According to Mendros, the legal department gave legal advice to the group to file for exemption because they are also covered by the ban.

text: Dugang pa ni Mendros, ginadumilian ang mga kandidato kag political parties  nga magpasakop ukon yara ang ila presensya sa mga aktibidades kaangay sang pagpanghatag sang bulig sa mga tawo agud malikawan ang ila pagpromote sang ila kandidatura.
english: Mendros added that candidates and political parties are prohibited from participating or being present in activities such as distributing aid to people to avoid promoting their candidacy.

text: Surpresa nga ginbisita ni Prince Harry, ang mga biktima sang gyera a Ukraine.
english: Prince Harry surprise visited the victims of the war in Ukraine.

text: Suno sa iya tagapamaba, ang pagbisita sang Duke of Sussex amo ang kabahin sang iya inisyatibo para sa mga war veterans.
english: According to his spokesman, the Duke of Sussex’s visit was part of his initiative for war veterans.

text: Ginpadulungan niya ang Superhumans Center sa Lviv, isa ka orthopedic clinic nga naga-alagad sa mga nasamaran nga sundalo kag sibilyan.
english: He went to the Superhumans Center in Lviv, an orthopedic clinic that serves wounded soldiers and civilians.

text: Gintan-aw ni Prince Harry ang mga makabag-o nga teknolohiya nga nagahatag sang libre nga prosthetics, reconstructive surgery, kag psychological support sa mga biktima.
english: Prince Harry looked at innovative technologies that provide free prosthetics, reconstructive surgery, and psychological support to victims.

text: Si Prince Harry nagserbi sang 10 ka tuig sa British Army kag kilala sa iya aktibo nga suporta sa mga nasamaran nga mga sundalo.
english: Prince Harry served 10 years in the British Army and was known for his active support of wounded soldiers.

text: Siya ang ikaduha nga miyembro sang Royal Family nga nagbisita sa Ukraine.
english: She is the second member of the Royal Family to visit Ukraine.

text: Patay ang Public Information Officer sang Zamboanga del Sur matapos gintiro sa Barangay Ambulon, Vincenzo Sagun, Zamboanga del Sur.
english: The Public Information Officer of Zamboanga del Sur was shot dead in Barangay Ambulon, Vincenzo Sagun, Zamboanga del Sur.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jesrel Gasper Himang, residente sang Barangay Kawit, Pagadian City.
english: The victim was identified as Jesrel Gasper Himang, resident of Barangay Kawit, Pagadian City.

text: Ang isa pa ka biktima nga natiruhan man amo si Celgwen Mae Quirbajosa Arellano, residente sang Tigbao, Zamboanga del Sur.
english: Another victim who was also stabbed was Celgwen Mae Quirbajosa Arellano, resident of Tigbao, Zamboanga del Sur.

text: Ang suspect amo si Reymond Antifuelo Lopecillo, residente sang Midsalip, Zamboanga del Sur kag amo ang security escort ni Himang.
english: The suspect was identified as Reymond Antifuelo Lopecillo, resident of Midsalip, Zamboanga del Sur and Himang's security escort.

text: Base sa inisyal nga impormasyon halin sa Vincenzo Sagun Municipal Police Station, magkaupod nga nagainom sa sulod sang function hall sang RM Beach ang biktima kag suspek.
english: According to initial information from the Vincenzo Sagun Municipal Police Station, the victim and the suspect were drinking together inside the function hall of RM Beach.

text: Nagbaisay ang mga ini tubtob nga nagkuha ang suspect sang pusil kag gintiro si Himang sang makapila ka beses sa ilong, tiyan kag kamot.
english: They argued until the suspect took out a gun and shot Himang several times in the nose, stomach and hand.

text: Gintiro man si Arellano sang makaduha ka beses.
english: Arellano was also shot twice.

text: Madasig nga gindala ang mga biktima sa Margosatubig Regional Hospital apang gindeklarar nga patay si Himang samtang ginabulong naman ang babaye nga biktima.
english: The victims were rushed to the Margosatubig Regional Hospital but Himang was declared dead while the female victim was being treated.

text: Natigayon naman nga maaresto ang suspek.
english: The suspect was arrested.

text: May iga-rekomendar si Vice President Sara Duterte nga abogado para kay Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa pananglitan nga ipadakop man ini sang International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Vice President Sara Duterte will recommend a lawyer for Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa if he is also arrested by the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Kasunod ini sang impormasyon nga ginpaguwa ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla sang nagligad nga semana nga may yara na sang arrest warrant, apang tubtub subong wala man sang nabaton nga kopya ang Department of Justice (DOJ).
english: This follows information released by Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla last week that there is already an arrest warrant, but so far the Department of Justice (DOJ) has not received a copy.

text: Suno naman sa vice president, wala siya sang verified information kaangot sa ginaalegar nga warrant of arrest, apang suno sa iya, napaandaman na sini si Bato nga magpreparar sa posible mga tikang sang ICC.
english: The vice president said he has no verified information regarding the alleged warrant of arrest, but he said he has warned Bato to prepare for possible action by the ICC.

text: Kabahin sang preparasyon suno kay Sara amo ang pagpili sang international law expert nga may eksperyensya man sa amo nga korte.
english: Part of the preparation, Sara said, is the selection of an international law expert who also has experience in the court.

text: Pahayag sini, napahibalo naman sini sa pamilya sang senador nga may irekomendar siya nga British counsel nga eksperto sa international law.
english: He said he has informed the senator's family that he will recommend a British counsel who is an expert in international law.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Dela Rosa ang hepe sang Philippine National Police (PNP) sang ginpatuman sang Duterte administration ang drug war.
english: Dela Rosa was the chief of the Philippine National Police (PNP) when the Duterte administration implemented the drug war.

text: Nadakop na si former President Rodrigo Duterte sang Marso 11, 2025 kag didto subong naka-detain sa The Hague, Netherlands kag nagahulat sang trial sa kaso nga crimes against humanity.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte was arrested on March 11, 2025 and is currently detained in The Hague, Netherlands awaiting trial on charges of crimes against humanity.

text: Nagbyahe padulong sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika si anay Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Manuel Bonoan nga isa sa ginatudlo nga involved sa flood control scandal.
english: Former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Secretary Manuel Bonoan, one of those allegedly involved in the flood control scandal, traveled to the United States of America.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Bureau of Immigration (BI) Spokesperson Dana Sandoval.
english: This was confirmed by Bureau of Immigration (BI) Spokesperson Dana Sandoval.

text: Pahayag sini, nagbiya padulong sa luwas sang pungsod si Bonoan kahapon sang hapon.
english: He said Bonoan left for the country yesterday afternoon.

text: “We confirm that former Secretary Manny Bonoan departed this afternoon for the United States via Taiwan,” suno kay Sandoval.
english: “We confirm that former Secretary Manny Bonoan departed this afternoon for the United States via Taiwan,” Sandoval said.

text: Suno sa iya, gin-check sang immigration officers kun may hold departure order ukon warrant of arrest batok kay Bonoan, kag sang ginklaro nga wala, ginpasugtan ini nga makalakat.
english: He said immigration officers checked to see if there was a hold departure order or warrant of arrest against Bonoan, and when it was clear that there was none, he was allowed to leave.

text: Nahibaluan nga lakip si Bonoan sa Immigration Lookout Bulletin Order (ILBO) nga ginpaguwa sang Department of Justice (DOJ).
english: Bonoan is included in the Immigration Lookout Bulletin Order (ILBO) issued by the Department of Justice (DOJ).

text: Kun yara ang pangalan sang isa ka tawo sa ILBO, buot silingon, gina-monitor sang awtoridad ang mga byahe sini.
english: If a person's name is on the ILBO, it means that the authorities are monitoring his flights.

text: Lain ini sa hold departure order nga amo ang makapugong sa isa ka tawo nga magbiya sa Pilipinas.
english: This is different from a hold departure order which can prevent a person from leaving the Philippines.

text: Na-implicate si Bonoan sa corruption sa government infrastructure works lakip na sa flood control projects.
english: Bonoan has been implicated in corruption in government infrastructure works including flood control projects.

text: Base sa Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), liable ang anay tiglikom sa “ghost” flood control project sa Bulacan nga balor P95.04 million.
english: According to the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), the former secretary is liable for the “ghost” flood control project in Bulacan worth P95.04 million.

text: Matandaan nga nagrekomendar ang ICI sang kaso-administratibo batok sa anay tiglikom bangud sa P72.4-million “ghost” riverbank project sa amo man nga probinsya.
english: It can be recalled that the ICI recommended an administrative case against the former secretary over the P72.4-million “ghost” riverbank project in the same province.

text: Matandaan nga nag-resign si Bonoan sa DPWH sa tunga sang sampaw-sampaw nga isyu sang kurapsyon, kag ang nagbulos sa iya amo si current Secretary Vince Dizon.
english: Bonoan resigned from the DPWH amid corruption scandals, and was replaced by current Secretary Vince Dizon.

text: Plano ni Justin Brownlee nga ipa-auction ang iya ginsuksok nga jersey kag sapatos sang ginpangunahan sini ang maragtason nga paglutos sang Gilas Pilipinas sa anay reigning champion nga China sa men’s basketball sa Asian Games sang Oktubre 2023.
english: Justin Brownlee plans to auction off the jersey and shoes he wore when he led Gilas Pilipinas to its historic win over former reigning champion China in men’s basketball at the Asian Games in October 2023.

text: Suno kay Brownlee, ang matipon nga kuwarta sa auction ang igahatag sini sa charities.
english: Brownlee said the money raised from the auction will be donated to charity.

text: Magluwas sa jersey kag shorts, ilakip man ni Brownlee sa auction ang Nike Kobe 8 Protro “Halo” shoes nga iya gingamit.
english: In addition to the jersey and shorts, Brownlee will also include in the auction the Nike Kobe 8 Protro “Halo” shoes he used.

text: Pahayag pa sang three-time PBA Best Import, gusto niya nga mag-umpisa ang bidding sa P2.5 million kag gusto man niya nga madamo nga tawo ang magabulig para sa mga nagakinahanglan.
english: The three-time PBA Best Import said he wants the bidding to start at P2.5 million and he also wants more people to help for those in need.

text: Ginakabig sini ang hampang batok sa China sa semifinals nga amo ang isa sa iya pinakapaborito nga hampang para sa Pilipinas.
english: He considers the match against China in the semifinals to be one of his most favorite matches for the Philippines.

text: Matandaan nga ang paglutos sang Gilas sa China sa isa gid lamang ka puntos amo ang nangin paagi agud nga makalab-ot ang Pilipinas sa finals kun sa diin ginlutos man sini ang team sang Jordan kag nahatag sa mga Pilipino ang labing-una nga korona sa men’s basketball sa Asian Games halin sang 1962.
english: It can be recalled that the Gilas' defeat of China by just one point was the way for the Philippines to reach the finals where they also defeated the team of Jordan and gave the Filipinos the first crown in men's basketball in the Asian Games since 1962.

text: Sang tion nga nag-atubangay ang Gilas kag China, wala gid naka-abanse ang Pilipinas halin sa una nga quarter sang hampang apang ginbubo ni Brownlee ang bug-os nga pwersa sa fourth quarter.
english: By the time Gilas and China faced each other, the Philippines couldn’t really take the lead from the first quarter of the game but Brownlee poured full force in the fourth quarter.

text: Halin sa 20 puntos nga abanse sang kasumpong, 17 sa 33 puntos sang naturalized player ang ginpaulan sa final frame antes nakuha sang mga Pinoy ang makahalawat-hawat nga 77-76 nga kadalag-an sa atubang mismo sang linibo nga Chinese fans.
english: From the opponent's 20-point lead, 17 of the naturalized player's 33 points were rained out in the final frame before the Filipinos secured a thrilling 77-76 victory in front of thousands of Chinese fans.

text: Halin sang Asian Games, subong naman nga Pebrero 2024 nakapakita si Brownlee sa Pilipinas bangud naglagbong ini sa doping test apang nakabalik na sa pungsod kag magabulig liwat sa Gilas sa first window sang FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers subong nga bulan.
english: Since the Asian Games, Brownlee has appeared in the Philippines in February 2024 because he failed a doping test but has returned to the country and will again help the Gilas in the first window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers this month.

text: Ginlunsar sang Land Transportation Office Region-6 ang kampanya nga ”Oplan Biyaheng Ayos: Undas 2025” bilang preparasyon sa ginapaabot nga pagdamo sang pasahero sa Iloilo sa tion sang Undas.
english: The Land Transportation Office Region-6 launched the campaign “Oplan Biyaheng Ayos: Undas 2025” in preparation for the expected increase in passengers in Iloilo during Undas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan, Regional Director sang LTO Region-6, suno sa iya, ang operasyon sang kampanya magasugod halin Oktubre 20 tubtob Nobyembre 4, 2025, kag magatutok sa mga terminal sa Mohon, People’s, Ungka, kag Tagbac.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan, Regional Director of LTO Region-6, said the operation of the campaign will run from October 20 to November 4, 2025, and will focus on terminals in Mohon, People’s, Ungka, and Tagbac.

text: Ginpahayag ni Geduspan nga kabahin sang inisyatibo ang pagpatuman sang istrikto nga seguridad ilabi na sa peak nga adlaw sang Undas.
english: Geduspan said part of the initiative is the implementation of strict security especially during the peak day of Undas.

text: Ginahingyo man sang LTO ang kooperasyon sang iban pa nga ahensiya para sa mas epektibo nga pagmonitor sang mga pampasahero nga salakyan.
english: The LTO also seeks the cooperation of other agencies for more effective monitoring of passenger vehicles.

text: Lakip sa mga ginatutukan amo ang pagsunod sang mga Public Utility Vehicles sa mga regulasyon, kag ang paglikaw sa aksidente paagi sa maayo nga sistema sang transportasyon.
english: Among the focuses are the compliance of Public Utility Vehicles with regulations, and accident prevention through a good transportation system.

text: Ginpanindugan sang LTO nga ang kampanya nagatuyo nga masiguro ang kasulhay kag kaluwasan sang biyahe sang publiko sa tion sang pagpanumbalik sang pista minatay.
english: The LTO insisted that the campaign aims to ensure the comfort and safety of public travel during the restoration of the pista minatay.

text: Masako na sa training ang Gilas Pilipinas para sa nagahilapit nga first window sang FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers subong nga Pebrero!
english: Gilas Pilipinas is busy training for the upcoming first window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers this February!

text: 10 na sa mga myembro sang national team ang nagsulod sa training camp sa Inspire Sports Academy sa Laguna para sa apat ka adlaw nga paghanas.
english: 10 of the national team members have already entered the training camp at Inspire Sports Academy in Laguna for four days of training.

text: Ini amo sanday Justin Brownlee, Scottie Thompson, Kai Sotto, Dwight Ramos, Carl Tamayo, AJ Edu, Calvin Oftana, Chris Newsome, Jamie Malonzo, kag Kevin Quiambao.
english: They are Justin Brownlee, Scottie Thompson, Kai Sotto, Dwight Ramos, Carl Tamayo, AJ Edu, Calvin Oftana, Chris Newsome, Jamie Malonzo, and Kevin Quiambao.

text: Wala sanday June Mar Fajardo kag CJ Perez sa una nga adlaw sang training bangud bag-o gid lamang matapos ang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Commissioner’s Cup kun sa diin ang ila man nga team nga San Miguel Beermen amo ang nagkampyon.
english: June Mar Fajardo and CJ Perez were absent on the first day of training because the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Commissioner's Cup had just ended where their team, the San Miguel Beermen, was the champion.

text: Apisar nga yara si Edu sa training camp, kumpirmado nga indi ini makahampang para sa Gilas sa first window bangud sa gin-suprer sini nga injury sa Japan B. League campaign kag indi man ini available para sa national team tubtub sa Abril.
english: Although Edu is in training camp, it is confirmed that he will not be able to play for the Gilas in the first window due to the injury he suffered in the Japan B. League campaign and will not be available for the national team until April.

text: Indi pa maathag kun ano ang plano ni Coach Tim Cone para sa core team apang nakit-an nga yara man sa training camp si Japeth Aguilar apisar nga wala ini sa 12 ka napilian sang coach.
english: It is not clear what Coach Tim Cone's plans are for the core team but Japeth Aguilar was also seen in the training camp despite not being among the 12 selected by the coach.

text: Nahibaluan nga pagkatapos sang apat ka adlaw sa Inspire Sports Academy, magapatigayon ang Nationals sang open practice sa PhilSports Arena sa Pebrero19 antes magkadto sa Hong Kong para sa labing-una sini nga hampang sa Pebrero 22.
english: After four days at the Inspire Sports Academy, the Nationals will hold an open practice at the PhilSports Arena on February 19 before traveling to Hong Kong for their first match on February 22.

text: Kun matapos na ang hampang sa Hong Kong, magabalik sa Pilipinas ang Gilas kag handaan ang hampang batok sa Taiwan sa PhilSports Arena sa Pebrero 25.
english: After the match in Hong Kong, the Gilas will return to the Philippines and prepare for the match against Taiwan at the PhilSports Arena on February 25.

text: Na-angkon sang San Miguel Beermen ang titulo sa Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Season 48 Commissioner’s Cup matapos gintumba ang Magnolia Hotshots, 104-102, sa Game 6!
english: The San Miguel Beermen clinched the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Season 48 Commissioner’s Cup title after knocking off the Magnolia Hotshots, 104-102, in Game 6!

text: Ini na ang ika-29 sa championship tally sa franchise history sang San Miguel nga ikalima man sa bug-os nga maragtas sang Commissioner’s Cup sa pungsod.
english: This is the 29th championship tally in San Miguel's franchise history and the fifth in the history of the Commissioner's Cup in the country.

text: Nagpanguna sa team si CJ Perez nga may 28 puntos kag amo man ang ginkilala nga Finals Most Valuable Player.
english: CJ Perez led the team with 28 points and was also named the Finals Most Valuable Player.

text: Si Perez ang una na nga ginhingadlan nga Best Player of the Conference nga may average nga 18 points, 3.8 rebounds, 2.8 assists, kag 3.2 steals sa best-of-seven series.
english: Perez was previously named Best Player of the Conference averaging 18 points, 3.8 rebounds, 2.8 assists, and 3.2 steals in the best-of-seven series.

text: Sa Game 6, pareho naman nga may tag-19 puntos sanday Bennie Boatwright kag June Mar Fajardo.
english: In Game 6, Bennie Boatwright and June Mar Fajardo both had 19 points each.

text: Sa bahin naman sang Magnolia, nagpanguna si Paul Lee nga may 25 puntos.
english: For Magnolia, Paul Lee led the way with 25 points.

text: Kadungan man ini sa iya ika-35 nga kaadlawan — adlaw nga iya ginlaragway nga pinakamasubo nga birthday bangud napaslawan siya kag ang Hotshots nga mapalawig pa sa Game 7 ang ila hampang.
english: It also coincides with his 35th birthday — a day he described as his saddest birthday since he and the Hotshots failed to extend their game beyond Game 7.

text: Kapin sa 50 ka mga hippopotamus ang napatay bangud sa anthrax poisoning sa Virunga National Park sa Congo.
english: More than 50 hippopotamuses have died from anthrax poisoning in Virunga National Park in Congo.

text: Kalabanan nga mga patay nga sapat ang nakit-an nga nagalutaw sa Ishasha River.
english: Most dead animals were found floating in the Ishasha River.

text: Base sa tests, nakumpirma nga anthrax ang kabangdanan sang kamatayon.
english: Based on tests, anthrax was confirmed as the cause of death.

text: Magluwas sa hippos, may nagkalamatay man nga mga buffaloes.
english: Besides hippos, buffaloes also died.

text: Nagtanyag sang bulig ang pila ka mga nasyon kasunod sang paglaslas sang duha ka magkasunod nga bagyo sa Pilipinas sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Several countries have offered assistance following two consecutive typhoons that hit the Philippines last week.

text: Suno kay Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, lakip sa nagpalab-ot sang bulig para sa humanitarian assistance kag disaster relief amo ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika, Japan, Timor-Leste, kag India.
english: According to Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, among those who extended aid for humanitarian assistance and disaster relief were the United States of America, Japan, Timor-Leste, and India.

text: Ini nga mga nasyon ang nagpadala sang sulat sa Armed Forces of the Philippines kag sa Department of National Defense.
english: These countries sent a letter to the Armed Forces of the Philippines and the Department of National Defense.

text: Ang Philippine military bases nga bukas man para sa mga US soldiers paagi sa Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA) ang gingamit man anay para sa disaster operations.
english: Philippine military bases that are also open to US soldiers through the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA) have also been used for disaster operations.

text: Nahibaluan nga pinaa-apektado ang Central Visayas sang naglaslas si Tino, samtang nagpahuway lang ang pila ka adlaw, nagsulod naman si Uwan, nahimo nga super typhoon, kag naglaslas naman sa northern kag central Luzon.
english: Central Visayas was the worst affected when Tino struck, while after a few days of rest, Uwan entered, became a super typhoon, and struck northern and central Luzon.

text: Magapadayun ang voters education sang Provincial Comelec Office Office sa mga botante sa bug-os nga probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: The Provincial Comelec Office Office will continue its voters education to voters throughout the province of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay  Atty. Roberto Salazar, provincial Comelec supervisor sang  provincial Comelec, iya ginpahayag nga mangin pilot area sa testing sang voters registration verification machine (VRVM) ang probinsya kag syudad sang Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Roberto Salazar, provincial Comelec supervisor of the provincial Comelec, said the province and Iloilo City will be pilot areas in the testing of the voters registration verification machine (VRVM).

text: Suno kay Salazar ang VRVM ang  isa ka customized tablet nga may fingerprint scanner nga maga-scan sang fingerprints sang tagsa ka botante.Pahayag pa ni Salazar nga kun medyo panas naman ang  fingerprints, mahimo naman nga iverify ang ngalan sa listahan sang mga botante nga yara sa mga  Board of Elections Inspectors (BEI’s).
english: According to Salazar, the VRVM is a customized tablet with a fingerprint scanner that will scan the fingerprints of each voter.

text: Lapnagon naman suno sa natungdan ang pagpahibalo tuhoy sa nasambit nga pilot test pinaagi sa media kag voters education sa tagsa ka mga kabanwahanan.
english: He said the pilot test will be widely disseminated through the media and voters education in each town.

text: Samtang gin-athagnaman  ni Salazar   nga santo sa  section 104 sang Omnibus Election Code, ginadumilian ang presensya sang nagapapili nga kandidato  nga nagahatag sang bagay nga posible kabaylo sang pagboto sang mga pumuluyo ukon ang mga nagapapili  nga kanidato nga nagapa ‘epal’ sa mga programa sang gobyerno.
english: Meanwhile, Salazar clarified that according to section 104 of the Omnibus Election Code, the presence of candidates who give anything in exchange for the votes of the people or candidates who 'epal' government programs is prohibited.

text: Gin-endorso sang principal counsel sang drug war victims ang duha ka mga medical expert nga makabulig sa pagtumod sa overall fitness ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The principal counsel of drug war victims has endorsed two medical experts who can help determine the overall fitness of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Gin-file ni Atty. Paolina Massida ang request sa International Criminal Court-Pre-Trial Chamber I sang Nobyembre 10.
english: Filed by Atty. Paolina Massida filed the request with the International Criminal Court-Pre-Trial Chamber I on November 10.

text: Pareho nga eksperto sa neuropsychology ang iya gin-endorso nga suno sa iya may relevant credentials kag may ikasangkol nga ma-appoint agud mag-upod sa panel of experts nga amo ang mag-conduct sang medical examination.
english: He endorsed both experts in neuropsychology who he said have relevant credentials and can contribute to be appointed to join the panel of experts who will conduct the medical examination.

text: Matandaan nga nag-appoint ang ICC sang panel nga bug-usan sang tatlo ka medical experts nga amo ang maga-examine kay Duterte.
english: The ICC has appointed a panel of three medical experts to examine Duterte.

text: Nagpetisyon naman ang kampo ni Duterte nga i-disqualify ang isa sa ila, rason nga nag-siyu sang order ang korte sa Registry nga magpasa sang bag-o nga shortlist sang mga eksperto sa neuropsychology.
english: Duterte's camp petitioned to disqualify one of them, prompting the court to order the Registry to submit a new shortlist of neuropsychology experts.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginapanindugan sang kampo ni Duterte nga indi na ini makasarang mag-atubang sa trial bangud sa iya edad nga 80-anyos.
english: It is known that Duterte's camp insists that he is no longer able to face the trial because of his age of 80 years.

text: Ginapahayag sang defense counsel nga malipaton na ini, indi na gani makadumdom kun ngaa didto siya sa The Hague, kag indi naman makadumdom mangin sa mga myembro sang iya pamilya.
english: The defense counsel claims that he is forgetful, cannot even remember why he was in The Hague, and cannot even remember his family members.

text: Nabalaka ang pila ka mga estudyante sa nakit-an nga litik sa salog sang isa ka building sa Iloilo Doctors College sa Molo, Iloilo City.
english: Some students are concerned about the crack found in the floor of a building at Iloilo Doctors College in Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Suno sa isa ka netizen, nakit-an ang litik sa 2nd floor sang New Administration Building.
english: According to a netizen, the crack was found on the 2nd floor of the New Administration Building.

text: Suno diri, nagakahangawa sila nga wala gid gin-suspend ang klase bisan pa nga ini ang nakit-an nga litik sa salog.
english: He said they are worried that classes were never suspended even though they found a crack in the floor.

text: Nahibaluan nga sini lang nga aga sang gintay-og sang magnitude 4.4 ang Guimbal, Iloilo kag nabatyagan man sa Iloilo City, Antique, Guimaras, kag Negros Occidental.
english: A magnitude 4.4 earthquake struck Guimbal, Iloilo this morning and was also felt in Iloilo City, Antique, Guimaras, and Negros Occidental.

text: ILOILO CITY – Heads up, Filipino Sheerios!
english: ILOILO CITY – Heads up, Filipino Sheerios!

text: Gin-reveal ni Ed Sheeran ang iya plano nga magpatigayon sang tour sa Asia sa 2024 sa iya nga Instagram stories.
english: Ed Sheeran revealed his plans to tour Asia in 2024 on his Instagram stories.

text: Sa isa ka question and answer portion, ginpamangkot si Ed Sheeran kun san-o ini maga-tour sa Asia.
english: In a question and answer portion, Ed Sheeran was asked when he would tour Asia.

text: Suno sa iya, himu-on niya ini sa masunod nga tuig.
english: He said he will do it next year.

text: Si Ed ang yara subong sa iya United Stated leg of tour agud nga suportahan ang iya latest nga album.
english: Ed is currently on his United Stated leg of tour to support his latest album.

text: Suno sa singer-songwriter, ini na ang iya most honest album kasunod sang mga hard-hitting events nga iya naagyan sang nagligad nga mga tinuig.
english: According to the singer-songwriter, this is now her most honest album following the hard-hitting events she went through in recent years.

text: Mangin isa  pilot area sang testing sang Voters Registration Verification Machine Mangin  pilot area sang testing sang Voters Registration Verification Machine (VRVM) ang syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jonathan Sayno, Election assistant sa City Comelec Office  iya ginpahayag nga  iga-introduce sa mga botante ang VRVM nga gamitun sa maabot nga May 13 midterm elections.
english: The city and province of Iloilo will be a pilot area for the testing of the Voters Registration Verification Machine (VRVM). Jonathan Sayno, Election assistant at the City Comelec Office, said the VRVM will be introduced to voters to be used in the upcoming May 13 midterm elections.

text: Suno kay Sayno, ang nasambit nga machine ang maga-verify sang fingerprint kun bala registed voter sang partikular nga precinct ang isa ka botante.Ini man suno kay Sayno ang pamaagi agud man malikawan ang pagduging sang mga flying voters.
english: According to Sayno, the machine will verify the fingerprint whether a voter is a registered voter of a particular precinct.

text: Apisar may yara sang VRVM, lantawun man sa gihapon sang mga botante ang ila pangalan sa listahan nga nakapaskil sa  guwa sang mga presinto kag tandaan ang ila voters number.
english: Although there is a VRVM, voters will still check their names on the list posted outside the precincts and remember their voters number.

text: Duha naman ka linya ang linyahan sang botante, ang una amo ang sa VRVM kag kun mahatagan na sang resibo magalinya sa ikaduha nga line agud magkuha sang balota.
english: Voters will line up in two lines, the first is at the VRVM and once they are given a receipt they will line up in the second line to get their ballots.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag man  ni Sayno  nga nagapadayun ang ila Operation baklas tagsa ka semana sa mga illegaly posted nga mga posters sang mga kandidato.Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga ginadumilian ang mga kandidato nga magpatigayun sang exposure sa  mga programa sang gobyerno kaangay sang pagpanagtag sang bulig sa mga biktima sang ano man nga emerhensya.
english: Meanwhile, Sayno said they continue their Operation baklas every week on illegally posted posters of candidates. He also explained that candidates are prohibited from conducting exposure to government programs such as the distribution of aid to victims of any emergency.

text: Patay ang 20 ka mga tawo matapos nga nasunog ang isa ka nursing home sa Hebei province sa northern China.
english: At least 20 people have been killed after a nursing home caught fire in northern China's Hebei province.

text: Nahamtang ang nursing home sa Longhua County nga kapin 180km northeast sang Beijing.
english: The nursing home is located in Longhua County, more than 180km northeast of Beijing.

text: Ang mga survivors naman ang ginsaylo sa ospital para obserbahan kag mabulong.
english: The survivors were transferred to the hospital for observation and treatment.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: May buho sa ulo kag may mga lagob sa lawas ang bangkay sang babaye nga nasapwan sa tunga sang kamaisan sa Brgy.
english: The body of a woman found in the middle of a cornfield in Brgy.

text: San Antonio, San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: San Antonio, San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Suno sa San Enrique Municipal Police Station, posible nga ginlampusan sang matig-a nga bagay ang ulo sang biktima.
english: According to the San Enrique Municipal Police Station, the victim may have been hit on the head with a hard object.

text: May yara man sang tattoo sa magtimbang nga paa sini.
english: It also has a tattoo on both legs.

text: Wala pa sa gihapon makilala-ang ang nasambit nga bangkay.
english: The body has not yet been identified.

text: Nagpanawagan ang kapulisan sang bulig sang publiko agud makilal-an ini ukon mapalab-ot sa iya pamilya ang natabo sa iya.
english: Police are appealing for the public's help in identifying him or informing his family about what happened to him.

text: Ginmandu ni Iloilo Schools Division Superintendent Dr. Ernesto F. Servillon Jr.
english: Iloilo Schools Division Superintendent Dr. Ernesto F. Servillon Jr.

text: ang suspension sang face-to-face classes halin sa Kindergarten tubtub sa Senior High School sa tanan nga mga eskwelahan nga sakop sang first congressional district.
english: the suspension of face-to-face classes from Kindergarten to Senior High School in all schools in the first congressional district.

text: Suno sa Department of Education – Schools Division of Iloilo, ini nga tikang ang para masiguro nga safe ang kabataan kag mga personnel sa mga area nga naapektuhan sang linog.
english: According to the Department of Education – Schools Division of Iloilo, this step is to ensure the safety of children and personnel in the areas affected by the earthquake.

text: “Following the recent magnitude 4.4 earthquake that affected areas within the First Congressional District of Iloilo, and in line with our commitment to ensuring the safety and well-being of all learners and school personnel, the Schools Division Superintendent Dr. Ernesto F. Servillon Jr.
english: “Following the recent magnitude 4.4 earthquake that affected areas within the First Congressional District of Iloilo, and in line with our commitment to ensuring the safety and well-being of all learners and school personnel, the Schools Division Superintendent Dr. Ernesto F. Servillon Jr.

text: has ordered the suspension of face-to-face classes from Kindergarten to Senior High School in all schools within the first congressional district, effective immediately,” kabahin sang advisory.
english: has ordered the suspension of face-to-face classes from Kindergarten to Senior High School in all schools within the first congressional district, effective immediately,” the advisory said.

text: “We appreciate your understanding and cooperation as we prioritize the safety of our children.
english: “We appreciate your understanding and cooperation as we prioritize the safety of our children.

text: For updates, please stay tuned to official channels or contact your school administration,” dugang sini.
english: For updates, please stay tuned to official channels or contact your school administration,” it added.

text: Sa separado nga abiso ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr., naghingyo ini sa mga eskwelahan, banwa, ospital, kag mga private spaces nga may high-rise structures nga i-assess ang structural integrity sang mga estruktura.
english: In a separate notice, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr. urged schools, towns, hospitals, and private spaces with high-rise structures to assess the structural integrity of the structures.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginpanubo sang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) sa 4.2 ang magnitude sang linog nga nagtay-og sa Guimbal, Iloilo 6:48 kaina sang aga.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) reduced the magnitude of the earthquake that struck Guimbal, Iloilo at 6:48 this morning to 4.2.

text: 4.4 magnitude ang una nga gin-report sang ahensya.
english: 4.4 magnitude was first reported by the agency.

text: Tectonic in origin ang linog kag may kadalumon nga 15 kilometros.
english: The quake was tectonic in origin and measured 15 kilometers deep.

english:
