text: Positibo ang Federation of Filipino Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Inc.
english: The Federation of Filipino Chinese Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Inc.

text: nga magapadayon ang relasyon sang China kag Pilipinas sa negosyo kag pang-ekonomiya apisar sang nagasaka nga tensyon sa West Philippine Sea.
english: that China-Philippines trade and economic relations will continue despite rising tensions in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Suno sa president sang federation nga si Dr. Cecilio Pedro, ang China amo ang pinakadaku nga market sa kalibutan gani ginakabig man ini nga mayor nga trading partner para sa mga negosyo nga nagatuon pa lamang kun paano sila magsangkad.
english: According to the president of the federation, Dr. Cecilio Pedro, China is the largest market in the world so it is also considered a major trading partner for businesses that are still learning how to expand.

text: Pahayag pa sini, pwede gid nga mapaiway ang mga geopolitical issues kaangay sang away sa West Philippine Sea agud nga matib-ong man ang pang-ekonomiya nga relasyon sang nagkalain-lain nga mga pungsod.
english: He said geopolitical issues such as the dispute in the West Philippine Sea can be avoided in order to strengthen economic relations between the various countries.

text: Dapat suno sa iya nga magbuligay ang duha ka nasyon agud nga maka-kontribwer sa gross domestic product (GDP) growth sa 2024.
english: He said the two countries should work together to contribute to gross domestic product (GDP) growth by 2024.

text: Ang Chinese manufacturing firms suno sa iya ang nagalantaw sa Southeast Asia para sa expansion nga isa gid ka maayo nga kahigayunan sa Pilipinas.
english: Chinese manufacturing firms, he said, are looking to Southeast Asia for expansion which is a very good opportunity in the Philippines.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Chinese Ambassador to Manila Huang Xilian nga ang China amo ang pinakadaku nga trading partner sang Pilipinas sa sulod na sang walo ka sunod-sunod nga tuig.
english: Earlier, Chinese Ambassador to Manila Huang Xilian said China has been the Philippines' largest trading partner for eight consecutive years.

text: Subong nga Marso, duha na ka separado nga insidente sang water cannon attack ang ginhimo sang China Coast Guard sa barko sang Pilipinas sa West Philippine Sea nga magakadto kuntani sa Ayungin Shoal para sa resuplly mission sa BRP Sierra Madre.#
english: This March, two separate incidents of water cannon attack were carried out by the China Coast Guard on a Philippine ship in the West Philippine Sea that was about to go to Ayungin Shoal for a resuplly mission to BRP Sierra Madre.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jonathan Sayno, Assistant City Election Officer sang COMELEC, iya ginpahayag nga kalabanan sa mga ginpangkakas nga mga campaign materials ang wala napaskil sa designated areas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jonathan Sayno, Assistant City Election Officer of the COMELEC, said most of the removed campaign materials were not posted in the designated areas.

text: Magluwas diri, wala man nagasanto sa ginpaguwa nga size sang COMELEC ang mga ginpangkakas nga campaign poster.
english: Besides, the removed campaign posters did not match the size released by the COMELEC.

text: Ginpahayag dugang ni Sayno nga unahon sang COMELEC sa pag-inspection ang mga public plaza sa diin madamu ang makita nga violators.
english: Sayno added that the COMELEC will give priority to public plazas where violators are found.

text: Sa subong suno sa natungdan, padayon ang inventory sa campaign materials agud matumod kun sanday sin-o nga mga pulitiko ang makabig nga violator.
english: He said the inventory of campaign materials is ongoing to identify which politicians are considered violators.

text: Todo ang kahangawa kag pagpangamuyo sang fans matapos nasaksihan nga nalipong ang singing sensation kag internet superstar nga si Gigi De Lana samang naga-perform ini sa isa ka show sa Paoay, Ilocos Norte.
english: Fans are worried and praying after singing sensation and internet superstar Gigi De Lana fainted while performing at a show in Paoay, Ilocos Norte.

text: Makit-an sa video nga gintinguhaan ni Gigi nga matapos ang iya nga “Noypi” performance, apang nag-uy-uy ini kag sang ulihi ginpalapitan na lang sang iya nga mga kaupdanan kag ginpaguwa sa stage.
english: The video shows Gigi trying to finish her “Noypi” performance, but she staggered and was later approached by her colleagues and taken out of the stage.

text: Nagpangayo man sang pasaylo ang banda nga “The Gigi Vibes” sa mga nagtambong sa amo nga show sa Ilocos Norte.
english: The band “The Gigi Vibes” also apologized to those who attended the show in Ilocos Norte.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes ang insidente, naaksidente si Gigi kag ang iya nga team.
english: It was learned that before the incident, Gigi and her team had an accident.

text: Si Gigi kag ang iban pa nga band members nga sanday Jon, Oyus, Mela kag ang ila nga crew members ang lunsay nag-angkon sang minor injuries.
english: Gigi and other band members Jon, Oyus, Mela and their crew members all sustained minor injuries.

text: Matandaan nga antes pa man ang aksidente kag antes pa man ang pagkalipong sa stage, una na nag-anunsyo ang singer nga magapahuway anay ini sa pagkanta bangud sa nodules sa iya nga tutunlan.
english: Even before the accident and before the dizziness on stage, the singer announced that he would take a break from singing due to nodules in his throat.

text: Popular ang amo nga singer kag nangin internet sensation halin sang nagpaguwa ini sang powerful kag emotional version sang “Bakit Nga Ba Mahal Kita” ni Roselle Nava.
english: The singer is popular and has become an internet sensation since she released a powerful and emotional version of “Bakit Nga Ba Mahal Kita” by Roselle Nava.

text: Nag-release man ini sang iya nga self-titled debut album sang 2022.
english: She also released her self-titled debut album in 2022.

text: Naatrasar man apang naghatag gihapon sang pagpasidungog ang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) kay Justin Brownlee bangud sa pagpanguna sini sa national men’s basketball team nga Gilas Pilipinas nga makuha ang korona sa Southeast Asian Games kag sa 19th Asian Games sang 2023.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) has paid tribute to Justin Brownlee for leading the national men's basketball team Gilas Pilipinas to the crown at the Southeast Asian Games and the 19th Asian Games in 2023.

text: Natabo ini sa halftime sa Game 4 sang PBA Commissioner’s Cup Finals sa tunga sang San Miguel Beermen kag Magnolia Hotshots sa Smart Araneta Coliseum.
english: It happened at halftime in Game 4 of the PBA Commissioner’s Cup Finals between the San Miguel Beermen and Magnolia Hotshots at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.

text: Ang iban nga Gilas members ang una na nga ginkilala sa PBA, apang ini ang una nga tion nga personal nga na-presentar si Brownlee sa atubang sang Filipino fans diri sa pungsod bangud subong lang ini nakabalik sa Pilipinas matapos nga ginhatagan na sang FIBA sang clearance nga makahampang liwat para sa Gilas.
english: Other Gilas members have already been recognized in the PBA, but this is the first time that Brownlee was personally presented in front of Filipino fans here in the country because he just returned to the Philippines after FIBA ​​gave him clearance to play for the Gilas again.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa sini nga conference, wala man nakahampang si Brownlee para sa Barangay Ginebra bangud boluntaryo na ini nga nagpaidalom sa suspension halin sang nagguwa ang resulta sang doping test sang Nobyembre 2023.
english: It is known that in this conference, Brownlee also did not play for Barangay Ginebra because he voluntarily underwent suspension since the result of the doping test came out in November 2023.

text: Ini man ang rason nga sang opisyal na nga ginpapanaog sang FIBA ang tatlo ka bulan nga suspensyon sini nga Pebrero, ginbuhin na nga daan ang mga binulan nga wala naghampang ang nasambit nga naturalized player sang Pilipinas.
english: This is also the reason why when FIBA ​​officially lifted the three-month suspension this February, the months that the said naturalized player of the Philippines did not play were already reduced.

text: Si Brownlee ang mangin masako liwat sa paghanas para sa una nga window sang Fiba Asia Cup qualifiers subong nga Pebrero kun sa diin atubangon sang national team ang Hong Kong kag ang Taiwan.
english: Brownlee will be busy again training for the first window of the Fiba Asia Cup qualifiers this February where the national team will face Hong Kong and Taiwan.

text: Ang 11 ka iban pa nga kaupod ni Brownlee nga ginpili ni Gilas Coach Tim Cone sa sini nga window amo sanday Scottie Thompson, Jamie Malonzo, Chris Newsome, Calvin Oftana, CJ Perez, June Mar Fajardo, Dwight Ramos, AJ Edu, Carl Tamayo, Kai Sotto, kag Kevin Quiambao.
english: Brownlee’s 11 other teammates chosen by Gilas Coach Tim Cone in this window are Scottie Thompson, Jamie Malonzo, Chris Newsome, Calvin Oftana, CJ Perez, June Mar Fajardo, Dwight Ramos, AJ Edu, Carl Tamayo, Kai Sotto, and Kevin Quiambao.

text: Nabun-an ang isa ka lalaki bangud gid lamang sa ginhaboy nga liso sang sandiya sa isa ka namatyan sa Pantabangan, Nueva Ecija.
english: A man was stabbed for throwing watermelon seeds at a funeral in Pantabangan, Nueva Ecija.

text: Ang biktima isa ka 30-anyos nga mangunguma samtang ang suspek naman isa ka 37-anyos nga kumpare sini.
english: The victim is a 30-year-old farmer while the suspect is a 37-year-old cousin.

text: Suno sa otoridad, magkaupod nga nagainom ang duha kaupod ang iban pa sa isa ka namatyan.
english: According to authorities, the two were drinking together with others at a funeral.

text: Ginpahayag nga naglahug ang biktima paagi sa paghaboy sang liso sang sandiya sa suspek.
english: The victim allegedly threw watermelon seeds at the suspect.

text: Ginpatihan nga nainsulto ang suspek sa ginhimo sang biktima gani nagkuha ini gilayon kag ginbuno sa ulo.
english: The suspect was believed to be insulted by the victim's actions and immediately took it and stabbed him in the head.

text: Madasig naman nga gindala sa ospital ang biktima.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital.

text: Natigayon naman nga maaresto ang suspek.
english: The suspect was arrested.

text: Ginpasuspende sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) ang penalidad batok sa paggamit sang temporaryo kag improvised nga plaka sang salakyan nga dapat untat magsugod sa Nobyembre.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has suspended the penalty against the use of temporary and improvised license plates that should be stopped starting in November.

text: Suno kay Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao, kinahanglan pa usisahon sang ahensya ang pila ka isyu antes magpatuman sang ₱5,000 nga multa.
english: Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao said the agency still needs to investigate some issues before imposing the ₱5,000 fine.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga indi angay nga pinahan ang mga motorista nga wala pa sang opisyal nga plaka bangud sang mga rason nga wala sa ila kontrol, pareho sang problema sa dealer ukon backlogs sang mga plaka sa LTO.
english: He also said that motorists who do not have official license plates should not be fined for reasons beyond their control, such as problems with the dealer or backlogs of license plates at the LTO.

text: Ginpaathag ni Lacanilao nga bisan pa gin-suspende ang penalidad, kinahanglan gihapon sang awtorisasyon halin sa LTO antes magbiyahe ang salakyan nga wala pa plaka.
english: Lacanilao explained that although the penalty has been suspended, authorization from the LTO is still required before a vehicle without a license plate can travel.

text: Gin-suspende man sang ahensya ang dealer policy nga dapat i-release ang plaka kag OR/CR sa amo man nga adlaw nga gin-turnover ang salakyan ukon motorsiklo.
english: The agency also suspended the dealer policy that the license plate and OR/CR ​​must be released on the same day the vehicle or motorcycle is turned over.

text: Suno sa iya, maayo ang intensyon sang polisa pero indi praktikal, labi na sa mga lugar nga malayo kag indi dayon mahatag ang dokumento.
english: He said the policy is well-intentioned but impractical, especially in remote areas where documents cannot be issued immediately.

text: Sa bahin sang rehiyon, ginpahayag ni Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II sang LTO Region VI nga mabudlay sa ila mag-confiscate sang temporaryo nga plaka tungod wala sang klaro nga awtorisasyon kag ang dokumento yara pa sa iban nga rehiyon.
english: On the part of the region, Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II of LTO Region VI said it is difficult for them to confiscate temporary plates because there is no clear authorization and the document is still in another region.

text: May plano sila nga mag-meeting upod kay Asec.
english: They have plans to hold a meeting with Asec.

text: Lacanilao agod istoryahan ang mga isyu.
english: Lacanilao to discuss the issues.

text: Isa pa sa mga rason sang problema amo ang backlog sa plate number, kag bisan sa mga kabanwahanan, nagagamay ang naga-claim sang plaka.
english: Another reason for the problem is the backlog in plate numbers, and even in the towns, the number of license plate claimants is decreasing.

text: Ginapanawagan sang LTO ang kooperasyon kag pagsunod sang tanan samtang gin-review pa ang mga polisa.
english: The LTO is calling for the cooperation and compliance of all while the policies are still being reviewed.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan sa paghatag ni Mayor Sorongon sang unauthorized mission order sa iya bodyguards agud nga makadala sang armas luthang sang tuig 2016.
english: This is in connection with Mayor Sorongon's issuance of an unauthorized mission order to his bodyguards to carry firearms in 2016.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 2nd district Board Member Liecel Mondejar-Seville, iya ginpahayag nga ang local chief executive ang wala sang kinamatarong nga maghatag sang mission order sa iya bodyguards.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 2nd district Board Member Liecel Mondejar-Seville said the local chief executive has no right to issue mission orders to his bodyguards.

text: Nagapakita lamang ini suno kay Seville nga ginlapas ni Sorongon ang simple misconduct.
english: Seville said this only shows that Sorongon committed a simple misconduct.

text: Bangud sini, nagapati si Seville nga bisan election period, ipatuman gid sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) ang desisyon sang Ombudsman nga 1 month and 1 day suspension without pay batok sa alkalde.
english: Because of this, Seville believes that even during the election period, the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) will implement the Ombudsman's decision of 1 month and 1 day suspension without pay against the mayor.

text: Ini bangud nga suno kay Seville, isa ini ka paglapas sa Graft and Corrupt Practices Act ang ginhimo sang iya hugot nga kasumpong nga si Sorongon.
english: This is because, according to Seville, it is a violation of the Graft and Corrupt Practices Act committed by his strong opponent Sorongon.

text: Labi pa nga ginakalangkagan ang Paris Olympics matapos ginsapubliko sang organizers nga espesyal ang mga medalya nga batunon sang mga tagdaog subong nga tuig!
english: The Paris Olympics are even more anticipated after the organizers announced that the medals that this year's winners will receive are special!

text: Suno sa organizers, ang tanan nga 5,084 ka mga medalya sa Paris Games ang maga-feature sang metal medallion nga iga-set kaangay sang gemstone kag iga-desinyo sang elite French jewelry house nga Chaumet.
english: Organizers say all 5,084 medals at the Paris Games will feature a metal medallion that will be set like a gemstone and designed by elite French jewelry house Chaumet.

text: Tanan man ini nga medalya ang butangan sang hexagon-shaped nga gamay nga iron nga halin mismo sa original nga Eiffel Tower nga natukod sang 1889 kag popular indi lamang sa Paris, France kundi sa bilog nga kalibutan!
english: All of these medals will also feature a hexagon-shaped piece of iron from the original Eiffel Tower that was built in 1889 and is popular not only in Paris, France but all over the world!

text: Tuman ini ka espesyal nga kombinasyon para sa organizers — gold, silver, kag bronze —  nga butangan pa sang halin mismo sa Eiffel Tower nga amo naman ang ginakabig pinakamalahalon nga metal nga amo nga pungsod.
english: It's a very special combination for the organizers — gold, silver, and bronze — to be topped with something from the Eiffel Tower itself, which is considered the most expensive metal in the country.

text: Nahibaluan nga tuman gid ka partikular ang mga tagpalasakop sa desinyo sang medal, logo, mascots, kag sa opening ceremony sa kada ginahiwat ang Olympiada.
english: It is known that the participants are very particular about the design of medals, logos, mascots, and the opening ceremony every time the Olympiad is held.

text: Ang tanan nga metal nga gingamit sa Paris medals nga nagabug-at sang halos tunga sa kilo ang gin-recycle lamang.
english: All the metal used in the Paris medals weighing almost half a kilo was simply recycled.

text: Kaangay man ini sa gingamit sa Tokyo Olympics kun sa diin ginpangtipon sang Japanese organizers ang recycled metal nga halin pa sa consumer electronics kaangay sang mobile phones kag laptops.
english: It is similar to the one used in the Tokyo Olympics where Japanese organizers collected recycled metal from consumer electronics such as mobile phones and laptops.

text:
Balantayan ang Paris Olympics sa Hulyo 26 tubtub sa Agusto 11 samtang ang Paralympics naman ang naka-schedule sa Agusto 28 tubtub sa Septyembre 8.#

(via Olympics.com)
english:
The Paris Olympics are scheduled for July 26 to August 11 while the Paralympics are scheduled for August 28 to September 8.

(via Olympics.com)

text: Ginapadasig na ang pagpadala sang United Nations sang halos $6 million ukon P354 million agud buligan ang masobra 400,000 ka mga Pilipino nga yara sa katalagman tuga sang bagyo Uwan.
english: The United Nations is accelerating the sending of nearly $6 million or P354 million to help more than 400,000 Filipinos affected by Typhoon Uwan.

text: Ginhimo ini sa idalom sang anticipatory action framework sang UN, duha ka minuto matapos masabat ang mga kondisyon.
english: This was done under the UN’s anticipatory action framework, two minutes after the conditions were met.

text: Paga-gamiton ang pondo sang Lima ka UN agencies agud magdul-ong sang pagkaon, serbisyo medikal, proteksyon, kag tubig.
english: Funds from five UN agencies will be used to deliver food, medical services, protection, and water.

text: Suno sa UN body, tinutuyo sini nga mabuhinan ang halit sang bagyo sa tunga sang aktibo nga panahon sang kalamidad sa pungsod.
english: According to the UN body, the aim is to reduce the damage of the typhoon amid the active disaster period in the country.

text: Ginalauman nga madugangan pa ang reported nga halit bangud tubtob subong wala pa nag-untat ang mga pagbaha sa low lying areas.
english: The reported damage is expected to increase as flooding in low lying areas has not stopped so far.

text: Antes sini, nahalitan man ang pila ka mga lugar sa pungsod bangud sa bagyo Tino.
english: Earlier, several areas in the country were also damaged by Typhoon Tino.

text: ILOILO CITY–Ginpanindugan sang  Iloilo Police  Provincial Office (IPPO)  nga wala sang political color ang pagserbe sang search warrant kay Calinog, Iloilo Mayoralty candidate kag incumbent Sangguniang Bayan (SB) member  Francisco “Iko” Calvo.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) insisted that the serving of the search warrant against Calinog, Iloilo Mayoralty candidate and incumbent Sangguniang Bayan (SB) member Francisco “Iko” Calvo has no political color.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay IPPO Director S/Supt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, IPPO Director S/Supt.

text: Marlon Tayaba, ginpahayag sini nga indi nila kilala si  Calvo, kag wala sang sila sang kaangtanan sa kun sin-o man nga pulitiko sa banwa sang Calinog.
english: Marlon Tayaba, said they do not know Calvo, and they have no relationship with any politician in Calinog town.

text: Gin-athag man ni Tayaba nga ginahimo lang nila ang ila trabaho bilang mga law enforcers kag mapasiguro nga malinong ang probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Tayaba also explained that they are only doing their job as law enforcers and ensuring peace in Iloilo province.

text: Suno kay Tayaba,  ang pagserbe nila sang search warrant ang santo man sa mga anonynmous text kag sulat nga ginpalab-ot sa ila talatapan sang mga tawo sa banwa sang Calinog sa ginapahayag indescriminate firing ni Calvo, lakip na nga kun kaisa makit-an ini nga nagataklos sang pusil sa ila banwa.
english: Tayaba said they served the search warrant based on anonymous texts and letters sent to their office by people in Calinog town on Calvo's alleged indiscriminate firing, including that he was sometimes seen carrying a gun in their town.

text: Suno kay Tayaba nga nagpatigayun sila sang monitoring kag validation sang impormasyon kag ila ini napamatud-an nga may yara sang insidente sang pagpalupok sang armas.
english: Tayaba said they conducted monitoring and validation of information and they confirmed that there was an incident of firing.

text: Ang nasambit nga mga impormasyon ang rason nga nag-apply sang search warrant sa caliber 9mm, m16 armalite rifle kag .45 caliber pistol apang wala narecober ang 9mm sa baylo natigayun nga nakuha ang mga bala kag empty shells sang nasambit nga armas lakip na ang .25 caliber pistol kag .22 long barrel.
english: The information led to the application of a search warrant for the caliber 9mm, m16 armalite rifle and .45 caliber pistol but the 9mm was not recovered instead the bullets and empty shells of the said weapon including the .25 caliber pistol and .22 long barrel were recovered.

text: Hingyu-on naman nila suno kay Tayaba ang kanselasyon sang Licence to Own and Possess Firearms (LTOPF) ni  Calvo.//
english: Tayaba said they will seek the cancellation of Calvo's License to Own and Possess Firearms (LTOPF).//

text: Isa ka bulan nga indi makahampang ang reigning Most Valuable Player (MVP) sa National Basketball Association (NBA) nga si Joel Embiid bangud sa pagpaidalom sini sa surgery sa tuhod.
english: Reigning Most Valuable Player (MVP) in the National Basketball Association (NBA) Joel Embiid will be out for a month due to knee surgery.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini sang iya team nga Philadelphia 76ers apang wala sang partikular nga petsa nga ginhatag kun san-o ini makabalik sa court.
english: He was announced by his team, the Philadelphia 76ers, but no specific date was given for when he would be able to return to the court.

text: Si Embiid, 29, amo subong ang leading scorer sa liga nga may 35.3 points per game kag may average man nga 11.3 rebounds kag 5.7 assists.
english: Embiid, 29, is currently the league’s leading scorer with 35.3 points per game and also averages 11.3 rebounds and 5.7 assists.

text: Sang nagligad lamang nga Enero 22, naghimo man ini sang rekord sang nakabubo ini sang 70 puntos kag 18 rebounds sa hampang sang 76ers batok sa San Antonio.
english: Just last Jan. 22, he also set a record when he poured in 70 points and 18 rebounds in the 76ers' game against San Antonio.

text: Martes naman sang nagsuprer ini sang injury kadungan man man sang kalutusan sang team sa kamot sang Golden State Warriors.
english: On Tuesday, he suffered an injury during the team's defeat at the hands of the Golden State Warriors.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala nakapakita si Embiid sa 15 na ka mga hampang subong nga season kag ginalantaw nga factor nga indi na sini makuha ang ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga MVP award.
english: Embiid has missed 15 games this season and is expected to be a factor in his second consecutive MVP award.

text: Sa idalom sang pagsulundan ang NBA, kinahanglan nga makahampang ang player sa 65 regular season games agud nga mangin eligible ini sa individual awards.
english: Under NBA rules, a player must play in 65 regular season games to be eligible for individual awards.

text:
Sa Eastern Conference, 30-18 ang rekord subong sang 76ers kag nagapang-lima sa puwesto.#



(Thearon W. Henderson/Getty Images)
english:
In the Eastern Conference, the 76ers currently have a 30-18 record and are in fifth place.



(Thearon W. Henderson/Getty Images)

text: Ginpamatud-an ni Pauline Amelinckx sang Bohol nga sa ikatatlo sini nga pagsabak sa Miss Universe Philippines stage, handa siya nga makuha ang korona.
english: Pauline Amelinckx of Bohol proved that in her third appearance on the Miss Universe Philippines stage, she is ready to win the crown.

text: Sa preliminaries sang national pageant sa Parañaque City subong nga Myerkules, 10 gid ka special awards ang naangkon sang 26-anyos nga Belgian-Filipina beauty queen.
english: In the preliminaries of the national pageant in Parañaque City this Wednesday, the 26-year-old Belgian-Filipina beauty queen won 10 special awards.

text: Lakip sa sini nga sponsor awards amo ang Miss Creamsilk Ultimate, Miss Soen, Miss Kemans Body, Miss Origee Beauty Drink by Skin Magical, Miss Hello Glow, Miss Jojo Bragais, Miss Titan Universe, Miss Enderun, Miss Smilee Apparel, kag Miss Avana.
english: Among these sponsor awards are Miss Creamsilk Ultimate, Miss Soen, Miss Kemans Body, Miss Origee Beauty Drink by Skin Magical, Miss Hello Glow, Miss Jojo Bragais, Miss Titan Universe, Miss Enderun, Miss Smilee Apparel, and Miss Avana.

text: Antes sini nga special awards, isa na ang Boholana beauty sa ginakilala nga frontrunner sa pageant subong nga tuig.
english: Before this special awards, the Boholana beauty was already one of the recognized frontrunners in this year's pageant.

text: Isa man sa mga kandidata nga nag-stand out sa preliminaries amo ang isa pa ka frontrunner nga si Michelle Dee sang Makati City nga nakakuha sang awards nga Miss Pond’s, Miss Aqua Boracay, kag Miss Zion Philippines.
english: Also among the contestants who stood out in the preliminaries was another frontrunner Michelle Dee of Makati City who won the awards Miss Pond’s, Miss Aqua Boracay, and Miss Zion Philippines.

text: Patigayunon ang coronation night sang Miss Universe Philippines sa Sabado, Mayo 13, sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: The coronation night of Miss Universe Philippines will be held on Saturday, May 13, at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Tatlo na ang na-report nga napatay bangud sang paglaslas sang Super Typhoon Uwan.
english: Three people have been reported dead as a result of Super Typhoon Uwan.

text: Suno sa Office of Civil Defense (OCD), ang mga biktima ang naghalin sa Viga sa Catanduanes, Catbalogan City sa Samar, kag isa sa Bicol Region.
english: According to the Office of Civil Defense (OCD), the victims were from Viga in Catanduanes, Catbalogan City in Samar, and one in the Bicol Region.

text: Suno kay OCD Deputy Administrator for Administration Assistant Secretary Bernardo Rafaelito Alejandro IV, naglab-ot na sa 1.4 million ka mga indibidwal ukon masobra 400,000 ka mga pamilya ang gina-evacuate sa mga safe nga lugar sa Metro Manila, Cordillera Administrative Region, Ilocos Region, Cagayan Valley, Central Luzon, Calabarzon, Mimaropa, Negros Island Region, Bicol, Western Visayas, Central Visayas, kag Eastern Visayas.
english: According to OCD Deputy Administrator for Administration Assistant Secretary Bernardo Rafaelito Alejandro IV, 1.4 million individuals or more than 400,000 families are being evacuated to safe places in Metro Manila, Cordillera Administrative Region, Ilocos Region, Cagayan, Central Valley, Lumazon, Lumazon, Valley Negros Island Region, Bicol, Western Visayas, Central Visayas, and Eastern Visayas.
